tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 20 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/sgol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/——

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs spegs ngo nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung so/'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du rma/sa gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi pha' cher ni dpu med bris rnying sha sta ga yin pas/ rma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang thi/sa klog nga/ka' ba'ang zhin tu ma rnga po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yi ga dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yi ga gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying ga 'an pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skru na gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnar/sa dang / lhag nga/ra du krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'dug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa—chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod r+ṣa po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta wo po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhud lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ to dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khra/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'gyung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyu/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs togo 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal nga khrind/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sprungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dag bzhas mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur ga'i/ ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song stsi krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ / dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ pa rtan spo 1 6 3 6 5 byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung / dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos nge dra/sa stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dag 'a dang kru bzang las dus snyen ra gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po u/san/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dpang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lus sa kyi sbyor drug si/ zab khrid mtha' dag sa/san te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma ma nga po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya sa zhung gi man ngag ma rnga ri po dang / kun rma khyen dol bo nga/'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhung tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rā pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' nga/zhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'gyung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen ngo/'i bzhed dgongs ltar nya myo5 sa su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang dra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsu nga gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu ma/bas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos / de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

she rge // / | / / ༵/ / rderde ma / / spre bhi hūṃ tsam sgreng la du stu hūm̐ rnyogs / stu ltu rwardo rdo sgo sproXr gnang tsam dang /zhe/dgung gra rje tsong /ngas kha pa tai rdo drug skozhugs ༵rwa'i btsubs mkhyegazigs| ༵ hūṃ / ༷ / ༵ | / rderderderderderdeX hūṃ ༷/ she / rig ri/ dgung lo so dgu par chos wor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang cha bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku ba ho gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje wo po/ tshe dpag med cas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen da 1 /nga lo zhe lha cig ༵ snro ༵ dzi rjo /snra shi/nga yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/grwa rlo gas kau/kau sna tsug spra/ khang dang dag 'a / grwa / bang rdo ༵rde~X ga sdu ༵ gas ༵ dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdu na dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khom ra 'o sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshe/gas mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/༵lha/ kū/ rjo dho ༵ ra mang ༵ dang ga/lgi ༵ ༵ ༵ da rgas po ri ༵ rjo sna rlo/ shing par du brkos pa ska : bas 4sna sna smo kau~X ༵ je ༵ rjo rjo dzī sna/ lho / ra byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar r+ṣa pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon to mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

de nyid bdun pa'i rnam par bshad pa rin chen snye ma bzhugs/ 1tshigs bcad bcu pa'i 'grel pa zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs/ 68rdo rje theg pa'i gnas lugs gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 95las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 126zab mo sngags kyi dri lan sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhu/gas/ kyi 156rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhu / gas / 6 177zab lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs/ 184thugs rje chen po tshom bu lugs kyi dmar khrid kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ ༷ 202smar khrid tshom bu lugs bzhugs/ 204snying po don gsum gyi khrid bzhugs/ 211bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 217lha so so'i bsnyen pa spyi khyab tu byed tshul bsdus pa/ 230—

byed tshul bzhugs/ 232gtso 'dus brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/ 236rgyud sde lnga'i gtso 'dus kyi mngon rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 238rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma bzhugs/ —244dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga bzhugs/ —248phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces bya ba bzhugs/ —253badz+ra ste ra ba'i spyin sreg bsdus pa bzhugs/ 260drag po'i thab bskyed gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas logs su bkod pa legs par bzhugs/ 262dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ —268dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 290rdo rje gdan bzhi'i yed yig ye shes sgo tsod ces bya ba bzhugs/ 323

snye ma bsdo/gas/oX snyu sti pra dza khyu: ye shes mchog gi 'bras rab stsol ba po/ /de nyid rig pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /nang gi 'od snang mchog gis kun gsal ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma rigs kyi mgon bshud de/ /de gsung dri med rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ khyud kun snang byed zab dang rgya che ba/ /zab don mtha' dag lta ba'i mig gcig ni/ /'gro la sbyin gyis skal ldan deng 'dir long / dbang phyug tsam gyis chog shes cher rlom rnams/ /chos brgyad mtho dma'i lam du rdeg 'chos nas/ /ma sbyangs man ngag mi shes mi sgom par/ /brjod 'dod dbang gi rab brtags g.yang du lhung / /phrag dog 'dzin khris gang ba'i yid mtsho sa /legs bshad gru chen 'jug pa dka' mod kyi/ /pad+ma'i gnyen gyis pad+ma'i mtsho la bzhin/ /skal bzang blo yi pad tshal rgyas byed yin/ /don bral glegs bam ri bo'i lus 'chang bas/ /sngon gyi shing rta che la 'gran pa mthong / /de ltar 'di min sngon chad 'di ma grags/ /nyung gsal go bde'i ngag gis bshad par 'dod/ /de la thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa gcig pu yin la/ de nyid kyang gdul bya rnams kyi skal ba'i rim pas theg pa du mar 'gyur ba yin te/ lang gar gshegs pa las/ lha'i theg dang tshangs pa'i theganyan thos kyi yang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rang rgyal gyi/ /theg pa de —1—

dag ngas bshad do/ /theg pa rnam pa mang bshad pa/ /sems can rnams ni drang ba'i phyir/ /theg pa tha dad ngas bshad do/ /theg pa gcig tu ngas bstan to/ /ji srid sems ni 'jus/ pa'i bar/ /theg pa dag ni thug nga/ med/ /sems ni yongs su gyur nga/ na/ /theg pa med/ cing 'gro ba'ang med/ /ces pa ltar mtha' yas pa'i theg pa de dag kyang mthar gyis bla na med pa'i theg pa la nye bar gzhol ba kho na yin pa'i phyir/ thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa kho nar gyur pa ste la myo gcig dad pa skyes pa tsam gyis kyang / tshe rabs mang por gsags pa'i bsod nams las kyang ches bla lhag tu 'gyur te/ mdo las kyang zla ba re rer mchod spyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin te/ /dam pa'i chos la dad pa yi sa/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes dang / mi ni lo brgyad nags tshal na/ /me la yongs brten gang yin dang / /gang zhig sgom la yud tsam zhig /mchod pa byed pa gang yin pa/ /mchod byed nge/ nyid ches rung gi /lo brgyar spyin sreg byed mi rung / /zhes so/ /de ltar theg gcig theg pa du mar bstan pa de rnams kyi rtse mor gyur pa ni/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa 'di nyid yin la/ theg pa de nyid kyang zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes yin cing / ye shes de'i rang bzhin gsal bar ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi rgya cher 'grel yi ge nyung ngur gyur pa 'di ni dpal dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis/ blo dman rnams la phan pa'i phyir du yi ge'i lam du mtshon par mdzad de/ bstan bcos 'di'i ming ni/ nge/ kho na nyid bdun gyi 'grel pa zhes bya ste/ rgyud sde gang du de kho na nyid ces gsungs pa/—2—

thams cad gsal bar byed cing / slob dpon chen po dza lan+ta ra'i zhal snga nas/de nyid gcig ste bdun gyi ming yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rgya cher 'grel pa'i phyir/ de skad ces btags so/ /rgyud gang la brten pa ni gtso bor 'khor lo bde mchog la brten mod kyi bla med thams cad kyi spyi 'grel du 'gyur la/ 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ spyi don dang / gzhung gi don gnyis las/ dang po la/ de kho na nyid nod par bya ba'i yul/ gang la 'doms pa'i slob ma/ ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul/ gdams bya de kho na nyid dngos te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bla ma dam pa man ngag dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ man ngag med pa'i mkhas smra la/ 'di'i gtam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa lha'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar sman pa mkhas gyur pas/ /nad pa bsgrub med dkon de bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i stobs brnyed nas/ /gdul bya ma yin shin tu dkon/ /zhes sems can gyi khams shas che ba yang yin mod kyi 'on kyang / gang zhig gang la gang dga' ba/ /de yis de de sngar bshad bya/ /nyams par gyur pa dam chos kyi/ /snod ni cis kyang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dngos su gang la bstan pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i rigs sad pa dang / dam tshig dang ldan pa dang / bla ma la gus pas bsnyen bkur ba dang / snying rje dang ldan pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa'i slob ma'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ji skad du kyai rdo rje las/ dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa nas brtsams te/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje brtsams/ /zhes gsu ngas pa ltar/ lam thun mong pas rgyud sbyangs zhing / shes —3—

rab ye shes kyi dbang yan chad rim can du nod zin pa la/ bzhi pa bstan par bya ba yin cing / de yang de nyid dang bdun dang ldan par slob dpon gyi ston dgos pa yin cing / gzhan yang bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim dang 'bras bu 'grub pa'i gnas skabs su phyi rol gyi dus khyad par can la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i dbang gi ye shes la/ de nyid bdun du ngo sprod pa yin no/ /bzhi pa la/ zung 'jug gi ye shes kyi mtshan nyid/ sku bzhi yan lag bdun tshang tshul/gzhi lam 'bras bu'i khyad par ro/ /dang po la/ gzhi'i dus dang / so so skye bo'i lam gyi skabs dang / 'phags lam gyi ye shes kyi mtshan nyid ste gsum las/dang po ni/ dri ma cung zad kyang ma sbyangs pa'i de bzhin nyid gang zhig stong nyid dang rten 'brel ro gcig pa'i sems kyang yin/ rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid kyi snang ba gang zhig zhu bde dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i lha sku snang stong ngo / /de la yang / bskyed rim dang /rgyu'i rdzogs rim dang 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim gyi skabs gsum po la rim pas rab brtags las byung ba dang / bcos min gyi lha'i sku snang stong mi brtan pa dang brtan pa zhes khyad par du sbyar ro/ /gsum pa la/ slob pa dang mi slob pa'i ye shes gnyis te/ dang po la 'phags rgyud kyi ye shes gang zhig zhu bde dang mtshungs ldan du 'byung ba'i lha sku kha sbyor dang / gnyis pa ni/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes mthar thug gang zhig kha sbyor la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim yin tsam gyi/ gzhi lam 'bras bu —4—

gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i 'bras bus ni ma khyab ste/ 'phags pa slob pa rnams dang / ye shes kyi sku dngos su grub pa'i so so skye bo'i lam gyi rdzogs rim bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la/ sku bzhi ji ltar tshang tshul dang / de nyid bdun tshang tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i snang ba las khams gsum kun snang ba yin te/ kun gzhi rnam par shes pa la sa bon bzhag pas rgyu byas shing / las nyon gyi rkyen byas pas snang ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi rang bzhin med pa'i cha ni chos kyi sku yin te/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir/ /bsam yas ye shes yul yin phyir/ /rigs pa'i rjes 'brang ngo bo'i phyir/ /skyob pa rnams kyi chos skur 'dod/ /ces chos thams cad kyi lus sam rang bzhin ni stong pa nyid yin pas na/ stong pa nyid de chos sku'o zhes pa dang mthun pa yin no/ /gnyis snang gi cha ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'khor bar 'khor ba'i cha ni sprul pa'i sku dang / de gnyis stong pa dang ro gcig pa'i zung 'jug gi cha ni bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /gzhan yang 'chi ba'i srid pa ni chos kyi sku dang / bar srid ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / skye srid ni sprul pa'i sku dang / de gsum ka'i 'gyur byas kyi bde ba'i cha ni bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /de ltar yang / mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa las/ sku bzhi rang bzhin dbyer med pas/ /tha dad med pa'i yid kyi'o/ /slar yang byang chub dbyer med pas/ /thabs dang shes rab nyid du 'dod/ /'chi ba nyid ni chos su brjod/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa bar srid —5—

dang / /'gro ba drug gzugs sprul pa dang / /'dod pa'i longs spyod bde chen po/ /sku bzhi yi ni rang bzhin 'di/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ smra ba'i dbang phyug gang dag skye ba sprul sku zhes pa'i tha snyad tshad ldan mi snang ngo zhes pa ni/ sre ba dgu'i gdams ngag mthar thug tu byed pa rnams la sdang sems kyi dbang du gyur pa'i bab chol lo/ /gzhi'i sku bzhi po 'di dag sku gzhi dngos ni ma yin la/gnas gyur dang dag bya dag byed kyi dbang du byas pa ste/ gnyis snang gi cha gnas gyur pa dang / dag bya bar srid kyi bag chags dag pa las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pas na/ de longs skur bzhag pa ste/ gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /lam gyi dus su ji ltar ldan pa'i tshul la/ dbang la sbyar ba dang / skyed pa'i rim pa la sbyar ba dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa la sbyar ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbang bzhi rim bzhin sku bzhi la sbyar ba'ang yin mod kyi/ 'dir dbang bzhi ka'i ye shes la sku bzhi sbyor te/ lha skur snang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa dang /de 'gyung lus dang go sa gcig par snang ba sprul pa dang / rang bzhin med par shes pa chos dang / sems zhu bde'i ngo bor skyes pa ni bde ba chen po'o/ /gnyis pa la/ stong pa'i ngang las skyed pa dang / zhu ba'i thig ler thim pa dang / stong pas rgyas 'debs pa ni chos dang / nad la sogs pa dang / yid ngor lha sku'i gsal snang ni longs spyod dang / mngon byang lngas bskyed pa dang / 'byung lus kyi snang ba dang bsre ba sogs ni sprul pa dang / zhu bde ni bde ba chen po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ spros bral gyi ngo bo la rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshul gyi 'jug pa chos dang /—6—

rang lus dang gzhan lus la brten pa/'i lhan skyes gnyis bskyed nga/ ni bde ba chen po dang / de dang gcig tu sres nga/'i ye she/sa kyi sku ni longs spyong/ rdzogs pa dang / de nyid rags pa'i lus rten la 'jug pas/ de dag par byed pa ni sprul pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid mngon du gyur pa ni/ chos dang stong pa nyid mngon du gyur pa na/ chos dang stong pa de rtogs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba'i ye shes rang bzhin lhan skyes mthar thug pa ni bde ba chen po dang / ye shes de nyid kyi snang ba'i cha dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi kham sa sogs mkhyen pa'i ye shes dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang mtshungs par ldan pa ni sprul rnga/'o/ /de ltar sku bzhi po de ni ngo bo gcig cing / sangs rgyas rang snang kho na las gzhan gzugs kyi sku ni 'dir dngos su mi bsdud de/ de dag ni smon lam gyi stobs 'a/sa gdul bya la snang ba tsam yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rang snang la kha sbyor sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyi dag pa'i dkyil 'khor mi snang ste/ de dag ni kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni spros bral kho na gzigs pa'o/ /zhes smra ba ni/in+d+ra bhu ti'i zhal snga nas ye shes grub par/ sngar yod pa ni thams cad zhigasngar med pa ni 'dir med pas/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'di 'dra na/ de las gzhan dag don med do/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang / gal te ye shes snang med yin na ni/ /gnyid log 'dra bar bsgrub bya nyid du 'gyur/ /gang yang dbang po rnams ni 'gog pa dang / /ye shes bye brag smra ba'i lugs yin no/ /zhes de nyid —7—

mkhyen pa rnams kyis bkag go /gal te longs sprul gnyis gzugs kyi sku yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ de skad du gser 'od dam pa las/ sku gsum gyi le'ur/de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings la rnam par rtog pa thams cad mi skye ba'i phyir/rnam par dag pa zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag pa'i sku ni med pa ma yin no/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu chos kyi sku ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnam par dag pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang bar 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pas sprul pa'i skur snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ye shes kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pas chos kyi skur snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na nam mkha' la brten nas glog 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /glog la brten nas 'od snang ngo / /de bzhin du chos kyi sku la brten nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku snang bar 'gyur ro/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la rten nas sprul pa'i skur snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rang bzhon rnam par dag pa'i phyir chos kyi sku snang ngo // /ye shes rnam par dag pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku snang ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pas sprul pa'i sku snang ngo / /de gsum rnam par dag pa ni/ chos kyi de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / rnam par grol ba'i de bzhin nyid dang / mthas klas pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku ni tha mi dad do/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang de bzhin gshegs pa ni bdag gi ston pa chen po'o zhes smra zhing mos pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gnyis su med par bsam pa thag pas shes pa yin no zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag pa'i sku zhes bya ba'i sku gsum ka —8—

yin la/ med pa zhes pa ni don dam par med pa ste kun rdzob yin la/ 'dir de rnams de ma yin par bstan cing / gzugs kyi sku ni kun rdzob yin no/ /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni khams gsum gyi nyon mongs thams cad yin mod kyi/'dir gtso bor bdag tu 'dzin pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i yid do/ /las kyi sgrib pa ni/ zag bcas kyi las thams cad do/ /ye shes kyi sgrib pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa'o/ /de rnams dag pa'i ldog cha nas so sor rtags pa yin gyi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas chos kyi sku gcig pu yin pas chos kyi sku ni zhes thog mar smos so/ /snang ngo zhes pa ni sangs rgyas rang snang la snang ba yin te/ gdul bya gzhan snang la chos sku snang ba med cing med par thams cad mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /glog gi dpe don sbyar ba ni/ rang bzhin rnam dag mngon du gyur pa'i cha chos kyi sku yin cing / de glo bur rnam dag mthar thug pas khyad par du byas pa na/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa chos thams cad la rjes su 'jug cing / phyin ci log gi snang ba gtan nas spang sa pa'i dag pa rab 'byams su snang ba'i ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'byung zhing / ye shes de'i mthus 'gro ba'i don byed pas de'i nus pa'i cha ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ de'i phyir de de las byung ba yin cing /de gnyis kyang gzhan don gyi sku yin no/ /phyi ma gnyis chos sku dang ngo bo gcig yin na don dam pa'i skur 'gyur ro zhe na/ rang gi ngo bos ni 'dod cing / ldog pa'i cha nas ni chos kyi skur mi 'jog pas skyon med la/ 'on kyang ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i dbye bas dang po gnyis don dam gyi sku dang phyi ma kun rdzob kyi skur ni 'jog la/ de brda'i skur ni ma yin no/ /de ltar na yang rgyud bla ma las/—9—

rang don gzha don don dam sku dang ri// /de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /yon tan dbye ba drug cu bzhi 'di dag /ces kun rdzob kyi sku gzugs kyi skur bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na yin mod kyi/ kun rdzob kyi sku la gzugs skus khyab par ma bshad pas 'gal ba ma yin no/ /de gsum rnam par dag pa zhes pa ni de'i sku gsum ste/ chos rnams stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir de bzhin nyid dang /don gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir g.yin ma yin pa dang / mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pas na ro gcig pa dang / spang bya las rnam par grol ba dang / mthas klas pa'i dngos po thams cad la nye ring med pa rnam gsum ka la tshang ba'i phyir sku gsum po thams cad tha mi dad do/ /de ltar sku gsum gnyis su med par shes pa na ston pa 'di nyid gzhan pas kyang ches chen po'o zhes mos zhing dang bar 'gyur zhes pa ni rigs kyi bu'am zhes sogs kyi bstan no/ /longs sprul rjes su mthun pa'am btags pa ba gzugs kyi sku gnyis ji ltar 'byung zhe na/sngar bshad pa'i sku gnyis po de dag med par ni gdul bya'i sems dag kyang mi 'byung la/ 'on kyang gdul bya'i sems rgyud kyi bsdus pa ni yin cing gdul bya'i sems dag pa dang / ye shes de gnyis/ sngon gyi smon lam dang rkyen nye bar phrad pa las snang ba yin no/ /de'i phyir sems dag pa ni nyer len dang / gnyis ni lhan cig byed pa'o/ /gzugs kyi sku sangs rgyas su 'dod pa mdzangs pa ma yin pa'i gtam rgya chen po dag ni 'di ltar rtag par bya ste/ lung 'gal phyir dang lus med dang / /don smras don dam min 'dod cing / /rig pas gnod phyir —10—

theg chen la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rigs ma yin/ /ci 'di bem po'am yang na shes/ /gnyis 'dus na ni btags yod tsam/ /bem po'i rgyal ba ngo mtshar rmad/ khres na so so skye sogs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes mthong 'gyur zhing / /mig shes yul na gzugs nyid dam/ /rnam pa de phyir byas sogs rgyud/ /rgyal dang sems can rgyud gcig 'gyur/ /de ltas kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /sangs rgyas gnyis su thal min nam/ /gcig na chos kyi skur 'gyur ro/ /lha mig gcig pus kun shes so/ /sangs rgyas gcig nyid lung du gsungs/ /rgyal yong gzugs med yod med gnyis/ /'gal ba mi zad smra de blun/ /gzugs sku skyes bur 'dod pa ni/ /gzhung lugs ma klags blo rtsing pa/ /skyes bur dbang po sogs 'dod nga// /theg chen 'di la gdon chen po/ /sems can kyang de ma yin na/ /blun po'i spyod pa mu med do/ /ye shes mi ldan par 'gyur na/ /gdong las me long gzugs 'byung yang / /de min de la gdong ci yod/ /de ltar 'di la de med do/ /ngan sems khrag phyung ci zhe na/ /rgyal la dmigs shing las rdzogs pas/ /gnod de khams gsum sems tsam yang / /dge dang sdig pas 'gro gnyis bgrod/ /de lta bas na re zhig 'dir/ /yang na phyi rol don du smros/ /rang bzo theg pa wo por min/ /de yang / de bzhi gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug nga 'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi sku ste de ni ma skyes pa/ mi 'byung ba/ mi 'gags pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal por yang / nam mkha' 'dra zhing rdul bral gzugs 'chang ba/ khres rab sras po lus dang mtshan —11—

mi mnga'/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rab zab thugs rje can/ /mtshungs med phyag ni bdag gi spyi bor bzhag /ces/ sangs rgyas la rdul las grub pa dang / lus kyi skye mched med par bshad pa dang / gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa ste/ /skye bo de dag nga mi mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /zhes dang / bstan bcos las kyang /mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te/ ji ltar be+e khur sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zhes gdul bya'i sems kyi snang bar gsal bar bshad cing / de dag la sogs pa 'khor lo bar pa dang tha ma'i mdo sde'i lung 'byams klas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur la/ de dag dgongs pa can no zhe na de ltar ston pa'i lung med cing / der ma zad gzugs kyi sku sangs rgyas dngos yin par ston pa tsam gyi lung yang bstan bcos rnam par dag pa las kyang ma mthong na/ zhal nas gsungs pa lta ci zhig sngags kyi theg pa 'dir yang / khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /sha dang rus pa khrag med pas/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad/ /ces dang / dag pa'i sems ni bzung gyur na/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rnam sgom pas/ /brtan lus khong stong ma yin pa/ /rdo rje'i sku ni nges thob 'gyur/ /zhes rgyun chad pa med pa dang khong stong ma yin pa dang sha khrag sogs kyi rnam pa rdo rje'i sku la gtan mi mnga' bar gsungs la/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams la ni/ de dag mnga' ste mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sku snyun po dang / sku mtshal dbyung bar —12—

bstan pa bzhin no/ /de lta na yang nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas rang snang gi rdo rje'i sku'o snyam na/ de yang spyir rgyun mi 'chad par ni bzhag tu rung mod kyi gdul bya gcig la bltos nas ni rgyun mi 'chad pa ma yin te/ bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang gi phyi rol gyi ston pa nges pa lnga ldan gyi snang ba 'gag pa yin cing / gzhan yang sku de sa/nyis la skabs 'dir rnam par dbye bar mi 'thad do/ /gal te bla na med pa'i byang chub thob nas kyang sngar gyi longs sku'i rnam pa de nyid rgyun mi 'chad par snang na longs sku gnyis su thal bar 'gyur zhing / med kyang snang ba dang / yod kyang mi snang ba ni rgyal ba la yod par khyed cag kyang mi 'dor grang / gzhan yang sngar yod pa las phyis med par gyur na rgyun chad par 'gyur ba dang / sngon nyid nas kyang med pa gsal snang yin na ni sangs rgyas su ci ltar 'gyur/ 'on te khong stong ma yin pa sogs kyi lung / don la med pa yin gyi tshul ston pa mi 'gal te/ 'phags pa lhas/ ji ltar phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang po/ /de'i sku la rkang rus sha med kyang / /semasacan phan phyir ring srel 'jog par mdzad/ /sprul pa'i sku yi bya ba mdzad pa ltar/ /zhes pa ltar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la de ltar mi mnga' yang / sprul pa'i sku la snang ba ni sprul pa yin no zhe na/ de ltar sprul pa yin pa nyid kyi skyes bu ma yin par grub bo/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas ci ltar yin/ sprul pa'i skyes bu zhes bshad pa ma yin nam/ de lta na ni skyu ma'i skyes bu yang / bshad pas sgyu ma yang skyes bur thal bar gyur ro/ /don smra ba rnams kyang / gzugs kyi sku ni sangs —13—

rgyas dngos su mi 'dod cing / nor bu dang za ma tog gi dpes ye shes chos kyi sku kho na sangs rgyas dngos su 'dod na khyed cag ni de bas kyang dman pa zhigagazhan yang ci gzugs kyi sku ni bem po'am shes pa'am de dag gi khyad par la gdags/ gsum pa ltar/ gnyis tshogs pa'i cha tsam mam gnyis ka ma yin na ni/ btags yod tsam du thal ba dang / dngos med ni gdul bya la snang ba dang 'gro ba'i don byed par mi rung ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i blos rnam par brtags pa'i chos gcig sangs rgyas su khas blangs pas shin tu tha chad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ltar na yang / bem po dang sangs rgyas kyi gzhi mthun pa khas blangs pas 'gal ba la ma 'khrul ba'i tshad ma ya mtshan che ste/ bem po dang shes pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /dang po ltar na sems can gyi rgyud du gtogs sam sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du gtogs/ dang po ltar na ni sems can dang sangs rgyas rgyud gcig par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas de yang kun rdzob slu ba'i chos can du thal ba dang / sgrib pa dang bcas par thal ba'am/ yang na sems can de nyid sangs rgyas yin par thal ba dang / chos kyi sku rgyud ldan yin par yang thal bar 'gyur te/ gzugs sku'i rgyud la chos sku yod par khyed nyid 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te gnyis pa ltar na yang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sems can gyis mthong bar thal zhing / mtshan dang dpe byad sogs mig shes kyi mthong na ni/gzugs sam gzugs kyi rnam pa gang du 'dod/ dang po ltar na ni skyon sngar bstan zin la/ phyi ma ltar na ni sems can gyi rgyud du khas blangs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas ni gnyis med kyi ye shes yin cing / de yod par —14—

'dod la gzugs sogs kun rdzob ni med par 'dod pas/ yod med gnyis don gcig la 'dus par 'dod pas shin tu nongs pa dang / sku gnyis ngo bo tha dad pa sangs rgyas su khas blangs pas gang zag gcig rnam par grol ba la yang sangs rgyas ngo bo tha dad pa du ma 'byung bar thal zhing / lung las ni gang zag du ma yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshe gcig tu gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha'i spyan gcig pos shes bya thams cad mkhyen par gsungs pa sogs ye shes ngo bo gnyis pa med par gsungs pa dang / bstan bcos las kyang / sangs rgyas nyid du zhugs na de dag kun/ /rten kyang gcig cing rtogs pa che la gcig /zhes sogs rnam pa mang po dag dang 'gal ches so/ /gzhan yang gzugs kyi sku ni smon la ma gyi sprul pa yin gyi 'byung po rnams kyis gzugs yongs su bsgyur ba lta bu ma yin pas skyes bur mi 'gyur zhing / de'i phyir rnam mkhyen rgyud mi ldan thal bar 'phen pa ni kho bo cag 'dod par byed de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni sangs rgyas rang snang gi sku gnyis kho na la bdag nyid gcig pa'i tshul gyi ldan te/ phrag khur thogs pa'i tshul gyis ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang skyes pa'i ngo bo dbang po drug la sogs par 'dod pa ni/ theg pa chen po 'di la mi bzad pa'i gdon yin te/ 'dis ni dbang po rnams yang srid pa'i len par byed ces log pa'i chos bstan pa la bsre bar byed pa'i snyad do/ /de bas na sems can kyang kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa la bzhag dgos pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi skyes bu gzugs kyi skur 'dod pa ni ga la zhig chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi sku 'byung ba ni yin mod kyi/ gdong las me —15—

long gi gzugs brnyan 'byung yang gzugs brnyan gdong ma yin zhing de'i rgyud la de med do/ /de sangs rgyas ma yin na de la ngan sems kyi khrag byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyi mtshal phyung bar ci'i phyir 'gyur/ de ni 'jig rten la grags pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa la lta zhog phyir mi ldog pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la yang bdud kyi tshogs thams cad kyis lta bar yang mi nus na de bzhin gshegs pa la su zhig gi sku mtshal 'byin te/ ri bong gis rwas bsnun na mtshams med par 'gyur zhes bya bar mi 'gyur ram/ de bas na gzugs kyi sku de yang 'jig rten la de bzhin gshegs par grags so/ /mtshams med par ni 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas la dmigs shing las de nyid zin pa'i phyir der 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen ma tshang ba med do/ /dper na khams gsum po thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba yin kyang / de dag la dmigs nas las byas pas 'bras bu myong bar 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /gzugs kyi sku rgyal pa'i rgyud du gtogs shing phyi rol gyi don du smra na ni/ drang don gyi mdo rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs la don smra pa rnams kyi lugs rten cig rang bzo'i sde snod brtsams par mi bya'o/ /'o na/ 'jig rten dag dang dkyil 'khor du/ /snang la lha dang mi rnams kyi/ /rnam pa kun tu mi mthong ngo / /zhes sku gnyis gzugs kyi skur bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ 'di'i sku gnyis la snang tshul dang gnas tshul gyi sku so sor 'byed pa sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyi lugs ni legs pa yin te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rkyen sangs rgyas las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sku la yang sangs rgyas kyi sku zhes pa btags ming ni —16—

'jug la/ des na sangs rgyas dang 'brel ba'i sku thams cad sku gsum du bsdus pa'i tshe gzugs sku gnyis kyang longs sprul gnyis su bsdu ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ye shes dang sprul pa'i ye shes gnyis las de dag byung ba'i phyir/ thun mong min pa'i rgyu'i phyir/ de'i tha snyad dbang ngo/sa byas/ /zhes pa ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'i sgo nas longs sprul gyi skur ming 'dogs pa yin la/dngos btags ma phye ba'i tshe na de dang de yin no/ /shin tu spros pas chog go /'on kyang lam 'di la longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i skur bsre ba'i man ngag rnams ni gcig la yang / snang tshul dang gnas tshul gyi sku gnyis ka dang mthun dgos te/ 'di'i gnad zhib tu shes dgos pa zhig yod do/ /gnyis pa yan lag bdun tshang tshul la/ dbang bzhi so so la sbyar ba/ bskyed rim la sbyar ba/ gnas skabs kyi rdzogs rim la sbyar ba/ mthar thug gi rdzogs rim la sbyar ba/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la sbyar ba ste/ 'di dag rnams ni rgya cher gzhan du bri bar bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum las/ gzhi'i de nyid bdun ni/sems nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni zab pa/ snang ba thams cad du khyab pa'i phyir rgya che ba/ nye ring med pa'i phyir khyab pa/ rgyun mi 'chad cing rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rtag pa/ / gsal ba'i 'char sgo ma 'gags pa lus su snang ba'i phyir ye shes kyi sku/ snang stong dbyer med pa'i phyir/ zung 'jugayul yul can ro gcig tu ye nas 'dres pa'i phyir bde ba chen po'o/ /lam ni/gzhi la de ltar gnas pa de nyid mngon du 'gyur pa'i phyir gzhi 'bras gnyis ka —17—

dang rnam pa mthun par sgom pa yin no/ /de yang rang bzhin med par sgom pa ni zab pa dang / de nyid dngos po thams cad du 'char yang rang rig pa'i bdag nyid du 'char ba la bslab pa ni rgya che ba dang / de nyid dngos po thams cad la khyab par byed pa ni khyab pa dang / sems kyi rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa la/slob pa ni rtag pa dang / lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'char ba la/ slab pa ni ye shes kyi sku dang / lha sku'i snang ba dang bde stong ro gcig tu bsre ba ni zung 'jug dang /zhu bde la brten nas rang bzhin lhan skyes mtsho ni par byed pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste/ 'di rnams la dbang dang bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i dbye bas so sor sgom tshul rgyas par sbyor dgos mod kyi tshegs chung ba'i phyir dang yi ge mangs kyi dogs so/ /gsum pa 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la sbyar ba ni/ji lta ba'i gnas lugs spros bral mkhyen pa'i phyir zab pa/ ji snyed pa rten cing 'brel 'byung thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni rgya che ba/ gnas tshul gyi sku gsum po nam mkha'i mthas gshugs pa la nye ring med cing / gzugs sku gnyis kyang mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten du mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya la nam zhig dus la bab pa na de nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ba sogs dngos po thams cad la gcig car khyab pa ltar gnas pas na khyab pa'am gar yang phyin pa zhes bya'o/ /sku gsum po la 'jig pa med cing ngo bo nam du yang 'gyur ba med pa ni rtag pa/ rang snang dang de'i rkyen gyis gzhan la'ang kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan du snang ba ni ye shes kyi sku yin la/ gdul bya rnams la sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs su snang ba yang 'di'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa ni zung 'jug—18—

rang bzhin lhan skyes mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rten brten pa dbyer med du gyur pa ni bde ba'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ bshad pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba dang / bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ mchod par brjod pa dang / brtsom par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po ni slob dpon dang 'gro ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas dbyer med pa la btud ces pa'o/ /de ltar phyag 'tshal nas ci zhig bgyid na/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde rnams nas de kho na nyid ces gsungs pa de rnams rab tu gsal bar bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ de kho na nyid kyi bsngags pa dang / rgyud las de kho na nyid gsungs pa'i rnam grangs dang / skabs don de nyid bdun rgyas par bshad pa dang / zhar byungs dang lam gyi rnam par ba 'ag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thub pa chen po'i chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po rnams thams cad thos kyang /de dag gi de kho na nyid gang gis mi shes pa de'i thos pa de thams cad 'bras bu med pa nyid yin te/ de rnams kyi rnam par grol ba'i lam mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang / mdo las/ ji tsam mang du smra byed pa/ /de dag dam chos 'dzin pa min/ /gang dag 'di na thos nyung yang / /lus kyi chos dag mngon sum byas/ /rim lnga las kyang / bdag la byin gyis brlab pa'i rim/ /gang gis brnyed par ma gyur pa/ /mdo sde rgyud dang rtog pa la/ /de yis ngal ba don med yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de la gzhung tshigs bcad gcig po 'di ni/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa'i rgyud las 'gyung ba yin no/ /de bas na de kho na nyid ni rgyud —19—

thams cad kyi don gyi bcud/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la 'grub pa'i thabs bla na med pa yin pas bcud len dam pa dang mtshungs te/ de'i phyir tshig rgya chen po'i mdo rgyud dag las snying po'i don de kho na nyid yang dag par len 'os pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ de kho na nyid gcig pur bshad pa/ de nyid gnyis su bstan pa/ bzhir bstan pa/ bcu bzhir bsha/da pa/ bdun du bsha/da pa/ rnam grangs thor bu pa gzhan bshad pa/ de nyid bcu gnyis su bstan pa rnams la/dang po ni/ de kho na nyid gcig pur bshad pa'i de kho na nyid ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ rang gis rig pa'i mtshan nyid can ni stong pa nyid de/ de ltar yang / sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam spyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar/ /rtog pa'i cho ga thams cad la/ /grub pa dam pa mchog gi mchog /ces sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dgongs pa ste/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba thams cad dang /lam sgom pa thams cad la 'di yod na grub pa kun gyi mchog gi yang mchog tu 'gyur zhes pa ste/ rgyud gzhan rnams su yang 'di'i don shin tu mang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ de kho na nyid ces gsungs pa 'ga' zhig rim pa gnyis la brjod par bya ste/ de nyid thob pa shin tu sbed ces gsungs pa lta bu ste/ 'di ni de nyid ces gsungs pa'i don gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de nyid ces gsungs pa gzhan kha cig ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang / lha'i de nyid dang / sngags kyi de nyid dang / ye shes kyi de nyid de bzhi po la yang rab tu brjod pa yod do/ /'di ni —20—

'khor lo bde mchog gi le'u gsum pa'i don te/ /kye rdo rjer 'di dang cung zad mi 'dra bar bshad la/ bya ba'i rgyud du'ang ming phyogs 'dra bar bshad mod kyi don khyad che'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig par/de nyid bcu bzhi bshad pa las/ de dag nang rdzogs rim la sbyar na 'di ltar yin te/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i lus ni gnas kyi de nyid dang / lha'i cha lugs su 'jug pa spros bcas kyi spyod pa la sogs pa spyod pa gsum ni phyag rgya lnga'i de nyid dang / phyag rgya gsum gyi bha gas bde chen 'dren pa ni shes rab yan lag gi de nyid dang / byang chub kyi sems khu ba steng du bcings pa'i sbyor ba ni de bzhin du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i de nyid dang / g.yon dang srog zla ba'i rlung dang /g.yas dang thur sel nyi ma'i rlung dbu mar dgag pa ā li kā li'i de nyid dang /bdag gnyis med pa'i don gyi/ stong pa nyid sgom pa ni stong pa'i de nyid dang /rdzogs rim pa'i ye shes kyi sku rlung sems tsam gyi snang ba las grub pa'i sgyu ma'i sku ni sga (sgra ka tshul gyi de nyid dang / de dag 'od gsal bar 'jug pa ni bsdus pa'i rnal 'byor gyi de nyid dang / byang chub kyi sems zhu ba lus kyi gnas rnams su phyin pa dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi khu ba'i bde ba ni bdud rtsi tshim byed kyi de nyid de/ 'dir lus bde ba zhes gsungs pas nges par zhu bde'o/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' las longs spyod rdzogs pa rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ni/ myang 'das kyi de nyid de/ 'di gcig pu 'bras bu'i skabs la sbyar zhing / de yang rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas spangs pas/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gtan nas log pa'i —21—

phyir 'khor bar mi gnas/ 'khor ba'i mtha'i bar du sku gsum rgyun chad med pas 'gro ba'i don spyod pas zhi ba la mi gnas pa yin la/ de gnyis yang dag pa'i mtha' dang rdo rje'i lus thob pas 'grub pa yin no/ /rtsa 'khor lo rnams kyi lte bar gnas pa'i khams rnams kyi dwangs ma ni rang gi thig le ste/ de phyag rgya'i mchog phyag rgya chen po dang sbyar ba'i phyag rgya bzhi po gang rung gis las rlung 'gags pa'i stobs kyi rang gnas su bcings pa lag mchod kyi de nyid dang /nye rgyu spyod pa'i gnas skabs gsum du rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba thob pas lhan cig skyes pa'i mchog rim pa gsum gnas skabs gsum gang yang rung bar mngon du byed pa ni dbang bskur ba'i de nyid dang / mi phyed ma la sogs pa rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhir rgyu ba'i rlud rnams 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang / dbang du byed pa'i rim pas dbu mar thim pa ni go cha chen po de nyid dang / der ma zad de bzhin du rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / de la sogs pa'i stobs kyi rlung gnas pa dang / stong pa nyid la thim pa rnams kun rdzob rdzogs rim gyi sngags dang / bde ba chen po'i ye shes ni don dam pa'i sngags kyi de nyid dang /yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pa'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i phyogs yin gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa ni 'dir ma bris so/ /de nyid bzhi dang bcu bzhi dang bcu gnyis la sogs pa ni/ de kho na nyid gnyis las phye ba yin cing/ 'chad par 'gyur pa de kho na nyid bdun du ni/ de nyid gcig pu yang dag grub pa dang / rim pa gnyis kar 'dus pa yin no/ /lnga pa la/ de nyid bdun dngos bshad pa/ de'i yan lag rnams bshad pa/ de rnams —22—

kyi rab dbye bshad pa gsum las/ dang po la bshad pa dang don bsdu las/ dang po ni/ zab pa dang / rgya che ba dang / khyab pa dang / rtag pa dang / ye shes kyi sku dang / zung du 'jug pa dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste ye shes kyi rang bzhin ngo bo gcig las/ chad rnam par phye bas bdun du bsgrags pa ste bshad la/ ngo bo tsam bstan pa ni/ dang po'i rgyud de mdor bsdus pa brjod pa yin la/ re re la yang gzhi gang yin pa dang / rigs mthun rgyu gang yin pa dang / mngon du byed pa'i rkyen nam thabs gang yin pa dang / dmigs pa gang yin pa dang / rnam pa'am 'dzin stangs gang yin pa dang / byed pa gang yin pa dang / las gang yin nga/ dang / 'bras bu gang yin pa ste/ don brgyad brgyad kyi ston pa ni gnyis pa'i rgyud sde rgyas bshad do/ /de yang mdor bsdus su mtsho ni na/ gzhi'am rten ni rnam shes dang ye shes kyi cha ma phye bar kun gzhi tsam ste bdun po thams cad du re dra'o/ /zab pa'i rigs mthun gyi rgyu ni sems nyid rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'o/ /rkyen ni de ltar stong nyid du gnas pa tshul ji bzhin du sgom pa goms par byed pa'o/ /dmis/sa/ pa ni chos thams cad yin la/ rnam pa ni spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'o/ /byed pa ni rang gi rang bzhin mngon du byed pa yin la/byed las ni mtshan ma dang mtshan med kyi rnam rtog thams cad gcod pa yin la/'bras bu ni/ lam gyi ye shes kyi dbang du byas na chos sku'i phyogs gcig mngon du byed de stong pa nyid do/ /rgya che ba la gzhi ni 'dra'o/ /rgyu ni sems nyid snang ba sna tshogs su 'char pa'o/ rkyen ni thabs sna tshogs la bslab pa'o/ /dmigs pa ni snang ba'i chos thams cad do/ /rnam pa ni brten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i —23—

rnam pa'o/ /byed pa ni rang gi rang bzhin rten 'byung mngon du byed pa yin la/byed las ni lta ba mchog tu 'gyur ba yin cing / 'bras bu ni chos sku'i phyogs gcig go khyab pa la/ rgyu ni sems nyid ris med pa yin la/ rkyen ni snang ba thams cad la rtsal sbyangs pa'o/ /dmigs pa ni dang po dang 'dra la/ rnam pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul yin cing / byed pa cig car 'phrin las sna tshogs spyod pa yin la/ las ni thag ring thung dang rgya che chung la chags thogs med pa'o/ /'bras bu sku gsum kar gyi phyogs gcig go /rtag pa la rgyu ni sems 'gyur ba med pa'i cha rkyen ni de nyid la de ltar shes pa/ dmigs pa ni chos rnams kyi rang bzhin/ rnam pa ni sems mi g.yo ba byed pa ni zab pa dang 'dra la/ las ni rkyen gang gis kyang mi rdzi ba/ 'bras bu chos sku'i phyogs gcig go /sku la/ rgyu ni lus kyi chos su sngon nas snang ba/ ji skad du/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i tshul can du/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas so/ /zhes pa ltar dri bcas ye shes kyi sku'o/ /rkyen ni yid ngor gsal snang thob pa'i lha sku/dmigs pa ni rlung sems tsam/ rnam pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang mthun pa/ byed pa ni lus sems ro gcig tu snang ba las ma dag pa'i snang ba 'phral du 'gog pa 'bras bu ni longs sprul gyi phyogs re'o/ /zung 'jug gi rgyu ni rang bzhin la gnyis chos med pa'i cha/ rkyen ni thams cad la ro gcig par lha sku rnam par mi rtog pas 'jug pa/ dmigs pa ni dang po dang 'dra la rnam pa gnyis snang rang bzhin med pa/ byed pa ni zab pa dang 'dra zhing / las ni gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba 'gog pa/ 'bras bu gnas tshul gyi sku gsum ga'i —24—

phyogs gcig go /bde ba la/ rgyu ni sems kyi rang bzhin bde bar gnas pa/rkyen ni zhu bde lhan skyes gtso bor gyur pa'i zhu bde thams cad/ dmigs pa lus sems su snang ba/ rnam pa lus sems kyi bde ba la rnam par mi rtog pas/byed pa rang bzhin bde ba mngon du byed pa/ las rang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'phral du 'gog cing stong pa nyid la ches bogs 'byin pa/ 'bras bu ni/ chos sku dang / longs sku/ de'i gzugs sku dang bcas pa'i phyogs gcig go /de la rgyu ni nyer len dang rkyen ni lhan cig byed pa ste/ zab pa la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu rkyen yin la/ de yang de nyid bdun dngos kyi 'jog mtshams 'phags lam kho na la byed cing don brgyad du ston pa 'di ni lam dus kyi ye shes yin la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bzhi bcu ni 'bras bu la gtso bor sbyor zhing / de la byed pa ni 'phral du mngon du byed pa'i gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang / 'bras bu ni mthar thug la sbyar ba yin te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la ni de gnyis tha dad du bzhag mi dgos so/ /'dis mtshon par byas te/ zhib tu slob dpon las mnyam par bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ de nyid gcig tu bshad pa bsdus pa dang / dang po'i rgyud du bshad pa rgyas pa dang / gnyis pa'i rgyud du bshad pa ni cher rgyas pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa de'i yan lag bshad pa la/ zab pa'i dang / rgya che ba'i dang /khyab pa'i dang / rtag pa'i dang / sku'i dang / zung 'jug gi dang / bde ba'i yan lag bdun las/ dang po ni/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rig tsam gyi ngo bor skyes pa rig bya rig byed gnyis —25—

dang bral bar rang rig pa dang / yon tan rang bzhin dang dbyer med du ldan pa'i phyir ngo bo'i cha nas yon tan 'phel ba med pa dang / ji skad du/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' ni/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/ /ces rang bzhin ni dri ma gtan du bral ba yin pas/ spang bya bri ba med pa ni 'phel 'grib med pa dang / mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gi yul ma zhing mtshan mas rnam par mi rtog pa'i bdag nyid du gnas pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa de nyid las dngos po thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan du snang ba po ste/ zab pa'i ye shes ni/ yan lag gam mtshan nyid lnga po de dag dang ldan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu bsod nams rgya che ba dang / ye shes rgya che ba dang / ye shes kyi spyod yul te de'i snang ba rgya che ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams la dmigs pa'i phyir dmigs pa rgya che ba dang / chos thams cad kyi rnam pas 'jug pa'i phyir 'jug pa rgya che ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don sgo nas thams cad nas sbyor ba'i phyir las rgya che ba ste/ rgya che ba'i mtshan nyid dam yan lag lnga yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ ye shes de yul thams cad du nye ring med pa dang / dus thams cad du nye ring med pa dang / gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ngo bo khyad par med pas /byab pa dang / stong pa nyid de/ de bzhin nyid tha dad med pa'i phyir khyab pa dang / chos thams cad rnam par mi rtog pas mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pa'i phyir khyab pa ste khyab pa'i yan lag lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa de la rgyun chad mi srid pas rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / lhag med du 'jug pa lta bu'i 'gog pa med pa dang / sku la rdul phra rab kyi chos med pa dang / ji 26—

skad du/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar/ rang bzhin la gnas skabs thams cad du 'gyur ba gtan med pa dang / rgyal sras chen po rnams kyis kyang bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir bsam yas ye shes te/ lnga po rtag pa'i yan lag nyid do/ /lnga pa ni/ zab pa'i don du 'gyur ba ltar snang mod/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du mi byed pa'i bar du ni/ glo bur gyi ye shes rnams rang bzhin 'gyur ba can yin cing de rnams kyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir 'gyur ba med pa'i yan lag tu 'brel la/ rtag pa ni 'gyur ba med pa'i don yin te/ /nam mkha' ltar rtag pa min gsung / lnga pa ni/ sku thabs shes yab yum kha sbyor gyi rnam pa dang / thugs rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i bde bar gnas pa dang / rnam pa snying rje chen po gsum dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa dang / bde chen gyi 'gal zla yin te/ rnam rtog gi nye bar sbyor ba thim pa dang / de'i bzhon pa las rlud yang thim zhing 'gags pa dang / zhu ba'i rkyen gyis bde ba thob pa las mngon du 'gyur pa dang / byang chub kyi sems rang gnas las mi 'dzag pa'i bde ba'i ngo bor gnas pa ste/bde ba'i yan lag bdun no/ /snying rje chen po bde bar bshad pa ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal nye bar 'gog pa dang / 'gyur med kyi skad cig re re skyes pa na/ 'gyur bcas kyi sems can rnams la snying rje dmigs pa med pa'i rnamachi/ pa can rgya chen po 'dren par 'gyur zhing / bde chen de nyid kyang de'i rnam par 'char pa yin pas/ las dang po pas kyang 'dra mtshungs su sgom pa'i man ngag shes dgos so/ /de ltar shes na/ thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa a bha ya ka ra —27—

gugs/ mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel du/ bde ba chen po sgrub par byed pa nyid kyis na gtso bor/ yul reg bya dang de'i dbang po dang de'i rnam par shes pa snying rje la sogs pa'i ngo bor dang shes rab lnga'i ngo bor yang sgrub pa'i ched du gsungs pa/ zhes gsungs pa la legs bshad chen por shes shing / grub chen dril bu pas/ bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /snang ba gsum snying rje gsum du bshad pa sogs la nges pa dpyis phyin pa ster bar 'gyur mod kyi/ 'di na phyogs tsam rtogs pa'ang nyung bar snang ngo / /drug pa ni/ thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes las byung zhing skyes pa dang / ma dag pa'i las snang gi sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang / gar yang phyin pa dang / rkyen gang gis kyang mi g.yo ba ste 'gyur ba mi sten (brtan pa dang / yid de sems kyi snang ba tsam gyi sku dang / rlung gi dwangs ma tsam gyi lus can dang / dus mthu'i skad cig la yul dus kyi bsdus pa'i shes bya kun ston yang mi 'gal ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan zhing rang dang 'dra ba'i sprin spro ba ste/ de ltar bdun po de ni rdo rje'i sku'i yan lag tu gsungs so/ /'dir rlung sems kyi lus gcig tu bsdoms pas bdun yin la/ rlung zhes bya ba bem po rang mtshan pa la go bar mi bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ gnyis snang thams cad gtan nas log pas gnyis min dang / sems sems byung gi rgyu ba chad de yang dag min rtog 'gags pas mi rtog pa dang / chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba la zhugs pa dang / gnyis snang med pas dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu snang ba dang / yul dus kun tu rnam pa kun nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad par snang ba dang / nam yang go 'phang de las —28—

g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes ni zung 'jug go /zhes zung 'jug gi yan lag drug go /snang ba med pa zhes pa ji ltar snang ba thams cad rang bzhin med par gzigs pa dang / kun tu snang ba rang snang gi dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'chad pa'ang yod gsung zhing / de ltar/ yan lag bzhi bcu po 'di rnams rdo rje spe'i rgyud las rgyas par 'byung ba/ man ngag gi don bsdus pa yin zhes rgyud de nyid kyi lung tshigs su bcad pa drug cu tsam 'dren par mdzad de bzung bar ma nus so/ /'di rnams kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la thams cad tshang zhing de'i phyir ye shes ngo bo gcig nyid yin gyi tha dad du go bar mi bya'o/ /gsum pa rab dbye bshad pa la/ de nyid bdun dang yan lag ci rigs pa dag la/ yang na so so kun gyi gzhi gang yin pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i dbang gi skabs su ji ltar thob pa dang / 'jig rten 'das pa nye rgyu'i dbang gi thob tshul dang / blo ldan sngags pa rnams kyis bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim rnams su 'byung ba'i tshul dang / sku gsum gang du bsdud pa dang / de dag de la ldan tshul gyi sgo nas kyang bshad par bya la/ yan lag bdun gyi rang bzhin gang yin pa dang / thob pa la gegs byed kyi spang bya dang / sgrub byed kyi lam gyi grogs dang de'i 'gal zla dang / gya nom te skyon med pa dang skyon dang bcas pa'i khyad par dang / zag bcas dang zag pa med pa'i khyad par dang / rgyun chad pa dang rtag pa ste mi brtan pa dang brtan pa'i khyad par dang / lo sogs kyi sgras 'dzag bcas 'dzag med dang / lus sems kyi ye shes dang / zhi gnas lhag mthong dang / rang —29—

snang gzhan snang dang / pha rol du phyin pa drug dang slab pa gsum la sogs pa rab tu dbye ba'i khyad par mtha' yas pas de kho na nyid bdun la the tshom bsal ba yin no/ /de la don lngar bshad pa de ni/ snga phyir brtags pas shugs la go ba yin cing / gnyis tshan dang po las/ rang bzhin ni spyi don gyi skabs su bshad zin la/ de rtogs pa la gegs byed pa'i spang bya ni/ zab dang rgya che khyab pa sogs kyi gzhung tshig gi go rim dang sbyar na bden par zhen pa dang / stong pa la chen pa dang / bdag gzhan du cen pa dang / 'gyur bar zhabru/la ba dang/ tha mal du nga rgyal ba dang / gnyis su snang ba mngon gyur ba dang / sems sdug bsngal du 'khrul ba rnams so/ /de dag kyang re rer rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog gi 'khor dang bcas pa dri bcas kyi snang ba gsum dang bcas pa ste/ mthong spangs dang sgom spangs kyi dbye ba dang bcas pa rnams te/ de dag ni phyogs gzhan du gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /grogs ni sngar bshad pa'i rkyen rnams so/ /'gal zla ni de ma thag tu bshad pa'i spang bya'o/ /gya nom ni bzang po'i mchog tu gyur pa'i ming ste/ de yang zag med kyi sems rgyud mngon du gyur pa na/de'i chos de nyid bdun po'ang zag med yin pas de 'phags pa la yod cing /so so skye bo rnams ni skyon dang bcas pa'o/ /de bzhin du zag bcas zag med kyang yin cing / de yang rags pa nyon sgrib kyi dbang du byas kyi/ spyir skyon can dang skyon med ni slob mi slob la bzhag na legs so/ /brtan mi brtan la so so skye bo'i ni rgyun chad cing 'jug pa yin la/ 'phags lam du ni ye nas rgyun chad pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang ma dag sa bdun du/ mnyam rjes so sor yod pas mi —30—

brtan pa dang / dag pa'i sa gsum du'ang da dung khyad par du 'gyur pa'i phyir/mi rtag pa zhes bya la/ sangs rgyas nas ni rang bzhin dang gnas skabs cung zad kyang 'gyur ba med pas rtag pa zhes btags pa yin no/ /rab tu dbye ba zhib mo 'di'i gtam tsam yang man ngag med bzhin du bdag mkhas pa'o zhes khengs gtam smra ba de rnams la yod pa ma yin na/ nyams su myong ba lta ga la zhigadrug pa rnam grangs thor bu pa bshad pa la/ ji skad du/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rje yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ces pa'i yan lag bdun la de nyid bdun du bshad pa dang / 'og nas 'byung ba'i thabs shes kyi de nyid bdun dang / stong pa nyid dang snying rje bde chen dbyer med pa don dam pa'i dbang bskur ba bzhi pa'i ye shes rim pa bzhin gong na med pas bla na med pa/ de ni don dam pa'i shes rab ye shes te/ shes rab rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa'am rnam med phyag chen las skyes pa'i ye shes sems kyi rang bzhin ji lta bu'i gnas tshul lo/ /zhes tsho pa ste/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi ngos 'dzin de nyid bdun du bshad pa gsum po 'di dag gang rung las shes dgos pa yin no/ /me 'o nga lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa ye shes lnga ni de nyid lnga ru bshad pa'ang yod la/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang /ye shes chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i sku ste/ sku bzhi ni sku'i de nyid rnam pa bzhir bshad pa dang / dbang phyug brgyad la de kho na nyid brgyad du bshad pa'ang yod nga sa/ spyir de nyid ces pa rgyud sde rnams su dgongs pa sna tshogs la gsungs pas/ phyogs gcig kho na la a mthas bar mi —31 —

bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ e ma ho/ zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar sdom 'byung las 'byung zhing / de yang lhan cig skyes dang zhes sogs bcu gnyis po'i ming bshad pas mdor bstan/ rgyud tshig gi rgyas par bshad pa 'dir tshig tshogs chung ngur sdom na/ 'di ltar/ e ma ho/ zhes pa ni rdzogs rim gyi de nyid 'di rnams la ngo mtshar skyes pa ltar ston pa ste/ lhan skyes dang / mkhyen pas khyab pa dang / skus khyab pa dang / las kyi khyab pa dang / dga' ba dang / 'od gsal rnams don gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir bsngags pa yin cing / skyu ma'i tshul yang don gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ lam 'di nyid la phyag 'tshal lo zhes gsungs so/ /de yang lhan cig skyes pa ni sa ha dza zhes pa lus sems su snang ba'i rten brten pa ni thog ma med pa nas lhan cig tu byung ba yin la/ 'on kyang skad cig re rer phan tshun gcig la brten pa ni ya mtshan to zhes lhan skyes kyi de nyid dang / bdag nyid chen po ni/ de ltar yang / bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag nye bar zhu bas dam pa'i bdag /ces pa ltar/ sems kyi rang zhin ni bdag dang gzhan du dbye ba dang / bden rdzun sogs gnyis chos kyi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir dam pa yin la/ de nyid nam yang rgyun chad pa med pas yon tan sgrub pa'i gzhi dang / las dang 'bras bu myong bar byed pa'i phyir bdag ste/ de ltar yang len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par 'gyur na mi rung zhes/ /byis pa rnams la 'di ni ngas ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ shin tu rtogs dka' ba'i phyir phra ba'i bdag gi de nyid dang / chos rnams kun gyi rang —32—
