pa yin zhing / de yang rim pa dang po ste bskyed rim mthar phyin pas/ tshogs kyi sa zhes pa tshogs lam chen po thob pa dang / skye ba gcig gis thogs par 'gyur zhes pa/ de nas gang zag de tshe 'phos na rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su skye ba'am gnas thob pa yin la/ de'i rten la zung 'jug gi sku thob pa yin cing / skye ba gcig brgyud par song bas skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i gang zag tu gyur ba yin la/ dro ba chen por zhes pa drod chen po thob par gyur nas ni/ lam mi gcig pas bgrod pa gtan nas med par gang zag thams cad lam bgrod pa gcig gis 'jug pa yin pas/ gcig tu zhugs shing zhes pa dang / snang ba la sogs thob la zhes pa/ yang snang ba dang mched pa'i sa thob nas gang zag de shi nas/ 'chi sems kyi don du sems dben pa'i ye shes thob nas/ bar do'i dod la mya ngan las 'da' zhes pa ste/ zung 'jug gi sku thob pa dang / skye ba'ang yod ces pa rig pa 'dzin pa lta bur skye ba len pa'ang yod ces pa'i don no/ /bdag las byin rlabs thob nas te/ gson pa'i dus na/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i sgyu lus kyi sku thob nas ni/ gang zag de la 'chi srid 'byung ba mi 'gyur te/ rgyu gang gis phyir na/ gnas skabs gsum la 'phags pa'i sa thob po zhes pa/ bdag byin rlabs pa thob pa'i gang zag de rtsol ba chen pos spyod pa gsum la sogs pa spyad cing sgrub na ni/ gnas skabs tshe 'dir 'phags pa ste slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub pa dang / yang gang zag des bdag byin rlabs pa'i sgyu lus kyi sku thob kyang g.yengs rkyen gyis sgom long ma byung bar 'chi ba byung na/ de la gzhan gyis shi ba ltar mthong yang / rang nyid la 'chi ba mtshan nyid pa med par de'i —85—

tshab tu zung 'jug gi sku thob pa dang / yang gang zag de'i tshe 'jug lta bur sgyu lus kyi sku thob bas sgom long ma byung na/ gong du bshad pa ltar 'chi ba mtshan nyid pa med kyang / 'chi sems kyi tshab tu lam sgom zhing bar dor sangs rgyas rnams kyis nye rgyu'i dbang bskur nas/ gnas skabs der zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa yin no/ /de nas grub pa'i khyad par 'ga' dang / brtsod ldan min yang rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pas lus g.yin nges par bsgyur zhes pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi sgo nas ri lu mig sman sogs kyi dngos grub 'grub nas tha mal gyi lus gnas gyur pa'ang yod/ yang rdzogs rim gyi skabs su gnas gyur pa'ang yod pa sogs lus gnas gyur 'gro mtshams mang yang / lhan cig skyes pa'i sku slob pa'i zung 'jug thob pa'i tshe ni/ chos nyid kyi nges par lus de nyid gzhan du gnas 'gyur ba yin no/ /༈ lnga pa rim pa gnyis par bshad pa la/ dang po bskyed rim gyi mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ 'bras bu dang mtshungs rtog pa'i rgyu can bde ba che dang stong pa'i rnam pa lha yi gzugs brnyan ni/ bde ba cung zad lam du byed nus snang dang 'dzin pa lhod byed rdzogs pa sbyor ba dang po ste/ zhes gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi ngo bo ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa bzhugs tshul dang mthun pa zhig dang /'khor ba'i gnas lus longs spyod dang rnam pa mthun pa'i sgo nas sbyongs thub pa zhig dang / rdzogs rim gyi lam gyi gzhi 'dings shing smin byed du 'gro ba cig dang / rtog pa'i rgyu can zhes pa ngo bo mi rtog pa las rang shar ba ma yin par/rnal 'byor rtog pa'i rtsol ba las 'byung zhing goms pa las lha skur shar ba yin —86—

pa/ bde ba che dang zhes pas/ de yang bde ba chen por shar ba/ stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pas/ de thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs shing rgyas thebs pa/ lha'i gzugs ni zhes pas/ tha mal gyi snang ba ma yin pa lha gang dang gang bsgoms pa de rnam pa shin tu gsal ba de lta bu yin la/ de nyid sgom pa goms pas ni/bde ba cung zad lam du byed nus pa yin te/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas 'bar 'dzas bli rkag de ba myong zhing lam du byed pa yin pas/ rdzogs rim lta bu'i bde ba chen po myong mi thub pas/ lam du byed nus zhes pa'o/ /snang dang 'dzin pa lhod byed zhes pas/ de lta bu'i byed las de'i byed pa ni/ ma dag pa'i snang ba gnas lus longs spyod la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs par shar ba'i snang zhen dam po 'di lhod por byed pa dang/ de las gang zag dang chos la sos sa pa 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes snyam du 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi blo brtan po rnams bskyed rim gyi lha sku bsgoms pas/ de dag gi snang zhen la sogs pa 'dzin pa brtan po rnams 'gag cing cing lhod po byed pa dang / rdzogs pa sbyor ba zhes pas/ lam gong ba rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du (mā/ra zhing mtshams sbyor ba dang /rdzo72/ rim sgom pa'i skal ba can du byed pa yin no / /rim pa gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyis ni/ ma brtags lus dang sems la ye shes 'byung ba dbu mar byed pa sna tshogs bcings pa nyid las so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rdzogs rim gyi skad dod ni/ ni sku sdo kra ma/ zhes pa/ ni khri ni rdzo gas pa ste/ rtsol med du thob shugs 'byung du 'byung ba'i don dang / kra ma ni rim pa'o/ /ngo bo ni ma brtags pa la rang shar ba yin pa ste/ de yang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa las byung ba —87—

zhig yin te/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa zhig med na/ ma brtags pa las 'char ba tsam mdo lam las kyang yod pas/ gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim la de gnyis char tshang zhig dgos pas/ rdo rje'i lus dang sems gnyis po de las yang dag pa'i ye shes 'byung ba yin zhing / de yang rags pa'i rtsa dbus mar/ byed pa sna tshogs bcings pa ste/ byed bcings sbyor ba sna tshogs kyis rnam rtog gi rgyu tha mal gyi rlung sems rnams dbu mar bcug cing 'gags par byas pa nyid do/ /de la dbye na/ bskyed pas drangs dang nang gi bde rig mngon sum lha dag lhan cig skyes pa rgyu dang bcas par dbye/ zhes pas te/ bskyed rim gyis sna drangs pa'i rdzogs rim btags pa ba dang / de dag la ma ltos par nang gi zhu bde lhan skyes rang gis rig pa ni pa rdzogs rim mtshan nyid pa dang / rnam rtog la sogs pa'i blos gsar du sgom pa la ma ltos par/ mi rtog pa'i rnal 'byor de kho na nyid kyi sbyor bas/ rdzogs rim gyi lha sku rang shar du byung ba ste/mngon sum dang ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ste/ de lta bu ni rdzogs rim gyi mtshan nyid mthar thug pa yin pa dang / stong gzugs dang bde chen gnyis lhan cig pa shar ba yang / rdzogs rim gyi khyad chos gcig dang / yang de dag gi rgyu ste lus dben lta bu yang rdzogs rim dngos ma yin yang / rdzogs rim gyi nye rgyu yin pas de'i ming btags pa sogs dbye ba de dag yod do/ /༈ drug pa spyod pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ grub pa spyod pa'i rgyu can dang po che dang sku yi don dang de nyid rnam par sbyong ba dang / zhes pas —88—

bstan te/ spyod pa la dbye na/ bskyed rim gyi spyod pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa gnyis so/ /thog mar spyod pa de dag spyod pa'i dus/ rags pa'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas/ ri lu la sogs pa'i dngos sgrub rnams ma grub pa 'grub pa'i phyir spyad pa spyod pa dang / phra ba'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas 'dod gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa bsgrub pa'i phyir spyad pa spyod pa ni bskyed rim gyi spyod pa'i dus dang / rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa ni/ dngos grub sbyor lam drod chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po gsum gang yang rung ba'i skabs su/ sgyu lus bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa'i rlung sems kyi sku sgrub don du spyad pa spyod pa dang / sbyor lam rtse mo sogs kyi skabs su rlung sems kyi sku de 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i phyir dang / slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku thob na/ 'phags pa'i sa bcu pa'i bar du spyad pa spyod pa ni/ gtso bor sems can gyi don sna tshogs gyi phyir du spyod pa dang / mngon byang gong 'og gi skabs su nye rgyu'i sbyad pa spyod pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi don chen por rgyur phyir spyod pa ste/ de dag kyang phal cher gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de dag tu ma zad gzhan yang nye tshe ba'i lam la spyod pa'i dus sna tshogs kyi dbye ba mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /spyod pa'i ngo bo la sogs pa ni/ngo bo nyid dang de bzhin gzhan ni spyod pa'i dgos pa bdag ste slar yang de nas gzhan/ gnas kyi dbye ba mdzad de dus dang cho ga na chod bsam pa 'dod chags shes rab kyis kyang gzhan/ zhes pas bstan te spyod pa'i ngo bo ni/ yul sna tshogs dang bde sdug 'dod yon la sogs pa thams cad/ nang ting nge 'dzin dang ro gcig tu bsres te bsgom pa'o/ /ji ltar spyod pa'i tshul ni/ spros bcas spros —89—

med shin tu spros med dam/ kun dar/ kun bzang / phyogs las rnam rgyal gsum ste/ phyag rgya rig ma mang po dang bcas te yul sna tshogs su rgyu zhing 'dod yon sna tshogs la rol la/ de dag tu brda' dang brda'i lan dang / glu gar dang bcas pa'i spros pa rgya chen po dang bcas te spyod pa ni spros bcas kyi spyod pa dang / phyag rgya ji ltar 'os pa dang bcas te/ brda' la sogs pa'i spros pa phal cher spangs te spyod pa ni spros med kyi spyod pa dang / las rgya spangs te ye shes kyi rig ma tsam dang / 'dod yon spangs pa shin tu sprod med kyi spyod pa'o/ /dgos pa ni dngos grub kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig ma grub pa 'grub pa'i phyir dang / grub pa rnams gong 'phel du 'gyur pa'i phyir spyod pa'o/ /gnas ni rang gi khyim kho nar 'dug bzhin pas spyod pa dang / pū li ra ma la sogs pa'i yul chen po nyi shu rtsa bzhir rgyu ba gnas kyi khyad par dang / dus kyi go rim ni thog mar spros bcas dang / de nas spros med dang / de nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyod do//cho ga ni de dag tu lha'i rnal 'byor dang / sngags dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / phyas/ rgya la sogs pa cho ga'i rim pa rgyas bsdus rnams dang / bsam pa ni/ sgrub po rang gi mos pas spyod pa gsum gang 'dod pa spyod pa dang / na tshod ni/ sa/zhonanu'i skabs su spros bcas dang / dar la bab nas spros med dang / rgam/ po'i dus shin tu spros med kyi sbyad pa spyod—do/ /de bzhin du 'dod chags shas chen spros/ bcas dang / de las chung nas spros med dang / shin tu chung na shin tu spros med kyi spyad pa spyod do/ /phyag rgya mang po ni spros bcas dang / nyung ngu ni spros med dang / spangs pa shin tu spros med do/ /spyod pa'i yan lag tu dgos pa drag shul —90—

gyi spyod pa bstan pa ni/ drag shul gyi sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ rim pa gnyis pa stong nyid goms pa dag gis so/ /gcig ni 'jig rten dngos grub don no glang po'i bdag po rta yi mtha' bzhin/ rdzogs pa la gnas pas/ /mtshan ma'i spyod pa 'jug pa nyid do zhes pas bstan te/ de la rdi zur gyi las sems phur bus gdab pa'am/ drag shul gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ba/ dngos grub kyi don du lha gnad la dbab pa yin te/ de'i sbyor ba ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la stong nyid kyi rnal 'byor goms pa dag gis bya dgos pa las/ dang po bskyed rim gyi drag shul sbyor ba ni bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i gang zag la gnyis yod de/ sngags la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa dang / nang la gzhol ba gnyis yod pa'i nang la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa la ni/drag shul gyi sbyor ba dgos pa ma yin la/ sngags la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa yin zhing / de yang gcig ni sogs kyi don de/ rags pa'i bskyed rim brtan pa ni sngags la gzhol ba yin pas/ des ril lu mig sman sogs dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir du/ spyod pa lan gsum bskyar nas zla ba drug la sogs pa'i bar du spyad kyang ma grub na/ de'i tshe sngags kyi lha la phur bu'i 'debs pa sogs drag shul gyi spyor ba byas pas dngos grub 'grub pa yin no/ /rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor pa la drag shul gyi sbyor ba mi dgos par 'dong pa yang byung mod/ rang lugs la ni rdzogs rim la yang dgos pa'i skabs kyang yod pa yin la/ de yang glang po'i bdag po sogs kyi don te/ rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ba des/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi don du/ spyod pa lan gsum bskyar —91—

ba zla ba drug tu spyad kyang ma grub na/ rdzogs rim gyi 'phros re zhig bzhug nas/mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i bskyes rim gyi spyod pa drag shul sbyor ba dang bcas pa la bzhugs pas 'grub pa yin te/ dper na skyes bu zhig gis ri la bgrod pa la bzhon pa glang po che la gnas nas g.yul 'thab pa la 'khru/gas pas rgyal bar ma gyur na/ de las babs te rta la gnas te 'thab pas rgyal ba bzhin no/des na rdzogs rim la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ba 'ga' zhig la'ang mtshan bcas kyi spyod pa drag shul sbyor ba dang bcas pa la 'jug dgos pa nyid do/ /gzhan yang 'phros don ni/ dbang bskur ba dang yongs su 'brel ba'i nye ba'i rgyu zhes bya ba/ sems dben pa dang nges par byang chub gnyis kyang dbang las gyur pa sbul dang longs spyod rdzogs las so/ /zhes pa ni/ spyod pa spyad pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la dbang bskur ba dang yongs su 'brel ba ni nye rgyu mngon byang zhes bya ba yin te/de yang sems dben gyi rnal 'byor pa de/ spyod pa'i skabs su rdo rje slob dpon mi'i rten can gyis dbang bskur ba yin la/ de yang mos pa lam byed tsam ma yin par dngos su rig ma dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba yin la/ de'i rgyud dam tshig ma nyams pa dang / rten 'brel gyi nye rgyus dbang bskur ba 'og mar sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis dbang bskur ba yin te/ sku dngos sam/sngar gyi rdo rje slob dpon de'i tshul bzung nas sam/ de la byin gyis rlabs nas dbang bskur ba dang / mngon byang gong mar ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams las dbang bskur ba thob pa yin no/ /༈ bdun pa 'bras bu ni/ bzhi dang bcu drug sku ste ye shes rnam pa lnga ni —92—

yan lag bdun dang ldan pa 'bras bu ste/ sku dang brjod tshul zhing dang mdzad pa 'di la rang rgyud bden pa gnyis kyi dbye bas so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sprul pa'i sku dang / longs spyod rdzos/sa pa'i sku dang / chos kyi sku dang / bde ba r+sā po'i ste bzhi dang / de dag las dbye ba'i sprul pa'i sku'i sku dang / gsung dang /thugs dang / ye shes te bzhi dang / longs sku'i sku dang / gsung dang / thugs dang ye shes te bzhi dang / chos sku'i sku dang / gsung dang thugs dang / ye shes te bzhi dang / bde ba chen po'i sku dang / gsung dang / thugs dang / ye shes te bcu drug go /ye shes rnam pa lnga ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes dang / bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes dang /chos dbyings ye shes te ye shes lnga dang / de dag kyang gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs 'dir/ gong du bshad pa'i yan lag bdun dang ldan pa nyid ni/de ni 'bras bu yin la/ de dag las longs sku dang sprul sku rnam pa gnyis dang /brjod tshul te gsung dam chos dang / de dag gi zhing khams dang / mdzad pa 'phrin las te/ gzhi po 'di la rang rgyud kyi bden pa re dang / gdul bya gzhan snang gis bsdus pa re ste gnyis su dbye dgos pa yin no/ /༈ rtsa ba'i gsum pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/ de ltar bdag gi bla ma chen po'i gzhung ni tshigs bcad brgya phrag gnyis las snying po tsam zhig bsdus/lam ni lnga pa bstan pa'i don 'dir 'bad pa'i mthu las 'gro ba kun la ye shes rgyas gyur cig /ces pa ste/ de'i don ni/ de lta bu'i bdag gi bshad pa'i gzhung 'di ni/ bla ma chen po ste grub chen zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa'i lam lnga —93—

bstan pa zhes bya ba gzhung tshigs bcad brgya phrag gnyis yod pa de las/ don gyi snying por gyur pa'i gzhung tshigs bcad bcu pa 'di slob dpon brnya gup+ta nā tha bdag gis bsdus pa yin la/ de lta bu'i lam lnga rnam pa bstan pa'i don 'dir 'bad pa las byung ba'i dge ba de dag gang yin pa de'i mthu las/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can ma lus pa 'di dag kun la/ bde ba chen po mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes rgyas par gyur cig ces dge ba bsngo bar mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pas te/ de lta bu'i gzhung 'di'i ming ni tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba'i lam gyi rim pa'o/gzhung 'di su zhig gis mdzad ce na/ slob dpon bzhi gup+ta nā thas nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bod skad du slob dpon sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon pos sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /'o na gzhung 'di su zhig gis bsgyur zhe na/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' snying pos gzhung mdzad pa po'i bla ma de nyid la legs par bsnyen bkur zhing bsten cing gsan nas/ slar yang bla ma de nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa paṇ+ḍi ta phi rnga badz+ra ste gang ba'i rdo rje la zhus nas tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes pa ste tā ra thā ni sgrol ba'i mgon po ste des rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o/ /gzhung 'di'i 'grel ba zin bris su bgyi ba po ni/ rje btsun nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge slong ye shes rgya mtsho bdag gis rang rtog gi dri mas ma gos pa bgyi ba lhur blangs pa'o/ /gcig zhus dag /sarba ma ṅga la karma ku bco ma/ /—94—

ces bya ba bzhugs/oX snyu sti/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi ye shes las byung ba'i sngags dang / de'i cho ga lam gyi gtso bor ston pa la/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di ni theg pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul spyir mang du yod kyang gtso bo ni las tshogs dang / dngos grub bsgrub tshul dang/ lha dang / sngags dang / lus la gnad du bsnun pa sogs/theg pa gzhan la med pa'i thabs mang ba ste/ slob dpon tri pi ṭa ka mā las mdzad pa'i tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs/ mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes thabs mang bar bshad pa la sogs pa'o/ /zhan yang gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag spyin ldan na/ /skye shing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun dag na/ /ma bsgom par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nga ltar/ tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nus pa nas skye ba bdun nam bcu drug gam/ bya rgyud lta bur ma mtha' shin tu thogs kyang bskal ba brgyad kyis sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phyir lam myur ba ste/ gsang 'dus las/ sems can mtshams med la sogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang / /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni —95—

'di la 'grub/ /ces gsungs shing / yang de nyid las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /yang der ma zad/ bka' thub dang dka' spyad mi dgos par 'dod yon gyi bde ba bsten pas dngos grub 'grub pa sogs bde bas sangs rgyas thob pa'ang yin te/thabs mang ba dang / dus myur ba dang / 'jug pa bde ba ste khyad chos gsum po 'di'i sgo nas/ theg pa g.yin thams cad las mchog tu 'gyur pa yin no/ /de la dbye na rgyud sde gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug la sogs pa'i bar du dbye ba yod pa las/ gtso bor rgyud sde bzhi yin la/ de'i nang tshan rgyud sde dang po bya rgyud la dbye na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje rigs te 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang / nor bu'i rigs dang / lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs ni 'jig rten pa gsum ste/ de ltar rigs drug go /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la dam tshig gsum bkod/ tshe dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla sogs sangs rgyas dngos rnams gtso bo'i rigs yin la/ 'jam dpal gyi rigs rnams rigs kyi bdag po dang / gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gdugs dkar dri med sogs rigs kyi gtsug gtor dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag rdor 'khor bcas ma gtogs/ byang sems rnams rigs kyi sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas spyan ma/gzungs grwa lnga la sogs pa rigs kyi yum dang / gshin rje gshed ni rigs kyi khro bo dang rig pa'i bdag po dang / mi g.yo ba la sogs pa rigs kyi pho nya dang /'phags ma 'od zer can ma dang / ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sogs dang / rgyal —96—

mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang / phyir bzlog chen mo la sogs pa rigs kyi pho nya mo yin no/ /pad+ma'i rigs la/ rigs kyi gtso bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin la/ bcom ldan ma gos dkar mo sogs rigs kyi yum dang / sgrol ma sogs rigs kyi lha mo dang don yod zhags pa dang / ha la ha la sogs rigs kyi sems dpa' dang / rigs kyi bdag po zhes bya ba rigs kyi khro bo ni rta mgrin no/ /ral gcig ma la sogs pa rigs kyi khro mo dang/ srin mo ral gcig ma dang / dpal chen mo la sogs pa ni rigs kyi pho nya mo'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs la/ rigs kyi gtso bo phyag na rdo rje/ rigs kyi yum lha mo mā ma gī dang me ltar rab tu rmongs byed/ rdo rje mi pham mo la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi sems dpa' ni khro gnyer rim par ldan la sogs pa yin yang khro bo'i khongs su 'dus/ rigs kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ rigs kyi pho nya stobs po che la sogs pa/ rigs kyi pho nya mo rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma la sogs pa drug cu rtsa bzhi yod par gsungs/ nor bu'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang pos bshad pa ste/ nga la dang nor rgyun ma la sogs pa'i rgyud do/ /lnga rtsen gyi rigs ni/ gnod spyin lnga rtsen nyid dang / 'phrog ma dang / bu nga ga' byed la sogs pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs la myongs pa/ dbang phyug khyab 'jugazla ba/ nyi ma/ mkha' lding rnams gtso bor bshad cing spyir lha klu gnon sbyin/ dri za mi'am ci/ lha ma yin/ mkha' lding / 'byung po ste sde brgyad kyi rigs mtha' yas pa rnams so/ /de ltar bya ba'i rgyud kyi rigs kyi dbye ba rnams bshad nas/rjod byed tshig gi rgyud la dbye na/ mdo sde dang / rgyud dang / rtog pa dang / cho ga —97—

zhib mo dang / gzungs te lnga yod/ dang po ni/ gser 'od dam pa lta bu cho ga bsdus shing sa lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag mang ba gcig la zer/gnyis pa ni cho ga rgyas shing sa lam bsdus pa spyi rgyud gsum dang zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs la sogs pa'o/ /spyi rgyud gsum pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / dpung bzang gis zhus pa dang / legs grub kyi rgyud gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ gnod sbyin ma'i rtog pa lta bu cho ga'am sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs gcig kho na zhib mor ston pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud sogs cho ga dang / sa lam gnyis ka rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /lnga pa ni gzungs sngags phan yon dang bcas pa tsam ston pa 'od zer can ma'i gzungs la sogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bya rgyud kyi nyams len lam gyi rim pa ni/ smin byed kyi dbang la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam las med cing / de yang bya rgyud rang lugs kyi slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob phyir du bskur ba dang / sngags bsgrub pa'i don du slob ma'i dbang bskur ba dang / bar chad zhi ba'i don du dbang bskur ba dang /'byor ba thob pa'i phyir du dbang bskur ba ste/ dgos pa'i dbang gis phye bas dbang bskur tshul bzhi yod/rgyud 'dir rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba kho na bshad/ grol byed kyi lam la mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis kyi dang po la/ bdag bskyed kyi lha'i rnal 'byor med cing / mdun bskyed la yang dam tshig pa bskyed rngo med de/ ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs phyag rgya bstan/ mchod pa phul te sngags bzlas nas mthar gshegs su gsol ba tsam yin/—98—

gnyis pa ni stong pa nyid bsgom pa ste/ mdo dang thun mong ba kho na'o/ /grub pa 'bras bu'i dus ni/ rgyud sde 'dir zhugs na dbang po rnon pos bskal pa brgyad nas sangs rgyas thob par bzhed/ drag po'i las thob pa'i skabs 'ga' dang / khro bo 'chol pa stobs po che bsgrubs pa la sogs pa dmigs bsal can rnams ma gtogs khrus dang gtsang sbra dang snyung gnas la sogs pa'i dka' thub dang / mchod rdzas kyang srog chags kyi lus dang ma 'dres pa gtsang ma kho na dgos par bzhed cing / bsnyen pa dang bsgrub pa'i dus tshangs spyod dge bsnyen yad chod kyi spyod pa la brten dgos pa dang / rgyud kyi nang sel re re tsam las mdun bskyed lha pho mo phan tshun gzigs pa la bsgrub pa rang nyid phar lta ba'i chags lam tsam bshad do/ /rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod ba'i rgyud ni/ phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi rnal 'byor cha mnyam du spyod pas spyod pa'i rgyud ces bya zhing rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir gnyis ka'i rgyud ces kyang zer ro/ /'di la dbye na rigs gsum ste/ sku'i rigs dang /gsung gi rigs dang / thugs kyi rigs so/ de la sku'i rigs ni/ rigs gsum gyi gtso bo yin la/ bod du 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas nas spyod rgyud mtha' dag gi gtso bo'am rtsa bar gyur ba rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud yin cing / de las lha'i rnam grangs mang po ston kyang gtso bo sangs rgyas rnam snang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can sku mdog ser po phyag mnyam gzhag mdzad pa cig gsungs/ bya rgyud du sangs rgyas rnams rang byung chags bral gyi rnam pa kho nar bshad/ 'di nas brtsams te rgyud sde gong ma —99—

rnams su sangs rgyas zhi ba sku rgyan dang ldan pa dang / khro chags kyi sku la sogs pa ma nges pa mang du gsungs so/ /de ltar na rigs kyi gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad dang / rigs kyi khro bo mi g.yo ba brtul phod pa'i rgyud dang / gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la gsung gi rigs ni bod du ma 'gyur/ gsum pa thugs kyi rigs ni phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud yin la/ 'di las lha'i rigs mang du bshad kyang / gtso bo phyag na rdo rje zhi ba yin/ 'od zer can ma lha mang gi rgyud 'di bod du sngar bya rgyud du grags kyang rang lugs spyod rgyud yin pas sku'i rigs su bsdu dgos/ ngan song spyong rgyud kyang rnal 'byor rgyud yin par grags kyang / rang lugs spyod rgyud yin/ dkyil 'khor sku gsung thugs 'dres par bstan pas/ rigs gsum ka 'dres pa'i rgyud du 'gro zhing 'di las dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bshad pa'i rtsa ba ni kun rig yin no/ /de ltar spyod rgyud kyi dbye ba bshad zin nas/ nyams len gyi rim pa ni smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi lam grub pa 'bras bu'i dus te gsum las/ dang po ni/ phal cher bya rgyud dang 'dra ba las/ mig thur me long gi dbang bskur sogs mtha' rten lhag po dang spyod rgyud kyi nang nas rigs mtho ba 'ga' zhig la chu cod pan phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu lta bu dang / ming gi dbang bdag po'i dbang sogs yod pas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga rjes mthun pa yod/ grol byed lam la mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su bdag nyid lhar bsgom pa yang yod cing mdun bskyed la yang dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bsre ba'i skabs kyang yod pa dang / ji skad du/—100—

rgyud las/ dang por khrus byas rnal 'byor bas/ /rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug nas ni/ /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom/ /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ phyi nang gi khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i bsrung 'khor bsgom pa dang / ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs te phyag rgyas btab nas mchod pa 'bul/ gsol ba btab/ de rjes gnas lugs kyi don bsgom pa stong pa'i lha/ de'i ngang las sngags kyi yig 'bru dang sa bon bsgom pa yi ge'i lha/ sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu bsgom pa sgra'i lha/lha'i sku gzugs sgom pa gzugs kyi lha/ thugs kar phyag mtshan sogs bsgom pa phyag rgya'i lha/ rang lus la sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pas lha skur bsgom pa mtshan ma'i lha zhes lha drug gi rnal 'byor gsungs so/ /mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la yang snying gar phyag mtshan dang yig 'bru bsgom pa dang / rlung srog rtsol dgag pa dang / lha pho mo rgod pa'i 'dod chags lam byed sogs bya rgyud las lhag pa'i khyad chos yod/ spyod pa gtsang sgra la gnas pa dgos kyang dmigs bsal re tsam ma gtogs dka' thub dka' spyad mi dgos te/ bdag nyid lhar sgom dgos pa'i phyir ro/ grub pa 'bras bu'i dus ni/ bskal pa chen po gsum nas sangs rgyas thob nus par bshad la/ 'bras bu ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ 'di dang bya rgyud gnyis 'dra ste/ spyod pa bzhi zhes bya ba/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa dbang dang dam tshig rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa rnal 'byor gnyis la brten nas bsnyen pa byed pa/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa rnal 'byor pa dmigs pa la brtan pa thob nas/ bris sku'am dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa la mchod cing bsgrubs pas dngos —101 —

sam rmi lam du lha'i snang ba 'byung ba/ sgrub pa chen po'i mchod pa so so'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar las tshogs dang dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/ /rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud la rtsa rgyud ni de nyid bsdus pa yin/ 'di'i dum bu dang po nas rdor dbyings/ gnyis pa nas khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gsum pa las 'gro ba 'dul ba/ bzhi pa las don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams ston/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo yin/ 'di yang rgyas bsdus ma gtogs dkyil 'khor ston tshul snga ma dang phyogs 'dra/ yan lag gi rgyud thams cad gsang ba dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sgos rgyud cig kyang yod/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po yin/ rgyud 'di las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dpal mchog rigs bsdus su grags pa 'di yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /yo ga rigs bzhi zhes kyang grags rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu la rigs bzhi yod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ rgyud so so ba rang ni med/ rgyud kyi dbye ba ni thabs rgyud shes rab rgyud gnyis su byed/ dpal mchog shes rab kyi rgyud yin/ gzhan rnams thabs rgyud do/ /yo ga'i skor la lugs srol mang po byung yang gsum po 'di grags che ste slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / kun dga' snying po'i lugs so/ /de gsum las kyang phyi dar la kun snying kho na'i lugs dar ro/ /'di'i lam gyi dbang du byas na/ smin byed kyi dbang gi dus su chu cod pan/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming dbang rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon te bum dbang bdun gyi mtha' rten dang bcas bla med phyogs 'dra rung yod/ grol byed kyi lam la lha'i rnal —102—

'byor mngon par byang chub lnga bskyed pa sos/sa dang bdag bskyed dkyil snyen ra rgyas pa yang yod/ dam/ tshig pa la ye shes pa bstim nas phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab byed/ dbang blangs te bzlas brjod byed pa sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa las sbyor rgyas par gsungs/ lag bcangs bde ba lam byed dang / mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor yang spyod rgyud dang 'dra rung ba las zab khyad thon pa yod/ grub pa 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyang dbang po rnon pos tshe gcig nas rtul pos skye ba bcu drug tshun chod la phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par bshad/ de nas kyang lam la 'bad pas mi ring par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub ste shin tu thogs kyang bskal pa chung ngu gcig la mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro// /rgyud sde bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla med la dbye na/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis yod cing / de yang rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud dang thabs rgyud dang pha rgyud skabs 'gar rnal 'byor chen po rnams don gcig cing / skabs 'gar rnal 'byor bla med ces pa'ang ma rgyud kho na la 'jug pa'i skabs yod/ spyir nas shes rab kyi rgyud dang ma rgyud dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams don gcig go /de gnyis kyi khyad par thabs dkyil 'khor lha yab gtso bor gyur pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag dang sngags dang cho ga gtso bor ston cing / shes rab lha mo'i sngags dang cho ga mchog bsgrub pa'i don du mi ston pa de ni thabs rgyud yin la/ thabs rgyud kyi khyad chos rnams shes rab kyi rgyud la tshang zhing / thabs rgyud la med pa'i gnad mang po yang shes rab kyi rgyud la yod pas/ thabs rgyud las shes rab kyi —103—

rgyud zab bo/ /des na shes rab rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang /sngags dang cho ga rgyas par ston pa de ni ma rgyud ces bya ste/ 'di la yang yab yum cha mnyam par ston pa dang / yum gyi rigs shas cher ston pa ste rigs gnyis yod do/ /gzhan dag thabs snying rje dang / shes rab stong nyid/ thabs spyod pa dang / shes rab lta ba/ thabs sgyu lus dang / shes rab 'od gsal/ thabs bskyed rim dang / shes rab rdzogs rim/ thabs snang ba bzhi dang / shes rab dag pa bzhi ston tshul gyi sgo nas 'byed par 'dod pa dang / gzhan yang sku'i rnam 'gyur rgyan cha lugs rtsa dang rlung sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba mdzad pa dang / pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis thabs shes phyogs re dang / gnyis med kyi rgyud thabs shes zung 'jug yin zer ba sogs 'dod tshul skyon dang bcas pa yin pas rang lugs la mi bzhed do/ /de las pha rgyud la dbye na 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud dang / zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud dang / gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud do/ /dbye ba 'di rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyan gyi rgyud las pond/ dang po ni/ gsang 'dus yan lag dang bcas pa dang / gshin rje gshed dgra nag dang / gdong drug pa dang / gshed dmar dang / rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba la sogs pa'o/ /dang po gsang 'dus la rgyud kyi dbang du byas na rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma dang /bshad rgyud kyi rigs la dgongs pa lung ston rdo rje 'phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa la sogs pa'i/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po slob dpon so so'i lugs srol ltar na/ spyir rgya gar yul du gsang 'dus la lugs nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod par grags/ bod du 'gyur ba la 'phags bskor zhes bya ba klu sgrub lugs/ slob —104—

dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/ slob dpon sharnyi pa'i lugs/ rdo rje bzhad pa'i lugs/ pad+ma badz+ra gyi lugs/ kun snying gi lugs te drug go /de'i phyi ma ni rgya gar mkhas pas bkral ba tsam yin yang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud yin nges pa zhig phyis yo ga'i tshul du bkral ba yin pas mkhas pa chen po rnams mi 'thad par bzhed/ gzhan rnams lugs rnam par dag pa yin no/ /dang po 'phags lugs ni dbang chog nyi shu pa/ sgrub thabs mdo byas/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga dang / spyod bsdus sgron me/ 'grel pa sgron gsal dang bcas pa'i skor rnams yin/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub mi yul du mngon sum par bzhugs shing / tshogs gsum gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa'i skabs gdul bya dus la ma bab pa 'di rnams gzhan la dngos su ma grags/ klu'i byang chub ces bya ba'i slob ma gcig kho na la bshad/ de grub pa thob nas 'chi ba med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs la/ phyis klu sgrub sku 'das nas lo bdun brgya tsam lon pa na klu'i byang chub dngos su mjal ba'i slo ba dpon ma ta lha pa dang / rgyal sras pa 'dres pa gnyis las rgya cher 'phel zhing dar ba yin/ gnyis pa ye shes zhabs lugs ni/bod kyi rgyal po mes ag tshom can khri lde gtsug brtan gyi dus tsam na slob dpon 'di byung ba yin/ 'dis slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang 'jo sgeg rdo rje dang / rnal 'byor ma gu ṇi ru dang / rnal 'byor ma dza ti dza la dang / slob dpon byis pa'i zhabs dang / grub thob srung ba'i zhabs rnams bsten/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang nus mthu dpag tu med pa thob/ da dung gnas lugs ma rtogs te sgrub pa mdzad pas/ 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin par lung bstan/ sa —105—

phyogs zhig tu 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid khyim btsun rig ma dang bcas pa'i tshul du gzigs/ gsol ba btab pas 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor dngos su gyur te dbang bskur/ gdams pa bstan/ ye shes khyad par can brnyes/ zas dang spyod pa dang cha byad gsum la ma dad pas lus gnas ma gyur/ bar dor sangs rgya bar lung bstan/ bi kra ma la shī la'i rab gnas dang /rdo rje gdan mchod pa dang / nā lan+da btul ba dang / gnod gnas dbang pos yon bdag byed pa sogs che ba sogs che ba dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon des/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gsung la zin bris 'jam dpal zhal lung bsdus/ sgrub thabs kun bzang / rdzogs rim grol pa'i thig le sogs mdzad/rjes 'brang so sos rgyud bshad 'grel pa rigs mi gcig pa mdzad pa mang du yod/ dngos slob mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba 'ja' lus ye shes kyi sku thob pa bzhi byung ste/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rab zhi bzhes gnyen/ rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin no/ gzhan rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa zhes bya ba bskyed rim la brtan par thob/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma bco brgyad byung / 'phags zhabs kyi lugs 'di gnyis rgya bod gnyis kar du shin tu dar la/ slob dpon rab zhi ye shes kyi 'grel pa sogs zhabs lugs cung zad tsam/ snga 'gyur gyi dus su yang byung /phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags/ lo tsā ba ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs kyis cung zad dar bar mdzad/ 'phags lugs ni bstan pa snga dar la ma byung phyi 'gyur la —106—

lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / 'gos khug pa/ lho brag mar ba/ chag lo sogs kyis dar bar mdzad cing / bar skabs su 'gos kyi slob brgyud sdog ston yab sras rnams kyis shin tu dar bar mdzad/gsum pa shwarnyi pa'i lugs la/ 'grel chen snyim pa'i me tog tsam zhig 'gyur ba dang / bzhi pa rdo rje bzhad pa'i lugs ni snga dar gyi dus lce bkra shis dang ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/ lnga pa pad+ma badz+ra gyi lugs la rgyud don nyams len gyi rim pa gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/ 'di gsum la dbang bshad man ngag ring du ma dar bar mngon/ rgyud zla gsang thig le dang / rdo rje snying rgyan/ nor thig rnams rgyud tsam zhig 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje gi ded nag po dang / gdong drug dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed de nag po skor gsum du grags pa la/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags dang / skyo 'od 'byung dang / zhang lo shes rab bla ma dang / gnyos lo tsā ba dang /klog skya shes rab brtsegs te lo tsā ba lnga po de las brgyud pa da lta'i bar ma nub pa yod/ gzhan rong zom chos bzang dang / ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa sogs sngon dus lugs gzhan yang mang du byung / rgya gar du la lī ta badz+ra chung ba dang /a mo gha badz+ra che chung dang / grub thob dpal 'dzin dang / slob dpon 'jam dpal ye shes la sogs pas bstan bcos mang du mdzad mod/ lugs srol tha dad pa'i dbye ba ma byung ngo / /de las dgra nag gdong drug gnyis 'dod chags kyi rgyud du gtogs la/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ni zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud yin par rtog pa bdun pa nyid las bshad do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni bstan pa —107—

snga dar gyi dus su 'gyur la phyi 'gyur rgyud 'grel gnyis tsam lo chen gyis bsgyur/ gzhan phyi dar la 'gyur byed ma byung / gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/spyir 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba yin cing / bod du 'gyur ba la mtshan brjod phan yon dang bcas pa kho na'o/ /'di dngos bla med kyi pha rgyud yin yang rgyud kun gyi bdag por gsungs pas slob dpon so sos sna tshogs su bkral te byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dus 'khor gyi lugs su bkral la/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal grags pa dang / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis yo gar bkral/slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes bla med pha rgyud du bkral/ gzhan yang bod dang rdzogs chen dang rgya gar du dbu mar bkral ba sogs kyang yod par grags so/de ltar pha rgyud rigs gsum po de dag mtshan dang mthun pa'i brjod bya ston tshul so sor yod de 'dus pa sogs bskyed rim gyi skabs su yab yum kha sbyor gyi sku dang / zhu ba glus bskul ba dang / 'khor tshogs yum gyi mngal nas spro ba sogs dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs su las rgya rig ma bsten pa gtso bor 'chad pa sogs chags lam gtso bor ston/ gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa dang /drag po mngon spyod cung zad tsam las rgyas par mi 'byung / rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu zhe sdang gi rgyud las ni lha'i rnam pa yab rkyang gtso bo dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs kyang rlung dbu mar 'gog pa'i thabs rang lus gtso che ba dang / drag po mngon spyod kyi las kho na rgyas par 'chad/ mtshan brjod lta bu gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud la lha yab rkyang ngam kha sbyor yod du chug kyang zhu ba glus bskul dang gag 'khor rnams mngal 'byin med cing / gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi —108—

gnas tshul rgyas par 'chad/ rdzogs rim kyang rnam par mi rtog pa nyid gtso bror 'don/ drag las dang chags lam sogs zur tsam ma gtogs rgyas par ma gsungs pas/ dbye ba de ltar shes dgos kyi kha cig rnam snang sgyu dra gti mug dang / gshin rje gshed dmar nag zhe sdang rigs kyi rgyud du 'dod pa sogs rgyud rang rang gi brjod bya'i don dang mi mthun/ gzhin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud la pha rgyud dang ma rgyud/ rigs gnyis ka yod/ le'u bcu dgu pa ni pha rgyud yin/chags can gyi rgyud du gtogs/ le'u nyer gnyis pa ni ma rgyud he ru ka'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i dbye ba shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ma rgyud la dbye na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs/ he ru ka'i rigs/ rtag pa'i rigs/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs/ rta'i rgyal po'i rigs te drug yod pa las/ dang po ni dus kyi 'khor lo dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa yin te/ dus 'khor rgya gar yul du shin tu dar yang rgyud dang 'grel pa gnyis ka zhal gsal bas lugs srol mi 'dra ba med/slob dpon dus zhabs pa chen po 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / slob dpon tsi lu pa dang/ pi ṭa a tsar ya gsum so sos re re zhing sham+bha la nas spyan drangs pa la sho lo ka re re gnyis gnyis mang nyung yod zer/ bod yul 'dir snga phyir lo tsā ba so sos bsgyur bas 'gyur mi gcig pa nyer bzhi tsam yod par grags/ de dag las rwa lo chos rab/ 'bro lo shes rab grags/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ tsa mi ngag dhi sum g.yod/༵/ snro tshog ༵ snra ༵ zlo rno rli rno/ dhi~X rnyi ༵ ༵ sna~X ༵/ —109—

rgyud ma chad par bzhugs/ rgyud 'di las dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis gsungs te sgrub le las sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / ye shes le'u las/ sdom chen sdom chung gnyis/ gsang 'dus lha dgu ma/ bcu gsum ma/bcu bdun ma/ nyer lnga ma/ so gnyis ma/ so bdun ma ste gsang 'dus rigs drug sgyu 'phru/la dra ba zhe gnig ma/ zhe lnga pa/ zhe dgu pa ste rigs gsum/ de ltar bcu gnyis so/ /de rnams kyi nang sel phye ba shin tu mang / sdom pa chung ba ma gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig po de sdom pa la dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor zhes zer ro/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud ni/ snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon hū ka ra dang / thu bo ra dza ha ti la sogs pa dang / lo tsā ba lha rin chen dang / dran pa nam mkha' la sogs pas bsgyur/ phyi dar la lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur/ 'di la rgya gar gyi yul du lugs srol gnyis tsam byung ste/brgya byin sdong po'i lugs dang / bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i lugs gnyis bod du yang 'gyur ro/ /'di las dkyil 'khor rigs drug kar ston kyang / gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas/ rdor sems kyi rigs su bsdu/ /gnyis pa he ru ka'i rigs ni 'khor lo bde mchog dang / dges pa rdo rje dang / ma hā ma ya dang / sangs rgyas thod pa dang / phyag chen thig le rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa dang / a ra snyi'i rgyud gnyis dang bcas pa rnams yin la/de las 'khor lo bde mchog la rgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud gnyis/ bshad rgyud kyi nang nas sdom pa 'byung ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams la dbang bka' re re yod cing / a bhi dha na'i nang nas —110—

gsungs pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur drug 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ bong zhal can/ mchog gi phag mo sogs dbang bka' mang du yod/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang / he ru ka sngon byung la sgos bka' med/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud sa myu ṭa'i kha sbyor rdor sems dang he ru ka bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rgyun yod/ kun gyi rtsa ba rtsa rgyud kyi dbang bshad man ngag gsum la spyir lugs srol shin tu mang ba yod par grags shing / rgya gar gyi grub thob shas che ba zhig rgyud 'di'i grub thob yin par grags pa dang / bod du yang lo dril nag gsum/ laṅka rgyal bzang / rin chen rdo rje/ mi thub zla ba/ bha ba bha dra/ shar phyogs lwa ba pa/ phyag rdor stod 'grel gyi lugs/ stong nyid ting 'dzin gyi lugs rnams 'gyur yod/ dang po gsum dang / phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs la da lta'ang dbang rgyun yod mod/gtso cher rgya bod gnyis kar du shin tu grags che ba'i lugs srol ni/ lha yi ba/dril bu pa/ nag po pa'i lugs gsum yin la/ de'i dang po ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong du nye ba tsam na rgya gar du slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med byon pa dang rags rtsis su dus mnyam pa/ bod yul du chos kyi dbu bsnyengs pa'i rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dang yang dus mtshungs pa tsam la slob dpon pū yi ba byon/ 'di u rgyan gyi rgyal po'i yig mkhan yin/ dang po'i bla ma grub thob shā bā ri pa yin cing / rgya gar shar phyogs bha ga lar nya'i rgyu lto gsol zhing sgrub pa mdzad pas rgya skad du ྅ yi pa bod skad du nya lto bar grags/grub pa brnyes nas yul la u ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po dang blon po rdzu 'phrul gyis btul/ phyis rgyal pos grub pa thob pa dha ri ka pa ste 'khor khri drug stong dang —111—

bcas nga 'ja' lus thob/ blon po grub pa thob pa ni ḍa rmi pa ste 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa 'ja' lus brnyes so/ /slob dpon pū yi pa 'dis bde mchog gi sgrub thabs tsam zhig mdzad/ de la lwa ba pas 'grel pa mdzad/ rgya bod thams cad du shin tu dar shing 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos tshul chu mgo lta bur grags so/ /'di'i mtshan sa skṛ ta'i skad du lha yi pa dang / zur chag gi skad lo i pa yin/ lu hi pa zer ba ma dag go /gnyis pa dril bu lugs ni/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu par grags pa 'di/ dang po grub thob dha ri ka pa'i slob ma yin/ mtshan dngos blo gros snying po'i dpal zhes bya/ mu stegs pa'i rgol ba 'joms nus pa'i mkhas pa yin pa las rdo rje phag mos dngos su lung bstan/ o ḍi bi sha'i yul du bsgrub pa mdzad tshe/dang po rgyal pos spyan drangs pa la ma byon/ phyir rig ma dang bcas par gyur pa la skye bo rnams ma dad pas de rnams 'dul ba'i don du khye'u gcig dang / bu mo gcig sprul/ lan cig grong khyer du de dag bcas te byon pas skye bo rnams kyis smad pa na/ rwa'i gshor zhal sa la brdabs pas sa 'og nas chu byung / khye'u rdo rjer byas/ bu mo dril bur song de gnyis phyag gnyis su bsnams slob dpon yab yum bde mchog lhan skyes kyi rnam par gyur nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pas mtshan yang rdo rje dril bu par grags/ de nas brtsams te sngags kyi theg pa'i 'gro don mdzad/ slob dpon 'dis bde mchog lus dkyil sgrub thabs/ dbang chog rdzogs rim rim lnga rnams mdzad de slob ma yang grub pa thob pa mang du byung ngo / / tshe

gsum pa nag po lugs ni/ shing rta'i srol 'byed slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i 'di ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma dang / mgon po mngon ཿnga las lung bstan te/ dus 'khor las/ kha ṭā cang te chang snod thogs pa nag po'i ming can rnal 'byor 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nag po chen po mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud las/ yul u ru bi sha der skyes bu brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing sbyor ba la brtson pa/ rā ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mthun pa sde tshan dang po'i dang po bdun pa'i bzhi ba cung zad na la zhon pa skyes bu'i mchog 'dis ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slob ma drug gis lus kyi dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /slob dpon 'di'i bla ma ni grub thob dza lan dha ra pa yin/ 'khrungs sa'i yul shar phyogs su u ru bi sha'o/ /yul dbus nā lan dar paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ byang phyogs dza lan+ta rar bla ma dang mjal/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa sa g.yo ba dang brag la thogs pa med pa'i nus pa brnyes/ mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo'i phyag nas nga ṭa'i rgyud spyan dra rnga ris/ ḍa mi to zhes bya ba 'gro lding yul du phra min pa thams cad btu'/ zhing / de rnams kyi gtso mo srin mo sna tshogs gzugs zhes bya ba 'dzam bu gling pa'i skye ngo mang po'i srog 'phrog pa zhig yod pa de 'dul bar byon/ dang por des 'khor mang po dang lhan cig 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis nam mkha' la 'ongs shing mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa la/ slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas sa la lhung zhing brgyal/ ting nge 'dzin gyis —113—

gzir dam 'og tu btsud pas de phyin chad 'byon pa na chibs dang / bzhugs pa na gdan du lus phul te gdug pa'i skye bo mang po skrag cing zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa dang / gdugs bdun 'dzin pa med par rang 'khor/ ḍa ma ru bdun 'brol ba po med par rang 'brol/ khru gang gis sa la ma reg par rtag tu 'byon/dus rtag tu snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang / mi snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang / grub pa thob pa stong dang bzhi brgya'i 'khor gyis skor la/ yul gru chen po bcu gsum gyi skye bo thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i chos la bkod pas de thams cad rnal 'byor po mor gyur te grong khyer rnams stongs par gyur skad/ bla ma'i bka' cung zad bcag pas/ sku lus de la mchog gi dngos grub ma brnyes kyang / ral gri la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad thob/ bar dor sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes pa yin no/ /'di'i slob ma'i mchog drug ni/ e ya la dang / ma hi la dang / dha ma pa dang / dhu ma pa dang / bzang po'i zhabs dang / dge tshul tshem bu pa rnams so/ /slob dpon 'dis 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dbang chog sbyin sreg ste bskyed rim gzhung gsum dang / dpyid kyi thig le dang rim pa bzhi pa dang / gsang ba'i de kho na nyid de rdzogs rim gzhung gsum mo/ /de ltar na nag po gzhung drug tu grags so/ /spyir do ha rdo rje'i glu sogs bstan bcos phra mo brgya dang nyi shu tsam yod par grags/ bod du yang thor bu mang du 'gyur ro/ /brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams su byon zhing mu stegs grub thob kriṣ+ṭha bhi ma dang ka rdzo rgyal po sogs btul/ shar phyogs bhang ga lar rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo thams cad —114—

mu stegs par yod pa/ he ru ka mnan pa'i dbang phyug gi bris sku/ dbang phyug mnan pa'i he ru kar song ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pas/ bhang ga la ba ril gyis sangs rgyas par song / grub pa'i slob dpon ches che ba'o/ /bde mchog gi chos skor khung ma rnams kyi nang nas lugs 'di rgyas shos yin/ phyis jo bo nā ro pa'i lugs 'di kho na gtso bor mdzad do/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i chos skor de rnams bod du byung tshul ni/ snga dar dus 'di ma 'gyur/ phyi dar gyi thog ma lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / laṅka rgyal bzang gi lugs dang / lha yi pa'i lugs dang / rin chen rdo rje'i lugs rnams bsgyur/ gzhan yang lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ ma nang pa chos kyi shes rab/ mal blo gros grags pa/ mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug pu rangs lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ rwa lo rdo rje grags/ klog skya lo tsā ba shes rab brtsegs/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/smon 'gro'i mar pa dang dar ma rdo rje/ 'dzim lo tsā ba/ bra bo lo tsā ba ste lo tsā bco lnga'i bde mchog rtsa rgyud bsgyur cing bshad/ de rnams kyi nang nas rwa lo mal mar do/ pu rangs lo chung ste lo tsā ba bzhi po 'dis ྅ dril nag gsum gyi man ngag dbang bka' rgyud bshad dang bcas pa shin tu dar bar mdzad cing /da lta'i bar du yang bzhugs pa yin/ bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i skor ni phyis gsum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba yin no/ /kyi rdo rje'i rgyud ni rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang / de'i zugad rgyud du yang sbyor bar mdzad cing rgyud rgyas pa'i don bsdu lta bu'i rgyud rdo rje gur gnyis yin la/ rgya bod mang po —115—

zhig sa sbu ṭi yang kyai rdor gyi bshad rgyud du bzhed mod/ 'di ni bde mchog dang /kyai rdor dang / gdan bzhi gsum cha mnyam pa lta bu yin gyi kyi rdor kho na min no/ /dges rdor la rgya gar du grub thob mang du byon zhing / lugs srol mi 'dra ba'ang mang du yod par grags na'ang / slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje'i lugs/ mi thub zla ba'i lugs/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs te gsum po mi 'dra ba che ba yod la/ gzhan nā ro mi tri sogs kyi lugs ni de gsum kas legs par bsdus pa lta bur yod do/ spyir bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs la ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i 'od dang / yab dpa' bo lha dgu'i sgrub thabs la mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs de gnyis po 'di kyai rdor gyi gzhung snga shos so/ /bod du lha mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis thog mar bsgyur/ g.yin yang lo tsā ba 'tshur dbyig gi snying po dang / rma ban chos 'bar la sogs pas kyang bsgyur zhing bshad mod kyi/ shin tu grags che ba ni 'brog 'gos mar gsum/ dpyal lo bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi lugs te rnam pa bzhi yin la/de las dang po gsum da lta'i bar du yang rgyun mi chad pa yod/ gtso bor 'brog mi'i rjes 'brang sa chen yab sras la kho sbyi'i lugs/ man ngag lugs/ mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs/ nā ro mai tri'i lugs te lugs srol drug byung / phyi ma gnyis da ltar chad/ g.yin rnams la bka' babs bzhi zhes pa lugs phyi rabs pa rnams zer/ 'gos lugs la mtsho skyes lugs dang / sharnyi pa'i lugs gnyis byung / mar lugs dang dpyal lugs gnyis ka nā ro pa'i rjes 'brang riyin/ mar lugs la rngog lugs/ mes tshom po'i lugs/ 'tshur dbang gi rdo —116—

rje'i lugs te gsum byung ba las/ rngog lugs da lta'i bar du yod do/ /de la brtag gnyis las/ sku kyai rdo rje phyag gnyis/ gsung kyi rdo rje phyag bzhi pa/thugs kyi rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ snying po dgyes zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsungs/ rdo rje gur las/ dges rdor rigs lnga so so dang / rigs bsdus dang / rdo rje sgrol ma sogs gsungs shing / gnyis ka nas ku ru ku lce'i sgrub thabs bshad/ re ṭi las/ kyai rdo rje mtshon cha can/ kha sbyor rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gsungs/ sangs rgyas thod pa nas rgya gar du/ grub thob sa ra he'i man ngag gi lugs dang / slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i lugs gnyis byung zhing / bod du yang gyi lo tsā ba'i lugs dang / spong zho gsal ba grags kyi lugs gnyis dang / mar pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbang tsam yod/ mahā ma ya ni grub thob ku ku ri pa zhes bya bas spyan drangs/ des sgrub thabs la sogs pa bstan bcos drug mdzad/slob dpon de nyid rgya gar du slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / bod kyi rgyal po khri srong gi sku tshe'i stod dang dus dang mnyam/ rig ma khyi'i gzugs su bsgyur bas/ ku ku ri pa zhes pa khyi mo can du grags/ g.yin yang slob dpon 'dul bas byin dang / rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba la sogs pas kyang bka' sgrol mi 'dra ba re re dar bar mdzad/ bod du 'gos lo/ jo bo rje/ mar pa lo tsā rnams kyis bsgyur bshad dar bar mdzad cing / mar pa nas rngog pa las brgyud pa da lta'i bar du yang dar ro/ /phyag chen thig le sogs thig le'i skor ni/dpal u rgyan gyi gnas su rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti chung ba'i dus su dar/ lugs —117—

srol mi 'dra bar dgyes pa med/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i slob ma a tsa ra dmar por grags pa slob dpon shes rab gsang bas bod yul du gtsang rong gi lo tsā ba phyug mtshams dgra bcom la bshad/ de dang 'brog mi sogs kyis kyang bsgyur te/ rtsa rgyud phyag chen thig le dang phyogs mthun gyi rgyud gsum yod de/ye shes thig le/ ye shes snying po/ rnal 'byor ma gsang ba'i sgron ma rnams so/rgyud 'di rnams kyai rdor gyi rgyud du 'dod pa dag ni mi 'thad de/ phyag thig nyid las/ 'dus pa'am ni kye rdo rje/ /der yang 'di ni ma bstan no/ /zhes kyai rdor las phyag chen thig le nyid lhag cing zab par bsngags brjod mdzad pas so//brjod bya ston tshul yang mi mtshungs pa cher yod cing / rgyud 'di bzhi las rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam gzhag shin tu zhib pa dang / sa lam mang po dang dbang gsum pa'i chags lam kho na rgyas par bshad do/ /rdo rje a ra snyi dang / ṛ gi a ra lnga'i rgyud ni grub thob ḍom+bhi he ru kas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas spyan drangs/ bod yul du 'brog mis bsgyur/ dbang bshad man ngag gi bka' ni ma byung mod/ rgyud gzhan la ma ltos pa'i rang rkang pa re yin pa snga ma dges rdor dang mthun shas che la/ phyi ma bde mchog dang mthun shas che'o/ /mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud gnyis kyang he ru ka'i rigs su bsdus na legs so/ /gsum pa rtag pa'i rigs ni bod du 'gyur ba gdan bzhi kho na yin la/ 'di la gdan bzhi rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud man+t+ra e sa dang sbyor ba'i rab dbye ste gnyis rgyud gsum yod/ rgya gar du rtsa rgyud la brten pa ār+ya de ba'i lugs dang / bsdus rgyud la brten pa slob dpon bha ba bha dra'i lugs gnyis gsal bar byung la/ bod du paṇ+ḍi ta 'e ta'i rang —118—

'gyur gyi skor dang / 'gos khug pa'i lugs dang / lho brag mar pa'i lugs rnams byung / da lta yang dbang rgyud bshad man ngag rnams tshang bar bzhugs so/ /de ltar na mar pa la ni gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang / dges skor dang /ma hā ma ya dang / gdan bzhi'i chos skor rnams zab rgyas su bzhugs/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang rgyun tsam yod/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos skor ni rdzogs par mi bzhugs pas/ mar pa nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog gi skor yin zer ba rnams ni bod du gsar bcos yin par nges so/ /bzhi pa rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ phyogs 'dir 'gyur ba rdo rje bdud rtsi kho na yin zhing / rgyud 'di grub thob bdud rtsi gsang bas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas spyan drangs/ rgya gar du slob dpon dri med bzang po'i lugs dang /slob dpon bha go zhes pa skal ldan gyi lugs te gnyis byung / bod du dang po byung ba ni lo tsā ba lce btsan skyes kyis bsgyur/ phyis 'e ti dang gyi co zla ba'i 'od zer gyis chos skor ci rigs bsgyur/ da lta rdo rje 'phreng ba'i nang gi dbang rgyun tsam zhig bzhugs/ lnga pa pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs la/ pad+ma gar dbang nyid kyi rtog pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba dang / rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/ drug pa rta'i rgyal po'i rigs kyi rgyud ni sngon snga dar gyi dus su dpal bdun pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud 'gyur te/ da lta bka' sogs med/ sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang / phur pa rtsa dum sogs kyang rigs 'di'i nang tshan yin zhing /mgon po mngon byung gi rgyun kyang 'phrin las kyi rigs yin pas phyogs 'dir —119—

bsdu/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba gsar du bsgyur pa 'di ni grub thob rol pa'i rdo rje dang log pra da gnyis kyis sgrub thabs so sor mdzad pas lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod cing / phyis grub pa'i dbang phyug zhi ba sbas pas dar bar mdzad de/ slob dpon pa ba rgyu nā tha dang / bzhi gup+ta nā tha dang / ga rla badz+ra ste gsum las 'jam mgon tā ra nā thas gsan zhing bsgyur bar mdzad pa yin/ rgyud 'di las sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / dbugs dbyung drug la sogs pa dkyil 'khor yang mang du 'byung zhing /rdzogs rim rgyas par bshad do/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba rnams bshad nas/ de dag gi lam gyi rim pa ni gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum mo/ /dang po rgyu rgyud ni sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal pa gdod ma nas bde ba dang stong pa dang gsal ba zung 'jug tu gnas pa de yin pas lam yang bde ba dang / stong pa dang lha sku gsal bar bsgoms pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i dus su yang stong pa chos kyi sku dang / bde ba longs sku dang / gsal ba dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sprul sku ste/ sku gsum thob tu rung ba'i nus mthu can sems la sku gsum sa bon gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa thabs rgyud ni smin grol gnyis te/ smin byed kyi dbang la dbang bzhi tshang ba ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba yin la/ bum dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon dang ras bris dang lus dkyil gsum gsal bar —120—

gsungs shing / blos slangs la sogs pa yang don gyis thob pa yin/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor de dag bdag mdun dbyer med dam tha dad gang rung gi sgo nas sgrubs shing mchod dgos pa yin la/ dbang bskur ba ni/ phyi nang gi 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas/ chu cod pan/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming ste rig pa'i dbang lnga dang /slob dpon dang / brtul zhugs dang / rjes gnang dang / lung bstan dang /dbugs dbyung dang / gzengs bstod de/ de rnams bum dbang yin la/ rjes gsang ba/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang dang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes dang / don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa rnams bskur ba yin/ yang dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/byis 'jug bdun dang / dbang gong ma bzhi gsungs te/ chu dang / cod pan dang / dar dpyangs dang / rdor dril dang / brtul zhugs dang / ming dang / rjes gnang ste/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun no/ /dbang gong ma la slob ma'i dbang gong ma dang / rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang / slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang te gsum po de dag re re la'ang bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa rnams su phye bas bcu gnyis su 'gyur la/ 'di skabs kyi bum dbang ni gzhan gyi bum dbang dang mi gcig ste/ bum pa zhes pa brdas bstan pa yin pas phyag rgya'i lus mtshon pa yin/ des na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ gzhan rnams spyi 'gros dang gnad gcig pa yin no/de ltar na bla med kyi rgyud sde 'dir khams gsum dkyil 'khor du dag pa dang gnyis sbyor 'od gsal lam du byed pa rgyas par bshad do/ /—121—

gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam la bskyed rim ni brdzus skyes dang mtshungs pa skad cig gis bskyed pa dang / drod gsher skyes dang mtshungs par sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed pa dang / sgong skyes dang mtshungs pa mngon par byang chub lnga las bskyed pa dang / mngal skyes dang mtshungs pa zhu ba glus bskul dang / mkha' nang nas spro ba sogs yin cing / mngon rtogs tshar gcig la 'chi ba dang bar do dang / skye ba gsum sbyang ba'i thabs tshang ba/ chos longs sprul gsum lam du byed nus pa cig dgos te/ de yang lha gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba/ 'khor tshogs spro ba dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dag pa dran pa dang / phra thig bsgom pa sogs las rgyal mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsum tshang ba'am/ bsnyen pa/ nye sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen te bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi tshang pa'i/ rnal 'byor/rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor chen po ste rnal 'byor bzhi cha tshang ba gang rung zhig dgos/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag tu bzlas pa dang gtor ma gnyis/ kha zas dang rjes chags gnyis/ nyal ba dang ldang ba dang gnyis/spyod lam dang mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis te rnal 'byor brgyad po de rnams dgos la/ sbyin sreg dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs la'ang bslab par bya'o/ /rdzogs rim ni klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa/ sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa mngon par byang chub kyi rim pa/ zung 'jug gi rim pa ste rim pa lngar bzhed la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ni snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le/ gsang bar rdzas kyi thig le/ sna sgor sprul pa'i thig le/ chos nyid ye shes kyi thig le ste —122—

thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhir 'dus par bzhed la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i bzhed pa ni/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa/ dza lan+ta ra'i rim pa/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ste bde mchog rim lngar grags pa ltar yin/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa ni rgyud kyi rim pa/ sngags kyi rim pa/ ye shes kyi rim pa/ gsang ba'i rim pa ste rim pa bzhi lam thams cad bsdus par bzhed do/ /dus 'khor dang gzhan yang rgyud mang por/ /so sor sdud dang bsam gto dang / /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces rnal 'byor yan lag drug gis bsdus par bzhed do/ /thams cad mthun par/gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi rtsa dang / rlud dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor shes nas dmigs pa dang / rlung spyor dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas rang lus rtsa dbu ma la gnad du bsnun pa dang / byang chub kyi sems kun+da lta bu dbab bzung bzlog khyab kyi rim pas rjes chags kyi dga' ba bzhi ngos 'dzin pa gzhan lus shes rab kyi lam dang / lus ngag gi rtsol ba dang / yid rnam rtog gis ma brtags par stong gzugs phyag rgya chen pos mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen 'dres pa ste rdzogs rim thams cad kyang gsum du 'dus so/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis la brtan pa thob pa na/ brtul zhugs kyi spyad pa spyod dgos pa las de la dbye na spros bcas spros med/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum mam/ yang na kun 'dar/ kun bzang / phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ste gsum du yod do/ /brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i ngo bo ni sems bde ba r+ṣa por shar ba dang rkyen —123—

las kyi phyag rgya sogs bsten pa'i bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gcig gi steng du/phyi bde sdug gi snang ba thams cad ro mnyam du bsre ba yin la/ de ltar spyod pa la brten nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu rgyud la thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub gnyis las/ thun mong la phra mo'i chung ngu las rim sna tshogs ni zhi rgyas dbang dgug bsad bskrad dbye mnan te las chen brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /'bring rdzas kyi dngos grub ni sa 'og dang / ral gri dang / ril bu dang / mig sman dang / rkang mgyogs dang / bcud len dang / ro langs dang / gter gyi dngos grub ste dngos grub brgyad do/ /chen po las kyi rig 'dzin ni/ 'dod khams kyi lha'i gzugs khams kyi lha dang bskal ba mnyam pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal lnga'o/ /gnyis pa mchog gi dngos grub la gnas skabs su sngags kyi lam la brten nas 'phags pa'i sa thob pa zung 'jug gi sku dang / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grub pa gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas ni sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'phrin las dang bcas pas bsdus pa'o/ /chos longs sprul gsum gyi steng du bde ba chen po'i sku bsnan pa ni sku bzhi dang / chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya ba sgrub ste ye shes lnga dang / 'phrin las ni theg pa gzhan du bshad pa dang thun mong pa yang yod/ rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor sprul bshad sogs thun mong ma yin pa yang yod do/ /de thams cad bsdu na yan lag bdun dang / dbang phyug brgyad du 'du/ ji skad du/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas yan lag bdun pa'i gzhung du/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/—124—

snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ces yan lag bdun no/ /gsang 'dus kyi 'grel chen sgron gsal las/ rgyud rgyas pa'i lung drangs pa na/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod byed dang yon to brgyad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te phyi ma gnyis ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang / yon tan gyi dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje theg pa'i gnas lugs gsal byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhas grub du ma'i gtsug rgyan 'jam mgon kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rdo rje'i gsung las byon pa dgas la spyod pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bla na bkur ba dang 'gro ba kun la phan bde'i dpal yon rtag tu sbyin pa'i snying stobs can kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya bas gsar du bsgrigs pa'i dge ba 'dis kyang skye dgu mtha' dag zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zhus dag/ //ma ṅga la//sna—125—

pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya be bzhugs/swā sti/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa mchog gi zhabs rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan zab gsal gnyis med dkyil 'khor las/ /ma lus rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs spro ba/ /bde stong mkha' la ye shes 'od ris shar/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ni las dang po la nyer mkho ba/ /cung zad bdag gis rnam par dbye 'dod na/ khres ldan rnams kyis sngon med nyung ngu'i gtam/ /'gro la phan pa'i rgyu ru mnyan pa'i rigs/ /sdom ni/ rgyud kyi rang bzhin de don sgom tshul dang / /rgyud rnams bshad pa'i man ngag ces bya'o/ /'dir rdo rje'i theg pa'i don ni 'di tsam ste/ rgyud rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / de'i don sgom tshul dang / rgyud bshad thabs te gsum po 'di dag go/de la rgyud ces bya ba ni sngags rnams dang de'i cho ga'o/ /de ston par byed pa'i bka'i tshogs la yang rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod dang rgyud ces bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dang / sngags kyi sde snod dang / chos 'di pa rnams kyi rgyud dang / rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod ces pa rnams grangs so/ /rdo rje theg pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes pa yang rnam grangs so/ /ci sngags dang rgyud so so'i skye bos byas pa —126—

dag yod dam/ yod de/ phyugs bdag gis byas pa dang / drang srong gis byas pa dang / lha dang 'byung po dang / gsang ba pa dag dang / sngags mkhan dag gis byas pa dag yin te/ de dag ni rdo rje theg pa dang / sngags kyi sde snod ni ma yin te/ gzhan du sngags dang rgyud ces bya'o/ /yong ye sngags kyi theg pa zhes bya ba ni ji zhig dbye ba ni gang dngos dang ming gis btags pa'i khyad par ni ci zhe na/rig sngags kyi sbyor ba gco bor ston pa'i lam dang / de'i 'bras bu ni sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /de yang rnam par dbye na/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i theg pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang / gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / de dag gi lam dang /gzugs med pa'i khams su skye ba gzhan la sngags kyi sbyor bas bgrod par byed pa'i lam rnams so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa gang zhe na/ theg pa gsum po dag go /'jig rten pa'i theg pa ni ming tsam ste/ go 'phang mi g.yo ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang / de la nges par 'jug pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang / yul dus nye tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten los 'das pa'i ni dngos te/ rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /de'i yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni gtso bo ma yin no/gang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod 'dir 'jig rten pa'i sbyor ba de dag 'jig rten pa'i theg pa zhes bya'am zhe na de ltar yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la dngos btags kyis dbye na/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i theg pa yang rnam pa gsum ste/'jig rten pa nyid kyi theg pa dang / nges pa la 'jug pa'i 'jig rten pa dang /sems kyi rten 'jig rten pa'o/ /dang po ni so so'i skye bos byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa —127—

tshe ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las 'byung ba 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi lam dang / sbyor ba'i lam mo/ /de la phyi ma gnyis ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sder gtogs te/ de ston par byed pa rnams kyang de'i sde snod du gtogs so/ /'phags pa'i sems can gyis rang dgar byas pa yang /de'i sder gtogs mod kyi/ 'on kyang sde snod ni ma yin no/ /bar sdom ni/ ngo bo rnam grangs 'jig rten pa'i/ /rgyud dang sngags kyi spre theg pa yi/ /rang bzhin dbye ba dngos btags khyad/ /'jig rten pa yi dbye ba'o/ khyud kyi ngo bo dang / rnam grangs dang / 'jig rten pa'i rgyud dang / sngags kyi theg pa'i rang bzhin dang /dbye ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'i dbye ba'o/ /'di la mdo dang rgyud ni ci zhe na/ 'dir mdo ni gcig las 'phros pa la sogs pa phal cher dag go /rgyud ni mkha' lding gi sbyor ba la sogs pa'o/ /mdo yang yin la rgyud kyang yin pa ni/sngags kyi sde snod de rnams so/ /gnyis ka ma yin pa ni rtog ge la sogs pa'o/ /rgyu'i theg pa dang 'bras bu'i theg pa'i khyad par gang zhe na/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya ba lha'i rnal 'byor gyi khyad par ro/ /pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul dang / sngags kyi tshul gyi khyad par gang zhe na/ sngags dang sbyor ba gtso bor ston pa dang / ma yin pa'i khyad par ro/ /ci'i phyir sngags kyi tshul mchog tu gyur pa yin/ sngags kyi tshul rnams ni du zhe na/ las dang po la thabs su gyur pa ste/myur ba dang / bde ba dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /ji ltar myur ba yin zhe na/ skye ba 'di'am/ skye ba bcu drug gam/ bskal pa gsum mam/ bskal pa brgyad kyi byang chub thob pa'o/ /rgyu cis myur ba yin zhe —128—

na/ cho ga'i khyad par gyis lha rnams dngos su mchod pa len pas yongs su spyad pa las byung pa'i bsod nams yod pa dang/ sngags kyi mthus chu thigs pa gcig la yang ga d+ma'i bye snyed kyi bsod nams 'byung ba dang / las dang po pas ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog pa'i zhing sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byed pa dang /sngags sam ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par re res kyang sems can rnams smin pa'i rgyu khyad nga ra can 'di dag theg pa la zhugs pa tsam la yang yod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyis gzugs bden pa gnyis ka'i tshul gyis 'bras bu'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i shes rab rnams dang po dang tha ma'i bar du yod pas na'o/ /ji ltar na bde ba yin zhe na/ lus dang sems la tshor ba rtsub po med pa nyid do/ /rgyu cis bde ba yin zhe na/ 'di la bskal pa drug dang ldan pa'i lus dang grub pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang ting nge 'dzin mang po thob pa dang / sngags kyi mthus sangs rgyas rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang / sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba'i bsam pa thams cad bsgrubs pas na'o/ /thabs sa la mkhas pa gang zhe na /tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang /spyod yul la 'jug pa rnams kyi'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / tshu la khrims mnyam (ma tos pas lha dges pa dang / spyod yul khyad par can dang 'brel pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / gzhan dag ni theg pa chen po tshul nyid kyi bslab pa gsum dang / spyod yul thams cad du lha dang sngags kyi thabs yod do/ /bya ba'i rgyud chen po'am/ spyod pa'i rgyud dam/ gnyis ka'i rgyud ces bya ba 'di lha'i bsnyems pa rgyas pa'i tshul gyis 'jug go /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la ni —129— —

lha'i bsnyems pa khyab pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med par ni bde ba'i sdom pa tshul khrims dang / bag chags dang / spyod pa dang / gong ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bde ba khyab pa dang / spyod yul de nyid la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang / snying rje chen po dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / rang bzhin med pa dang / bde ba dang / lha'i rnam pas khyab pa dang / des de dag nyid mchog la sbyor bas spyod yul la 'jug go /tshul khrims ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang / rgya che ba dang / zab pa'i khyad par dang ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyang thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang / rgya che ba dang / zab pa'i khyad par ro/ /ci'i phyir bde ba chen pos myur zhe na/ bde ba ni snying rje'i rang bzhin/ de nyid rang bzhin med cing / dmigs pa med par mngon sum mam/ mngon sum gyi tshul gyis las dang po bas bskyed pas/ bde bas stong pa phul du 'gyur ba mngon sum gyi rnam pa dang / des kyang bsod nams phul du phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bar bsdom ni/ rgyud dang 'bras dang sngags kyi khyad/ /myur bde thabs mkhas rnams kyis mchog /myur dang bde la ji ltar rgyu/ /yongs spyad 'phel dang sbyong dang smin/ khres rab kyis myur lus ting 'dzin/ /mngon sum bzhugs dang bsam pa sgrub/ /bslab gsum spyod yul bla med la/ /thun mong min dang rgya che zab/ 'dir sngags kyi tshul ni gsum ste/ mchog dang dman pa dang yan lag go /de'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ bde ba chen po dang / lha'i bsnyems pa dang / sngags dang sbyor ba tsam dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni dngos dang / sngags kyi theg pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul dang / sdom pa dang 'brel ba yin no/ /phyi ma ni —130—

rnams ma yin te gzhan du na/ sngags pa zhes pa tsam mo/ /yang sngags kyi tshul bdun te/ gtan du ba'i lam dang / cha shas can dang / khyad par du gyur pa dang /dang por bden pa dang / phal cher bde chen gyi tshul dang / 'ga' zhig bde chen dang / cung zad bde chen gyi tshul lo/ /'dir thams cad bde chen zhes bya ba yod mod kyi/ de ni gto du ba'i lam nyid du 'gyur ro/ /bar sdom ni/ gsum la dbye ba ngo bo dang / khyad par dang ni tshul bdun no/ /sngon chad kha ba can 'dir ni/ /sngags par smra ba shas ches kyang / 'di ni ma rtogs 'di rtogs pa/bla ma rnams kyi drin nyid de/ /tshul 'di ji bzhin ma shes pas/ /mdo rgyud khyad par mkhas pas kyang / /rnam pa kun tu ma phyed cing / /'phags pa rnams kyi gtam 'di yin/ zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de la rgyud dang sngags ni rnam par dbye bar bya ste/ de la sngags gang zhe na/ gsang sngags rnams dang / bde ba chen po'i ye shes so/ khyud gang zhe na/de'i sbyor ba ste/ las dang dngos grub kyi tshogs rnams so/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi rim par phye ba ste dang po'o/ /de la de nyid rnam par bshad par bya ste/ rgyu'i rgyud dang / thabs kyi rgyud dang / 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /de skad du yang / rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ khyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang ngo bo rang bzhin dang / /mi 'phrogs pa yi rab phye ba/ zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo / /ngo bo gtso bo mtshan nyid dang / /rnam grangs ldan pa gnas skabs dang / /mi 'gyur bas kyang rgyu rgyud bsdus/ /rgyu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ thog ma med pa'i dus rnams nas rgyud de 'ongs pa sems —131—

rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba gang yin pa dang / sems dang sems las byung ba rnams dang / snod dang bcud kyi rang bzhin dang / rtsa dang rlung dang / khams dang ka chos kyi dbyings gang yin pa de rnams so/ /de rnams kyi gtso bo ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nyid gang zhe na/ zhing dang / sku dang / ye shes la sogs pa 'bras bu'i chos mthun pa'i khyad par can/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po rgyun chad pa med pa/ chos nyid kyis thob pa ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyu'i rgyud dang / sbyang gzhi dang / kun gzhi dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas ni rnam grangs so/ /rgyu ni du/ gzhi ni du/ kun gzhi ni du/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ni du zhe na/ rgyu ni bcu bzhi ste/ nyon mongs pa'i rgyu dang / las kyi rgyu dang / sdug bsngal gyi ste kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dang / snod dang / bcud dang / lam gyi rgyu dang / stong pa dang / bde ba dang / zung du 'jug pa'i rgyu dang / rags pa dang /phra ba dang / shin tu phra ba'i rgyu dang / gzugs kyi sku gnyis dang / chos kyi sku'i rgyu rnams so/ /gzhi ni bco lnga ste/ snod dag pa'i gzhi dang / bcud dag pa'i gzhi dang / nyer spyod dag pa'i gzhi dang / rnam par 'gyur ba dag pa'i gzhi dang /rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhi dang / 'khor ba'i gzhi dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi dang / rang bzhin gyi gzhi dang / rnam grangs kyi gzhi dang / mthar gshugs pa'i gzhi dang / kun rdzob kyi gzhi dang / don dam pa'i gzhi dang / rags pa'i gzhi dang / phra ba'i gzhi dang / shin tu phra ba'i gzhi rnams so/ /dang po lnga ni las dang bya ba'i sgo nas te/ sbyang bya'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gsum ni bcings grol gyi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gnyis gnyis ni dngos dang btags pa ba —132—

dang / rdzas dang btags pa'i rab tu phye ba'o/ /tha mar gsum ni rtogs tshul gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de la rags pa'i gzhi gang zhe na/ dgu po 'di dag ste/gang zag tu btags pas yod pa dag la brjod de/ tsan dan dang / ut+pal dang /pad+ma dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / rin po che lta bu dang / nyon mongs pas rnam par phye ba dang / las kyi rnam par phye ba dang / lus kyi rnam par phye ba dang / rigs kyi rnam par phye ba'o/ /dang po lnga ni mtshan nyid kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /phyi ma bzhi ni rnam grangs kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /'dir kun gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ sde snod kyi tshul las 'byung ba kho na bzhin no/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ni gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi dang po dang / glo bur gyi dang po'i sangs rgyas so/ /'di la ji ltar na skyon dang yon tan dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu dag dang 'brel bar ldan zhe na/ sad pa'i gnas skabs dang / rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang / gnyid stug gi gnas skabs dang / bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba gnas te/ dga' ba bzhi'am snang ba bzhi dang lhan cig gnas pa yin no/ /rlung bzhi dang / thig le bzhi dang / 'khor lo bzhi las dri bcas dang / cung zad dri bral dang / chos dri bral lam/ 'dzag bcas kyi dbang dang / 'dzag med kyi dbang dang / shin tu 'dzag pa dang bral ba'i dbang las rigs bzhi dang / rgyud bzhi dang / 'gro ba bzhi dang / yon tan bzhi dang / thun skrudi bzhi dang / bag chags bzhis rnam par rtog pa bzhi 'byung ste/ thams cad yod par rtog pa dang / rdul phran du rtog pa dang / sems tsam du rtog pa dang / de yang mi dmigs pa ste/ grub mtha' bzhi dang / sde pa bzhi dang / skad cig ma bzhi dang / dga' ba bzhi dang / bden pa —133—

bzhi la sgro 'dogs pa'am de dag la ji bzhin du rtogs pa ste/ de bzhin du e wa ma yā dang / gnas bzhi dang / rigs bzhi'i phyag rgyas dri ma sbyong ba'i khyad par dang / sku bzhi dang / rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa ji ltar rgyud las rgyas pas 'gyung ba de ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir gnas skabs gang zhe na/ thar pa'i cha mthun ma bskyed pa dang / bskyed pa dang / so so'i skye bo'i lam dang / slob pa'i lam dang / mi slob pa rnams su dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / rgyu'i rgyud dang / lam du zhugs pa dang / 'phags pa dang / 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes ming gis btags so/ /de rnams su 'gyur ba med pa ji lta bu zhe na/ snga ma las phyi ma'i tshe ngo bo mi 'gyur ba ste skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / 'gro ba rnams dang / rten 'brel rnams dang / rigs pa dang / bden pa mthong ba dang /rnam par mi rtog pa la zhugs pa dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang mi 'jig cing mi 'gyur ba'o/ /thabs kyi rgyud gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ dbang bskur dam tshig sdom pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /lnga po 'di dag ni thabs kyi rgyud de/ /dbang bskur ba dang / dam tshig rnams dang / sdom pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / las dang dngos grub kyi sbyor ba'o/ dbang bskur ba gang zhe na/ bum pa dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes dang / bzhi pa dang / 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / slob ma'i dbang dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / tha mal gyi dbang dang / mchog gi dbang dang / 'jug pa'i cho ga dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / lung bstan pa dang / gzengs bstod pa dang / yon dbul ba dang bcas pa rnams so/ /dam tshig gang zhe na/ ngo —134—

bo'i sgo nas bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / sgrub pa'i dam tshig go /bsrung ba'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ rtsa ba'i lhung ba dang / yan lag gi ltung ba la sogs pa bsrung ba nyid do/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba gang zhe na/ bcu bzhi po rnams so/ /yan lag gi ltung ba gang zhe na brgyad dam dgu po rnams so/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /sbun la smad par mi bya zhing / /sems can rnams la byams mi spangs/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /ma smin pa la gsang mi sgrag /phung po rnams la smad mi bya/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi spangs/ /gdug pa can la byams pa spangs/ /ming sogs bral la der mi rtog /dad ldan sems ni sun mi dbyung / /dam tshig spong dang bud med smod/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba zhes brjod do/ /'di dag mi shes mi rung bas/ /sngon gyi mkhan po'i lung las shes/ /zhes pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sgrib pa'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin dang / spyod lam dang /bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / mi 'bral bar yo byad kyi dam tshig go /rigs lnga po rnams kyi dam tshig gang yin pa de rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang dam tshig ni gsum ste las dang po pa dang / brtan pa thob pa dang /brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig rnams so/ /yang dam tshig ni gsum ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ yang gsum ste bum dbang gi dam tshig dang / gsang dbang gi dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i dam tshig dang / 'jig rten pa so so'i sgrub pa'i dang / las so so'i dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa'i dang / sgrub pa chen po'i dam —135—

tshig go /de la dam tshig ces bya ba ni brtul zhugs so/ /sdom pa ni/ thob par byed pa'i cho ga dang / thob pa'i dus dang / ngo bo dang / dbye ba dang / gtong ba'i dus dang / gso ba'i cho ga sde drug po de dag go /sdom ni cho ga dus dang ngo bo dbye/ /gtong dus gso ba'i thabs rnams so/ /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bshad pa'i cho ga las ni sdom pa med de brtul zhugs tsam mo/ /de'i phyir cho ga ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dus ni dbang so so'i dngos gzhi rdzogs pa na'o/ /ngo bo ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems kyi rgyun gyi khyad par nyes pa rnams bzlog par byed pa yon tan gyi rten mthu brtas pa'am/ dbye ba ni thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong gi sdom pa gang zhe na/ bya ba dang rnal 'byor phyi'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ slob ma dang / bum pa dang /gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi sdom pa rnams so/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis gnyis su rtogs par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyang phal cher 'dod pas bsdus so/ /gzugs dang gzugs med pas bsdus pa dag kyang yod do/ /gtong ba'i dus ni rtsa ba'i lhung ba dag 'byung ba dang / sngags kyi theg pa spong ba de'i che'o/ /cha shas cha shas ni rang rang gi rtsa ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa na'o/ /gso ba'i cho ga ni sdig pa yongs su sbyangs nas slar yang blang ba yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang mtshan ma med pa'o/ /de yang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ bdag gi de nyid dang / lha'i de nyid dang / bzlas brjod kyi de nyid dang / bsam gto gyi —136—
