de nyid do/ /bdag gi de nyid dang / bsam gtan gyi de nyid ni mtshan ma med par gtogs so/ /bar pa gnyis ni mtshan ma can du gtogs so/ /lha drug ni/stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang / /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod/ /bzlas brjod ni gsum ste/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyu byer gzhi la gnas/ /yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags bzlas/ /ngal na bdag la ngal gso zhig /bsam gtan ni/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgrar gnas rnal 'byor ster bar byed/ /sgra mtha'i thar pa sbyin par byed/ /ces 'byung ngo / /spros pas chog go /'dir ni bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de gnyis sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sgra don dang /grangs dang / go rim nges pa ni sngon gyi mkhan po dag gis bshad pa dang /gzhan du smra bar 'dod do/ /'dir re re yang ngo bo dang / yan lag dang / dbye ba dang / gnas skabs dang / dngos dang btags pa'i khyad par ro/ /bskyed pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ rnam pa ra rtog pas gsar du bsgom pa las byung ba'i lha sku'i rnam pa can srid pa gsum dang chos mthun du bsgom pa'i zhu bde'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /yan lag gang zhe na/ mthun mtshams sam mchod pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa dang / rnal 'byor brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir yan lag ces bya zhe na/ rang gi ngo bo'i srid pa dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa la lam du mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dang po sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang /las rgyal mchog dang / bsnyen pa dang / nyer bsgrub dang / sgrub pa dang / sgrub wo dang / rnal 'byor dang / rjes su rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor dang /—137—

rnal 'byor chen po rnams so/ /gnas skabs gang zhe na/ las dang po pa dang /ye shes phebs pa dang / ye shes la dbang ba dang / ye shes la ches da/bang ba rnams so// /dngos ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa yin la gzhan rnams ni btags nga/'o/ /bskyed rim gyi dpyad pa'i gnas drug gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sbyang gzhi gang yin mthar thug 'bras bu gang / /rdzogs rim gang yin smin byed dgos pa gang / /ngo bo gang yin mthar phyin tshad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas drug yan lag kun la sbya ra/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ ngo bo dbye ba so so yi/ /rang bzhin dang ni dpyad pa'i gnad/ /ngo bo gang zhe na/ sems dang yid dang rlung dbu mar thim pas/ mngon du gyur pa'i bde stong ngo / /dbye ba gang zhe myo// dngos dang / btags pa dang/ mtshan ma can dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / khyab byed dang / khyab bya rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la thog ma gnyis ni rang bzhin gyi dbye ba'o/ /tha ma gnyis ni tha snyad kyis phye ba'o/ /bar ba gnyis ni rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /de rnams nyid kyi rang bzhin gang zhe na/ de yang zhu ba'i bde ba lhan skyes chen po dang / sgyu ma'i sku dang / rang bzhin lhan skyes dang /zung 'jug gi sku dang / rlung dbu mar thim pa'i mthar thob pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba snang ba gsum dang / dga' ba gsum dang / de rnams dngos su 'thob pa'i lam gang yin pa de rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos zhes bya'o/ /btags pa gang zhe na/ rtsa'i rnal 'byor dang / rlung dang / phra mo dang /thig le dang / phyag rgya'i rim pa rlud dbu mar 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang /thim par byed pa'i las can rnams so/ /mtshan ma'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe —138—

na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma dang / btags pa'i mtshan ma can no/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma gang zhe na/ snang ba gsum sems dang sems las byung ba'i mtshan nyid can 'od gsal bar gnas yongs su ma gyur pa ste so so'i skye bo thams cad dang gzhan la yang yod do/ /btags pa'i mtshan ma gang zhe na/ sgra don can gyi rtog pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa gang yin pa ste/ don gyi 'od gsal ma thob pa'i bar dag tu ci rigs par yod do/ /mtshan ma med pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma med pa dang / btags pa'i mtshan ma med pa ste/ dang po ni 'phags pa kho na la yod do/ /phyi ma ni so so'i skye bo la yang yod do/ /khyab byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ so sor sdud pa dang / bsam gtan dang / srog rtsol dang /'dzin pa dang / rjes su dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / dga' ba bzhi dang /snang ba dang / snang ba mched/ pa dang / snang ba nye bar thob pa dang / 'od gsal ba dang snang phyogs dang / stong phyogs dang / bde ba'i phyogs dang / phyogs dang bral ba rnams so/ /de la dang po drug ni yan lag gi rab tu phye ba dang / de nas brgyad ni ngo bo nyid dang / de nas gsum ni rnam pa dang / tha ma ni rang bzhin gyis rab tu phye ba'am/ yang na bzhi ga'ang rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ ci'i phyir khyab byed ces bya zhe na/ gang rdzogs pa'i rim pa de thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ khyab bya gang zhe na/ lus rnam par dben pa dang / ngag dben pa dang /sems dben pa dang / bdag byin rlabs pa dang / 'od gsal ba dang / zung 'jug dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdag byin rlabs pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / nor bu 'gengs pa dang / dza lan+ta ra dang /—139—

bsam mi khyab dang / rang byin gyis brlab pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / rgyud kyi rim pa dang / sngags dang ye shes dang / gsang ba'i rim pa dang /so sor sdud pa la sogs pa yang 'ga' zhig tu yod de/ gzhan yang sngags dang /dbyibs dang / chos dang / rtsa dang / rlung dang / thig le dang / me dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes dang / dam tshig dang / phyag rgya chen po dang / snying ga'i thig le dang / nor bu dang / sprul pa dang / mi shigs pa'i rnal 'byor dang / de dag la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dag go /dpyad pa'i gnad rnams gang zhe na/smras pa/ ngo bo gang yin gang la gnad du bsnun/ /ji ltar gnad bsnun de yi nyams rtags gang / /yon tan gang bskyed de yi rgyu mtshan gang / /dngos brgyud spangs bya gang spong mthar phyin tshad/ /sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang gegs sel dang / /bogs 'don ci zhig gtso 'khor khyad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas bcu gcig gi sgo nas dpyad/ /rdzogs rim rim pa kun gyi gnad shes 'gyur/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pa lus kyi rnam par bzhag pa gang zhe na/ lus chags pa dang /gnas pa dang / 'jig pa'i tshul lo/ /brjod pa/ ba sbu'i bu ga'i grangs nyid kyi/ /rtsa ni bye ba phyed dang bzhi/ /de las stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /de las brgyad cu gnyis lhag brgya/ /de bzhin brgya dang nyi shu dang / /sum cu gnyis dang rtsa gsum mo/ /bskyed dang bsdud pa thams cad kyi/ /gnas ni snying ga yin pa'i phyir/ /grub pa rnams dang mkhas rnams kyi/ /snying ga kho na bsngags pa yin/khams kyang so gnyis bcu drug dang / /khu khrag 'khor lo gnas tshul dang /dkar dmar 'phel 'grib 'pho ba'i 'gros/ /rlung yang nyi khri chig stong dang /—140—

drug brgya brgyad lhag brgya dag las/ /bcu ni rnam par shes par bya/ /re re yang ni gnas dang grangs/ /rgyu tshul kha dog mgon po dang / /lha mo rnams kyi dbye ba dang / /'jug gnas 'byung dang 'pho tshul lo/ /phung khams dbang yul ye shes lnga / /nyer lnga phra dang rags pa'i tshul/ /sems de'i bzhon par gyur pa ni/ /rlung yang phra rags rnam gsum mo/ /ji ltar gnad du bsnun zhe na/ /yul gyi gnad dang / dus dang/ lus dang / rlud dang / dmigs pa'i gnad do/ /dmigs pa'i gnad kyang / gang la sems 'jog pa dang / rlud sdud tshul dang / dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par te/ bzhi po de dag gis yon to mngon du byed cing / dri ma rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang zhe na/ lam ni lnga ste/tshogs dang / sbyor ba dang / mthong ba dang / sgom pa dang / mi slob pa'i lam mo/ /ye shes phebs pa ni tshogs lam chung ngu ste dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /ye shes la ches dbang ba ni yang dag spong ba ste tshogs kyi lam 'bring po'o/ /de nyid spyod pas mthar phyin cing lta stangs rnams thogs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams mngon du 'gyur pa dang / skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa can/ tshogs lam chen po'o/ /rdzogs rim dngos kyi sems dben pa thob pa zhu ba'i bde ba mthar thug pa dbang po lnga'i rang bzhin drod dang rtse mo zhes bya la/ ye shes kyi sku ni nam mkha' mdzod thob pa stobs lnga dang ldan pa bzod pa dang chos mchog go /'dir rtsa dang / rlung dang / thig le thim pa'i ye shes yon tan gyi gzhir gyur pa gong ma'i lam dang mthun pa bcu gnyis so/ /de'i tshe ye shes kyi sku la sangs rgyas zhes btags so/ /de las gzhan pa'i mos —141—

spyod kyi sa bcu yang yod do/ /'phags pa'i sa bcu dang / mos spyod kyi sa dang /sangs rgyas kyi sa ste bcu gnyis ni/ lam 'di'i sa'o cog sa bcu gnyis su sdud pa rgyud las 'byung zhing mkhan po rnams kyis kyang bshad do/ /don dam pa'i so so rang gi rig pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ni dang por byang chub yan lag mthong ba'i lam mo/ /'di la dga' ba'i rang bzhin bden pa bcu drug dag go /slob pa'i zung 'jug rnam pa dgu ni sa lhag ma dgu'o/ /sa bcu tsam dang / rgyun mtha'i ye shes dag las rnam grol lam dang / khyad par lam ni sa bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum ste/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i ye shes gong ma'i gzhir gyur pa'o/ /'di dag ni sgom pa'i lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do/ /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni mthar phyin pa'o/ /man ngag las ni thog mar rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / gzhan yang sna tshogs par 'chad do/ /de dag la ni rim pa mi 'dra ba dag 'byung ste/ gal te spyor ba'i lam du zhugs na ni bye brag med pa kho na'o/ /mos pas spyod pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa la spyod pa/mtshan ma la spyod pa drug dang / mtshan ma med pa la spyod pa bdun dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med par spyod pa gsum la sogs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la spyod pa dang / yon tan brgya phrag bcu la sogs pa ni thams cad du mdo'i sde bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dir ni tshe gzhan du ma gyur pa kho na yin gyi skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'ang ma yin na/ bskal pa mang po ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/de'i phyir dus myur ba kho nas rdo rje sems dpas yang dang yang du ma bstan no//gzhan dag ni rang rang gi man ngag nyid du rnam per bzhag gi 'dir mi brjod —142—

do/ /'dir smras pa/ grangs nges mtshan nyid go rim nges pa dang / /nges tshig yon tan sbyangs bya 'bras bu dang / /rten dang shes bya spang bya nyams len tshad/ /dbye bsdu 'di rnams rim pa kun la sbyar/ /phung khams khams gsum 'dus byas rdzas yod dang / /kun rdzob yod dang lus sems rten gyi khyad/ /blo rigs rten 'brel zag med rab dbye bcu/ /rim pa gnyis kyi khyad par gzhan yang ni/ /btags pa dang ni mngon sum gyur pa'i lha/ /rags dang phra ba'i sngags dang rig 'dzin gnyis/ /las dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i khyad par dang / /sngags dang ye shes sku zhes rnam par phye/ /tha mal bag chags dngos su gnon dang 'joms/ /rtag pa'o ri srid dang snang ba'i srid 'joms dang / /las dang ye shes sgrib sel rnam shes dang / /ye shes kyis rab phye dang dngos grub gnyis/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgyud kyi sbyor pa gang zhe na/ las kyi rgyud dang / dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /de la las kyi rgyud gang zhe na/ khyad par bcu'am/ brgyad de/ phyogs dus lha dang cha byad bsam pa dang / /gnas dang yul dang zas dang cho ga sngags/ de yang bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi las dang / sbyin sreg gi las dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi las dang / sbyor ba'i las phal pa'o/ /de kho na ltar dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'on kyang dam tshig gi khyad par dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas ni lhag pa'o/ /las ni las chen bcu gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /dngos grub kyi rgyud ni gnyis te/ /thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /thun mong gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / lus dang / longs spyod dang / 'dod pa dang / gzugs —143—

kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / gzugs med par 'gro ba'o/ /dang ba dang / mkha' lding dang / khyu mchog sogs bzhon pa dang / rin po che sna bdun dang / rdo rje dang / 'khor lo/ pad+ma la sogs pa dang / 'jig rten pa rnams kyi mtshon cha dang /yi ge dang / ming gi sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa bsgrubs pas gzhan la brten pa'i dngos grub mtha' yas pa yod do/ /'di las che long tsam bsdus pa ni/ chung ngu ni brgyad de ril bu mig sman dngos grub dang / sa 'og ral gri dngos grub dang /mkha' la 'phur dang mi snang dang / khre ba med dang nad 'joms so/ /'bring ni 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa phal pa'o/ /chen po ni tshe dang / longs spyod la sogs pa bskal pa drug pa dpag tu med pa 'dod pa dang / gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dngos grub gnyis kar spyod pa bsgrub pa yin te/ thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa la zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong grub pa na'o/ /de la spyod pa gang zhe na/ gang zag dang / 'bras bu dang / dus dang / ngo bo dang / nges tshig dang / dbye ba dang / cho ga'o/ /de la dbye ba gang zhe na/ spros bcas dang / sprosamed dang / shin tu spros med dang / yang na gnyis spangs dang / kun bzang dang /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang / yang na 'dod 'jug dang / rten slob dang /rig pa brtul zhugs dang / yang na res 'jog dang / mnyam por spyod pa dang /mnyam bzhag dang / rjes thob dang / chags bral dang / chags can dang / 'dod chags chen po'o/ /de yang sgom bsam dang / dus dang / bya ba dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas spyod pa gsum du bzhag go /smras pa/ gnas dang phyag rgya'i grangs dbye ba/—144—

mtshan nyid cha lugs khyad par ro/ /cho ga dang / ngo bo dang / spyod tshul dang /dbang po sbyangs ma sbyangs dang / gnas skabs dang / rang bzhin gyi sgo nas de rnams su dbye'o/ /'di dag ni brjod par bya ba mang ngo / /mchog gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /sdom ni/ khyad par ngo bo dpe rnams dang / /de yi rig 'dzin gyi khyad dang / /rig 'dzin zung 'jug yon to dang / /sku dang ye shes nye rgyu'i tshul/ /'bras bu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ dngos dang btags pa'o/ /dngos ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'o/ /btags pa ni sgyu ma'i sku dang / zung 'jug gi sems can no/ /'di gnyis dri ma can dang / dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi sku ste/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang / 'ja' lus zhes brjod kyi khams gsum pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje sku'i dpe bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ sgyu ma chu zla mig yor smig sgyu dang / /rmi lam brag cha mig 'phrul dri za'i grong / /'ja' tshon glog dang chu bur me long gzugs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gang zhe na/ 'di ni khyad par bdun dang ldan te/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa dang / mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa dang / zhing sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang / 'dod cing 'a tums pa med pa dang / 'dod pa mtha' yas pa la bde ba chen por spyod pa dang / tshe tshad las brgal ba dang / yid kyi lus so/ /'dir rig pa 'dzin pa dang / ye shes kyi sku la khyad par ci/ phung po'i za ma tog ma nyams pa ni ye shes kyi sku tsam mo/ /las sam ting nge 'dzin gyis nyams pa de'i tshe rig pa 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyang / yon tan brgyad tshan gnyis te bcu drug dang ldan pa'o/ /zung 'jug —145—

gi yon tan gang zhe na/ ro myang brgyad dang / dbang phyug brgyad dang / kha sbyor bdun dang / yon tan brgyad ces bya ba ste/ /rtag pa dang ni mi gdung dang / /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang / /bde ba dang ni dri med dang / /dga' ba dang ni yid dang ba/ /sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod byed dang yon to brgyad pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /gzugs phra reg pa yang ba dang / /khyab pa yang dag thob pa nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba nyid bstan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi phyogs dang tshad med dang / dbang bcu dang /stobs bcu dang / shes pa bcu dang / ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa dang / smon nas mkhyen pa dang / thugs rje chen po dang / zad par dang / zil gnon dang / rnam thar la sogs pa'ang bshad par bya mod kyi/ de dag ni sde snod gsum gyi tshul las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /sde snod 'dir yang mtshan yang dag pa la sogs par bshad do/ /sku gang zhe na/ chos dang / longs spyod dang / sprul pa dang / bde ba chen po dang / sku bcu drug la sogs pa dang / rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yongs su mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /chos kyi sku gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gang zhe na/ kha sbyor gyi yan lag bdun mthar thug pa gcig tu gyur pa chos thams cad la rdzogs par spyod pa'o/ /de yang brda dang don no/ /brda ni byang chub —146—

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /don ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kho na te/ sems can la snang ba ni med do/ /sprul pa'i sku gang zhe na/ brda dang don no/ /brda ni so so'i skye bo 'ga' zhig la yang mngon sum du snang ba'o/ /don ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bya ba bsgrubs pa'i ye shes thugs rje chen po'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gang zhe na/ sems can gyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang / ro myang brgyad dang ldan pa don dam par spros pa dang bral ba gang yin pa ste/ 'di yang chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni sku bzhi ka yang bsdus par rig par bya'o/ /sku bcu drug gang zhe na/ bzhi po de dag thugs dang / gsung dang / sku dang / ye shes kyis phye bas bcu drug ste/ rlud dang rdul dang khu ba dang rnam par shes pa dag pa dang / sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi gdung ba med pa dang / rdo rje snying rjes sems can sgrol ba dang / bde ba chen po zung 'jug gi rang bzhin no/ /de yang yang na gnyis su med pa dang / g.yo ba med pa dang / ris med pa dang / 'dod pa dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dang /'dod chags chen po dang / dngos po dang dngos med zad pa dang / ye shes dang /sems pa dang / kun tu bzang po dang / nyon mongs med pa dang / nyon mongs chen po dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang / byang chub kyi sems 'dzin pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang / thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /yang na mnyam pa nyid dang / yid kyi gzugs gnyis snang spangs pa dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dang / bag chags spangs pa zhes pa ni sku bzhi'i don no/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa yang bshad pa/ sprul pa yi ni sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor —147—

sdom pa dang / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang / /dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang / /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa ni/ /sad rmi gnyid sdug bzhi pa yi/ /dbang po gnyis skyes bde min zhing / /zhes 'byung ba'o/ /ye shes gang zhe na/ lnga'am bdun no/ /lnga ni me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba sgrub pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /bdun gang zhe na/ zab pa'i ye shes dang / rgya che ba dang / khyab pa dang / rtag pa dang / bde ba dang / sku dang / zung 'jug rnams so/ /zab pa gang zhe na/ rang bzhin med pa dang / rang rig pa dang / 'phel ba dang / bri ba med pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / gsal bar snang ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /rgya che ba gang zhe na/ bsod nams dang / ye shes dang / yul dang /dmigs pa dang / 'jug pa dang / 'phrin las rgya che ba'i mtshan nyid do/ khyab pa gang zhe na/ yul thams cad dang / dus thams cad dang/ rgyud gsum la khyab pa dang / stong pa nyid dang / mnyam pa nyid kyis khyab pa'i mtshan nyid do/ rtag pa gang zhe na/ rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'gog pa med pa dang / rdul phra rags kyi mtshan nyid med pa dang / sngon dang phyi mar mi 'gyur pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /bde ba gang zhe na/ kha sbyor chen po dang / rang bzhin bde ba dang / snying rje gsum dang / yid dang rlud thim dang / zhu ba dang / 'dzag med kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rdo rje'i sku gang zhe na/ stong pa las skyes pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang / gar yang phyin pa dang / go 'phang mi g.yo ba dang / yid —148—

kyi lus dang / rlud gi lus dang / skad cig la thams cad sprul pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad kyi mtshan nyid do/ /zung 'jug gang zhe na/ gnyis chos med pa dang /yang dag min rtog med pa dang / rang bzhin la zhugs pa dang / snang ba med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dang / nam yang mi g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /nye rgyu gang zhe na/ mchog gi dngos grub la dang por dngos su reg pa dang / mthar thug par dngos su reg pa dang / gnyis kar rgyud mar reg pa'o/ /dang po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag par dbang bskur ba las byung ba'i spyod pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pas dbang bskur ba'i 'o/ /gsum pa rig ma'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa thams cad de/ de yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bya ste/ chu dang / cod pan la sogs pa gsang ba'i dbang gi bar du sbyin nas/ nyi ma dmar thag chad pa na shes rab ye shes sbyin te rig ma dang lhan cig tho rangs mngon par byang chub pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang / rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun tu brtsams par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo / /'di la dang po dang tha ma la ni phyag rgya gsum ka yang yod do/ /bar ba la ni las kyi phyag rgya dang / phyag rgya chen po kho na yod do/ /tha ma kho na bde chen gyi lam la ni/ de dag phyag rgya chen po kha na'o/ khyud gsum gyi rim pa phye ba ste gnyis pa'o/ /rjod byed kyi rgyud bshad par bya ste/ rgyud ni du/ dbye ba ni gang / mtshan —149—

nyid ni gang zhe na/ rgyud ni gnyis dang gnyis dang bzhi dang lnga ste/ dang po ni bya ba dang / rnal 'byor dang / de yang gnyis gnyis te bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'o/ /de dag kyang tsam po dang / khyad par can gyi dbye ba ste/ mi dang mi'i rgyal po zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bya ba'i rgyud ni drug go /spyod pa ni gsum mo/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni gnyis sam lnga'o/ /bla na med pa ni gnyis so/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ gang dang gang gi dkyil 'khordo ra dang / sngags gtso bor 'byung ba de dag go /rgyud lnga ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / phyi ma dang / bshad pa dang / cha mthun dang / 'phros pa'i rgyud do/ /yang gnyis ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bsdus pa'o/ bzhi ni mdo sde dang / rtog pa dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gzungs zhes pa'o/ /lam ni rgyas la sngags dang sbyor ba nyung ba ni mdo sde'o/ /cha shas kyi rtog pa ni rtog pa'o/ /thams cad kyi rtog pa ni cho ga zhib mo'o/ /sngags tsam ni gzungs so/ /ci'i phyir rgyud dag tu bzhag ce na/ thabs kyi rgyud bzhin don dang tshig tu 'brel ba dang / sgrub pa po nas slob dpon dang / slob ma dang dbang dang / dam tshig dang / sngags dang / sbyor ba dang / dngos grub rnams 'brel zhing rgyun chags pa'i phyir ro/ /bya dang rnal 'byor gtso bo'i phyir/ /rgyud gnyis dang ni nang yang sbyod/ /rnal 'byor rab kyi phul gyur pas/ khyud bzhi ru ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'dod chags bzhi lam du byed pa yang yin mod kyi/ de ni sgra don dang 'jog byed kyang yin zhes zer ro/ /rnal 'byor bla med dang / rnal 'byor bla ma dang / rnal 'byor chen po dang / gnyis med kyi rgyud ces pa yang phal cher rnam grangs so/ /bla na med pa'i rgyud gang zhe na/ zhu ba dang / rang bzhin gyi bde stong —150—

gnyis su med pa ston pa gang yin pa ste/ de'i phyir 'di kho nas skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas sbyin par byed do/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /bu ni bu mo dang / bu pho'i dbye gzhi ste/ 'on kyang bu ni pho kho na la brjod pa ltar rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang / sngags dang / sbyor ba rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /sangs rgyas rnams gyi dkyil 'khor dang / gsang sngags dang / sbyor ba kho na rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor ngh+ru rgyud do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ngo bos ni thams cad kyang dbye ba med do/ /don 'di ma rtogs par phyogs 'dir mkhas pa dang / mi mkhas pa dag kha cig ni cha chung dus dbye bar 'dod/ kha cig ni rnam grangs du mar byed/gzhan dag don bzang po rlom pa dag gis dbye bar 'dod de/ ma nges pa kho na smra'o/ /rgyud kyi sa/myo/sa lnga gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ las rim dngos grub dam tshig sdom / /ting 'dzin rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /las kyi rim kwa ni dpag tu med de/ de 'a sa che long che long bsdus pa ni/ de nyid bcu phyi yi dang / gsang ba'i de nyid bcu'o/ /yang na bcu gcig ste/ sdom ni/ sa chog sgrub dang mchod pa dang / /sbyin sreg dbang bskur rab gnas dang / /yo byad dkyil snyen ra mtshan nyid dang / /tshogs 'khor bsnyen pa las tshogs so/ /yo byad ni rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / phyag mtshan dang / rgyan dang de dag la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid ni bri ba dang / bslang ba dang / lus dang / bsam gtan no/ /sngags kyi stobs las bsod nams 'phel tshul dang / /bde bas stong pa rtogs pa'i tshul mchog dang / /bde dang myur dang thabs mkhas khyad par dang / /bslab —151 —

gsum nyon mongs lam sbyod 'bras bu'i tshul/ /dmigs pa dam tshig rgyud gzhan bskul ba yis/ /lam 'dir khyad par 'phags par kun gyis bshad/ /bcu gcig po 'di gzhan la yod ma yin/ /'di gnyis byang chub mchog la khyad par ming / /ces pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rjod byed kyi rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o//sgom pa'i tshul gang zhe na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni so sor bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'di ltar sgom ste thog mar snying gar dh+wa ti'i nang du nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūX bsgom mo/ /yang na nor bu zhu ba'i thirge le dmar skya yung 'bru tsam bsgom mo/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams su yi ge'am/ thig le bsgoms pas rlung bzlog cing / mngon shes kyang 'grub bo zhes so/ /de ltar lte ba'i gtum mo spar te spyi bo'i haX zhu ste snying ga'am lte bar 'bar 'dzag bsgom mo/ /gzhan yang ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gis 'od gsal du 'jug go /gtum mo ni gsum ste/las dang rnal 'byor dang rang bzhin gyi ga tsho/ mo'o/ /gal te bskyed rim so sor sgom mi nus na/ bsnyen pa la sogs pa spyi'i cho gas bya'o/ /rim par phye ba 'di ni shin tu mang po'i man ngag so so las rtogs par 'gyur bas 'dir mi bri'o/ /bsgom pa'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o/ /rgyud bshad pa'i thabs gang zhe na/ 'di la bya ba dang rnal 'byor phyi la ni dgos pa'i don dang / bsdus pa'i dang / tshig gi don dang / mtshams sbyor dang / brgal lan gyi sgo nas dang / gleng gzhi dang / gtam gyi sbyor ba ni sngon byung dang / rjes 'jug gi dbye bas bshad do/ /re re tsam ni mtha' drug gis bshad de/ de skad du thams cad zos shing —152—

kun byas kyang / /'gru/ba 'gyu/ra nyes pas mi gos na/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa la ni rgyan bdun dang / de'i gtam gyi sbyor ba la ni/ sngon byung dang / rjes 'jug dang / rgyud 'ga' zhig la ni phyi dang gsang ba de bzhin nang / /de bzhin nyid don rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes dang / phyi dang / nang dang / gzhan dang / brton pa bzhir bshad pa dag go khren tu sbas pa'i rgyud la ni tshul bzhi'o/ /mtha' drug ni thams cad la ste/ nges pa dang drang don la lhag ma bzhi bzhis phye bas brgyad do/ /de bzhin du gzhan la yang ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /tshul bzhir 'chad pa med pa la ni tshogs dang / slob ma'i dbye ba med do/ /yi ge gsang chen du bshad pa ni yi ge'i don ma yin zhes kho bo smra'o/ /tshig gcig don gcig gam gnyis su ston pa ni mtha' drug dang / don rnam grangs du ma ni tshul bzhis 'chad do/ /de yang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin te/ spyi'i don nyid gsum mam bzhi la sogs par bshad pa yang yod de/ de dag la rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa la sogs man ngag yod par yang 'dod do/ /gal te tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas rgyud mnyan par bya'o/ /de la slob dpon dang / slob ma'i mtshan nyid shes pas brtags nas blangs la dbang bskur ba nod par bya'o/ /dam tshig dang / sdom pa la gnas pas/ rim pa gnyis la zhib mor mkhas par byas la rgyud mnyan no/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yang sgom pa dang / gtor ma yang spyin pa dang / thams cad dkyil 'khor du bltas la/ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' la yon dang / maṇ+ḍal byas la/ sngon byung ji lta bar sgom pa ni/ slob dpon slob ma gnyis kas so/ /lus dang / ngag —153—

dang / sems kyi skyon bcu gcig spangs te/ de dag gang zhe na/ nyal ba la sogs pa lus kyi gnas ngan len dang / rtsed mo dang kyal ka dang / zhe sdang ba'i brgal lan dang / ca co dang / ha cang rtog ge la dga' bas gtan tshigs dang thal 'gyur gyi rnam gzhag thal ba dang / man ngag med pa dang / rdzun gyi man ngag dang / ma smin pa'i skyes bos thos pa dang / 'gran pa dang / rnyed pa'i sems so/ /gzhan yang smra ba'i rgyun dang ldan pas brjod de/ rnal 'byor la ni mi g.yeng bas 'chad pa dang / mnyan pa la ni rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams lhag par yang gzigs so/ /rgyud bshad thabs kyi rim par phye ba ste lnga pa'o//bstan bcos 'di'i ming ci/ las dang po la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya'o/ /'di ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i ma mo'i snying po bsdus pa yin te/ sngags kyis gtan la dbab pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'di dag rgya che bar bla ma'i ngag las rig par bya'o/ /de ci rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa yang shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod de/mngon pa ni bar bar dag las bsdu bar bya dgos so/ kha cig 'di ni gtso bo yin te de'i phyir sde snod gsum du mi bsdu'o/ /zhes pa ni 'thad par mi snang ste/dper na brgya byin ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gtso bo yin la/ de ni brgya byin ma yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar na 'di yang chos yang dag par bsdud pa gtan la dbab pa ste/ 'di kho na bzung bas kyang sngags kyi theg pa'i brda rnams la rmongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di'i dge ba yang / skye ba 'di kho na la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'gro ba la phan pa'i rgyur bsngo'o / / /las dang po pa la phan pa'i rab tu byed pa rdzogs so/ /rdo rje theg nga/'i lam las chos kyi rgyun gyi —154—

ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa rje btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug gu ru lho phyogs pa'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la spyi bos reg pa tā ra nā tha kun dga' snying pos sngon med pa'i gtam bzang po dag las ci rigs par rang lo nyer gsum pa'i dang po nag po'i nya la gnas ri bo mthon po'i mgul bsam gtan sdings su thun gsum la myur bar sbyar ba'o// //zhus dag/ //maṅgal bistur//—155—

cas bya ba bzhug/sa/ —rma swā sti/ blo chen rnams kyi blo gros dang / /mthun pa'i dri lan 'debasadaka' yang / /rang gi blo la gang shar ba/ /de tsam smra la nyes pa ci/ /dri ba dang po'i lan ni/ rjes gnang lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung /gzengs bstod rnams dkyil chog spyi la grags pa ltar na/ cho ga de rnams nyid kyi rang ngos nas/ bum dbang nyid kyi cho ga'i yan lag yin dgos te/bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can ru no/ /gsum pa kun nas sbyor bas ste/ /bzhi pa'i don ni dam pa'o/ /gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ste/ bcu gnyis pa ni gsang ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu bzhi pa ni don dam ste/ /zhes chu sogs dbang bcu gcig po bum dbang yin par bshad cing / thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i grub thob tsam dang / paṇ+ḍi ta tsam gyis bshad pa la/'thad mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa gtong du rung yang / rgyud rnam dag nas bshad pa la yid ches kho na byed pa las/ gzhan du mi rung bas so/ /des na lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gsum po gsang ba/ shes rab/ bzhi pa gsum gyi mtha' rten du go rim bzhin du spyor ba 'di la/ dkyil chog rin chen 'bar ba nas bshad pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan rgya gar ba'i lung —156—

gsal po med/ bod kyi bla chen 'brog mi'i man ngag las ni 'byung ngo / /de la man ngag spong du mi rung mod kyi/ de rnams ngo bo'i sgo nas bum dbang gi mtha' rten kho na yin kyang / bum dbang ni kun gyi thun mong yin pa'i phyir/dbang gong ma rnams kyi mtha' rten du sbyor ba'ang mi 'gal te/ dper na grong pa'i sgos g.yog rnams rgyal po'i yang g.yog tu 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na lung bstan ni gsang dbang gi cho ga'i yan lag ma yin kyang / gsang dbang dag dag byed yin cing / lung ston pa yang ngag gi bya ba yin pa'i phyir/rigs mthun pa'i sgo nas de'i mtha' rten du bla thabs su sbyar nas byed pa sogs gzhan gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ chos mthun sbyar nas skabs de dang der byed pa tsam yin gyi gzhan du na de dag gong ma gsum gyi yan lag kho na yin na/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs lta bu la/ dbang bzhi nub so sor bskur ba'i tshe bum dbang gi mtha' rten du de rnams sbyor dgos pa/ slob dpon rtse mo'i dbang chu chen mo las gsal bar bshad pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur te gong ma gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag de/ bum dbang gi mtha' rten du sbyar na ga la 'thad/dri ba gnyis pa'i lan ni/ rigs lnga'i dbang bum dbang yin nam min zhes pa 'di la/ rigs lnga zhes pa yin na/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i don du 'gyur ba yin la/ de lta na ni nges pa med cing / rigs lnga zhes gsung rgyu yin na/ rig pa'i dbang lngar 'gyur bas/ dus 'khor dang sems 'brel skor gsum lta bu nas gsungs pa'i rnam gzhag rnams bor nas/ gzhan spyi khyab —157—

pa'i rnams kyi lugs ltar byas na/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bum dbang nges par yin la/ rig pa'i dbang lngar song ba'i chu cod pan sogs bla med kyi khyad chos yin pa dang / spyod rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud na yod pa'i chu cod pan rdor dril sogs la rig pa'i dbang gi tha snyad mi 'jog lags/ de'i rgyu mtshan sbyang bya phung po lnga'am rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ sbyong byed rgyal ba rigs lnga'am/ rigs lnga dang dod mtshungs pa'i lha'i rnam gzhag dang sbyor zhing / ma rig pa lnga spong / rig pa ye shes lnga bskyed ces pa'i sgra bshad dang / rig pa'i lha mos dbang bskur ba'i don rnams/ bla med kho na las gzhan de dag la mi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa rgyud sde gong ma'i chu cod pan gnyis dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i dbang / bya rgyud rang rkang nyid la gsang ba spyi rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i dbang du grags pa de gnyis yin la/rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming / /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ni rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis kyi dbang la/ rdo rje dril bu'i dbang yod mod/ spyod rgyud la rdor dril nges pa can gyi dbang med kyang / rdo rje dril bu gnyis ka phyag mtshan gyi dbang yin pa bzhin du/ rgyud der yang ji ltar 'os pa'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang yod pas/ de dang 'di phyogs mtshungs tsam la dgongs pa yin ci nga /spyir spyod rgyud kyi dbang la/ phyag mtshan dang ming dbang yod pa'i nges pa med de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ chu dbang dang / mig thur dang / me long dang /—158— ———

chos bshad rnams las ma gsungs cing / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ chu cod pan rdo rje ming dbang ste bzhi po gsungs par mkhas pa rnams la grags pa dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud lta bu da lta rnal 'byor rgyud kho nar grags la/ bla ma rnams kyis rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba yin gyi/ rgyud kyi ngo bo la bltas na spyod rgyud du gsal la/ jo bo rje yang spyod rgyud du bzhed pas/ rgyud 'di las kyang / dbang gi dngos ga'i de dag dang / gung mthun par 'byung bas na/ spyod rgyud kyi nang mtshan 'ga' zhig la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dod tsam yod par ston pa'o/ /des na spyod rgyud kyi chu sogs dbang lnga dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi de lnga dang / bla med kyi rig pa'i dbang lnga la ming mtshungs pa dang / dbang rdzas phyogs mthun pa dang / rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis la ni cho ga'i tshig rigs kyang phyogs mtshungs tsam yod kyang / don mi 'dra ba shin tu che bas/ bla med kyi dbang bzhi dang zlos par ni mi 'gyur la/spyir bum dbang tsam ni bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum 'o4 yod par brjod kyang mi 'gal te/ bum pas dbang bskur bar yang nas yang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang bzhi'i ya gyal gyi bum dbang ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bum dbang yin pa'i phyir/ de dag la med mong/ kyang / spyir dbang bzhi bla med kyi khyad chos su 'chad pa'i don dbang bzhi po re re nas bla med kho na'i khyad chos yin zhes 'chad mi dgos kyi/ rgyud de dang de las dbang bzhi tshang bar ston pa ni/ bla med kyi khyad chos yin zhes pa'i don no/ /dper na stong nyid bcu —159—

drug gi rnam gzhag theg chen gyi khyad chos yin yang / stong nyid dang po bzhi nyan thos kyi theg pa nas bshad pa lta bus mtshon no/ /dri ba gsum pa'i lan ni/ phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang / /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang /nang tshan cho ga'i yan lag gis phye ba'i dbang drug yod par ma zad/ gsang dbang gi ming can zhig kyang yod mod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bum dbang dang gsang dbang med pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi po bla med kyi khyad chos su bshad pa dang mi 'gal lo/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi slob dpon gyi dbang de la/ rgyud de nyid rang gi lugs kyi dam tshig gsum sbyin pa yod kyang /spyir bla med kyi dam tshig gsum du khyad che zhing / rdor dril gyi dam tshig gnyis phyogs mthun rung tsam yin kyang / sgos phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig la khyad par shin tu che'o/ /yang dkyil chog phal che ba'i dbang du byas na/ dam tshig gsum spyin pa slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su byed pa mang ba yin yang /mtha' gcig tu nges pa med de/ rgya bod gnyis char du mkhas mchog rnams la shin tu grags che ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'am/'jig rten snang byed ces bya ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa las/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ slob ma'i dbang du bshad nas/ slob dpon gyi dbang gzhan zhig gsungs so/ /spyir bum dbang thams cad la slob dpon gyi dbang du bshad pa yang yod de/ gong du drangs pa/ gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ces —160—

pa'i gtso bo ni slob dpon gyi ming yin pa'i phyir dang / brtag gnyis kyi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa yang / bum dbang thams cad la slob dpon gyi dbang du ming 'dogs par dgongs so/ /dri ba bzhi pa'i lan ni/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu mthar thug 'og min gyi rig 'dzin yin pa dang / dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu sa bdun du bshad pa mi 'gal lam zhes pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bdun la sbyor na'ang / de sbyor lam yin na/ dbang bdun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bur mi 'gyur/ zhes pa 'di la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bdun la sbyor ba'i gsal kha ni med mod/ 'phags lam gyi sa bdun la sbyor phyin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sa la'ang don gyis 'byor te/ de gnyis 'gros mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sa bdun dbang bdun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bur yang ma bshad la/ dngos 'bras su yang mi byed do/ /'o na ci zhe na/ dbang bdun bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na 'phags pa'i sa bdun po de dag thob par 'gyur nges pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ste/ 'di skabs kyi ma 'ongs pa yang rgya yan la mi 'jog gi dam tshig ye ma nyams pa'i dbang du byas nas/ spyir btang la gnas skabs de'i skye ba phyi ma'i mtha' tshun chod la'o/ /des na sa bcu gnyis thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa la dbang bcu gcig gam/ bcu gnyis bskur ba yin zhing / 'on kyang lam bsgoms pas sa thob pa yin gyi/ dbang de dang de'i dngos 'bras las/ thob ces kyang mi brjod la/ dbang bdun gyi sa bdun thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grig par byed 161—

kyang / sa bdun thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig byed la dbang bdun dgos pas khyab pa'ang ma yin no/ /des na rten 'brel bsgrigs pa tsam gyi sgo nas ma 'ongs pa na thob par 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu'i dbang du byas na/ dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu mthar thug kyang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rdo rje bzhi yin la/ dbang bdun gyi dbang don nam/ dbang de'i lam bskyed rim gyi dngos 'bras mtho shos/ 'og min gyi rig pa 'dzin pa yin par bshad kyi de las mtho ba ma yin no/ /des na dbang bskur bdun po rang gi dngos 'bras ni/bskyed rim bsgom du rung ba'i nus pas rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par de yin la/de/ nas bskyed rim bsgom pas 'bras bu de 'dra thob pa yin pas/ 'og min gyi rig 'dzin de yang dbang bdun gyi dngos 'brel min la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bu yang min no/ /de bzhin du/ rdzogs rim bsgoms pa la brten nas sngags lam gyi tshogs sbyor gnyis thob pa de yang / mchog dbang 'og ma gsum gyi brgyud pa'i 'bras bu tsam du ni 'gyur yang / dngos 'bras dang /mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis kar du mi 'gyur ro/ /des na dbang dang sa'i sbyor tshul ni/ dag bya dag byed kyi sbyor tshul yang min cing / rten 'brel bsgrig bya sgrig byed kyi rgyu 'bras tsam yin pas/ sa mtshams nges pa can du sbyor pa yang mi dgos so/ /dri ba lnga pa'i lan ni/ yi ge dkyil 'khor dang po ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pa a bhi dha na'i lung 'di/ rdul tsho ni gyi dkyil 'khor kho na'i dbye ba min/ bum dbang gang du bskur ba'i phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khordo ra la drug tu phye ba lags/ dang po lnga po la yang / rdul tsho ni ras bris —162—

sogs sna tshogs 'byung ba lags shing / drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/gzhal yas khang gi khang pa dngos su bslangs pa'am/ chu tsho ni gyis sa gzhi la bris nas lha so so'i gnas su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dngos su 'god pa ste/dper na/ dges rdor la mtshon na/ dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon nyid gtso bo'i gnas su 'dug /gzhan sngags kyi spyod pa can gyi bud med dgu yang lha mo dgu'i gnas su bzhag lha'i chas su bcug nas/ bdag bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i chogs 'khor gyi tshogs dkyil 'khor sgrub pa yin pas/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no/ /dri ba drug pa'i lan ni/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i khungs/ shin tu gsal bar yod pa ni/ mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud na yo da/ rgyud de yang thog mar rong pa shes rab seng ges bskul nas/ yar klungs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba yin cing / 'gyur byed sa yang sa skya rang yin/ phyis paṇ+ḍita nagasarin gyi bar du lo paṇa gzhan dang gzhan 'ga' res 'gyur bcos cung zad tsam byas 'dug rgyud de las dang por rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul rgyas par bshad nas/ de rjes/ yang na dkyil 'khor bri bya ba/ /ras brisatshul du bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin bris byas nas/ /dbus su mi g.yo mthing nag bri/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ras bris rgyas par gsungs nas/de dang 'brel ba nyid du/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi cho ga rgyas par bshad do/ /sdom gsum rab dbye mdzad pa po chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta'i dus na rgyud 'di ma —163—

'gyur bas lan ni/ gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces gsungs thal po can du byon gda' 'on kyang rab dbye la sdang shugs byed pa po phyis 'byung gi bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis/ rgyud 'di la gzhig 'grel chug pa'ang med la/ rdul tshone la sdang ba bzhin ras bris la la'ang sdang bas/ khong dag lung 'di la dga' ba yang med do/ /der ma zad/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i khungs kyang 'ga' zhig tu snang ngo / /dri ba bdun pa'i lan ni/ dbang bskur ba'i don dri ma 'khrud pa la shin tu 'jog /dbang ni ye shes ma skyes kyang / slob dpon gnyis char gyi sems ma yengs par sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum 'dzoms pa'i dbang chog byas na dri ma 'khrud pa'i tha snyad thob ste/ sngags kyi sdom pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang ba la/ gsol gzhi'i las kyi cho ga byas na/ sgom stobs kyi ye shes ma skyes kyang tshul 'chal gyi rgyun spong ba'i gnas skabs thob ste/ de'i gnyen po dge slong gi sdom pa skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de dang 'di 'dra lags/ kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i tshogs/ kun rdzob kyi sdom pa thob nus pa yin/ dbang gi ye shes skyes na yang / ye shes de la phyag chen yin min gnyis ka yod/ rab dbye las/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ dngos dang rjes mthun pa'i phyag chen la dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / rim gnyis gang rung las —164—

skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis tshur khyab mtha' 'cha' ba yin gyi/ dbang dang rim gnyis kyi ye shes la/ phyag chen kyis phar khyab mtha' 'cha' ba min/dbang gi dri ma 'khrud pa ni/ dri ma 'khrud pa'i 'go brtsams pa yin gyi/ dri ma bkrus zin yang min pas/ ye shes dngos su skye bas kyang ma khyab bo/ kha cig dbang bskur tshad la ye shes skye ste/ dbang rnon la gsal bar skye/ dbang brtul la mi gsal bar skye/ zhes zer yang / ye shes de skye na snang du rung dgos pas/ mi gsal bar skye zhes pa'i zol 'jog de la/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i gnod pa 'jug la/ lar byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin ces pa lam 'bras kyi chos skad dang bstun dgos na/ gsang dbang gi ye shes yan chad rang byung gi ye shes yin pas/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par/ /phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang / /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba spang dgos so/ /dri ba brgyad pa'i lan ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes kyang / dpe'i ye shes ni nges par yin/ chos rgya'i ye shes sogs dpe'i ye shes gzhan gyi rgyu byed kyang / kho rang dpe'i ye shes yin pa mi 'gal ste/ don gcig la mtshon byed kyi dpe du ma 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /lar las rgya'i ye shes las chos rgya 'byung / de las phyag rgya chen po 'byung / 'bras bu dam rgya yin ces bya ba 'di ni/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'i phyag rgya bzhi pa'i gzhung dang / de'i rjes 'brang mai tri pa dpon slob rnams kho na'i bzhed pa yin no/ /gzhan phyag rgya bzhi la nā ro pa'i bde dgyes kyi man ngag dang / dril bu pa'i nor bu 'gengs —165—

pa sogs na mi 'dra ba re bshad pa/ thad so thad so der 'gal ba med/ phan tshun bsre mi thub/ dges rdor gyi 'grel pa kha che chen pos mdzad pa las kyang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya dus 'khor nas bshad pa dang mtshungs/ spyir las rgya ye rgya phyag chen gsum gyis zlas drangs pa'i las rgya dngos rig dang / ye rgya sgom pa'i rig ma la zer/ phyag rgya bzhi bgrod pa'i skabs/ dus 'khor las kyang ye rgya bgrang ba nyud zhing / gzhan rnams kyis ye rgya lar nas ma bgrangs te/ chos kyi phyag rgya bgrod pa yin/ las rgya'i ye shes de phyag rgya chen po dngos ma yin par nges/ rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba ni yod/ phyag chen rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas na ni/ bskyed rim phyag chen dang / gtum mo phyag chen la sogs pa 'byung bas nges pa med kyang / phyag chen dngos la dbye na/ rnam bcas dang / rnam med gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ rtsa dbu mar 'bar 'dzag byas pa'i bde stong gi rigs gcig la/ bde stong de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rkyen gzhan med kyang slar gsar du rlud dbu mar 'gags te/ bde drod kyi nyams khyad par can skye ba zhig yod pa de la zer/ gnyis pa ni stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po yin no/ /las rgya'i ye shes ni las rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba kho na'i rkyen gyis zhu bde'i bde stong tsam 'dren pa yin pas/ bde stong spros bral kho na la mnyam par bzhag pas gsar du bde stong drangs pa dang / las rgyas drangs pa'i bde stong gnyis po shin tu khyad che'o/ /mi tri pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa dam brgya'i ngos 'dzin gtum cho la mi byed/ 'bras bu zung 'jug gi sku la byed pa yin pas/ de'i lugs kyi —166—

dam rgya ni so so skye bo'i gnas skabs na med/ nā ro sogs dam rgya gtum mo la byed pa'i lugs ltar na/ dam rgya ye shes mtshan nyid pa spyor lam drod nas yod do/ /'di dag la mtha' chod nga/ zhig rgyas par bshad dgos na'ang/ stu/ ge'i tshogs la 'dzems pa dang gsang ba zab mor song bas/ 'phrin yig tu mdor bsdus tsam las ma brjod do// /dri ba dgu pa'i lan ni/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po bya ba/ stong gzugs las grub pa'i lha sku yab yum kha sbyor gyi ming yin/ de tsam gyis kyang mi chog khyad chos gsum po 'di tshang dgos/ dbu ma'i nang du rtsal rdzogs pa'i gtum mo las grub pa gcig shes pa kho na yin kyang rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi bya ba byed pas 'dod chags chen ngo/'i bde ba myos nus pa dang gnyis/ khyad gzhi lha sku de la khyad chos 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brlan thams cad gcig car 'char ba dang gsum mo/ /'di so so skye bo'i gnas skabs na ni yod de/ yan lag drug gi rjes dran gyi rim pa'i skabs nas 'byung ngo / /dri ba bcu pa'i lan ni/ nyin rtags drug gi ngos 'dzin rgyas pa ni/snyan brgyud bka' rgya can lags pas 'dir 'bri ma nus/ ngo bo ni thig le ser po dang / dkar po dang / dmar po dang / nag po'i snang ba rnams la ser po 'bar ba sogs bzhi dang / mchog gi cha 'od 'byug pa dang / thig le zhes pa thig le sngon po yin/ 'di rnams shar ba tsam sor bsdud mthar phyin pa na 'byung bas/ sbyor lam drod kyi sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i skabs nas yod la/ rjes—167—

mthun pa ni las dang po pa nas kyang yod do/ /yan lag drug po thams cad la rtags bcu rnams gong 'phel du 'gro bas/ so so la yang 'char lugs mi gcig pa'i khyad par shin tu che ba yin/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po de yang rtags bcu'i rang bzhin du gnas pa yin lags/dri ba bcu gcig pa ni/ phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan gyi phyag rgya chen po la/rtogs bya yul gyi phyag chen de don gyi ye shes yin yang / rtogs byed lam gyi phyag chen la don gyi ye shes yin pas ma khyab ste/ 'di la gnyis snang gi cha shas dngos su spong ba nas brtsams te/ lam gyi phyag chen dngos yin yang /da dung rdzogs par spangs ma zin pa'i bar du mnyam gzhag dang gnyis snang gzhan 'dre bas/ don gyi ye shes dngos ma yin/ mnyam gzhag tu gnyis snang mtha' dag 'gags pa'i tshe/ yul yul can dbye ba med pa'i phyir don gyi ye shes dngos yin pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang po thob pa nas bzung /dus 'khor lugs la phyag rgya gsum gyi zlas drangs pa'i phyag chen gyi ye shes dngos skyes pa yin/ don gyi ye shes kyi cha shas kyang thob pa yin mod/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig rdzogs pa na don gyi ye shes kyang rdzogs pas/don gyi ye shes thob pa'i sa mtshams ni rdzogs par thob pa la 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i sa dang po nyid yin/ des na don gyi phyag wo rdzogs pa dang / mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba rdzogs pa ni ngo bo gcig go /spyir phyag chen tsam ni/ sbyor ba yan lag drug ka yin te/ ji skad du/ so so bsdud pa phyag rgya che/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas shes so/ /lar —168—

mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba'i ngos 'dzin thun mong ma yin pa nges tig can cig gi ni phyis lho byang khri skor gyi dus 'khor ba ci 'dra zhig gi yang / thugs dang zhal gnyis can la 'dug pa ma mthong / rtsa rlung gi nus pa cung zad tsam yod par rlom pa 'ga' zhig la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba brnyes so zhes slob ma rnams sgrog par gda' ste/ zhu bde 'gyur med dang mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba gnyis dbye ba ma phyed pa'i cal col du 'dug yang bka' brgyud pa rnams gnas lugs phyag chen gyi dbang du byas nas/ sems kyi rang bzhin gnas skabs mi 'gyur bar shes pa tsam la/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar ngos 'dzin te/ gser dang ra gan nor ba lags so/ /gnas lugs phyag chen la ni/ phyag chen gyi sgra bshad du yod pa dang / mtshan nyid phyogs mthun tsam yod srid kyang rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i phyag chen gyi mtshan nyid ma tshang ngo / /dri ba bcu gnyis nga'i lan ni/ spyir dga' bzhi'i ye shes tsam rgyu'i dbang bskur ba'i dus rang na yod/ yang dbang las byung ba'i ye shes yin kyang / dbang bskur ba'i dus rang du skye dgos pa rang gis kyang ma khyab/ skad cig ma'i dga' bzhi ni gzhi dus nas kyang yod pas/ nam skye nges pa med cing / de'i ye shes tsam bskyed rdzogs kyi skabs kyang thams cad du 'byung ngo / /sa lam gyis bsdus pa'i dga' bzhi bya ba cig yod pa/ tshogs lam gyi skabs na ni med de/ lam der rdzogs rim gyis sa ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis yas babs kyi dga' bzhi'i sas —169—

bsdus shing / bzod mchog gnyis mas brtan gyi dga' bzhis sas bsdus so/ /dri ba bcu gsum pa'i lan ni/ rig 'dzin zhes pa/ spyir don mang po la 'jug kyang gtso cher rig sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha 'dzin pa la byed na/ rja sa kyi rig nga 'dzin pa bya ba/ ril lu so gas grub pa brgyad lta bu yin cing / longs spyod kyi rig pa 'dzin pa ni/ sngags kyi mthu las sgrub pa po rang snang du 'khor los sgyur pa'i 'o ngas spyod sogs thob pa cig yong bas/ de lta bu la zer/ de dag kyang mi'i rten ni gnas gyur nas 'gro ba yin pas/ mi'i 'gro ba dngos ni min/ lus kyi rig nga/ 'dzin pa ni gnyis te/ lus 'dod khams kyi rig pa 'dzin nga/ dang / lus gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa cig gis spros bcas spros/ med gang rung gi spyod pa spyad pas/ lus 'di nyid ma spangs par gnas gyur nas/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'ja' lus su gyur pa'o/ /snga ma gnyis dang 'di ste gsum kar spyir 'dod khams kyi rig 'dzin yin no/ /gnyis pa ni dbang po rno na/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa des/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ mi lus gnas gyur pa yang yod la/ dbang po rtul na 'dod khams kyi rig pa 'dzin pa sgrub pa'i rjes su/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ 'dod khams kyi lus de gnas gyur nas 'gro ste/gang ltar yang gzugs khams kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'ja' lus su gyur pa'o/ /des na 'og min gyi srid pa 'grub pa tsam la 'og min gyi —170—

rig 'dzin du mi 'jog la/ 'og min gyi dngos grub tu yang mi 'jog go /de la dngos grub tu 'gyur ba la/ lha dang sngags kyi nus pas sgrubs pa zhig dgos shing / rig 'dzin grub pa'i tha snyad kyang / sngags kyi sgrub pa'i don dang / khyad par lus kyi rig 'dzin grub pa la/ sgrub pa po ma shi gong gi tshe 'di nyid la de dang de 'grub pa dgos kyi/ tshe 'phos te skye ba phyi ma der skyes pas go mi chod do/ /spyir rig 'dzin dang / rig sngags 'chang ba 'gyur khyad ma gtogs don gcig dper na da lta'i mi phal pa rnams bzla ba'i yi ge drug pa 'di/ rig sngags kyi gzugs brnyan yin gyi/ rig sngags dngos ma yin pas/ mi de dag rig sngags 'a myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas yig drug de shin tu bsgoms pas/ gsal snang mthar phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnyed cing / de nyid bzlas pas nus pa 'grub ste/ de'i cho ga brtsam pa tsam gyis las dang dngos grub de dag 'bad pa med par 'grub rung du song ba na mi de'i rgyud kyi yig drug de rig sngags 'chang dngos su song ba yin pas/ mi de yang rig 'dzin nam rig sngags 'chang ba zhes bya/ de da ltar dngos grub ma thob kyang / des bsgrub na dngos grub de dag 'phral du 'grub la/ dngos grub 'grub na dngos 'grub de la rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub ces bya zhing /gang zag de yang grub pa thob pa'o/ /rig 'dzin dang sngags 'chang de 'dra la zer/ dri yig 'di na 'og min gyi srid pa phyi rol pas 'grub pa yod pas so/ /gsung ba zhig 'dug ste/ gzugs khams kyi srid pa zhes gsungs rgyu la yi ge nor pa yin las che/ theg pa spyi'i lugs la 'og min gnas gtsang ma —171—

yin pas 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong gi nang tshan bsam gtan spel sgom byas pa rnams kho na der skye ba mngon pa las bshad pas/ phyi rol pa der skye ba mi srid cing / dus 'khor las zad par bsgoms pas gzugs khams gzugs med nyi shur skye ba zhig bshad de/ don ni spyi dang mthun la/ sngags kyi dngos grub 'di lta bu 'grub pa'ang phyi rol pa la med de spyir phyi rol pas snyoms 'jug pa'am/ grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur yang chos nyid kyis thob pa'i gzugs khams gzugs med du skye ba yod kyang / phyi rol pa'i sngags la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'dod khams kho na'i yin gyi/ gzugs khams kyi med do/ /'dod gzugs kyi lha'i rigs 'di dag rnams/ las kyi dbang gis der skyes pa'i lha rnams dang mi 'dra ste/ de'i phyir skal pa mnyam pa zhes pa'i tshig sbyor dgos so/ /dri ba bcu bzhi pa'i lan ni/ rtsa ltung lnga po dus kyi 'khor lo las/kun+da byang sems sbong bar bshad pa gsal kha can yin cing / rgyud gzhan rnams las byang chub kyi sems spong ba zhes pa ma gtogs byang sems la ngos 'dzin gsal kha med/ rgyud kyi don 'chad pa'i rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bshad/ bla ma rje btsun chen pos rtsa ltung 'khrul spong du/kun+da byang sems spong ba tsam la rtsa lhung du 'dod pa phyogs sngar mdzad nas dgag pa dngos su mdzad gda' ba la/ bar skabs su byung ba'i mkhas pa mang pos/ 'gog byed dang / sgrub byed mang po mdzad gda'/ rtsa ltung gzhan rnams kyi skabs su dus 'khor gyi lung re drangs shing / lnga pa'i skabs 'dir —172—

ma drangs pas/ dus 'khore la dgag pa yin snyam pa dge bshes phal cher la byung gda'/ gsung de phyir re mda' pas/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang / /dpyod ldan chen po 'ga' yis rnam par dpyad/ /ces chos sbong gi sdig pa chen po gsog pa la ham pa skye ba'i rgyur yang song 'dug ste/ rje btsun chen pos dus 'khor 'gog pa ni ye min te/ skabs gzhan thams cad du dus 'khor la mchog tu dges shing lung mang du 'dren pa'i phyir ro/ khugs la dgag par song snyam yang ma song ste/ dus 'khor gyi dgongs pa'ang phyogs snga ma de ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang po gnyis kyi bde ba don dam pa'i lam du 'dod pa'i log rtogs dang 'brel bas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i lam la ma gus pas kun nas slang ste/ kun+da byang chub sems spang ba rtsa ltung du dgongs pa yin la/ dbang gsum pa'i dam tshig gi skabs su bshad pa rnams dang ni mi 'dra ste/ de skabs ni kun slong bsam pa'i khyad par de lta bu sbyor mi dgos par tshul de lta bus kun+da spangs kyang / dbang de'i dam tshig gi nyes par 'gyur ba 'di yin no/ /spyir 'di dus 'khor du ma zad/ 'khor lo sdom pa nas gsung pa'i dam tshig brgyad kyi nang na yang yod pas/ rgyud gzhan gyi lugs kyi bum dbang gi dam tshig tu mi 'gyur ba yang ma yin no/ /rtsa lhung lnga pa rje btsun chen po'i rang lugs la/smon sems spong ba la bshad cing / rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa'i gzhung la rtsa lhung 'grel chen sogs bshad pa byed pa'i lugs tha dad pa rnams dang bskrun na/rje btsun chen po'i lugs de gzhan rnams las legs pa yin la/ dus — 173—

'khor pa rnams kyang / dus 'khor lugs ltar 'chad dgos pa gzhir bzhag na'ang/ spyi ldog nas lugs gnyis po gang legs zhe na/ dus 'khor ltar legs par mngon te/ smon 'jug gi byang sems rnams byams snying rje dang 'gro ldog gcig pas/ rtsa lhung gsum pa byams pa spangs pa tsam gyis de dag kyang spangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dri ba bco lnga pa'i lan ni/ bskyed rim ni/ mchog sgrubs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam min par dam 'a rma ri dgos la/ bskyed rim nyid kho na bsgom pas 'phags pa'i sa bdun thob pa ni nam du yang mi 'dod do/ /dbang bdun dang sa bdun 'brel tshul ni gong du bshad pa ltar yin la/'phags pa'i sa dang po thob nas bskyed rim bsgom pa mi srid de/ des bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi lta bu'i dmigs pa'i rim pa sgom pa la gal te yod srid kyang / rdzogs rim gyi nang nas kyang / zung 'jug kho na yin gyi/bskyed rim min no/ /de'i phyir bskyed rim rkyang pa sgom pa lta zhog rdzogs rim dang 'dris te sgom pa yang de yan chad du mi srid de/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs pa gtod tshul ci 'dra zhig mdzad kyang / rnam rtog 'byung ba mi srid pa bzhin no/ /'phags pa min yang rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la brtan pa thob na/ drag shul sbyor ba sogs dgos pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig la/bskyed rim cung zad sgom pa srid kyang / phal cher mi sgom ste/ dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dbang bdun gyi 'phags pa'i sa de dang de thob pa'i rten 'brel sgrig kyang / des de dag thob par byed mi dgos te/ dper na lha'i —174—

mngon rtogs kyi 'gor ye shes tshogs bsog bsgom pas chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel sgrig kyang / de tsam gyis chos sku thob par mi 'gyur zhing / chos sku thob la khad pa'i skabs su de 'dra sgom yang mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /des na dbang bdun bskyed rim dang bcas pa ni/ sa bdun thob pa'i ring rgyu tsam byed kyang / dngos rgyu byed pa mi srid cing / rgyud pa'i rgyu la yang 'di rnams med kyang / thabs gzhan gyis sa bdun po sgrub tu yod pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yang ma yin la/ med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yang min no/ /'di ni dus 'khor ba'i chos skad du ma zad/ rtsa ba'i grub mthar dam 'cha' ba lags/ yang las dang po nga la de dag mi dgos zer ba ni/ ye ma lags/dbang po rnon po kha cig ma gtogs phal cher la gal yang shin tu che ba yin la/ rang re yang de dag la 'bad rtsol byed par mos pa yin mod kyi/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid dang chos nas bshad tshul la mi lta bar/ rang la mkho ba de mchog tu sgrub cing / mi mkho ba rnams la brnyas se byed pa de/ blun po'am g.yo can gyi rnam/ thar yin pas/ ring du spang pa lags so/ /spyir bla ma re la grub mtha' re'i dpe yin pas/ 'di ni bden gyi gzhan ni gti mug go zhes mi zer yang / bdag cag nyid kyi sems la rnam rtog gting tshugs pa'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa mang po bdog cing / khyad par du sngags kyi lam rim la/ bod rnams kyi zer sgros phal cher yang khong du chud mod/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang ngam/ he ru ka dngos rgya gar gyi grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs srol la yid brtan 'cha' ba yin gyi/ dpe nyog zer sgros bsdu mkhan —175—

lags/ /slar yang chos dang ldan pa yi/ /gleng slang 'di 'dra gong 'phel shog /bo dong bya rgod gshongs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pa klu sgrub sku skye drung gi dri lan/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// //zhus so/ /bkra shis/

gsal ba zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/oX snyu sti/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim mdor bstan pa/ /bla ma rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin lhan skyes 'gyur med dngos/ /bla ma'i zhabs la dang por 'dud/ /bde ba che dang gnyis med sbyor/ khres rab pha rol phyin phyag 'tshal/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag /he ru ka dpal de la yang / /sor bcu spyi bor nges byas nas/ /bden pa gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal lo sems can kun gyi 'od gsal ba/ /'di ni ye shes don dam ste/ /stong pa chen po rang ngo bo/ /nam mkha'i ri mo 'dzin pa'o/ /gang gi rang bzhin dag pa dngos kun khyab/ /nam mkha' 'di la mtha' dang dbus med bzhin/ /rang bzhin dag pa sangs rgyas sa bon 'di/ /'gro ba kun la ro mnyam gyur ba'o/ /skra shad lta bur rnam rtog gis nyon mongs/ /med par rtogs na 'dir gang 'ching mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i de nyid yon tan bcas/ /mi rtog las kun mdzad 'di bsam yas te/ /'di la srid dang zhi ba'i bye brag med/ /de phyir yon tan thams cad 'di la yod/ /skyon bral chos rnams dag pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /de kho na 'di mkhas pas rig ces bya/ /rang bzhin sems 'di rgyu zhes bya ba ste/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar de las las kyi rlung / /de las 'od zer lnga dang yon tan 'byung / /de dag las kyang kun tu rgyu sogs rlung / /de mthar las kyi bag chags bgo —177—

byed de/ /rnam shes de bzhin yid dag dbang shes so/ /bag chags las kyi rlud dang yon tan las/ /bdag la chags sogs 'di na bskyed par byed/ /bag chags rnam par shes pa las rlud gis/ / dkrugs pas gzung 'dzin snang ba'i nges pas so/ /snying pos rdul dang mun pas snod kyi ni/ /'jig rten 'gro ba'i lusadang bcas pa bsgrub/ /de bzhin rnam par 'jig cing lus can gyi/ /rlud sogs gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin no/ /'dir gang rkyen bzhi bag chags dang snang ba/ /gang dag zhag gas pa de 'dir rnam par rig /de ltar rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dngos 'di ni/ /gzhi dang lam du gnyis min pa/ /mi 'phrogs dbye ba nyid la yang / /yon tan gsum gyis skye zhing 'jig /de yi 'od kyis khams gsum sgrub/ /khu rdul rlud gi tshogs phra ba/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi rang bzhin nyid/ /de ltar dag pa'i dngos 'di sbyong ba'i lam/ /'dir ni shes rab ye shes dpal dang ldan/ /'di ni rang bzhin 'od gsal rgyal ba'i rigs/rang bzhin dag pas gsar du dag pa'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'pho ba med pa ste/ /bde chen 'dus ma byas dang de bzhin du/ /rang rig pa dang rnam pa thams cad pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i 'od gsal dam pa'i don/ /de ni bla ma'i zhal las rtogs bya ste/ dngos grub don du slob dpon bsten par bya/ /bla ma bsten tshul don dam bsnyen pa dang / /rgyud sde rnams dang lnga bcu pa sogs ltos/ /de nas slob dpon gyis ni thun mong dang / /thun mong min pa'i dbang bskur yang dag brtsam/ /rung bar bgyis pa'i sems ni 'di na dbang / /rdo rje slob dpon cho ga las la sogs/ /dam tshig ma nyams skabs bzhin bsrung ba yi/ /bu bzang de —178—

la lam yang bstan par bya/ /rgyud dang bla ma dag la yid ches pas/ /thog mar rgyud sde zab mo rnams thos nas/ /thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab dri med dang / /chos rnams rab tu 'byed pa dmigs med bcas/ /de mthar lam ni rnam gnyis yongs su brtag/ 'di dag chos la mos pa la sogs te/ /de phyir lam la mi 'phrod par 'dzin pa/ /de sogs sgrib pa bzhi yang don gyis bstan/ /sgrib pa'i gtso bo bag chags rnam bzhi ste/ /sad rmi gnyid stug bzhi pa zhes bya'o/ /so so'i nges pas lam yang nye tshe ni/ /zhi gnas mthar yang bskyed rim gtum mo dang / /phyag rgya'i lam las slob ma 'khrid par byed/ /phyi nas bzhi pa'i lam gyis bkri na mdzes/ /bzhi pa don dam shes rab ye shes ni/ /rtag tu khyab cing lam kun 'di na'o/ /bskyed rim bcos ma glo bur nye tshe ba/ /de yi 'bras bu dri bral khyab rtag ci/ /'di na bde ba dam pa rdzogs rim ste/ /sku bzhi'i dngos la reg par rgyal bas gsungs/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rang bzhin gang / /yongs su dag pa de yi lam yang 'di/ /dag par shes nas mnyam par bzhag gyur tam/ dh+ra ti'i dbus su mi shigs thig le las/ /rnam kun 'od gsal sgrub par byed pa'am/ /gzhan du rgyud kyi rim pa zhes kyang bstan/ /nam mkha' yid dang mig dang rlung bcings pas/ /dpyid kyi sgrub byed si tir gzugs mthong ste/ /du ba la sogs rnam bcur dngos kun rig /bsnyerna pa'i yan lag mchog tu gsungs pa ste/ /rlud bcu dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa'i tshul/ /rlud gi rang bzhin rdo rje gsum bzlas zhes/ /de bzhin gzhan las sa bon dang bral ba'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rim dang nor bu 'gengs/ /sngags kyi rim —179—

pa zhes kyang gsungs pa ste/ /srog rtsol bkag nas dbu mar 'bab pa gang / /'khor lo drug tu srog thur mnyam sbyor ba/ /'byung ba drug gi nyi zla'i bgrod pa 'gog /'di ni nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag go /sgyu ma'i dngos por chos kun bden pa ste/ /ye shes rim dang dza lan+ta ra yi/ /rim pa mchog ces rgyud sde 'ga' las 'byung / /phyag rgya gsum las dbang po'i dbye ba yis/ /so so'i rim dang tha mar phyag rgya che/ /nor bur lhan skyes bde ba rang 'dod kyi/ /rnam bcu'i sgyu lus dbang po thams cad pa'o/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i yan lag de nas gzhan/ /snang gsum mthar yang dri med 'od gsal ba/ /gzung dang 'dzin par snang ba dag pa can/ /mngon byang chub ces dpal ldan 'dus par dang / /gzhan las bsam mi khyab dang gsang ba'i rim/ /las rlud nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'gog /de snyed mi 'gyur bde chen thob pa ste/ /gtsug tor mchog tu byang chub sems brtan pa/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i byed pa'o/ /'di ni bsgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ /dpal ldan ting 'dzin ces gang gsungs pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rba rlabs zhes pa'ang 'di kho na/ /'dzag bde'i dngos kyi gnyen po 'di yin no/ /'di ni dpal ldan phyag rgya chen po ste/ /rang byung ye shes mngon du byas pa yin/ /sems nyid gsal tsam rig las 'di khyad 'phags/ /ris med bde ba chen 'di rgyud sde'i don/ /deng sang gnas lugs phyag rgya cher grags pa/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo lugs sgom rim zhig /dbang po'i rim pas sngags dang go bstun pas/ /'gro ba rnams la sgron me lta bur gyur/ /lam 'bras pa yi snang gsum sogs dang mtshungs/ /bde stong phyag rgyar grags dang 'di mtshungs mod/ /'on —180—

kyang de ni cher yang lam bzhin bkri/ /de ltar de ni rnal 'byor pa yi lam de nas spyod pa bya bar rgyal pas bshad/ /re shig gsangs te spyod pa bya ba ste/ /phyi nas a wa ga ti'i spyod pa dang / /spros bcas la sogs phyogs lhas rnam rgyal gyi/ /spyod pa༄ yin zhes chen po 'ga' zhig gsung / /la la shin tu spros med bhu su ku/ /spros med a wa dh+wa ti'i spyod pa dang / /brda' dang tshogs kyi rim pa rnam mang po/ /spros bcas in+d+ra hūṃ tis mdzad pa ste/ /'dis na tshogs kyi 'khor lo dbang bskur zhes/ /gsungs te 'di gnyis 'gal ba yod ma yin/ /gnas 'dir phyag rgya chen po kho na'ang yod/ khren tu spros med kun tu bzang po zhes/ /gsungs pa rnams kyang 'di la dgongs pa yin/ /'di ni grub pa rnams kyi lam yin te/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas rdzas kyi rig 'dzin dang / /las rgyas 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa grub/ /ye shes phyag rgyas gzugs khams phyag chen gyis/ /ye shes zung 'jug sku la snga nas sbyor/ /rnam kun ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ /nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'o/ /de mthar thabs kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /snying rje chen po bsgrub ces bya/ /stong dang brgyad brgya'i 'pho ba 'gog pa na/ /re re zhing yang sa ni thob par 'gyur/ /sa gsum gsum ni bsnyen pa la sogs te/ /ye shes sku chen sgrub par byed pas na'o/ /lus ngag thig le 'pho ba'i bag chags dang /yan lag bcu gnyis dus sbyor bcas pa bzlog /tha mal sgo gsum thig ler bcas bzlog pas/ /bde ba'i rdo rje rnam bzhi 'thob par 'gyur/ /yan lag rnam bzhi chos mos sogs sbyor bas/ /chos sku gtsang dang ye shes bde ba dang /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'dir yang dam pa'i bdag /sprul sku rtag pa dam pa 'bras —181

bu bzhi/ /thabs dang shes rab dbye bas gzhi dang ni/ /lam du'ang rnam pa gnyis su bshad pa ste/ /de phyir ye shes sngags kyi sku rnam gnyis/ /bden gnyis ngo bo gcig pa rnam par rig /'di ni zung 'jug mi gnas myang 'das rim/ /gsang rim bsam mi khyab dang ting 'dzin 'bras/ /ye shes lus las tha mal ba la min/ /gzhom med sgra dang 'gyur bral bde chen thob/ /bde ba che dang rnam kun pa'i/ /yul gyi dbye bas ye shes sku/ /gzhom med nā da dang snying rjes/ /gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis su shes/ /ma rig bag chags sa dang yid kyi lus/ /mi shigs thig ler 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / /gnas skabs bzhi dang rlung sems phra mo dang / /rlung dang rnam shes khu rdul tshogs pa dang / /don dam stong nyid de bzhin rnam kun pa/ /snang gsum rtsa rlung thig le 'od gsal dang / /zhu bde lhan skyes rang bzhin lhan skyes dang / /ye shes lus dang longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /'pho med bde chen gzhom du med pa'i sgra/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin dang / /glo bur rnam dag de bzhin spyan lnga dang / /phyag rgya gsum dang dga' ba'i skad cig dang / /spyod pa gsum pa rnams dang dgu sogs dang / /bden don bcu gnyis de bzhin bcu drug gi /rnam pa'i rab dbye shes na gsang sngags kyi/ /nges pa'i don la da gzod spobs pa 'thob/ /'di ni kun dga' snying po yis/ /rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa rnams/ /'gro la brtse ba'i sems grim pos/ /mdo tsam yongs su bzhad pa yin/ /chos 'di'i ming ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rab tu gsal ba zhes bya'o/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos bris pa'i dge bas rtag brtan g.yu drung —182—

ba'i mdzod/ /rab phye nam mkha'i rdo rje gsal ba'i gzhung / /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /thos bsam bsgoms pas 'di don rtogs par rbe(ga /zhus dag/ shubha ma stu sarba dzā ga taX/ dge legs 'phel// //

oṃ khyu sti/ na mo gu ra be/ rang gi mdun du seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog dbyer med sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/yum phag mo dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa la snyoms par 'jug pa/mchan khung du kha ṭāX ga /g.yas brkyang gis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus mang nyung ci rigs dang / de nas bstod pa ci shes dang / oṃ rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo hūX/ oṃ hiXha ha hūX huX phaṭa/ oX nai oX/ bzlas pa'o/ /ar+ghaX sogs dang bstod pa bya/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+re bha ba a bhi 'a ṣañtsa huX/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /sogs kyi bum dbang / yab yum byang sems lce thog tu gnang / oṃ āXhuX/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs kyis gsang dbang / phyag rgya btad/ dga' gter gnas ster sogs/ snyoms par zhugs/ tsho( sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra sā bhā ba at+pa ko3haX/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / ye shes 'di ni sogs dbang bzhi pa'o/ /yi ge brgya pa bzla/ bzod par gsol/ bla ma rang la thim/ smon lam btab/ bkra shis bya'o/ /bde mchog lhan skyes kyi gnas su yi dam gang mos skabs sbyar rig par bya'o/ /yang bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum po re re dang / gsum car gyi 'od zer rang la stim pa la dbang bzhir byed pa yang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gnad chen po yod la/ dbang bzhi dang chos mtshungs tsam yin gyis/ dbang dngos kyi cho ga ma —184—

yin no/ /bla ma 'od du zhu/ smin mtshams sogs gnas bzhir khyab pas dbang bzhi thob par bsam pa yang dbang dngos ma yin kyang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyong ba la gnad che zhing / dga' ba bzhi 'char bar byin gyis brlabs pas bde stong sgom pa la bsngags pa zhig go /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yig chung ste dang po'o// bkra shis/ khri//na mo gu ra be/ lam bsgom pa la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rnam par dag pa cig gal che/ zhi gnas la sems gnas thabs dgu/ nyes pa lnga spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad la brten nas/ sems gsal ngar can shin tu dwangs pa la/rnam rtog gi g.yo ba med par rtse gcig tu gnas pa zhig dang / lhag mthong la/spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i lta ba go ba tsam ma lus pa'i myong ba thon pa zhig dgos/ 'di ma byung na sems gnas pa than thun gyi mtshams shig nas rtsa bral du ngo sprod de/ dbang po rab re re gnyis gnyis ma gtogs/ bon dang / ha shang mahā ya na'i lugs kyi sgom du 'gro ba mang / de mu stegs pa rab kyi ting nge 'dzin las dma' ba yin/ zhi lhag rnam dag cig yod na/ /de ma bor ba'i ngang nas gang shar ma bcos pa lam du byed pa btsan thabs su ngo sprod pa 'di/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag grub chen rnams kyi lugs yin/ spyir zhi lhag bzang po thun mong ba de/ tshe ril bsgoms kyang / rkyen la brten nas 'phel 'khrib sna tshogs byed pa zhig 'ong ba/ de ma bcos pa lam du byed pa 'dis zin na/rna rkyen gang gi yang 'gyur ba med pa zhig 'phral du 'grub pa yin/ de tsam na rtsa bral du song ba yin no/ /'ga' zhig zhi lhag gi gzhung lam la 'gro mi dgos/ deng phyag —185—

rgya chen po seng lam pa yin/ grub thob 'ga' zhig ngo sprod tshig res grol ba bzhin no zer te/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag de rnams/ sngon bsgoms pa'i nus pa rkyen des sad nas grol ba yin mod kyi/ las dang po pa la mi rung / rnal 'byor ma bi na sa/ chu bum chags pa mthong bas grol ba dang 'dra ste/ gang zag phal pa rnams/ chu bum pas/ stong gsum zhig pa mthong yang ga la grol/ 'on kyang ma bcos pa lam du byed pa 'di ma nor ba zhig byung na/ than thun skyangs kyang chos brgyad rags pa mgo snyoms nus pa zhig 'dug mod kyi/ da lta phal cher/ bon lugs su ngo sprad pas/ nyi ma skyel ba dang mi tshe 'phul ba tsam du 'gro yin snang bas/ 'di'i gnad ma 'chugs pa zhig lag tu blang ba'i tshul la/ dang por sems gnas rta pa sa/la che zhing / dmigs rten gang la 'jos/ kyang / ched 'dzin dang bral zhing / rtse gcig tu 'dril ba zhig dgos/ dmigs pa yang phyi la mi bya bar sems la sems 'jog pa'o/ /gnas dang lus gnad lta stangs gcig la sems brtan nas de rnams nges med du byas la sems sngar bzhin slab/ sgom du ci yang med pa la yengs su brdul tsam med par bya/ de nas phyi rol gyi gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i snang ba gang shar gyi 'char sgo lam me ba de la/ sngar bzhin skyong / de nas spyod lam thams cad la bsre zhing na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i ngo bor snang ba/ 'char sgo lhang lhang ba de'i ngo bo la sngar bzhin bskyangs/ nyin mo sgom rgyun mi chad du song ba'i tshe/ 'dun pa cung zad kyi khyad par gyis/ mtshan mo gnyid mthug po dang / rmi lam du'ang 'ong bas zhi gnas khor yug tu 'gro zhing / de thams cad la dran pa skyong ba gal che ba yin —186—

no/ /sems gnas pa thun mong ma yin pa'i yig chung ste gnyis pa'o/ khri //na mo gu ra be/ sems gnas pa de la brtan pa thob nas/ man ngag ltar skye 'gags gnas gsum legs par rtsal bas/ snang tsam la gang du yang ma grub pa zhig 'ong ste/ de la mnyam par 'jog de'i rtsi ma yal ba zhig dgos pas/ yang nas yang du 'phro bcad de skyar gin sgom pa la gal che'o/ /de yang snga ma bzhi'i mnyam rjes thams cad la rtsal zhing sre bar bya'o/ /thams cad la sre nus shing / rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i tshe ma bcos pa lam du byed pa yin te/bzang ngan 'char sgo ci byung yang / shar tsam nyid nas/ rang gi rang shes shing /shes tsam nyid nas ngo bo skye 'gag 'gro 'ong med pa/ go ba tsam min par lhag ge mthong ba gcig 'ong ste/ gong snang thams cad rang ngos nas rkang tshugs tshugs 'dra ba 'di/ yul med du bud kyang 'char sgo thams cad 'gags pa med pa zhig 'byung ngo // /de'i tshe ched gnyer gyi mi slod mi sgrim ched gtad mi sgom mi 'chos/gang shar de nyid la bzo bcos byed don med/ yang don gal po che sems pa dang / gsung rab kyi don phra mo la dpyod pa sogs la'ang / de dang de'i 'char sgo la ma bcos pa'i skyong tshul dgos shing de'i tshe sgom la nga bdag bral/ dgag rgyu dang sgrub rgyu ma snyed/ spang bya dang blang bya ro mnyam du song / 'char sgo thams cad 'char kyang / 'char bya 'char byed brnyed rgyu med par/ rang ngo rtsol med du shes pa zhig byung ba'i tshe/ rtsa ba bral ba zhes bya ba'am/ 'gyur ba med pa yin no/ /'di thob nas kyang rig pas dpyod pa dang / bskyed rim sogs spros bcas ji ltar mang gin rtsa bral las mi 'da' bas shin tu bogs che ba yin gyi/ nyon —187—

mongs ye shes su rlom shing / spros bcas kyi dge sbyor la sdang ba ni spangs blang 'dzol ba'i chos la log go /rtsa bral gyi yig chung ste gsum pa'o/ khri/ /na mo gu ra be/ khyad par dug lnga lam 'khyer la/ 'jig rten phal pa rnams/ dug lnga rang dgar spyad pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ pha rol du phyin pa las/ byams pa la sogs pas mgo gnon/ stong pa nyid bsgoms pas rtsa ba nas spong par bshad cing / yang snying rje la sogs pas thabs mkhas 'ga' zhig gis lam du byed pa theg chen thams cad las 'byung / rnal 'byor bla med ma gtogs/ sngags gzhan rnams kyang de dang phal cher 'dra/ bla med 'dir/'od gsal mi rtog pas/ gti mug lam du 'byer ba dang / mngon spyod kyis zhe sdang dang / lha'i nga rgyal gyi nga rgyal dang / rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi bde ba la sogs pas 'dod chags ched du ma spangs par brten pas lam du gyur na spang bya rang dag tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir/ lta ba la brten nas dug lnga ma bcos lam du 'byer tshul ni/ dper na/ sems 'dod chags kyi rnam par lam me shar ba'i tshe/ rang dga' mar song na skye bo phal pa'i sems dang 'dra/ched kyi spong na thabs la mi mkhas/ des na chags yul/ chags mkhan/ chags tshul rang bzhin gyi grub pa med cing / brnyed rgyu med kyang / 'dod chags kyi 'char sgo ma 'gags pa de la skyon yon du mi lta/ las mi 'chol bar 'char sgo de ka la bzhag pa'i tshe/ 'dod chags rdo rje rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba yin no/ /de bzhin du nyon mongs pa lnga char la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'di la'ang rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rim pa gnyis 'ong ngo nam —188—

mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor ba/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'gro don byed/ /nyi zla lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nyi zla lta bur 'gro don byed/ /chu bo lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /chu bo lta bur 'gro don byed/ /sa gzhi lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sa gzhi lta bur 'gro don byed/ /dug lnga gra zur ma chag kyang / /sman du 'gro ba ngo mtshar che/ /sngon chad dgra bo yin pa yang / /thabs kyi gnyen du khugs pa 'dra/ /'dod chags rdo rje la sogs pa'i yig chung ste bzhi pa'o/ khri/na mo gu ra be/ lam rim pa gnyis las/ bskyed rim gyi man ngag rnams gzhan du shes par bya bas 'dir ma brjod/ lha'i rnam pa bsal ba dang gcigang rgyal shugs drag pa dang gnyis/ rang bzhin med pa'i lta bas zin pa dang gsum rang lhar sgom pa gang la yang gal che/ bskyed rim du 'gro ba la de'i steng du skye shi bar do gsum sbyong byed dang / sku gsum lam khyer du song ba/ zhu bdes rgyas thebs pa rnams dgos/ rdzogs rim la gtum mo sgom na/ lus gnad sogs lag len ltar bya/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ phyi lus kyi stong ra dang bcas pa thun re re la/ lan gnyis brgya tsam re sgom zhing / thun bzhi byas la/nyin zhag mang du sgom ste dmigs skor gnyis/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba la/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i yi ge re re gsal 'debs pa la dmigs skor re re/ me rlung gnyis la re re lag len ltar bum pa can byas la yi ge rnams gsal btab pa'i rjes su/ lte ba'i gtum mo kho na la sems 'dzin pa dmigs skor gciga'akhor lo bzhi 'bar ba'i re re/ de bawo gshegs pa'i rgyud la 'gro 'ong byed pa la gcig /dkar dmar 'dres pa dang po la gcig /'bar 'dzag gnyis ka —189—

sgom pa la gcig ste/ de nas de nyid rtag tu sgom mo/ /des rtags lnga dang yon tan brgyad 'byung ngo / /gtum mo'i yig chung ste lnga pa'o/ zhu/na mo gu ra be/ bum pa can brtan pa'am/ cung zad myong ba thon nas/lus gnad lag pa gnyis rkang pa'i bol la bcang pa lce spyang gi 'dug stangs byas la/ lag len bzhin/ rlud phyir bus la mnan/ 'thur sel then/ rtsa'i ka ba gzug par bya/ thog mar sgra med la slab ste thun gcig de nas ha dang ha ka dang hi dang hri dang / hū gi sgra rnams la thun re re/ de nas steng rlud cung zad brngub cing thur sel 'dren pa la thun gcig 'di dag sgom pa'i tshe/ kha spyor drag tu steng du drangs pa dang / spel nas sgom dgos shing / kha sbyor 'dren pa de nyid la yang dgos su skyong zhing / 'og gi lam gnyis snol ma'i sbyor ba yang lpin zhag mang du slab/ de dag la/ yang yang krug 'grems dang 'khrul 'khor mnad du che/de nas hu rings kyi srog nang du drangs shing / hū thung gi thur sel steng du drangs/phaṭa kyi sbyor bas sre ba ni hūṃ phaṭa kyi sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ 'di shin tu gal che ba yin/ de nas khams 'gyur ba 'gag pa/ ril ba zhabs tshags can gyi sbyor ba yang goms par bya/ thog mar re re la ci rigs par goms nas/ bum pa can la gzhi byas te sbyar ba gzhan de rnams kyang thun bzhir ma chag par sgoms/gsang ba'i rlung kha sbyor rgyun ma chad par bya/ gnad ma 'chugs par sgom na zla ba drug gam/ lo tsam sgom pas/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnad 'byugs pa'i rlung spyor gyis ni mi tshe la'ang yon tan mi skyed par snang ngo / /rlung sbyor gye yig chung ste drug pa'o/ lho/—190—

na mo gu ra be/ gal te rmi lam bzung bar 'dod na/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ yi ge oṃ dmar po la sems gtad cing / rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ thun re re la dmigs pa gsal 'debs thengs dang /'dun pa stong ba lan lnga brgya tsam bya'o/ thun mtshams thams cad du rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu btang / nyal ba'i tshe oṃ la sems gtad pas/ rmi lam 'phral du zin pa yin no/ /rmi lam sgom pa la rlud gnad du che/ rmi lam sbyangs pa/ snang ba sna tshogs su bsgyur ba ni/ gzhan dang mthun la nyin par rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dras/ tu bskyed nas/ 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa bsgoms pas/ mtshan mo'i dus rmi lam shar yang / slar 'od gsal du 'jug pa yin no/ /nyin par rmi lam zin pa brtan pos/ nyin par snang ba sgyu ma rtag tu bsgoms pas/ rmi lam thams cad lha skur sgyur nus pa yin no/ /lha sku 'od gsal du ldang 'jug gi dmigs pa yang yang bsgoms pas/ rmi lam gyi lha sku rang shar 'byung ba yin no/ /rmi lam yig chung ste bdun pa'o/ khri/na mo gu ra be/ snang ba sgyu ma la/ las dang po pa dang / brtan pa thob pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtum mo 'am las rgya la sogs pa'i bde stong gi myong ba cung zad yod na rab/ med na stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyi bskyed nas/bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sgom/ gsal snang cung zad thob nas snang ba thams cad la gsal snang dang bden med kyi 'dun pa spros nas/ yang bdag nyid la bsdu ba sogs goms par bya'o/ /'dir bskyed rim dang thun mong pa yin yang rdzogs sna rim gyi sgyur 'gyur ba la shin tu zab bo/ / gnyis pa ni/ bde —191—
