stong gi ye shes skye khar 'phen pa btang bas/ de sad pa dang lha skur rang shar dus snyam yod pa yin te/ de yang bde stong gi nyams skyes pa na 'phen pa btang ste lha sku stong par stim/ sad pa na rnam rtog gzhan gyi bar ma chod par lha bskyed nas spro bsdu dang / sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyong ba yang yang goms pa las 'byung ba yin no/ /'di gsang 'dus rim lnga'i bdag byin brlab pa dang mi gcigalus dben dang don gcig kyang / sgyu lus kyi tha snyad mi 'gal zhing / sad rmi gnyis ka'i dge sbyor la gal che'o/ /sgyu lus kyi yig chung ste brgyad pa'o/ khri/ /na mo gu ra be/ las dang po pa'i 'od gsal sgom par 'dod na/ snying kha chos 'khor gyi lte bar/ hu sngon po'am/ thig le la sems drag tu gtad la yun ring du sgom/ mtshan mo yang / de ka'i ngang la gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ gnyid du 'gro ba'i tshe na yang dmigs pa dang dran 'dzin bya/ ha cang grims grags na gnyid du mi 'gro/ ltod grags na mi zin pas ran pa'i skyong lugs bya/ thim rim than thun dang 'dres pa'i ci rigs zin na/ snang ba gzhan thams cad rjes gzhig gi bsdus nas/ chos 'khor tsam dmigs nas sgom/ de yang bsdus nas hu tsam dang / nā da tsam dang / stong pa la rtse gcig tu gtod pa rnams re re la zhag mang du byas te nyin par sgom zhing / mtshan mo'ang de dang des mtshon/ phyi ma 'di rnams la lus kyi stong sa ma 'chugs pa gal che/ thams cad la brten lha sku dang ldang ba na yang / lha skur ldang ba gal che/ 'od gsal gyi yig chung ste dgu pa'o khri //na mo gu ra be/ spyir dgyes rdor sogs spyi'i lugs kyi/ sad dus rlung —192—

——sems lte bar gnas/ gnyis mthug la snying khar/ rmi lam la mgrin par/snyoms 'jug gi tshe spyi bor gnas par gsungs/ dus 'khor las/ thog mtha' gnyis go zlog tu 'byung zhes mkhas pa rnams gsungs/ dus 'khor las kyang thur sel gyi dbang du byas na/ lte ba sad dus su bshad cing / steng gi dbang du byas pa la yang spyi bo sad dus su bshad pa med/ dpral ba sad dus su bshad pa yin/ lte ba la yas mas kyi cha gnyis yod pas mi 'gal ces bla ma lho phyogs pas gsungs / de'i gnad kas nor bu dang snying khar 'od gsal/ gsang ba dang mgrin par rmi lam/ lte ba dang spyi bor yas babs dang mas brtan gyi lhan skyes sogs sgom pa yin/ lhan skyes de sgom pa la rtog can rnal 'byor la brten pa gtum mo'o/ /chags can 'og sgo la brten pa la/ rlud las rna ma par rgyal ba thob nas sgrub pa ni gtso bo yin la/ cung zad nus pa thob nas/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob pa'i phyir brten pa'ang yod de/ gang ltar yang / lta ba la cung zad myong ba thon pa dang / lha sku'i gsal snang ngam/ ma mtha' yang mos pa brtan po dang / rlung sogs man ngag gi gnad la goms pa'i yid brtan thub pa cig tha mar yang dgos pa yin no/ /'di la thog mar yid kyi phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas gsang ba'i phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas las kyi phyag rgya'i gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / phyi'i reg bya rnams la rim gyis bslab/ de nas rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar bas kur ma'i 'gros kyis 'khor lo bzhir dga' ba bzhi so sor skye ba la rim gyi bslab/ de yang / dbab dang gzung dang zlog dang khyab/ /rlung dang stong par sre ba la/ /shin tu 'bad nas bsgom par bya/ /rtsa 'tshol ba —193—

sogs gnad che zhing / /lta bsam zin ngan song rgyu/ /'dod chen khu ba myur 'dzag pa/ /de la dngos grub mi byung zhes/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las gsungs/nga yi rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di/ /bka' las 'da' bar ma byed cig /byang chub sems ni lhung 'gyur na/ /dam tshig nyams pas dmyal bar lhung / /tshe 'di sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung / /bde ba nyams par mi bya'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i yig chung ste bcu pa'o/ khri/ /na mo gu ra be/ tha mal gyi sgo dgag pa 'di ni/ rdzogs rim gang gi mngon du sgom kyang / shin tu bzang ba yin no/ /de la 'dis rlung nang du zlog dbang po rnams kyi nad sel/ byang chub kyi sems sgo thams cad nas 'ching / yan lag gi rlud dul/ mngon par shes pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ /tha mal gyi sgo dgag pa'i yi ge rgyas pa ni/ spyi gtsug tu hūX khriX brtsegs pa/ smin mtshams su haX hūX/ lce'i rtsa bar suX/ mgrin par snro / mig la huX/ rna ba dang / sna bug la yuX/ lte ba dang 'og sgo gnyis su dzhaiX / phrag pa gnyis su snro / snying khar snro / yi ge bzhi brtsegs yu rnams mgo nang stan nyal stabs su 'god par rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin 'grub na shin tu mthu che ba yin/ de tsam ma 'grub na gnas de rnams su thig le kha dog dkar po re re bkod/ de'i 'od zer dkar po mthug pos sgo de dang de brtan por bkag par bsam/ re re la yang zhag lnga lnga re bslab cing / de nas gnyis sdoms sogs la rim gyi bslab/ mthar thams cad gcig char gsal btab nas/ rlung nang du bzlog pa'i rtags byung —194—

byung sgom ste/ bum pa can dang sbyor dgos so/ /lus gnad kyang lce spyang gi 'dug stangs bzhin byed pa gdan bzhi'i dgongs pa yin/ de goms nas nye ba'i aX dmar po gsal btab/ de'i 'od kyi lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas e la bsdus pa sgom pa ni/ khab byed bsdu ba ste/nad thams cad zhi bar byed cing / rlud thim pa la yang gnad du che ba yin no/ /yi ge brgyad po rnams snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la bkod pas rtsa gnas gzhan gyi rlung bkag nas dbu mar 'jug pa sogs mang po gdan bzhi'i rgyud la sa 'byung ngo // sgo dgag pa'i yig chung ste bcu gcig pa'o//na mo gu ra be/ gong du 'pho bar 'dod na 'pho ba'i lha ye shes dbang phyug mar bskyed pa'am/ yi dam gang yang rung bas/ bshad ma thag pa'i sgo dgag pa de nyid la nan tan du 'bad/ phyi nang gi rlung log pa'i rtags byung zhing bum pa can brtan na rab/ ma brtan kyang ci rigs bsgom pa la 'gal ba med de/ 'on kyang 'di la ni spel gyin sgom pa yin no/ /bum pa can ma brtan na/ gser gyi sgo 'byed nus pa dka' zhing / khyad par 'pho ba dang grong 'jug la dbang 'byor ba ni mi 'byung ngo / /des na bum pa can brtan brtan gyi bar bum can 'dod du mi rung ngo / /'pho ba rgyas par/ snying khar yi ge bdun 'god pa ste/ yum bzhi dang / huX dang / hika kha dog sngon po rnams so/ /de tsam sgom mi nus na yi ge gsum la brten pas kyang chog ste/ hūX dang hi ki'o/ /de yang mi nus na huX gcig pus chog go gang ltar na'ang chos 'khor 'dab brgyad kha thur stan gyi lte ba na rlung gi dkyil 'khor la yig mgo thur bstan du 'phyang ba/ lte ba'i aX gi me —195—

'bar ste snying kha'i yi ge dang spyi bo'i ha la bsnun pa'i 'bar 'dzag gi gtum mo sgom pa sngon du 'gro ba gal che ste/ sems brten gyi dkar dmar skyod pa la dkar dmar gzhi rgya 'bar 'dzag gal che ba yin no/ /dngos kyi dmigs pa ni/a dmar po'i 'od kyis snying kha la 'phog pas yi ge rnams dbu ma'i lam nas spyi bor 'phangs te spyi bo'i steng du cung zad mthon par bsam/ ha yi mthen cing ka yi 'phul/ pad+ma 'ang kha gyen la bstan/ rlung 'byung ba'i tshe hika nyi shu rtsa gcig gis steng du 'phang / brngub pa'i tshe ka hi snying khar dbab par bsam/ grong du 'jug pa dang / tshar gcad rjes 'dzin 'dir ma bkod/ sgo 'bring nas 'pho ba'i man ngag kyang shin tu mang bas ma bris/ 'pho ba'i yig chung ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ khri/ /na mo gu ra be/ gal te 'khrul 'khor byed 'dod na/ /'chi med grub pa la sogs bya/ /yang na thor bu ba rnams bsdu/ /lto ba skor dang ro stod bcu/ /mgo bo bskor zhing dgye dgu bya/ /steng du 'phar zhing 'og tu bdab/ / yan lag dkrug dang brkyang bskum bya/ /dang po srung shing srub par bya/ / gnyis pa rgya mtsho skyod par bya/ /gsum pa bsad pa nor lha gnyis/ /bzhi pa yan lag brkyang bskum ste/ /phyogs bzhi g.yo zhing srid gsum skrag /sbyor ba drug ldan ri rab 'degs/ /gcan gzan skyug dang wa ltar snom/ /yi dwags 'dug stangs glang chen rting / /g.yang mo'i rgang dkrugs sesgo'i rtsal/ /hri tri seṅge rnam par brol kyi phrol ka/ /rjes chags skre (ske kar gas 'khor lo bskor/ /zhags pa 'phangs dang rtsa mig bdab/ /nyi ma'i 'gros dang sernye'i g.yal/ /glang chen bzhi 'phras —196—

bu chung lugs/ /bab bzhi 'phrab dang mi chen lugs/ /yan lag lnga sbyor ban+ta gnyis/ /gling bzhi gnad bor sgrad pa'i mtha'/ /rtsa bcing mig sogs 'khrul 'khor ro/ /'di rnams bya sla zhing gnad che ba dag go /'khrul 'khor gyi yig chung ste bcu gsum pa'o/ khri//na mo gu ra be/ rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa gang la yang / sems gtad pa tsam gyi rlung yon po yang mnyam rgyur thengs na/ dbu mar zhugs pa zhes bya/dmigs pa gang la sems gtad pas/ sna sgor rgyu ba 'gags na gnas pa zhes bya/ khong rlung gi khengs pa bzhin yod pa yang yal zhing thim pa'i tshe/ thim pa zhes bya/ thim ma thag drod dang zhu bde skye/ bde drod ma byung na thim pa rnam dag ma yin/ drod la srab mthug dang / phyi nang dang / gnas gzhan du 'pho ba myur bul sogs kyi khyad par yod/ brtags lnga yang rlung thim pa'i tshe gtso bor 'byung ste/'ga' zhig rtags lnga dang / dkar lam shar ba sogs/ sems kyi khyad par gyi dper bzhed pa'ang yod/ 'on kyang rtags snang de rnams 'char ba yin te/ de la snang ba dkar lam 'jam pa dang bde ba'i rnam pa can du 'char/ mched pa dmar lam rtsub cing gsal ba thod dka' ba'i rnam pa can 'char/ thob pa nag lam rgyal ba dran med kyi rnam pa can 'byung / bzhi pa 'od gsal gsal zhing rig pa bde ba chen po'i rnam pa can 'gyung / de rnams phyi ma phyi ma rnam rtog nub phul che zhing / myong ba ngos zin pa gal che/ de bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi phyogs mthun pa yin mod/ 'on kyang 'khor lo bzhir babs pa'i nyams myong gi dbang du byas na/ bde bar snang tsam gdong la ljid babs pa 'dra ba ni dga' ba —197—

rdzogs pa'i tshad yin/ snying khar lhang bas ni mchog dga' rdzogs ste bar shigs se 'byung bas khyad dga' rdzogs/ gsang bar mer gyi 'byung ba ni lhan skyes so/ /lugs bzlog la yang / gsang bar stong sang ba dang / lte bar sgring nge ba dang / snying kha khang ba dang / spyi bor sgrid chil ba dang bde ba dang zug ngu'i rnam pa can ci rigs su 'byung ba ni mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'o/ /dga' ba bzhi po 'di dag las dang po pa rnams la/ las kyi phyag rgya kho nas gsal bar mtshon la/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa man chad ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang gtum mos kyang gsal po mtshon nus so/ /dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig ma bzhi sbyor ba myong ba'i steng nas ngos 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin du skad cig ma bcu drug sogs kyang ngos zin dgos la/ rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye ba'ang zhib tu shes dgos mod kyi rnam gzhag rnams/ bshad pa las shes shing / myong ba lag len ltos pas rtsad bcad par bya'o/ /nyams kyi yi chung ste bcu bzhi pa'o khri/ /na mo gu ra be/ 'di'i lo rgyus zur du shes/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad 'di la rnam pa lnga ste/ kha sbyor gyi drang ba dang / lto ba phyir bskyed pas bogs dbyung ba dang / nang gi kha spyor gyi bcud len cing nad gsal ba dang / glod cing skrad pa'i mtha' 'gyur ba 'gegs pa dang / rgyal mtshan gzug pa'i cho gas bogs dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni steng rlung bsu ma cung zad bcug la/ thur sel dal bus drang ba dang / drag tu drang ba dang / dpe med par 'dren pa gsum/ thur sel gyi bsu ma bcug nas/ srog mnan pa dang / drag tu mnan pa dang / dpe —198—

med par mnan pa dang gsum mo/ /'di srog thur bsre ba la bsngags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rlung gnyis kha sbyar ba rgyab nas rlung mdun du drangs/ sus khri sug 3par sdig la lto ba phyir skyed pa dang / drag tu bskyed pa dang / dpe med par bskyed pa dang gsum mo/ /'di gong ma'i bogs 'don no/ /gsum pa ni/ lte bar kha sbyor drag tu byas la 'pho bar drangs// der rtse gcig tu ga/tho med du bzhag ya nga rgyab nas drangs te lto ba kha sbyar dang / drag tu kha sbyar dang / dpe med par kha sbyar dang gsum mo/ /'dis pho nad la sogs pa 'joms so/ /'di brtan na gang na sar/ kha sbyor de nyid drag tu byas pas sel lo /bzhi pa ni/ srin po'i lam phul ba dang / drag tu phul ba dang / dpe med par phul ba dang gsum mo/ /'dis ni thig le 'gag go /de'i bogs 'don du/yan lag bzhi sgrad pa dang / drag tu sgrad pa dang / dpe med par sgrad pa gsum mo/ /'di la lus nya bzhi glod pa yin la/ 'dis kyang nad sel ba yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ steng rlung khong mnan tsam bya/ a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas/ rgyal mtshan gzug pa dang / drag tu gzug pa dang / dpe med par gzug pa dang gsum mo/ /'di la nya bzhi sgrim bzhin khro bo ltar bsdus/ skabs 'gar lto ba 'gyur bya/ bde ba'i bogs 'don no/ /dang po la/ lha dkar po zhi ba/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya can zhabs kyi rtse btsugs pa gcig sgom/ lus kyang bya rog gi 'dug stangs bya/ gnyis pa la/ ser po brjid pa la bzhugs pa gcig sgom/lus gnad lag pad pus mo la 'gebs/ gsum pa la/ lha mo nag mo khros pa —199—

gcig sgom/ lus thab 'gal bya/ bzhi pa la/ lha ljang khu spyan gyen du gzigs pa gcig gi sna'i nang du/ du ba dmar ser yal le ba sgom/ lnga pa la/ lha dmar po g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon dril bu 'khrol ba gcig sgom/ de gnyis la lus gnad nges pa med/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi yig chung ste bco lnga pa'o khri //na mo gu ra be/ rlud rang 'gag dang / shes pa gnam du 'phang pa dang /nam mkha' la yas pa dang / spyi bor gtad pa dang / gzo med dang / bde ba'i ngo bo dmigs gtad zhig pa rnams bzung ba'i man ngag go /rgya mtsho'i ri rab la cer ba dang / dar chen rang gnas su 'phyar/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdus/ bya rgod nam mkhar sbur/ ri rab rtse mo dgug shes pa spyi bor gtad la hu phaṭa kyi mda' gzhus 'phang ba ni zlog pa'i man ngag go /lus 'ja' tshon ltar ban bun song bar bsam pa ni/ khyab pa'i man ngag go /dpral bar mig dmar po 'byed 'dzum byed pa la bsams pas 'gyur ba dal bar 'gyur ro/ /e re'i thal ba dang / dha du ras byugs pas kyang ngo / /'ga' zhig sor mos skud pa gnon pa dang / rdzas kyi sgo nas 'gyur ba rengs par byed pa ni thabs sdugs so/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po dang / mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las mang du gsungs pa'i las tshogs tsam la dgongs pa yin no/ /man ngag gi gnad thun mong pa'i yig chung ste bcu drug go/ /man ngag 'di rnams skal ba dang ldan pa dag gi nyams su longs shigardo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di la 'grub pa'i thabs chen po bla na med —1khri0—

pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying byung ba yin no/ /gnad dang lag len bla ma'i zhal las shes/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas byin rlabs shing / /dkyil 'khor slob dpon chen por gyur/ /lhas byin rlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i sems dang ldan/ /de yi man ngag ji lta bar/ /mngon sum du ni rtogs na yang / /re zhig yi ger ma bris pa/ /deng 'dir yig chung so sor bkod/ /sdom pas yi ge chen por song / /dbang chog gsang ba'i lo rgyus dang / /lam gyi chings rnams shes dgos so/ /'di ni gsang ba chen po yin/ /zab lam bka' rgya ma'i yi ge 'di rnams kyang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer lngar nye ba la/ slob ma zab don gnyer ba rnams kyi don du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dad ldan grags pa bzang po'o/ /yi ge 'di ci thod thod ma ston cig// // 201 —

kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/na mo gu sa spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ khrin can rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ / myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal yum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog bdag med lha/ /rgyal sras grub pa'i dbang phyug tshom bu pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub dar ma 'od zer spyi yi lha/ /chos rje byang chub tshul khrims brag dmar ba/ /snying po'i don gzigs lha btsun dgon gsar ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzos/sa mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa thugs rje brtson 'grus zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po chos rje shes rab 'bum/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med dngul chu ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byis gyis rlobs/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin chos rje rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /skad gnyis smras pa'i dbang po ngag dbang grags/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes dkon ma/chog rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byis gyis rlobs/ /mkhas btsun dam pa kun dga' mchog —202—

grub zhabs/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog rje/ /rgyal tshab dam pa lung rig rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas / /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byis gyis rlobs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /sngon sbyangs dam pa rin chen rgya mtsho ste/ /bstan pa'i srog shing blo gros rnam rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs chos kyi rje/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskyed rdzogs phro phyin nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed zung sbyor sngon 'gro dang / /bskyed rdzogs zung sbyor dngos gzhi'i nyams len sogs/ rjes spyod chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi gzhan gyis bskul ngor jo nang dpal rir bris/ /bkra shis/dge'o/ /zhus dag /—203—

o spru sti/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i man ngag las brtsams nas/yi dam kun gyi smar khrid nyams su blang bar 'dod pas 'di ltar bya ste/ de yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / las rgyu 'bras bsam pa rnams spyi dang 'dra ste/skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim nga sogs gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs 'jug pa maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa rnams yin te/ de dag kyang rgyas par zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig tu blta bar bya'o/ /bsdu na thun 'go'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor tsam gyis kyang chogaganyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun gyi sngon 'gro ni/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la dmigs te/ ci mdzad khyed rang shes so snyam pa'i blos 'gel gyi skyabs 'gro dang / mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la dmigs nas snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed gsal btab ste/ sangs —2slo—

rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /zhes sogs yid ma yengs par mang du brjod/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ mos gus dung ba dang bcas pas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsgom/ cung zad sems ngal gso/ thun gyi dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnam pa gsum ste/ rang yi dam kun 'dus su bsgom pa/ spyi bor bla ma kun 'dus su bsgom pa/ mkha' khyab bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ swabha wa'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas/ snang ba thams cad 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song / sems spros bral la cung zad mnyam par bzhag chos nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub pa'o/ /de'i ngang las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam ste/ sku zla ba la byang chub pa'o/ /de'i steng du hruXdakar po bsam ste/ gsung yig 'khru la byang chub pa'o/ /de las pad+ma dkar po sdong bu dang bcas pa lte ba la khyoXs mtshane par gyur pa ni/ thugs phyag mnan la byang chub pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim/ zla bas sa bon phyag mtshan ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur grub pa ni/ lha sku yongs su rdzogs pa la byang chub pa'o/ /de nas sku mdog dkar po phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas phreng ba/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sogs mtshan nyid spyi dang mthun/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od/ zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ rgyud sde —205—

bzhi'i lha tshogs zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim/ badz+ra sa mā dza dza / paṃ ho zhes brjod/rang nyid rnam pa ma 'gyur pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin la/ ngo bo yang ma gyur pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rang bzhin la/ mtshan nyid khyad par gyi chos yi dam kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam du mos pa drag po bya/ de nyid lan gsum sogs bskyar gyin bsgom mo/ /nyams khrid du byed na re zhig de la dmigasaskor gcig tu byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam par byon/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzir bha wa a bhi shiñtsa hu/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig sgrib dag yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ bla ma 'od dpag med rang gi spyi bor bzhugs/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dngos su chos 'brel thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang / dngos su ma mjal yang chos brgyud la bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad spyan drangs te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med la thim pas/ de nyid bla ma kun 'dus su gyur/ de la mos gdung drag pos rtse gcig tu gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /'di yang dmigs skor gcig gogasum pa ni/ de nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hu/ zhes bzlas pa na/ rang yi dam kun 'dus yin pas yi dam thams cad kyi bzlas par gyur la/ rigs bdag bla mas gsungs pas bla ma thams cad kyi bzlas par song / rang gi skra nyi khri chig stong / ba sbu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi/ srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs —206—

kyang lha'i ngo bor gnas pas/ de thams cad las yig drug gi sgra re byung /mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad lhar gsal ba dang / nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad las kyang yig drug gi sgra rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung nas/ snang srid thams cad yig drug tu 'u ru ru 'dug par mos te/ ma ṇi gang nus su bzla ba nyid do/ /thun gcig go /de thams cad la thun gyi rjes ni/ lha sku stong pa nyid du sbyangs la cung zad bzhag de ltar bsgoms pa'i dge bas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pas bsngo ba smon lam gdab/gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam/ de ye nas ma lcogs na sems dpa'i skyil krung bya/ lag pa mnyam gzhag gam/ khu tshur brla ba theg sga tshigs bsrang / so mchu rang sar bzhag lce rkan la sbyar/ dpung pa phyir bkyed/ mig lta stangs cung zad gyen du gtad de/ de rjes rlung ro gsum bsal nas rlung rang sor bzhagasems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog yid byed spros pa thams cad spangs nas/ ma bsgrims ma glod gang yang ma bsam par rngam me bzhag bying rmugs dang 'phro rgod byung na/ cung zad bsgrims shing bsgrims 'phro la glod/ thun gyi rjes snga ma dang 'dra ste dmigs skor gcig go /de ltar na sems gnas pa de nyid ngos bzung bral zhing / snang cha ma 'gags pa ngos zin par bya ste/ yang dmigs skor gcig go khing snang ba gang shar thams cad gsal la ngos bzung med par —207—

gdod ma nas gnas pas/ dgag sgrub spang blang med pas gang shar de kha'i ngang skyong ba ste/ yang dmigs skor gcig go /rgyas par na sor sdud bsam gtan sogs kyi man ngag kyang 'dir ci rigs pa bstan dgos la/ yang na phyag rgya chen por grags pa sogs lta khrid gzhan dang mthun par ngo sprad kyang rung ngo / /mdor bsdu na/ rdzogs rim dmigs skor gsum po nyid la gnad thams cad tshang bas 'di tsam gyis chog shes par yang bya'o/ /des dngos gzhi'i khrid tshar/gsum pa rjes kyi chos drug ste/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor/ bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor/ 'dug sa gnas khang gi rnal 'byor/ gnyid log 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor/ 'chi khar sangs rgya ba 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor/ bar dor sangs rgya bar do'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ bza' btung che chung gang la longs spyod kyang / lko ā hū/ zhes ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur/ de nas 'bru gsum kho na mang du brjod la/ phud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la phul/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis longs spyod do/ /gnyis pa ni de dang 'dra ba las/ gos lha rdzas kyi na bza' dpag tu med par byin gyis rlob/ gsum pa'ang de dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang ngam 'dug sa gang yin pa de/ gzhal med khang du byin gyis brlabs nas mang por spel ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ snying gar yi dam 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sor bzhi tsam pa gsal btab/ spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med bsgom/ gnyis ka la mos gus dung dung pa spel mar bsgom/ nyal pa'i tshe spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med —208—

tshangs bug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i yi dam la thim pa'am/ de'i rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa gang mos pa zhig bsgoms la/ snying ga'i bla ma yi dam la sems gtad de/ gnyid du 'gro bar byas pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro//lnga pa la sbyang ba dang / las la sbyar ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ spyi bor bla ma/snying gar yi dam/ lte bar chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du thig le sngo dmar/tshangs bug rgya mthong kha bye ba bzhin du skya thal le yangs po zhig bsgom/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung bag tsam bzung bas lte ba'i thig le sngo mar de'i dkyil nas/thig le dkar ser yungs kar tsam zhig thon spyo ring po brjod cing rlung kha nas phyir bsal bas thig le dkar ser de yang hril li li byung / snying kha'i yi dam la bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ tshangs bug nas rgyang ste thon nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ de lta bu bskyar gyin lan bdun sogs gang mang bsgom/ de nas 'bebs pa ni/ yar 'phos pa thams cad gcig tu 'dud pa'i ngo bo yungs 'bru lta bu de sngar gyi lam brgyud nas lte ba'i thig le la thim/ de nyid lan mang du byas nas/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas thim/ tshangs bug kyang zum par bsams nas dge ba rnga pre sngo/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ dus la babs pa'i tshe bya ste/ 'bebs pa dang bla ma bstim pa dang sgo 'gegs pa gsum spangs pas gzhan sngar bzhin no/ /drug pa ni snang ba 'di thams cad la bar do yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ gnas skabs 'di yar 'gro dang mar 'gro'i sa mtshams chen po yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong snyam pa'i zhe bcad drag tu byas nas/ gzugs su snang tshad spyan ras —209—

gzigs kyi sku/ sgra grags tshad yi ge drug pa'i sngags/ dgra gnyen chags sdang gi yul sogs bdag gzhan snod bcud snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ thun mtshams su yang dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ste/ sems can mthong tshad yi dam du bsgom/ chags sdang gi yul sogs gang shar thams cad bden med sgyu ma'i rtsis zin par byed pa gal che'o/ /de ltar na smar khrid tshim bu lugs kyi snying po bsdus pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag /dge legs 'phel/ / zu—210—

oṃ snya sti/'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal lung/rje btsunami tra dzo gi'i gdams pa/snying po don gsum gyi nyams len mdor bsdus pa ni'adi yin te/tshe 'dir rgyun gyi yi dam bsgom//'chi khar 'pho ba'i stseg ba/bsgom//bar dor bsre ba bsgom par bya//rgyun du bsgom pa kun gyi gnad//ces gsungs te/tshe 'dir sgom pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la/sngon 'gro dang dngos sto gnyis so//dang po ni/mi rtag sdug bsngal dran byas nag snying rje chen po rogabaskyed de//zhes gsungs pa yin te/da lta'i lus sems snang bdang bcas pa la gzhig 'grel zhig bcug nas/'di thams cad mi rtag cing 'jig pa'i chos/can yin/khyad par nam 'chi cha med/'chi ba la chos min pa cis kyang mi phan snyam pa dang /shi nas khungs med du ni mi 'gro/da lta'i dgra gnyen longs spyod snang ba 'di rnams gang yang rjes su mi 'brang /las bzang ngan gyi dbang gisarigs drug tu skye ba len pa na/gang du skyes kyang skyid med sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig yin snyam pa dang /khams gsum 'khol ra ba thams cad sdug bsngal yin pa/de yang legs par brtags na mkha' mnyam 'gro drug gi sems can drin can pha ma rnams sdug bsngal mtha' med pa myong ba yin snying re rje/'di rnams sdugabasngal las bdag gis drang bar bya snyam pa ste/'dun pa gsum po de rgyun

chags su bsgom pa yin pa las/ 'dun pa gsum po de la thun re re'am gsum kar bsdoms nas thun gcig tu byas kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma snying gar lha/ /rang sems skye med bsgotshapar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnad gsum las dang po spyi bor bla ma bsgomapa ni/ rang gi spyi bor chos sku'i ngo bo ni shel gyi ma rdzo rten sgo stong dang la pa'o/ /longs sku'i ngo bo ni de la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /sprul sku'i ngo bo ni/ sgo re re na sangs rgyas re re bzhugs pa/ sku gsum dbyer med kyi ngo bo mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang na rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos sam/ rdo rje 'chang go rnaslapa can no/ /mos gus dung byas la/ skye med chos sku'i ngo bo bla ma rin po tshelagasol ba 'debs so/ /'gag med longs sku'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che lagasolab 'debs so/ /gnas med sprul sku'i ngo bo bla ma zin po che la gsol ba lebasaso/ /sku gsum bde chen gyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs go/bdag la byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de 'od zer ratshabadud rtsi'i rgyun du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag gnad gnyis pa snying gar yi dam bsgom pa'i man ngag ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa 'i'am/'phags pa phyag bzhi pa gang mos pa zhig bsgom/ thugs kar zla ba la hriX'adab ma stong la a yig dkar po re re/ snying ga'i yi dam la mos gus dungasab dang ldan pas/ o.āXhiXhuX zhes pa dang / oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūX zhes ci nus su bzla/—212—

mthar de rnams 'od du ltem ste zhu/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur pa'i ngang la bzhag gnad gsum pa rang sems skye med bsgom pa'i gdams ngag ni/ lus gnad bcas/dbugs rang babs su bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog spangs te/ rangababs su shig ge rang zhal la bltas pas ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba ni/gzhi gnyug ma gnas pa lam du byed pa'o/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i snang ba dang / dga' sdug mtho dman la sogs pa rnam rtog gi 'char sgo gang 'byung ba/de ka la rang ngo shes tsam bzo bcos med par bzhag na/ gdod ma'i dzinasalugs dang dbye ba med par 'char ba ni/ lam gnyug ma 'gyur ba lam du byed pa'iman ngag go /'og tu 'chad pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi'i sgo nas ngo sprad kyangachog ste/ dngos gzhi la thun bzhi'am lnga'o/ /gnyis pa 'chi khar sgom pa 'pho ba'i man ngag la/ rang lus mchod spyin byas nas su/ /ltos pa thams cad rakraspangs te/ /'od kyi sbu gu'i sbyor ba yis/ /sems ni dga' ldan gnas su 'phang//zhes gsungs te/ rang gi mdun du mi mgo'i sgyid bu gsum byung / rang gi thod pa 'breg mtshams nas skor gyis phog pa de'i steng du bkal pas snod shin tu che bar gyur/ rang sems spyan ras gzigs kyi sku mthe bong tsam zhig lusakyidabus nas 'thon/ lus ni thod pa'i nang du lings kyis song / rang sems lha skus oṃ āXhuX/ zhes brjod pas/ rang lus bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags sna khri/sa thams cad spyan drangs/ oṃ āXskyoX kho na bzla bzhin pas/ dang por rtsa ba'i glam/denas brgyud —213—

pa'i bla ma/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos skyong srung ma rnamasalaphul bas dgyes par bsam/ lhag ma 'grob rigs drug la gtor bas tshimazhing sdug bsngal zhi/ de'i yang lhag ma mchod pa dang yo byad dpag tu med parasprul te/ dkon mchog rnams dang rigs drug thams cad la phul bas tshim zhingadagyes par bsam pa ni/ rang lus mchod sbyin du gtong ba'o/ /da lte'i snangabathams cad la sems gtad nas/ ma dag las kyi snang ba 'di rnams la sngarayang zhen pas phud da yang zhen chags byed mi nyan/ zhen pas 'bor b.ra'akhyams pa yin/ 'di dag dang nges par 'bral/ mi rtag cing 'dzin pas zhenapas phan yang mi phan/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'di la zhen rim yang mi chogabaden med sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khrul snang yin pas/ zhen par byed pa la zhen rgyu rangayang mgrub snyam pa blos lings kyis btang bar bya ste/ stos pa bcad pa'i man 2 gago /dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun byams pa la mos gus dung ba byasapas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi sbubs rag dung lta bu zhig nar gyis byung nagarang spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba 'od kyi sbu gu de'i nang du chud par bsam ste/lam btsal ba'i man ngag go /de ltar man ngag de gsum ni 'pho ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ /de nas byams pa'i thugs kar 'pho dgos pa'i 'dun pa drag po byasapas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa sbu gu'i nang na mar byung/rang spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba de/ 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu des sa ca/nas skad cig gis byams pa'i thugs kar thim/ 'di dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa yin pas lan gsum bzhi bstud nas bsgo me/ yang byams pa'i thugs kanas—214—

phyir spros te/ pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas chos nyan par bsam/ rjes kyi dmigs pa'o/ /gsum pa bar dor sgom pa bsre ba'i gdams ban ni/ 'de nyid bar dor shes bya la/ /phyi nang gsang bar bsgyur bar bya/ /stong nyid snying rdzo rnal 'byor gyis/ /mkhas pas nyid mtshams sbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa nye 'a lasngon 'gro'i gnad de/ da lta'i snang ba thams cad srid pa bar do dngos yin para'adug skabs 'dir ma 'khrul ba zhig bya dgos snyam pa'i skyo shas dang 'dun pa drag po btang nga / /dngos bzhi ni/ da lta'i ma dag pa'i snang ba dza de kal bzhagan/ chags sdang gi rnam rtog skyes te 'khor bar skye ba len pa 'dun pas/ dgapa'i snang bar bsgyur dgos snyam pa bya la/ phyi gzugs su snang tshad spyan rasagazigs kyi sku dang / sgra grags tshad sngags su mos pa bya/ nang rang lus spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang / ngag sngags su mos pa bya/ gsang ba sems rangasems skye med sgom pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar gnas lugs spru mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ bsgyur ba gsum mo/ /rjes ni bdag gzhan 'gro drug go semasacan snod dang bcas pa thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bur 'dug pa la de ltar ma rtogs pa snying re rje snyam du cung zad bsgom mo/ /chos snya ṣ+ka kyi lta sgo me spyoda'abras bzhi ni/ gang shar ngos 'dzin lta ba'i gnad/ /de la ma yengs sgo me pa'i gnad/ /dran pa ro snyoms spyod pa'i dzi/nad/ /ltongs su gyur na 'bras bu'i gnad/ /grub thob chen po'i gdams pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ sems/gnasasam 'gyu'am gang shar ye gdod ma nas ngos gzung dang bral ba ngos zin par byed pa ni lta ba/ de nyid dran shes kyis rgyun skyong ba ni sgom pa/ bde sdug dang—215—

dgos kyang nam zhig na rtsol med rang byung du shar ba na lhongs su gyur pa ste'abras bu'o/ /'di dag gi don rgyas pas khro phu lotsā ba byams dpal gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig wo mo nyid las rtogs par bya'o/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid yig 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag /bkra shis//

rdo rje'i lam bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bde chen rdo rje shrī mu dhe ru ka zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs/oṃ snya sti/ oX badz+ra bhā ra ya na mo/ rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra sum rga nā oṃbod skad du/ rdorje'i lam bzang po zhes byung ba/ rdo rje'i 'dzin pa la phyag rnye/lo/ /mgon po bde ba chen po ni/ /bla ma rdorje can zhabs 'dud/ kho lus rgyud rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid rab tu gsal bshad bya/ /rgyud kyi dang por e waX yig /phung po kun gyi snod yin 'dis/ /stong dang snying rje'i zhe sho /sangasargyas 'dir brjod 'khor ba'ang 'a/ /'on kyang ra bzhi mngon gyur dag /'dzagamed sems kyi de nyid rig /'gro la snying rje'i sems chen po/ /rgyud shes slob dpon bsten bya ste/ /bla ma la gus drang po'i dngos/ /lam dang ston pa gzhan spangs pa/ /zab mo'i don la rtog bral bas/ /'bad na thams cad 'bras burabacas/ /bde ba mchog gi thar pa'i rgyud/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu ni/ /thams cad rang bzhin bde ba che/ /bde bas bde ba che grub pa'o/ /'di la sems kyi rang bzhin gang / /sku gnyis por ni rnam par gnas/ /shin tu sprosamed chos kyi sku/ /ni gzugs lus dang snod bcas pa'o/ /gang la thog ma med padang / /dang po rgyu na sangs rgyas chos/ /sems can kun la rtag gnas pa/ rgyu yirdo—217—

rje 'chang bar brjod//phung po lnga bdag 4sa rgyas dang//rig ma 'byung ba rnamasadakyil 'khor ra//dbang po yul dang bcas gang dag/byang chub sems/dpa' lha mor bcas//de ltar dri ma rnams sbyangs pa//ye shas wo po sgom parabya//bskyed pa'i rim pa legs gnas pa'i//rdzogs pa'i rim pa rdzer bsgo merdebyos//rten dang brten pa'i rgyu yi phyir//lus med pa la bde med pag/lusani dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la//sems kyang yang dag bde bar 'gyur//bsnyen pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang //bsnyen pa che dang sgrub par bya//bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa dang //sgrub pa wo po bsgom bya zhing //rnal 'byor rjes su rnal loldedang //shin tu yang dag rnal 'byor che//sbyor dang dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog/phyi nas las rgyal mchog bsgom bya//bdaganyid rkang bu ltar snang ga/ba bkrardedabang po'i gzhu ltar snang //phyi nas tswas po kun la spro//gcig dang du mdang bralab//dkyil 'khor dag gi sgo nas byung//zas sogs bya ba thams cad spyad//lha yigasal dang mngon zhen gyis//rang gi mi mthun shin tu 'gag/sna rtser yungasakar rnam brtags pa//yi ge de bzhin mtshan ma dang//gzu stegs brnyan/lasogs dkyil 'bor gyis//spros pa'am yang na bsdu bar bya//rdorje45yā'i sna rtser ni//yungs kar tshul gyis tho ma bsgom//dkyil 'khor sprokhibasdud pa dang //re re zhing yang rnam par bsgom//sku dang bde bar rabazhi med//rnam par rtog las nges byung pa/khrid pa'i rnam pas de sbyong byed//'brasabu'i lam gyur skyes pa'o//zhes pa ni rim pa dang po'o// sems 0 ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te//dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba//rang8

bzhin skye 'gag med pa dang //cho se kun rma chog tu rgyas btabs/'o dod chags chags bral kun las 'das//stong pa ma yin mi stong min//yod dngamed dang yod med 'das//rnam par rtog pa'i yul kun spangs//min dang mingadu brjod pa bral//bsam gtan rdzun pas ma bslad pa//'bad rtsol rgyudang bral ba yang //bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur//rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyesapa//bden min brdzun min 'di lta bu//gang la'ang mi gnas chos kyi sku//chosarnams kun tu rnam par snang //sems can khams la rtag gnas pa zhi/sangs/rgyas rang gis rig bya nyid//dpe dang rtog pa'i mar+sā du med//bla' byin rlabs 'pho bas /bde dang sdug bsngal kun las grol//rkyen gyis sgyur min rkyen byung min// dang sal g.yo med pa//rang gis rang nyid shes parabya//dzi ltar nam mkha' bcos min pa//lag sogs mi 'gyur me ngon gyuraphyir//rang gi sems la yongs tsho li ba//bla ma dam pa'i rim las rnyed//rangabazhin dang ni yid 'gyus kun//chu dang rlabs bzhin dbyer med pa//'dilarang bzhin spros bral bas//g.yo bdag kyang rnam par dag/mi rtog skrun rnamartog min//bya ba byed las yongs 'das pa//dpyad pa las 'das phyagagyoche//ye shes zhabs kyi rim las brnyed//rnam par mi rtog mu stegs byed//dpyod byed blo ngan sangs rgyas pa//rnam pa kun ldan chos gang gor//mgo tramachog tu dben pa'o//zhes pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o//e wa mā yā yi ge mchog/'khore lo bzhi la rnam par gnag khri yi pa chos dang longs spyod dang //de bzhin bden wo 'bor lo'o//btso khri nyis9

stong dha ti/brgya she nyi hūṃ lhag pa dang /'a cu rtsa gnyis dang/'ag/dang/a wa dhū dar+sha /sgo bzhi / brgyad dang /༵༷ hor mu ge rnams she /sku' sga ༵/ dang /gsung sga ba daX /thugs sga ga/sa ge tha dang /srag/dang/thuradang /mnyam gnas lha sbyi /gyan rgyudang /khyab tha ni dang/klu dang/༵sa/sbal sna tshordedang /rtsang pa dang /lha na dang/gzhu las rgyal dang /spu je tshu/mas rdzo/dang /3 rjo /grangs dang zhi// rdeb dang /dbyug gu dang /chu dang /'pha rnyi dang /bzhi dang /rang ba dang /las dang khams lnga dang /drug dang / shu rtsa ba dang /khu ba dang rdul thad da dang/mnyam/ snying stobe sa sgyu pa dang/de dag ni ga e gaX 'char ba she /mun pa dang /rdul dang / nga stabs 'bab pa dag //rde/ wa shwa5sa sda/nga ba 'a// mu zhis nya gā sgu ba nā da gnas//bcu rags pa'i 'kho ༷ ba3 spyi//༷curdeg kha las kyi yan to brgyad/༵/ dang she gor dhi nu shad bar bye ba / so//b.rabade ba chen/ pa ste//dga' dang dang gnas thad pa// ga sogs las/kyang gsal gyur te//de tshe gtso bo khyim bder spyod//rnam par dag las bdeze'i na/rje skye/ ye spro bye/ 0ri sno ni/ 0ri /she/rtse ge ge sde ge ge sde 4 thung dod dge cha sa 3༷ ya rgyal//rang baX dang na nga yang sku~X/rde/rnal ge mu rnams spru gtum ma'//thi du le'i yi spyad der she yang//'gyur she/da lasaXrgag/rde gzhan shes//ga le' ge rtsa la sa gag/gangardebasgam sa kyang ri mag tu 'gag/ga li/'gag pa sne she 'bar ba'am/༷/ya/rwalas dbu ma 'byad par 'gyur//rtsa gnyas las 'gra 'ang ba dang //'a yo rdelarnams su 'bar zhing bzlog/thig le'i ye shes sting ba ni//phyag gyor+ṣa po 0

mngon du 'gyur//bum pa can dang rdul mtha' can//bgang ba de bzhin rengasabyed pa//'khor lo rnams su dgag pa dang //sngags dang snying kha de bzhin du//rdzas kyang thig le gsum pa ste//mi shigs pa dang nor bu dang //hod kyangathig ler mngon brjod pa//a ni gtso bo dam pa ste//gsal zhing mar medagadang mtshungs//mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba'o//a u mā/srog dang/gyen rgyu dang/thig le'o//a a hā/srog dang /gyen rgyu dang /thur sel go/hwa u ma/thubasel dang /srog dang /thig le'o//yi ge gsum gyi de nyid kyis//rlud rnams/mchog tu zhi par byed//rtags ni lnga las ye shes te/khams brgyad shin tu rnamadag pa'o//zhes pa ni gtum mo'i ye shes so//gang phyir dga' ba de snang ba//snang ba mched pa mchog dgarabashad//dga' bral las ni nyer thob ste//lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsalardeba'o//rig dang 'jug dang skyed pa dang //mtha' las ma nyams gzhan yanga'adi//yi ge bcu drug dang ni tshes//de bzhin dga' ba bcu drug go/'dod pa dang /dga' ba dang /g.yo ba dang /'dar ba ni dga' ba bzhi'o//gang ba dang /mchog dga' dang /'char ba dang /nub pa ni mchog dga' bzhi go/'bar ba dang /khyad par gyi dga' ba dang /sems dang /thig le ni khyad par dga' ba bzhi'o//o sna dang /lhan cig skyes pa dang /gnyid dang /nā da ni/lhan skyes bzhi'o//'dod chags ma yin chags bral min//dbu mar 'jug par mi 'gyuraro//gsum po spangs pa nyid kyi phyir//lhan gcig skyes pa byang chub

brjod//mchog / gi mtha'i thams cad bdag/yang spya kun shes cha paraspangs//mas ngas tshad da / na ni lhug phra//khul sogs ta zhi/he ba : ruka/pad+ma can dang /nga~Xmadad/༈༵ lcug phran mal sags/ṣ+ka bzangarderab tu bzung nas// 'gyuṇa bde ba rgyur bsgrub bya//yang na las/byungardeba'am//mi tsor ba ni rdo rje gsor//'on kyang las nar/kho phyanimathar a ra pa /dan//sgro tshe ldan po ྅ spo pa las//nor bu ga pyomin//rang ba na ma rga gyur dang lha sa spru /rde//lasacazha rnams las ga༈garden//thim spre bskur ba dang sems bdag ga/dhū spyo pa'i dang bstan pa dang //ma dang ye shes brtan pa dang //spel dang spyod pa brtul zhugasardedang //skyon sgron ye shes sgom byed pa//rdzo par byang chub ska spohrūrnyag/khan ni ye shes sku ni/de dag bang ma'i byed pa cwa/sna tshogos de :rgon/rdo bye gle ni 'i dib rnam na dang //rnam nye6sko dang mtshan/nyad bral//ṇa lus ni dag sbyo rdelarab las/ ste//blo brtan rnya gan bcas pas so//sbyor bas lus ba ni / sal//ski 'og sbyor she kyi tu gru//sgo dbye btsan thabs sbyor ba //ste 'di sil lko/mtho 1 ba 'a//rjes su chags pas smos daghoste//'a las rang ba na ma 1 bzung nas//gyen du skyod dang ༵khro/rden ldan/ rdzus//lhan zhi skyes pa sgom par bya//zhes pa ni/las kyi phyag rme shesathas/// re sho/ni jig sa ni ma ze 1 5 rdeme long gzug gas brnyan ༵//sgyu ma' lus na ma par bya/khadog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu//a pa chu zla bas go/i rnams sgyu ma ltar shes

bzhi/na/rdze 'a bzhin bde sgom bya//snrang ba mtha' dag rnams/sprus pa//rangab sprul pa' sku ru brjod//sprul pa' wor lo'o//smra dang spyo lenges spyod ri'i khaganas pa//sems la'ang 'a brnyan tshul 'char te//rma lam rma b.ra' ston pa//she cad dzī rnam par da'//kun she mund pa sgyumato//longs spyod das 'a sku yang de//de dzod bar da' glosa.ā+ogyur//rdo rje sku yang de nyad yan//longs spyod kya stsor lo//skrodang nye bar longs spyod dang //glu dang rol mo sogs bsten ༷ //sgyu 'dalarab 'ju / ka pa//chu zla dag dang mtshungs par bya//mthang ba dang na reg pa nyid//'gro ba sgyu ma dzi bzhin bya//gang zhig rdo rje sems sogs thi/gzugasarde‘sa :sku rdebarnyan sna tshogs rab bsgyur te//gang gang sems kya ༵nga sprul pag/'i so/ las len pa 'gags/yang na btsan thabs sbyor ba sa//tshangs po'o sgo dbye bar bya//dpal ldan bde wo mgon po yi//zhal gyi rim pa las/snangs/rnga/྅z-i(/rde//sne/ ‘rirde—na bral mkha' la mnyam/ gzhag ste//mngon par zhen pa' lta bsaso//de las sgyu ma rab grub ste//nā/ shes par thi po maspyo ges ge/khring bdang ni 'de sa she daX //de ba rnam par ma ṭā na//gto dang ha dang gnyis gnyis sprod//stang pa gsum du rnam par rag/'a dang snangabamago pa dang //nye bar thob dang 'od gsal ba//stong dang shan ris pa / dang //stonge pa che dang thams cad /༵ na/rde/sems dang sems byung ma rig pa//gsum las 'das pa mngon par ma //〈gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gzhung dras par

bzhi brgyad bcu'i ngos 'dzin〉/chags bral dang ni bar ma nyid//〈ni yul la mi sdugapar 'dzin pa ngo bo zhing ste de yang 'dzin stangs/〉de bzhin du ni chen po dag/yid la'agro/ zhing 'ong ba dang //〈yul la sems pa dang slar nang du sems pa ste sems pa laphyeba'o//〉myang na 〈go yid du 'ong ba'i yul dang bral ba'i gdung ba ste che bar chung gsum mo//〉'i/sogs gsum de bzhin//〈ba ni ngal zhing thang chad pa lta ra to de 'dug pa ste shesabazhin/〉zhi dang rnam rtog 'jig pa dang //'jigs pa bar dang shin tu 'jigs//sred dang 〈pa ni yid du 'ong ba dus gsum la dmigs nas zhen pa'o//〉sred pa b.ramadang //shin tu sred dang nyer len dang //〈len pa sred pa'i yul 'jug par byed pa'i sems so/〉mi dge 〈pa ni 'gyod pa'o//〉bkres dang skom nyid dang //tshor dngatshor ba bar ma dang //shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang //rig pa po dang riga'adzin bzhi//so sor rtog dang ngo tsha shes//snying rje dang ni brtseb gsum//〈bde sdug btang snyoms/〉dgos dang bsam pa nyid dang ni//phrag dog tses ni bya bar bshad//dang po'i rang bzhin rnams so//〈thob bya'i yul la yid/〉chags/dang zhen 〈thob zin gyi yul〉dang de bzhin dga'//〈yul yid du 'ong ba snang tsarasadag 'ab ste gsum mo/〉dga' ba bar ma shin tu dga'//rangs dang 〈pa ni god don grub pa la dga' ba'o//〉rab tu mgu ba dang //ngo mtshar 〈ni gsar thob rol brten nas sems mtho ba ste ma zhi ba〉de bzhin rgod pa dang //tshim/ pa 〈ni ngo mi pa'o/〉dang de bzhin 'khu/da pa dang //'o byed pa dang 〈gsum ni de rnams byed par 'dod pho sems/ / te yul la chags pas lus ngag gi bya ba rtsom pa dang yang yang de bzhin 〉'jib pa dang /brtan 〈pa ni sems mi 'gyur ba ste 'du shes gzhan du rgyur mi thub pa'o//〉dang rtson dpang4

rgyal dang /〈rtsol ba dang rtsom pa mi 'dor ba'i dpe'o//ba ni mtho bar sems pa ste nga rgyalabadun la sogs pa'o//〉bya dang 〈pa ni 'du byed kyi don de bya ba rdzogs par byed pa'i //bami 'dor ba'o//〉phrag dog 〈bar 'dod pa ni stab na ci dang 〉stobs dang nyi/da/rdespro dang 〈pa ni las la 'jug pa la yid spro ba'o//〉lhan ga yi ri/ 〈tshamatsham〉——rde dang //〈ni gas 'joms par 'dod pa ste gnod sems so//〉de bzhan gya tsho / b.ramadang //gya ce6/ 〈ni the tshom ste bya dka' la sbyor ma nus pa'am tshom tshom/〉chen po dragapo'o/rde/〈ni khro ba/〉rnam par sgeg dang zhe 'gras nyid//dge dang 〈t+yā las la yid rangs pa'o//〉mi/ga gsal 〈pa ni ga po gyi go ba 'du shes ma sgyur pa/〉bden pa〈rasmyab〉dang// ba//pa 〈snyu shes bsgyur ba ni yi dam brtan por mi dhi starnyi / cha'o//〉dang de ba nges//nye bar mi len 〈〉yul 'dzi par mi dzad pa/ —na pa po//〈ra 'dod pa/〉skul 〈yul ga ska du/〉dang de bzhan dpa' bo 〈rma pa las grol 'dod do//〉dang //ngo tsha pe 〉 mi 〈pa ni kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem yo//〉dang sgyu' gdug/〈pa lta ngan snga ma ste sbu ba 3 'a pa 〈༷spun la thos meX brodang rna gya gyunyad//'a///gnyis sdom/〉gnyas pa 'arang bzhan rnams ༵rdes//chags pa bar ma' skad ga dang /brjed ngas pa dang 'khru/la pa 'a //smra ba 'gyu/radang skyo ba dang //le lo de bzhin the tsho mi ste//gsum pa' rang bzhin rnams/so//rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni//nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med//'on 9da snye rtu)rdo rdosnikyang 'a la dbyer yod de//mtshan mo nyi/ lti mtshams bdag //mtshan mosnrang ba 'a cha ste 'a〈spar ma la tsha〉nga gi rang ba/ri 'gyu ge zhe ge/'a ba mche/cig yam///mtshams na snang ba thob pa rang rang bzhan rnams kyas lan ———rderde

min par 'gro//mawo min swo par ma yin skadago kyi gang wo ra bzhin she rnams dang she bral byā//de to ji 9 chub nar spro /na ni gis shing she rmal/rdedabyibs ni thad dpan ma mkha'i//byings / na sna ni / de nyid /ni thi~X/rdedangadabyabs na tha dad pa//nam mkha dbyangs su rjo/rdeng nas //de nyad du parakhyur//de bzhi rang bzhin thams cad ni//snang ba gsum gyi rgyus te/ma' ral tsho nilus yul la ra sbyor bang//'chi ba'i sem 'jug dror da/khabakun rni sngi dzi sbyar bdang/sa/rjes su gzhig dang ge mu rges maX 'a cu/rdepa//shel par 'an dang gzhan gya sa sna gzhag/'a ni / dge lam 'dres gyur par bya//hro sngus phra ba 'a gzugs kyas sa//shas dang yang dasnang migs par be//snying ḍi lam she na//bams gsum na ni ga 'an me da de byed//nga pa gi gyur pa rang she 'a//kham/ gsum ba bzhi/ rde she da /she/ zhen ge mun zi dzod dodage ge gsum sna/she/rma tsho/pa ba'i kyi rje stodag du ma/nga/sna/ 'a pa rdaXpo dang tsho/she/de shes stang ḍi 'a dug3/kyid cangamun sde khre rgyu nyad du//dngas pa 'a pa snga sa bya/de/a kya gni la ṅgikya kyi/ 'a she dang she dang ye ge rje zhes//gu zi ༷rdes pa nishepa//maXye sna ru sprag par brjad//mro kya gor la 'a//kho pa 'ad ba/blo5‘pa/rde ba nur rde tha rga spros// pho sna/ri ra tsho/rnyes pa/rdzo ri rdelha dang bla 'a d+dhi /rdzuslalta~Xmyo / myos ba la/she/ ga rdzob sems/dang ldan gos tsho /rde//'ji kya 'a pa ༵da spra na//nus bra~X spyad pa ma lnga yi sherdebs//ba dang 'jags dang yad rdod//gang la'ang mas khral/yangs

// sa//dzhai sab/zhi/rdo ༵ sa can do sno kā ba phyi snrod/ //ya/ḍi sna ga rdzu byed rjo~X sbyin//sems kyi g.yo ba bcad par bya//yid ni gzhan du mgyur par/sna cho gisardetā rno~X sdong//spyu / la/ kau rni ga nyid nas sna~X /ba /mkhri ༵/pa /snying dhi spyu pa la//dpral ba gtsuste ga tor la bad kan//'dus pa gsang ba'i 'kho/ra lo ste//de // sa skyo sna ༵ spya /tsol/ ༵//tshor ga ༵ ba'i ༵ na 1 dbye ༵༵na///zlo/ rkyu rnyirdeyang de der bsal//phyin ci log tu rnam sbyar zhing //nam yang byang chub sem/sa~Xrdo ༵ nā / zha/༵ lung ste/ dhi/dzhai ༵ ༵pa/sa/ kau snam rde~X sgi /na/swa yo/ /dang ni sdom pa dang//dgyes pa'i rdorje ra yang bshad do//ye shes ldan pal spyod mibyed //de yis/tshe'i dir byang chub med/de phyir ye shes bstan gnas pa/gtso dodags gar gyi rol mo bya//dang por masno dus gsang de spyad//rnyas spang༅kunatu spyod pas rgyu//gal te dro ba'i bya ba thob//rnal 'byor ldan par khas/blangango //phyi nas 'phags pa'i gnas thob pa//des ni phyogs las rnam rgya 'kha bya/sha zabazhin du kun spyod pa'am//yang na khyim du zlos gar bya//rim pa dang por rig 'dzin dang //'dod dang gzugs khams lhar sgrub pa//ye shes skudangamatho byang chub//sa dang sal mngon bsgrod pa//de ba smi mngon par byang chu0che//spyod pa'i dus rnam pa lnga//

bskyed rim bde ba bcas bsgo me na/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam bzhi'o/ /yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang / /dbang po stobs rnams spyod bcasapa/ /bde chen byang chub yan lag bdun/ /sa dang sa la yan lag brgyad/ /pho3 kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /rtsa rnams las ni sa bcu dang / /rlung gi bsgrod bcas de bzhin bcu/ /gzhan ni ye shes sa bcu ste/ /rtsa sogs ye shes lusathim pa'o/ /bcu gnyis sa yi dbang phyug ni/ /bde mchog bde chen rdorje 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud las/ /man ngag rab tu bsdusapa'o/ /dpal ldan bde chen las 'ongs pa/ /mi shes 'jig rten rmongs rnamasal/ /sems ni snying rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /bde chen rdo rje bdag gis bshad/ces pa ni rdo rje'i lam bzang po gsal bar byed pa/ slob dpon chen po bdeb chen po'i rdo rje'i zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan he ru kar mngon par dbang bskur ba/brtul zhugs spyod pa zhi ba sbas pas mdzad pa'o/ /mchog tu rgya che'i gzhung lugs las/ dī na ka ras rnams bsdus pa/ /ye shes mchog gis mchod byas te/ /'gro la phan pa bskyed phyir byas/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po bzhi gubha'i zhal snga nas dang / ni bī ṇa shrī'i zhabs la/sno phazhupa tā ra nā thas zhus te gus pa chen pos 'bad pas bsgyur ba'o/ /rim lnga dang kyai rdo rje'i lung grangs pa sogs ni 'gyur rnying ji lta ba bzhin du bris pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pas nang gi khyab pa zhes bya ba tshigs bcad nyis brgya pa dang / rtsa'i mdo la phyed dang nyis brgya/ rlung gi mdo la phyed dang sa brgya/khams kyi mdo brgya phrag gcig lam lnga bstan pa la (〈 zhi〉 rgi lung 'dren mi —228—

the ba tshig gsar ) nyis brgya/ rgyu bstan pa la brgya/ gnas bstan pa la nyis(brgya/ phyag gyo chen lam rdzogs pa dang / gtum mo'i gzhung la brgya nyi shu/ desalam rdzogs pa dang / lhan skyes gsal ba zhes pa la brgya bdun cu/ phyag rgyas lam rdzogs pa dang / ye shes nges bstan la sum brgya/ sgyu lus dang 'od gsal rnam par bzhag pa dang / man ngag thor bu la lnga brgya/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang kyai rdo rje dang bde mchog rnams la bsdus pa'i don gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang /rdo rje'i glu dang sgrub thabs chung ngu yang mang du mdzad par gda' la rgyas pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas pa dang / 'bring du dga' ba la/ de dag las bsdus te rdo rje lam che ba tshigs bcad stong tsam yod pa rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra la sogs pa/ slob ma mchog mang pos spyan sngar bsdus so/ /bsdus pa la dga' ba la lam bar ba tshigs bcad sum brgya pa slob dpon su mā tis bsdus so/ /shin tu bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du (〈 byu〉 lam ) gzhung chung ba 'di la rgya gar skad du tshigs bcad brgya dang lnga yod pa 'di yin te/ bod skad du'ang rags rtsis la tshigs bcad de tsam ste rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ dī ni ka ras zhus nas bsdus pa 'di ni shin tu dar ba yin par gda' 'o/ /zhesapa'ang tā ra nā thas reg zig go/ //dge'o// //maṅgal//—229—

bsdus pa bzhu/gas/oṃ snyu sti/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i lha so so'i bsnyen pa spyi khyab tu byed tshul bsdus pa ni/ spyir bsnyen pa gang la'ang thog mar mtshams 'og tu mi mang nyung gang bcug kyang chog cing thog mar mtshams 'og tu ma bcug pa phyis mi 'jug mtshams 'di mi tshe gang bya zhing /grol ba snga dro grol bar bya'o/ /thun gyi skabs ngag bsdams shing ngag bcad pa'i sngags de grangs du rtsi zhing / thun mtshams rnams su ngag bcad gcig tu mi dgos/ sngags gang 'grub bgrangs/ thun mtshams kyi sngags grangs su mi rtsi/bsnyen pa'i 'phreng ba mi g.yin gyi mi mthong bar byed/ khyad par yi dam gang sgom pa'i skabs mtshams tho brtsigs na der sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / de skabs phyogs 'dir bdag lha'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa sogs/ tshig bsgyur 'phrin las bcol/ spyir thun bzhi po gad na'ang sngags 'gro che ba'i snga thun dgong thun gnyis mdzad/ thun mtshams nyin gong bar mdzad/ gtor ma dgong thun gyi mjug srod kyi dus der bsngo/ bsnyen pa grol ba'i tshe gtang rag gi tshul du gtor ma rgyas pa re btong zhing / 'grub na bsnyen pa rdzogs mtshams nang du rdzogs par bya/ mtshams grol/ bsnyen pa'i thun mtshams skabs gtam cal col mang po mi smra zhing sgrub g.yogs pa'i kyang skad cha gsal ba che ba rnams mi —230—

bshad/ bzlas pa'i skabs sngar mi dran pa mang po dran pa dang / dpe cha lta ba dang / shor ba sogs bsnyen pa nyid ma yin pa'i bya ba gang 'dod kyang bar chad du go bar byas nas spang pa gtso/ tshogs gsogs dang / bsrung 'khor dmigs pa gang gsal de sgom pa'i bar chad mi snang ba yin/ khyad par bsnyen pa la 'dod pa bsdug pa dang / dgongs pa tshab tshob mi byed par blo bde ba'i ngos nas byed/ nyi ma gcig la grangs 'di tsam song ma song mi byed/ spyod lam bag yang tsam bya'o/ /rig pa gtsur gtsur mi bya/ skra sen mi 'dreg gdan mi bsgul/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gtor ma'i skabs gsol 'debs 'don pa gal che/zhes pa 'di yang slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba ltar tā ra nā thas chos lung byang rtser sbyar ba'o// //sarba ma sgo la/—231 —

byed tshul bzhugs/zab mo gsang sngags bzlas gyur na/ tshe 'dir smin grol thob par the tshom med/ oX shrī tsakra saX bha ra khyoX sbyor ba bsnyen pa gang la'ang thog mar mtshams 'og tu mi mang nyung gang bcug kyang chog cing thog mar mtshams 'og tu bcug pa phyis mi 'jug mtshams 'debs pa'i tshe dgong mo bya zhing / grol ba snga dro grol bar bya'o/ /thun gyi skabs ngag sdom zhing / ngag bcad pa'i sngags de bsnyen pa'i grags su rtsi zhing / thun mtshams rnams su ngag bcad gcig tu mi dgos/ sngags gang 'gru ba 'grub sgrongs/ thun mtshams kyi sngags grangs su mi rtsi/ bsnyen pa'i 'phreng ba mi gzhan gyis ma mthong bar byed/ khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i skabs/ mtshams tho brtsigs nas sa der sngon 'gro gtor ma btang /de skabs sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub par 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i zhes sogs 'phrin las bcol/ spyir thun bzhir bshad na'ang / sngags 'gro che ba'i stabs snga thun dgong thun gnyis mdzad/ thun mtshams nyin dgung yod pa mdzad/ gtor ma dgong thun gyi mjug srod kyi dus bsngo/ de yang thogs ma yi dam la 'bul rgyu dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor de gtor ma gnyis bya dgos kyi chos skyong yod na'ang gtor ma 'cha'/ gtor ma'i mdun du nang mchod dang / chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga —232—

bshams/ de nas nyi ma re re bzhin/ 'theb skyus sngar gyi gtor ma de dgos pa yin/ thun gyi skabs yig brgya song ba'i rjes su nang mchod byin rlabs dmigs pa gang gsal gyi rgyas pa bya/ nang mchod byin rlabs gting ma gnyis la rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun pa'i rung / mngon rtogs kyi mgo mjug tu sems ma yengs pa dgos shing / dmigs pa gsal rung mi gsal rung / tshig so so'i thad du rnam pa lam lam dran pa'i shar sgom tshar re gal che/ dag pa dran pa'i rjes su 'phreng ba byin rlabs re byed dgos shing / de yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hruXlas pad+ma hiXmatshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum gos dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'byud pa/ 'og la gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga /g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ de'i snying khar oX ha dkar po nas tsi rnyi ka'i bar dang / gnas gsum du oX āXskyoX/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha phe/ dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa asti khiñtsa huX zhes dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i phreng bar 'gyur/ oX āXdzi hūX phaṭa swāhā/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa ni 'phreng ba byin rlabs so/ /de nas sum bha lan bdun tsam bzlas/ de nas yab yum gyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig song nas/ yab yum sgrags pa'i snying po gnyis la grangs 'dzin/ thun gcig la yab yum gyi sngags su song ba de'i bcu cha/ dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi'i sngags bzlas/ de'i bcu cha yum bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags bzlas pas/ gtso 'khor dus mnyam du bsnyen pa 'gro bzhin/ yang de mi bde na —233—

thog mar gtso bo yab yum gyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i dus su/ rim pa bzhin du 'khor rnams so so la bsnyen pa byas cho/'i drang / de'i tshe gtso bo yab yum la 'bum phrag bzhi/ yum bzhi la stong phrag bzhi bzhi/ dpa' bo dang/'a mo nyer bzhi la/ bzhi khri re/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ yum bzhi dang ri 'dra/ yab yum gyi bzlas pa dang / rnam pa dang / nga rgyal la slob pa'i dmigs pa ni/ dkyus nas gsal zhing 'khor du slebs pa'i skabs/ rang rang so so'i thugs kar pad zla la sngags bkod la/ klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla/ snga gas gang bzla rung lha thams cad dang / gtso bo yang zhal bzhi kas bzlas par bsam mo/ /bsnyen pa grol ba'i tshe gtang rag gi tshul du gtor ma rgyas nga re gtong / 'grub na bsnyen pa rdzogs ma/tshams/ ma gro' gong zhag 'ga' re gtor ma 'bul zhing / de nas sbyin sreg rnams kyang mtshams nang du rdzogs par byas/ mtshams grol/ bsnyen pa'i thun mtshams skabs gtam 'chal chol mang po mi smra zhing / sgrub ྈ/yog pas kyang skad cha gsar pa che ba rnam sa mi shod/ bzlas pa'i skabs sngar mi dran pa mang po dran pa dang / dpe cha lta ba dang / shor ba sogs bsnyen pa nyid ma yin pa'i bya ba gang 'dod kyang / bar chad du go bar byas nas spros pa gcod/ tshogs bsogs dang / bsrung 'khor dmigs pa gang gsal te sgom pa bar chad mi 'byung ba yin/ khyad par bsnyen pa la 'dod pa sdug pa dang dog pa tsab tshob mi byed par blo bde ba'i ngos nas lhod lhod nas bya/ nyi ma gcig la grangs 'di tsam song na ma song ni mi bya/ nang du spyod lam bag yang tsam bya/ rigs pa bcur bcur mi bya/ skra sen mi dreg gdan mi bsgul/ bla ma la gsol ba —234—

zhes pa'ang slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul bas tā ra nā thas chos lung byang rtser bskur ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur/ phyogs dang gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur par cig/ //bkra shis/ /ma ṅga laX/

'bebs bzhugs/rdor 'chang nai gu khyung po rmog cog pa/ /skyer sgang gnyan ston sangs ston shangs ston pa/ /tshul mgon ras chen shangs dkar skyud lung pa/ /nam rgyal rgya sgom rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /grol mchog lhar grags kun rgyal sgrol ba'i mgon/ /kun mtshon byams mgon lhun blo 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ grags pa blos stobs 'jigs med rnam par rgyal/ /chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal/ bde kyai 'jigs gsang mahā ma ya sogs/ /gtso mchog lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rab gus gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / gtum mo'i bde drod sgyu ma'i rang nyams dang / /rmi lam rang zin rtsol med 'od gsal shar/ /'pho med legs rtogs bar do dang po la/ /rang sems longs skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'di'i thog mtha'i sho lo ka gnyis po ni rje grol mchog gi rdo rje'i ljags kyis stsal ba dngos yin la/ bar gyis kha bskang gi sho lo ka zung ni dharma nywa rnya'i gnang ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel/skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ kyai ma seng/sa can sdug bsngal ching / /kun rtog —236—
bsgom bya/ /lan gsum/ ye shes lnga ni/ sngon po mi bskyod pa/ ljang gu don yod grub pa/ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/ ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/ dmar po snang ba mtha' yas so/

zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ dkyil 'khor ma lus kun 'dus pa/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /de la gusapas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de 'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rinachen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrung thabs dang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dgagrub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rnams ni gzhi lus bde mchog lhan skyes dang dgyes mdzad lhan skyes la sbyar ba ci rigs pa yod cing bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la yang ci rigs su mdzad pa gnyis ka ltar yang rung zhing yid tshes can yin no/ /de yang 'dir dza mchog lhan skyes brten nas bshad par bya ste/ de la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nang mchod mchod gtor yo byad rnams sna tshogs par byas nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin rlabs la/ oṃ shā n+ya ta sogs/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūXsngon po ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud ma lus pa slar 'dus te 'od du zhu ba thig ler gyur de las rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar huX/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX spyiX phaṭa/ni gsum/ thugs ka'i huX las raX 'og phyogs su chad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khore du gyur/ huX spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis sa gzhi dang de lasa'aphros pa'i rwa gur du gyur cing / huX las hūX dpag tu med pa phyogs bcura'aphros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med —238—

par gtams nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu zhu ste ra gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying kha'i huX gis 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaX ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon ma/chogardegasum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum bya/ rang gi lusang ga yid gsumartegyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang tshogs zhing dbyer med du gyur/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ su bhā ba shudha sarba dharma su bhā ba shu sgo3haX/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do/ oṃ hūṃ n+ya ta rnyon badz+ra swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te chos thamasacad stong pa nyid do/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gisabasrung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil ge bor/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan de'i steng du rang semasahuX las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams mnyes/ par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgripasbyangs te he ru ka yab yum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams he ru ka yab yum kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ hūX yig rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+t+ra nī la ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'ong/ zer 'phros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba khro zhing bgegs la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa zhal shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can bung ba ltar —239—

gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang /g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdu bu'i tshogs dang / ska rags dang mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan/ dpa' bo dar dpyangasadang bcas pa mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bkrol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud la zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar po mnan pa/ garagyinyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la'abyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogasathams cad gnon cing g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang bas yab la 'khyud pa gcer bu skra 'khrol zhing phyag rgya lnga'i brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang / do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs bas yab la 'khu/da cing yab yum gnyis ka'ang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi sku la tso gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa skad cigagis grub pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar/ rdorje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i yon tan gyi ngo bo rang dang mtshungs pas bde mchog yab yum/ bde chen 'khor lo sku gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po yud tsawa240— tsho

khro ba rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang mtshungs kyi yum la 'byud pa/rdorje skyilakrung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing / dar dang zin po tshes brgyan po rdo /lor/spyod 'khor lo gsung mahā ma ya mthing ga phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dmar mo rang mtshungs la 'byud pa skra ser brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la mi ro mnan pa'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lorathugs dgyes mdzad rdorje mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skra ser gyen du brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa sho /bde skyong 'khor lo 'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i zhal cwa/ phyagaganyis kyi gri gug dang / thod khrag 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing dur khrod kyi mas rdzog༅pa g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la ma he mnan pa'o/ /yang na thams cad huX las bskyed kyang rung bar bshad do/ /rang gi stsing kha'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med parathim/ rang gi dpral bar lkoX dkar spre po/ mgrin par āXdamar go thugs kar hūXsngon po yang rang gi snying kha'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyasabyang chub sems dpa' khro lo dngang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oXsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khiñtsa du maX/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oX badz+ra bha wa a bhi sa ṣañtsa huX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i —241—

spyi chus bor nas dbang bskur/sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pasamibaskyod pas dbu brgyan/ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang /oṃ utu gis nangamachod 'bul/gsang mchod dang de kho na yid kyis mchod pa nyid la dran pa tsam bya'o//de nyid pasabastod pa ni/chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang //bas kyi sokhrobo'i skur bstan gdug pa 'dul//tshe ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/yin bzangahe ru kal phyag 'tshal lo//he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/rnam dag rdo rje dang phyugadang //rjes chags chags pa tshe rnams kyi//rdorje phag mo la 'du ge gi tangs rgyasakun gyi sku gsung thugs//yon tan 'phrin las rab rdzogs pa//dkyil/'khoralnga po thams cad la//kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo//zhes bstod do//o hi ha ha hu hū phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ṇi ye hū hu phaṭa swāhā/zhes pa nyid gtso bor bzla zhing /oṃ u badz+ra dhika hu hū phaṭa swāhā/o urdi gi hū phaṭa swāhā/nye snying/rnam sna gad45rdo rje khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa bzhi tshul/rdo rje snang mdzad ma sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/rdo rje'i rigs/oṃ khyu wa pi tsu badz+ra hu hū hu phaṭa swāhā/hu hihi phe kṛ tan na hūphaṭa/ces pa rnams kyang ci rigs par zla'o//rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/'khor lo lnga'i lha rnamasathig ler zhu ba bkra shis lha 'jam po rdo rje legs bcas dang de'i 'od zer gyis drag po mche ba rnam par gtsags pa'i mdog can/lus gang ba sogs spros bsdu la sems 'dzin par bshad cigachos drug nyid bsgoms pa yin no/mthar/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal ngang du thim par gyur/ces brjod cing cung zad mi rtog pa'i ngang nas mnyam par bzhug /slab thangarang nyid he ru ka yab brkyang gi nga rgyal la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas thun mtshams la 'jug go/gtor ma/a my-i tas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ya 'aḥ5rlud/ra 'bre/4

me'i steng du ā las kā pa la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba huX bhuX aX dzo khaX rnams kyis mtshan pa/rlung g.yos/me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas/pa zhu sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim pas ye shes kyi sgron gsal las/don ma rdzo pa ni sa bon nam zhes gsungs/bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho re gyur/oṃ āXhuX ha hoXhriXlan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la/rang gi snying kha nas 'od zera'aphros/rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaXs spyan drangs/gongadubashad pa'i snying po rnams kyis mthar/tso( ā ka ro rdo/btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bulalo//gong bzhi ma rdzo bstod dang /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/kun grub shog gi b.ragyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/yig brgyas bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shisarnams bya'o//gal te dgyes mdzad lhan skyes la brten nas bsgor/ par 'dod na gzhi lus dgyesamadzad lhan skyes nyid du byed pa dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs kyi rdzas skye mched drug byin rlabs kyang bya'o//bzlas pa dang /de wa pu tsu badz+ra gtso bor byed pa rnams khyad par rdo/phyi dkyil lha lnga'i tshul du bsgom par spros na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar du gsang 'dus/lho ru dgyes mdzad/nub tu mahā ma ya/byang du 'jigs byed/mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la bum thod bzhi gsala'adebs/phyi dkyil du bsgom pa'i yig rnying phal cher na gtso bo gsang ba 'dus pa la byas pa nyid mang bar 'dod pa yod na'ang /rang gang la mos pa nyid gtso bor byas pas chog go/de pe khri du yig rnying 'ga' na phyi dkyil 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga la brten nas yang yod do/khren tu zabapa'i sgrub thabs 'di//khyung po rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i//de nyid mkhyen pa'i lung ni don//po/ 'don tsam du bsgrigs pa yin//zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o////dgolegasa'aphel/ 4

tshigs bcad ma bzhugs/na mo badz+ra bhe ra wa ya/ skyabs se mes sngon du btang / tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shā n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor dbus/ /e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dbus/ /khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhel yas khang / /dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus/ /yaX las rlung dkyil du ba'i mdog /de steng zla bar dhīXyig las/ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser pod ral 'dzin/ /thugs kar nyi ma las 'od 'phros/ /sangs rgyas la sogs bkug nas bstim/ /'jam dpal gdan bcas nyi ma la/ /thim par dpag tshad brgya stong gi /tshad can nyi mar huX mthing nag /de las rdo rje rtse dag gdengs/ /me dang mtshon cha'i tsha tsha 'phros/ /sdang dang gdug can tshar bcad nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'jigs mdzad kyi/ /rnam par spyan drangs 'dres pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bor gyur pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyang rnam par 'gying pas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong / /huX dang phaṭa kyis sgra chen sgrogs/ /steng zhal dmar mo rgya chen bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can cung zad —244—

khro/ /g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ dang po sngon bo mche ba gtsigs/ /gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing / /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ /g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po dkar po rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud kha rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag po gsod par byed/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rim pa bzhin/ /gri gug 'phang mdung ba khun shing dang / /chu gri rdo rje rtsegacig pa/ /dgra sta gdung mda' lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa kha ṭāX 'bor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang / /ral gri rde'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang / /ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug ṣe thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang / /'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyi rim bzhin su/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mong khyi lug lce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rin bzhin bya rgod dang / /lug pa bya rog ne tso dang / khra dang khyung chen ri skeg bzhad/ /mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang / drag po gzhon nu gdong drug dang / /tshogs bdag nyi ma zla ba rnams/ /bskyel nas kha bub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis/ /khro zhal rnams kyi dbu la brgyan/ /mimagokhrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang / /sbrul nag chen po'i do shal can/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar mo glog lhar 'byug /rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang / /khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le —245—

dang / /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyi mtshan/ /ling ga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yis/ /gar dgu'i rol dang ldan pa nyid/ /ye shes me dpung dbus la bzhugs/ /mig tu k+ṣi dkar sa snying dngos/ /rna bar phyag rdor dzi nag po/ /sna la khaX ser nam mkha'i snying / /lce la gaX dmar 'jig rten rje/ /dpral bar sgrib sel skaX ljang khu/ /lte bar kun bzang saX sngon po/ /dpral bar sku yi rdo rje oṃ/ /mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje āX /snying gar thugs kyi rdo rje hūX/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /'jigs mdzad rnam par spyan drangs te/ dgug dang gzhug dang bcings mnyes pas/ /bdag la gnyis su med par bstims/ /badz+ra dzhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ hruXha bho mahā kro dha a ru a ga smo a rma dha ra pū dza pra ti rmi sna skye pra sa bha mi dhi man ku ru ku ru swāhā/ dzaXhuX baX hoX mkha' dbyings gang ba'i bde gshegs kyis/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub rdo rje drangs rgyas la/nas/ nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stso la/ /dbang bskur rdo rje r+ṣa po la/ /nas/gnas las byung ba'i sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ mi bskyod rgyal pos dbu brgyan can/ /snying gar 'jam dpal gzhon nu bsam/ /de yi thugs kar rdo rje nag /huX yig nag po 'bar bas mtshan/ /nam mkha' khyab pa lha mo'i tshogs/ sprul nas bdag la mchod par 'gyur/ /oṃ khyo:sgyiXhāX oṃ huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ku ma ra ru pi ni dza dza: oṃ khyiXha he phaṭa/ oṃ tibha lo tsa na/ bi kri tā na na mahā aṣ+ṭa spyo ha sa na di ne tibha ya swāhā/ oṃ bi kṛ tā na na du niX satwa da ma ka ga ga ga—246—

skye te mahā bhu ta a dhi pa ti i maX ba li grihā pa ta ya swāhā/ skye( āXhuX/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bha wa at+pa ko3haX/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhes pa nas/ dud kha mun can khyod la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū ta badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ oṃ ya ma ra dza/sa do me ya/ ya me do sa ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya slo ya/ ya spyo snye ni ra ma ya hūX pha/ṭatsā lkoX hiXsgyiXbi kri tā na na huX phaṭa/ oṃ ya man+ta ka huX phaṭa/ khams gsum dkyil 'khor rang la thim/ /bdag nyid 'od gsal du bsdus/ /slar yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i/ /rdo rje 'jigs mdzad skur gyur ro/ /gong bzhin skye mched byin rlabs dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi go cha ba bod/ /dge ba bsngo/ zhes pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs blo dman gyi nyer mkho zhes bya ba 'di yang tā ra nā thas pa ra 'brog stag lung du sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis/ /—247—

oṃ snyu sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rags pa tsam zhig blo la nges par bya'o/ /de nas cho ga'i go rim gyi sdom ni 'di yin te/ gnas khang byi dor brgyan byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal bshams shing yo byad tshogs/ /byin rlabs sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / /gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs/ /slob dpon yod na zhu 'bul bya/ /bdag bskyed bzlas pa lag byin rlabs/ /mdun bskyed ye shes spyan drangs nas/ /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs bya/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /mthar ni rjes chog bya ba yin/ /spro zhing shes na mchod pa yi/ /sngon du lag mchod bya bar bshad/ /ma grub na yang nyes pa med/ /ces bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal bshams pa ni/ dbus su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi/ lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su thig le zlum po re re/ dri bzang gi lde gu'i tshom bu dang bcas pa bshams/ dri bzang gi lde gu'i tshom bu ma 'byor na/ dri bzang gi chu'i thig le steng du/ me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bya/ so sor 'god long ma byung na/maṇ+ḍal la me tog bkram zhing / dbus su sbungs pas chog mdun bskyed zhal tshur bstan pa'i g.yon du yi dam gtor ma dang / g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams mchod pa rnams ci bde bar bsgrigs pas chog rdor dril/ ḍā ma sa nang mchod/ rol mo sogs 'dzoms par byas nas rdo rje gsor/ dril bu —248—

dkrol la su bha brjod/ yang rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa sa la reg su bha bzlas/ thog ma nyid du nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ tshogs pa yod cing tshogs kyi slob dpon yod na sgrub mchod ltar zhu 'bul rgyas par bya/ tshogs pa yod slob dpon med na mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ kun bzang rnam sprul: sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ tshogs pa med na ni zhu 'bul mi dgos so/ /de nas spro zhing long yod na mngon rtogs rdzogs par bdag bskyed bsgom/ bsdu na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya rnams song ba'i rjes su dag pa gsum tsam mo/ /lhan skyes tsam zhig bsgom kyang rung mod kyi/ 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas nas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad kyi bar bsrung 'khor rdzogs par bsgom/ de'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la nam mkha'i nā da babs te/ hu dang a gnyis su gyur/ de las dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur ces pa'i bar bsgom/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod na (〈dza〉 rtse bzlas pa ) cung zad bya/ rang gi snying ga'i hū las 'od zer 'phros te/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ ces pa nas/ rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ltar bya ste bdag bskyed do/ /de nas lag pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gis g.yon pa la nang mchod gtor/ bsangs sbyangs/ lag mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams la —249—

g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ baX/ oṃ haX yoX/ glu lto hrī moX/ oṃ ༷spri hri/ oṃ huX hūX/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa/sor mo lnga la mthe bong nas brtsams te/ oṃ oṃ ha/ oṃ na ma hi/ oṃ swāhā huX/ oṃ bo dzin he/ oṃ huX huX ho/ sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa las/ oṃ phaṭa haX/ de rnams go cha'i lha bcu gnyis kyi ngo bor gyur/ lag pa'i sa khams ltung byed ma/chu khams gsod byed ma/ me khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlud khams gar dbang ma/mkha' khams dra ba can gyi ngo bor gyur/ argaX nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āXhuX/ zhes nang mchod gtor ba tsam bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ bsangs sbyangs/nang mchod gtor nas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ maṇ+ḍal la reg pa'am reg par mos la/ lkoX pi ṭha u pa pi tha ya swāhā/ oX slo dra u pa spyo ṭa ya swāhā/ oṃ tsharnyo ha u pa tsharnyo ha ya swāhā/ eX( me la ka u pa me la ka ya swāhā/ tsho( shā sha na u pa shra sha na ya swāhā/ glu tshe pi la pa u pa pi la ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gdan dang bcas nga/ skad cig gis grub par 'gyur/ phe/ rang gi snying ga nas dkyil 3khor gyi snyen ra lo spros te mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la 'bod pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nas dbus na bzhus sa pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nas rdo rje phreng bas mtshan pa'o'i/ bar mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bzhin cho// /snying ga'i huX yig nas yo ga shurnyo ྅ 'i sngags kyi bar dkyil snyen ra rgyal mchog bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu gnyis 'bul ba nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje'i glu'i bar mchod pa sde tshan bcu gnyis —250—
