dkyil chog gi mchod pa'i skabs su 'bul ba ltar phul la/ slar yang lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ oṃ āXhūX/ zhes me tog blangs te dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lan gnyis dor/ de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gnyis/ 'khor rnams la so so'i sngags dang thod pa bzhi la/ oṃ āXhuX gis sngar bzhin me tog re re maṇ+ḍal du gtor de nas lag pa g.yas pa me tog re re lag pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas su bzhag la/ oX baX sogs dang / oṃ ha sogs brjod/rkang brgyad gnyis 'don pa bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa'i me tog de yang maṇ+ḍal la 'thor bar bya'o/ /pad skor gyi mthar thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag pas yo ga shurnyo3 brjod/ lag pa'i lha rnams go cha'i gnas su thim par mos/ gong gi lag pa byin rlabs dang 'di sdebs pas lag mchod bsdus pa yang tshang ba yin no/ /su lhas bsangs ba nas/ ha ho hrore bar gtor ma byin rlabs kyang mngon rtogs bzhin/ mgron 'dir sbyan 'dren mi dgos pas/ oṃ a ra snyi ho sa ma stuX nas kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis gtor ma gnyis po phul zhing 'phrin las bcol/ de nas yan lag bdun pa dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung sogs dang /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed smon lam sogs kyang ci shes bya'o/ /de rjes tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / byin dbab/ tshogs phud dang por bcad/tshogs bsres/ yang phud cig phud dang po dang bsre bar phud gcig bcad khā+e bzhag tshogs phud de gnyis lhan cig tu 'bul zhing bsngo/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bkye ste tshogs la longs spyad/ mthar bar phud bzhag pa de lhag gtor dang bsre/ tshogs lhag bsdus pa la kha khrus btang/ de rnams snod gcig tu —251—

sbungs/ tshogs lhag bsngos te phyir gteng ba'i skabs/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma yang phyir btang ngo / /tshogs mchog ngag 'don ni logs su shes par bya'o/ /rjes chog ni/ mchod pa kha gsos/ byin rlabs/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/rjes chags/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams bya/ 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya/bzod gsol/ yo ga shurnyo'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ mgron gzhan rnams la gshe/gas gsol/ bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs/bdag srung ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya ste/ phal cher dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar bshad pa'i rjes chog dang 'dra'o/ /mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs phyi mchod dang / gos zung / rig ma bcu druganang mchod/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba/dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu / me tog 'bul ba rnams ma chad par bya/ g.yin ji ltar 'os pa skabs dang sbyar zhing / de dag la yang sngags tsam brjod pa dang / tshigs bcad sbyar ba sogs long skabs dang bstun te/ rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa sbyar/skabs 'di'i rjes chog la rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa med kyang chog go /ji skad bshad pa 'di dag la go rim cung zad bsgyur kyang chog pa'i skabs 'ga' re yod do/ /de ltar na phyi rol mchod pa la brten te tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nag po zhabs lugs dang 'brel bar sgrub tshul gyi yi ge mdo tsam smos pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas so/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ //—252—

na mo gu sa 'dir rgyal ba rgyal sras chen po'i tshul 'dzin pa/ rin chen snang ba 'od kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ rje btsun shākya mchog ldan gyi zhal snga nas kyi gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig 'di'i go don nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa ni/dang po so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang yang rung ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs par blangs/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mig 'bras bzhin du legs par bsrungs/ de nas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa la thun mong ba thabs gtso bor gyur pa'i khrid dang / thun mong ma yin pa thabs shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i khrid/ de'i bog dgrang zhing gegs bsal ba'i khrid/ tshogs gnyis rgya cher spel ba'i khrid de bzhi las/dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gsal btab la/ skyabs su 'gro ba la lan gsum bya/ dus 'di nas brtsam ji srid par/ /sdig pa kun las bdag bzlos kyang / /lus dang ngag las yid sgo nas/ /dge la rab tu brtson par bgyid/ /ces theg dman dang thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba lan gsum/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems kyis/ /ji ltar byang chub thugs bskyed ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang sems bskyed cing / /byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par —253—

bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ zhes sogs lan gsum gsol ba btab/sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus lha sku gsal stong la sems gtad/ bum dbang ngo / /byang chub sems sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pa khar phab/oṃ āXhuX/ zhes brjod/ ngag grags stong la sems gtad/ gsang dbang ngo / /de rnams 'od du zhu rang nyid la thim/ rang lus bde bas gang / sems stong gsal ba la mnyam par bzhag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i ngang du cung zad cig bsgom/ ga bzhi pa'o/ /de ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig gso ba'o//rdo snyas bdag dang sems can thams cad nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan/ shi ba'i tshe shul du lus/ der ma zad 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang mi rtag cing mi brtan/ snying po med pa'i rang bzhin can yin zhes mi rtag pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba yid dgrang bar bya/ de nyid yang bcar gyin bsgom/ thun mjug tu dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar nyin thun gsum/ mtshan thun gsum drug tu bsgom par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro bas sdom pa gsum blangs pa ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / dge rtsa bsngo ba rjes te 'di gnyis thams cad la 'dra'o/ /de ltar na dmigs skor gcig go /de nas 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin te/ ngan song gsum na tshor ba sdug bsngal sran du med/—254—

mtho ris gyi bde skyid mi brtan cing 'jig lus sems la sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa rgyun mi chad pa yod/ las nyon sdug bsngal gsum gyis 'khor lo bskor ba 'di las ci nas kyang thar dgos pa 'dug snyam du sdug bsngal gyi sgo nas 'khor ba mtha' dag la skyo shas drag tu bskyed de dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /lus 'di mi gtsang zhing snying po med pa'o snyam du bsgom pa ni dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /nga zhes bya ba ni/ phyi yul/ nang lus/ bar gang na yang mi gnas pa'i phyir/ bdag ni gang du'ang grub pa med do/ /zhes bsgom pa ni dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba'i snying re rje/ 'di rnams bde na/ skyid na snyam pa ni/byams snying rje'i dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /sems can 'di rnams byang chub mchog la reg pa'i don du/ bdag sangs rgyas myur du thob par bya'o/ zhes yang yang bsgom pa ni dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /de rnams sngon 'gro'i khrid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lu sa rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas la/ sems spros nga/'i mtshan ma/ thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ kha nang log gi shes nga 'i cher gyis blta sa pa na/gzhi gdod ma nas dngos bzung thams cad dang bral zhing gsal ba'i chos mi dor ba/ ཿra med kyi dbyings la rang ngo shes pa skyong pa ni stong pa nyid bsgom pa ste/ rang rig mngon sum gyi rnal 'byor ye shes kyang / bde gshegs snying po bsgoms pa zhes kyang bya/ gnyis med kyi ye shes rang zhal lta ba zhes kyang bya/yongs grub kyi rnal 'byor zhes zer te dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /rang sems lha sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon dwangs pa la sems gtod pa ni lha sku gsal stong —255—

bsgom pa ste dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /rlung bum can kha sbyor tu bzung zhing lus khong stod du bsgom pa'i lte ba'i dbus na/ mar me sor bzhi pa khrig khrig g.yo ba/de g.yo bas lus bde lam lam 'dug pa gcig sgom/ thur sel khong 'dren gyi sbyor bas cung zad bde ba bskyed/ de ni bde ba sgom pa ste dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /de gsum so so'i la nyams rtags thon na/ rang bzhin 'gyur med brjod bral de kha'i ngang nas/ sems kyi ro bde bar lhang nge ba/ snang cha lha skur lam me ba/ kha nang bltas kyi shes pa dang ma bral ba de kho na bsgom ste/ g.yo med kyi bde chen zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes don dam gyi rnal 'byor 'di ni dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /de gsum dngos gzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems kyi gsal ba'i nyams la ma zhen cing sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'o/ /de bzhin du bde ba dang stong nga 'i nyams la ma zhen pa bya/ bstod pa dang bde ba dang longs spyod phun tshogs rnyed pa la sogs pa rnams la zhen pa dang dga' spro mi bya/ smad pa dang sdug bsngal dang / dbul phongs la sogs pa rnams la skyo ba dang mi dga' ba la sogs pa mi bya/ thams cad rmi lam lta bu mnyam pa nyid du shes par bya/ bde sdug dga' mi dga' sogs kyi snang ba ci shar thams cad 'dzin med kyi dbyings su ci thub bsre'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa pha rol du phyin pa drug la rnam pa thams cad du bslab par bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' yang nas yang du bya/ de dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la slob pa'i dam bca' bya ste/ dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /sems —256—

——can 'di rnams myur du sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god dgos pas/pha rol phyin pa'i lam yang shin tu 'gor te/de bas na smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam gyis tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya'o//zhes dam bca' yang yang bya/dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o//de gnyis rjes sam yan lag gi chos te sa bcu gsum dang chos mtshungs pa dmis sa skor bcu gsum mo/khrid bzhi po de la ni gzhi chos zhes bya'o//gzhi chos kyi snying po ni/gnas lugs kyi lha ba ngo sprod pa ste/de'i la gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med par ngo sprod pa/rang rig ye shes don dam du ngo sprod pa dang /de nyid bde chen zung 'jug du ngo sprod pa'o//dang po ni/sems rang bzhin mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/phyi snang ba la cher gyis bltas pas ngo shes yod ste/yul dang sems kyis dbye ba'i sa mtshams phyes med do//snang ba de nyid rang gi sems yin par gzugs su snang ba lam me ba dang /sgrar snang ba lhang nge ba dang /de bzhin du dri ro reg byar snang ba thams cad kyang rang sems gcig po de las logs su snang ba med par gtan la dbab pa ste/ngo sprod pa dang lnga'o/de nas rang sems kyi 'char sgo nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ci shar ba thams cad/me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gdod ma nas snang la ngos bzung med par ngo shes kyis gtan la dbab/de ni gzung 'dzin gnyis rang bzhin med par gtan la phab pas ngo sprod gnyis pa'o//lus snang dang sems kyi 'char sgo ci byung yang /rang snang 'khru/la ba tsam las sems kyi rang bzhin la nam yang ma gos/ par gto la dbab pa ni/kun rtog glo bur gyi dri ma gdod nas yod ma 257

myong bar ngo sprod gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba brjod pa'i yul las 'das kyang / rang rig rang gsal nam yang rgyun mi chad pa dang / yul snang dang rnam rtog ma shar gyi khyad par 'pho 'gyur gang yang med par nyams su myong bas gtan la dbab pa ni/ gnyis med kyi ye shes don dam bden par ngo sprod pa ste/ ngo sprod bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems kyi snang ba ma 'gags pa/ dag ma dag gi snod stsod kyi snang ba 'char du wo ba ni/ snang stong brjod du med pa'i phyir dag pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / de nyid kyi ngo bo 'pho 'gyur gto nas med pa/ ro bde bar shar ba ni/ lhan cig skyes nga/'i bde ba chen po ste/ de gnyis ming 'dogs tha dad ma gtogs ngo bo logs su med par rig pa skad cig ma gcig po 'di'i steng du gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ rang sems zung 'jug tu bstan pa ste/ ngo sprod lnga pa'o/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon pa'i ngo sprod rim pa lnga'o/ /de ltar na gzhi chos dang snying po ngo sprod de/ phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces bya'o/ khrid dang po gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ yon tan thams cad skyed pa'i gzhi yin pas so/ khrid gnyis pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ de nyid gtso bo yin pas so/ khrid gsum pa dus phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ gegs sel zhing bogs thon pa dus kyis mchog yin pas so/ khrid bzhi pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ gnyis pa'i 'khor yin pas so/ khrid lnga pa chos phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ gtso 'khor de gnyis kyis nyams su myong bya yin pas so/ /de ltar na 'di la phun sum tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces pa'i rgyu mtshan de —258—
bstan 'dzin dang smra ba'i dbang po blo gros dpal bzang dang rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' blo gros kyis kyang bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //bkra shis/ bṛ ya tsha/ zhus so/ /

'dir sbyin sreg bsdus pa ni/ sa stegs gru bzhi khru phyed do zhig gi steng du thabs khung gru gsum nang gi rgya la che na khru gang / 'bring la yang sor nyi shu/ chung na mtho gang yod/ dpang du rgya'i cha phyed srab 'thug rtse mor sor gsum gcig bya/ rang gi mdun du hom khung gi nang du liṅga khrag gis byugs pa gcig bcug dmar gtor gru gsum dang mchod pa spyi dang mthun pa dang / rak+ta nang mchod la sogs pa yang bshams/ thab kyi nang du drag po la tsher ma can dang / zhi ba la lci skam mam dge ba'i shing gis gang bar byed/ drag po la tsher ma can gyi shing dang / shing brul sogs kyis gang bar byed/ thabs kyi nang du ting lo zhig bzhag go /thabs nang gi 'bud shing dang mtshungs pa'i yam shing rang gi g.yon phyogs su bsag de bzhin du rgyas dbang gsum la dkar gyi mar khu dang / drag po la rke tshes mar khu dgos/ 'khru mar gzhan nas ji ltar 'os pa gnyis ka la phul ba'i chog gzhan sreg rdzas kyi dngos po 'khru rnam pa sna tshogs dang / rtsa ku sha zhi rgyas dbang gsum la zas mchogadrag po la sha khrag sna tshogs dang / bong bu'i sbangs dang / skra shad dang / dur khrod kyi rus pa la sogs pa dgos shing / mes bsregs par 'os pa gang 'dzoms pa de phul bas chog de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs dang / bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ nang mchod gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oX āXhuX dang / ya man+ta ka mang du bzlas/ bsreg rdzas rnams la/ skye( tseX( swāhā/ skyed āXswāhā/ glu rna lha swāhā/ skye ste ku ra co ku 29 swāhā/ zhes lan gsum re bzlas/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūX/ zhes dpa' 'bar gyis me sbar te thabs nang gi ting lo sbar ro/ /hūX huX zhes rlud yab kyis g.yabs so/ /spyir sbyin sreg gi me rlud yab kyis g.yab/ sbud pas 'bud du —260—

rung / khas 'bud par mi bya'o/ /oṃ a mṛ te hūX phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las byung ba'i thab yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ raX las me'i phung po nyid drang srong chen po me lha/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la/ bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ drag po la/ nag po srin po ltar khros pa gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ /yang / ya man+ta kas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ me lha'i snying gar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po/ bdag bskyed ltar yongs su rdzogs par bskyed de/ dbu rgyan gyi rgyas btab pa'i 'bar ro/ /yang na skad cig gis bskyed pa'i kyang chog ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa nas dud kha mun can gyi bar brjod/ hiXsgyiX'i mthar/oṃ asna ye swāhā/ bdag gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar ma rdza de cig ces pa'am/dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces mar khu 'bul lo/ /hiXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a ta ya huX phaṭa/ spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar/ yam shing 'bul/ de nas sreg rdzas g.yin rnams la/ oṃ khyiXsgyiX bi kṛ ta na na/ nai mo ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ zhes btags pa kho nas 'bul lo/ /zhi ba la lha mo mar ra ya'i tshab tu ma ma shan+ti ku ru zhes pa'o/ /drag po'i las la bar 'dir liṅga dgug gzhug nas sgrol tshig gi bar drug cu pa'i gtor chog nas bshad pa bzhin bya la/ling ro rnams gong bzhin ltar gsad sngags spel ba des 'bul/ de rjes gtor ma la dmigs nas mngon rtogs nas bshad pa ltar gtor chog yongs rdzogs bya/ 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yig brgya bzla/ tsha 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / sogs/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod sogs/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa las kyang shin tu bsdus pa 'di/ chos bzang nyi mas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //ma ṅga laX//—261 —

bkod pa legs par bzhugs/oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs/nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas a mṛ ta/ bzlas shing bsang chu gnas khang dang yo byad kun la gtor/ nang mchod gso ba'i rigs yin na des kyang gtor la/ oṃ ā0༷huX/ lan mang du brjod/de nas gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bsreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya byas pas gtad la/ skye( tsho tshe swāhā/ lam gsum gyis ma dag pa bkrus par bsam/ glu( āXswāhā/gsum gyis yam shing / oṃ shri swāhā/ gsum gyis zhun mar dang / oṃ dzi swāhā/ gsum gyis 'bru thams cad dang / oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ gsum gyi rdzas gzhan rnams la byin gyis rlabs(par de ku sha nas bzung bsang chu la dmigs te/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ /sa las skye ba'i snying po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi dag byed 'di/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed shog /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig drag po'i las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ oṃ āXhuX gis me blangs/ sgron me sbar/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang chu gtor/ a mṛ ta bzlas bzhin thab la g.yas bskor bya/ oṃ dz+wa badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la huX phaṭa/ zhesapa'i me sgron thab nang du zhugs/ hūX huX zhes bcas brjod cing rlung yab kyis me sbar/ thab khung a mṛ tas bsangs/ snya bhā was sbyangs/ thab mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung gru gsum nag po sor nyi shu pa —262—

kha khyer dmar po la rdo rje phyed pa'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ mu ran sngon po la mtshon cha'i tshogs 'phros pa/ phyi rol thams cad du ye shes kyi me kha dog sna lnga 'bar bas phyed dpangs su yod pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par 'gyur/ thab kyi dbus su paX las pad+ma raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raX yongs su gyur pa las me'i 'khor lo gru gsum pa'i steng du/ 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ pad+ma āX'i mtshan pa/ rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo me shin tu drag cing khro ba 'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed pa/ skre khams pa gyen du 'khyil ba/ 'od brgya stong du mas brgyan pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal gnag g.yas dkar/ ga/thon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na spyi blug gsum pa na skyabs spyin/ g.yon gnyis pa na dbyug gu/ gsum pa nas bgrang 'phreng bsnam par bsgom/ gnyis pa spyan drangs pa ni/ lag pa dgang gzar dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa blug gzar dang dril bu bzung la/rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho mtshams nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te byon pa/ra 'gyur/ stug gi rtse gsum gyis phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oX tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchogabasreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ṭak+ki ni huX dzaX oṃ e phya hi mahā shudhe pa ri shudhe satwa a ma la hu de kasmi sa ni he do bha wa kro dha asne ma ma ma sha truX ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ zhes thab khung ji lta ba bzhin bskyed pa'i g.yas g.yon du bzhag la/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/gsum pa ni lag pa gnyis thal mo sprad mthe'u chung srin lag gis rtser btsug —263—

la/ skye rna asne ya sa ma ye stu/ zhes pa'i dam tshig las mi 'da' bar bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ me lha 'dir ni byon pa legs/ / bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gis phul pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par ma rdzod/ /oṃ asne ya ar+gha pra titsā swāhā/ dgang blug gis ar+gha 'bul lo/ /ji ltar bltams pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /lha 'i rgyal po khrus gsol ltar/ /lha 'i chu ni dag pa yis/ /bdag gis khyod la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ 'a ya pra wa ra sad ka ra pra tisnro swāhā/ bdag dang 'gro la nas de srid drang srong bzhugs su gsol/ o asne ya pad+ma ka ma stu/zhes pas me tog gdan 'bul te thab kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ lnga pa ni mar dgang blug gsum phul te/ mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ asne ya de ba ta dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ zhes pa zhal du phul la gzhan bsreg rdzas gcig tu 'gres te/ bsreg rdzas dgra bo'i sha khrag tu bsam te 'bul bar bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ oṃ glu( asne ya de ba ta/ zhes pa la rnam lnga ba khas la 'bul bar bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍak+ki dbang bskur pa/ khres rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ ces pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhu ta dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba bhasmi ku ru du ni na hu phaṭa/ dri shu dza / ba ho sa ma ya sta/ sa ma ya ho zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhug me lha'i thugs kar hu ljags las rdo rje rtse gcig pa ra gyis mtshan pa dgang blug gi kha la yang hu gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ asne ya a ti bya a ti bya/ a bi sha a bi shamahā shri ya ha bya ka bya wa ha na ya/ bdag gis sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ spa pa lan —264—

bdun gyis dgang blug 'bul/ de bzhin du sngags de nyid kyis ya shing lan gsum phul/ slar yang sngags de nyid ji ltar 'os pa'i sreg rdzas thams cad la bsres de nas ci rigs par 'bul lo//tse( asne ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i mar blugs gzar gang thab tu phul/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /me lha de nyid 'od du zhu nas 'bar ba me'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar yang bsangs sbyangs/'bar ba me'i dbus su chos 'gyung gru gsum zhes pa nas/ ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ces pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra lha rje ho zhes pa'i bar bsgrub thabs bzhin no/ /snying po'i sngags kho na bsregs par byed pa nyid la ci tsam dgos pa'i grangs 'dzin pa nyid bzang po yin no/ /sreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i mthar so so'i mngon rtogs nas byung ba'i gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams byas la/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ ā rngo spo ta/sogs nas/ chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hu ha ho hri lha thams cad kyi ljags nas sho/ga oṃ in+d+ra nas shog oṃ kā la ru pa nas shog oṃ ā hū ho badz+ra ṭak+ki ni nas stsal du gsol/ oṃ ā hū ha ho hrī h+pha badz+ra a ra slo nas shog ces pa'i bar ro/ /de nas gzhus gi mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ka pa la yangs shing nas do nub khyod kyis bskrad par gyis/ lko pa'i bar ro/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/mchod yon nas oṃ shrī badz+ra be+e ra wa nas ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod la/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po nas mchog sgyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ nas snyud nyi shu'i bar gyis bstod la/ gsol gdab yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byordo ra ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rlobs blo yis ni/ /bas pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa —265—

yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ khyod kyi sems can lko pa'am/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med nga/'ang stsol/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra mu oṃ dza ya dza // /sogs gzhung la 'jug go/ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ nas lte bar sa rnams kyis rgyas gdab par gyur/ kun rtog gzung 'dzin/ sogs rang gi snying gar bsdu/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /me lha de nyid sngar gyi rnam pa ci lta ba bzhin du gyur/ tsho( asne ye swāhā/ces pa'i bar mar dgang blugs gang du phul/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyi mchod pa gong bzhi tsol/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung ba yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thab kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ga rnye bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba rnyes kyang thugs rjes che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal ces—2yo—

pas bstod/ me lha'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āXhuX las byung pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūṃ ha hoXhiX.oṃ ji ya a ti khyu nas wa ha na ya oṃ a kā ro lan bdun gyis/ gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang sgong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gis yen las gzhol/ mchod yon nas gong bzhi phul/ bstod pa bya/ gang yang bdag blo nas bzod par gsol/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon cing / /bdag gis dngos grub thams cad bsgrub/ /oṃ āXbadz+ra muX ye shes kyi me lha de nyid rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba me'i nang du thim par gyur/ bkra shis dang smon lam ci 'grub bya'o/ /me rang bzhin gyi zhu bar ma 'gyur gyi bar du dkrug par mi bya'o/ /glo bur las rjes bsdu dgos pa byung na 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu la/ tsho( ru ru spru dra/ nas sa dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas me la blugargyas pa la sogs pa gzhan rnams la yang cho ga 'di rigs 'grel/ lha nyung ngu'i dkyil 'khor dang /cho ga bsdus pa'i rigs dang bsgrub thabs phra mo sogs la de dang 'brel bar mdor bsdu 'di tsam kho na legs shing gzhan gong ma ltar la/ dngos gzhi'i skabs rdzas sngags so so byed pa bor ba ni shin tu bsdus pa'i rigs su gtogs so/ /gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas drag po thabs bskyed logs su bkol ba'o/ /gsang ba spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdo tsam 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smrasapa'o// //dge legs ma ṅga laX/ /—267—

dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu sa ye shes rang bzhin bde ba'i gter/ /chos dbyings mkha' mnyami ra / bang phyug ma/ /grub pa kun gyi mchog stsol mdzad/ /rdo rje lha mos dge legs stsol/ /thar pa dam pa'i grong khyer du/ /skal ldan gzhug pa'i sgo mo brgya/ /de las gcig gcig 'dir dbye ste/ /rgyal ba'i lam 'di thun mong min/ /'dir rnal 'byor rma 'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje gdan bzhi las 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rje btsun ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can sgrub par 'dod pas/ sgrub pa dngos kyi rim pa dang / rjes thun mtshams kyi chos so/ /dang po la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te bskyed rim dngos dang / yan lag bzlas pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rnal 'byor dang / rjes su rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /yang na dbye ba gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang /las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin te gsum mo/ /de rnams kyi dbye ba'i sdom ni/ rten sbyang mchod sgrub bgegs bsrung dang / /tshogs bsag rnams ni rnal 'dra1ra ro/ /bskul bas bzhengs dang byin gyis brlab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod rjes rnal 'byor/ /rten bskyed brten pa bskyed pa dang / /byin brlab shin tu rnal 'byor yin/ /dgug gzhug phyag rgyas rgyas btab dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ /rnal 'ebyor chen po yin par bshad/ /de ltar yan lag bcu bzhi ni/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yis bsdus pa yin/ /yang na ting 'dzin gsum gyis bsdus/ /gtso mo bskyed pa yan chad —268—

ni/ /dang po sbyor ba yin par 'dod/ /rten dang brten pa bskyed pa gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog zhes su bya/ /rnal 'byor chen por gang bstan pa/ de ni las rgyal mchog yin no/ /mngon rtogs chings ni gnyis yod kyang / /yan lag bcu bzhir mtshungs pa yin/ /de la yan lag bcu bzhi ni/ rten sbyang ba/ ma sna de pa sgrub pa bgegs bsrung ba/ tshogs bsag pa/ bskul nas bzhengs ba byin gyis brlab pa dbang bskur ba mchod cing bstod pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa brten pa lha tshogs spro ba go cha byin gyis brlab pa ye shes 'bor lo dgug gzhug phyag rgyas btab pa mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams so/ /de la dang po bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du tsan dan dmar po la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa/ mdun du mchod yon g.yas su nyer spyod/ g.yon du gsang chu rnams bsham/ skyabs sems dang yig brgya ci rigs pa jon du btang la/ dang po rten sbyang ba ni/ rang skad cig gis ye shes mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba'i snying chu shing gi me tog 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa huX gis mtshan pa ni sems sbyang ba'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a yig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo lnga la āXsuX spuX yuX huX rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pa'i mthil du ༷ soX yig las zla ba/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo lnga la/ saX snro dzhai smyiX ljoX rnams las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga par gyur/ lag pa byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /mgrin par hruXlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po/ lce'i 'dab mar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ oṃ āXdzi ha saX brta ni hūX phaṭa/ lan gsum/ g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas rnams su reg cing / spyi rje1 khriX mig gnyis su hūX/ rna ba dang sna la yum/ lte la suX/—269—

mgrin par snyi / dpung par ljo / snying gar ༈ /lte bar ljo ces byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa mchod pa sgrub pa ni/ seng ge mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/ skye( snro zhes mang du bzlas pas bsang chu bsgrubs la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya mchod yon gyi snod dang gtor ma la reg ste/ oṃ huX swahā/ zhes lan bdun/ ār+ya de ba'i gzhung dngos las mchod yon kho nas bsang chu byed par bshad kyang lag len du bsang chu logs su byed pas/ sngar bsgrubasapa'i bsang chus/ gnas dang mchod rdzas la gtor la/ oṃ sarba bi ma la saX sho dha ni huX phaṭa/kyis bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gser gyi snod bzang zhing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ baX huX shri kuX khyuX i rgu rnams las byung ba'i mchod rdzas zag med bde ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya dang /oṃ pra tī ts+tsha ar+ghaX huX/ g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub sbyar ba dang / pra ba ra sa ta kwa ra pā duX pra ru hūX/ de bzhin du dri chab la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ huX swāhā/ glu( shrī swāhā/ tsho( ṭaX/ swāhā/ skyed khyuX swāhā/ tsho( i swāhā/ 8( guX swāhā/ zhes byin gyisabarlab/gsum pa bgegs bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba dang / skyed huX phaṭa/ mthe bong gnyis sbrel/ sor mo lhag ma ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu phyir ldog la snying gar ba lha ka oṃ badz+ra ka wa tsa huX phaṭa/ bdag bsrung ba'o/ /sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya phyogs kun du bskor la/ oṃ huX swāhā/ phur bu'i sa gzhi dang rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra bar gyur/gnas bsrung ba'o/ /rdo rje khu tshung gan kyal las 'dzub mo brkyang ba rtse sprad de ldog nas snying ga dang —270—

rgyab dang spyi bo rnams su lan gsum bskor nas/ oṃ ḍa ṭuX huX swāhā/ mnyam pa'i thal mo lan gsum gdab ste/ oṃ badz+ra tu shu hoX ces go cha bcing ba ni rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ /bzhi pa tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ de la mchod pa ni g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma rnamasabarkyang ste/ oX shrī swāhā/ me tog dang / lag pa brkyang ste dris byug pa'i tshul du/ oṃ huX swāhā/dri chab dang / lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo bsgreng zhing sor mo lhag ma'i rtse sbyar ba dang / oṃ kuX swāhā/bdug spos so/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur las mthe bong bsgreng ba dang / oX khri swāhā/ mar me'o/ /thal mo kha gyen du phye ba las/ mthe bong gnyis dbus su bskyod pa dang / oṃ i swāhā/ zhal zas dang /de nyid las mthe bong phyir bskyed pa dang / oṃ guX sruhwas gtor ma 'bul lo/ /de nas pad skor sngon du 'gro bas thal mo sbyar nas/ oX na ma ste hūX na mā mi hūṃX na mo na maXhūṃX swāhā/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī pū dza u pa sa thā nā ya at+ta nāX nir ya ta yā mi/ oṃ ā rti rla pū dza u pa sa thā nā ya at+ta nāX ni cha ta yā mi/ oX sa ka la twa pa ri tra ṇa ya ut+pa nāX ni rla ta yā mi/sa ma ya stuX/ sa ma ya ho ho hoX zhes pa rnams lan gsum gyis phyag bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag gi skyabs su mchi/ /thams cad theg pa gsum po dang / /spyor ba gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mchog /snang ba mtha' yas don yod sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/—271—

bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ che ge mo zhes bya ba bdag /dus 'di nye bar bzung nas su/ /byang chub chen po thob kyi bar/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub du ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog r+ṣa po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan di pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum/ /mchod yul rang la thim/ lnga pa bskul zhing —272—

bzhengs pa ni/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i khri yig dmar po'i 'od zer kyis rang lus dang snod bcud thams cad bsregs te stong nyid du sbyangs/ /sems nyid 'od gsal chos kyi sku la gnas par gyur/ /oṃ snyu bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā snyu bhā wa shu rje rna ha/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ dzadza dzadza rdo rje sems dpa' dngos grub bzhugs pa'i bdag po khyod/ /ha ha ha ha hu yig mgon po dam tshig bdag po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ba ba ba ba rdo rje sgrog gi gsang ba las byung sku 'dzin pa/ a a a a a ho mgu ba'i rdo rje a li gcig tu thim pa'i skyo/ de nas stong pa'i ngang las a ā i yī u mū ri rī '-i lī e i o au a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis par gyur/ dz+nya no ྅ha/ zla ba'i dbus su hu las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hū gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra shudha sarba dharmā badz+ra shu rdzo3ha/ rdo rje de las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ zhing khams thams cad du sems can gyi don byas/ slar yang rdo rje de nyid la thim oṃ brta mo no3ha ho de las rang nyid ye shes mkha' 9/gro ma sku mdog sngon mo char sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu 'od zer 'bar ba/ rtsa zhal mthing kha shas cher khros pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po cung zad bzhad pa/ g.yo n-i zhal dmar po sgeg pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser grol ba/ sangs rgyas lnga dang thod skam kyis dbu la brgyan pa/ na bza' dmar po bsnams zhing sbrul dang rin po che'i spras pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ phyag drug gi —273—

g.yas pa gsum gyis kha ṭāX ga 'phyar ba dang / dgra sta dang / rdo rje/ g.yon gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu dang / thugs kar gtod pa'i thod pa dang / ral gri 'dzin pa/ sesgo'i gdan gyi steng du pad nyi la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rang 'od kyi rdo rje sems dpa' la 'byud pa'o/ /oṃ udha wo3haX ā ā ā aX huX swāhā/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharmāXyo ga shurnyo3haX/ rdo rje gsor wo / oṃ dz+nyā na kā yo3haX/ drug pa byin kyis brlab pa ni/ gong bzhin yan lag brgyad bsrung ba dang / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ skye( badz+ra kā ya ho/ tso( badz+ra bā kya āXglu tshe badz+ra tsit+ta hūX/ zhes pa rnams kyis rgyas btab/ bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mtha' bzhi lcags sgrog ltar 'dud/ dbus gnyis rtse sbyar/bar pa bzhi brkyang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying ga dpral ba mgrin pa spyi bo rnams su reg cing /sa ma yo3haX hūX huX sa ma yo stuX a dhi ti gi māX/ ces brjod/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya mgo bo'i gnas lngar reg ste/ tsho( huX āXswāhā/ rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/brgyad pa mchod bstod ni/ gong du bstan pa ltar phyag gyo byas la/ oṃ badz+ra pukhre mā le swāhā/ oX dh+ra pe shwa ri huX swāhā/ oṃ pa dī pe huX swāhā/ oṃ pra ru su ga rnye hūX swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku pru mahā ba li hūX swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ oX huX swāhā/ rdo rje bzung / oX khyiXswāhā/ dril bu dkrol/ 'phrog byed cod pan nor bu'i 'od kyis zhabs gnyis brgyan/ /dril bu las byung thugs kar dam du 'khyud pa'i sku/ /zhabs gnyis bskyod pas gsang ba las byung pad+ma ra sbyor/ /rdo rje sems mdzes dbang phyug dam pa'i go 'phang mchog /ces bstod/ dgu pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i rgyab dang /g.yas kyi mdun sbyar bas dbang ldan nas brtsoms te bskor zhing / oX badz+ra pra ka ra huX phaṭa/—274—

rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / lag gnyis phan tshun rtse sprad/ oṃ rju swāhā/ steng du rdo rje dra ba dang / g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis mthe bo sa la btsugs te/ tsho( bhu swāhā/ 'og tu phur bu'i sa gzhi dang / de rnams steng du bskor te/ oṃ rja swāhā/ nam mkha' la rdo rje'i bla bre'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yum las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam khri las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ su las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du hu las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ hu su hūṃ las ri rab lhun po lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdam pa kha sbub ste sa la bas oṃ hu swāhā/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i steng du rin po che'i sna bdun gyis spras pa'i gser gyi gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang / dra ba dang /dra ba phyed pa dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang ldan pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi ka ba dang / dril bu la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pas steng thog rim par phub pa/ dbus phyur bu'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ser nub dmar lho nag dbus sngo ba'i steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol pad+ma'i khor yug dang / mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dur khrod wo po brgyad dang / rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / me'i khor yug gis bskor ba/ nang gi pad+ma'i nye ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la seng ge'i gdan pad nyi dang bcas pa/ steng gi nam mkha' la gdugs dkar po re res —275—

brgyan pa'o/ /byang shar du glang po che/ shar lhor rin po che'i sna bdun gyi khri/ lho nub tu ma he/ nub byang du sbrul/ sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan de rnams kyi steng du'ang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re'o/ /ri rgyu pa brten pa lha rdzos spro ba ni/ bdag nyid nam mkhar gnas pa'i thugs ka na khams lnga'i dwangs ma rlung 'od kyi gong bu gzhal med khang gnas su babs shing / zhugs pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du huX du gyur/ hūX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du las ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo nas sems pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'di spyi ther ba rnam rgyal dbang po dang /rngog pa'i bzhed pa ni/ nam mkha'i lha nyid babs par bzhed do/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la yi ge rlung gi rang bzhin gyi lha tshogs rnams 'khod par bsam rang gi thugs ka nas nam mkha'i rlung hūX zhes spros pa las ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes dbang phyug ma dang bcas pa dbus kyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ rang gi chu'i rlung suX zhes bya bas phyung ba las shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i mdog can/ me'i rlung spuX zhes bya bas phyung ba las byang du drag mo mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can/ rlung gi rlung yuX zhes bya ba bas phyung ba las nub tu ro langs mkha' 'gro ma byi rle'i mdog can/sa'i rlung hūX zhes bya bas phyung ba las lhor gdol ba mo mkha' 'gro ma bung ba'i mdog can/ de bzhi kar yang gos dmar po bsnams shing / phyag g.yas kha ṭāX ga g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /me chu 'dres pa'i rlung snro zhes pas spros pa las/ byang shar du seng ge gdong ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ chu sa 'dres —276—

pa'i rlung zhes sne pas spros pa las shar lhor stag gdong ma g.yas dkar g.yon jo ba/ sa rlung 'dres pa'i rlung snro zhes pas spros pa las lho nub tu ce spyang gdong g.yas jo g.yon dmar ba/ rma me 'dres pa'i rma nā zhes bya bas spros pa las nub byang du lug gdong ma g.yas dmar g.yon rlu ser ba/ de rnams mdzes pa'i na bza' can/ g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdig 'dzub mdzad pa/ gsher byed kyi rlung phuX zhes bya bas spros pa las shar sgor rgyal dbang ma dkar mo lag pa'i rtse gnyis khar bcug nas drag tu rgod pa/ sreg byed kyi rlung phre zhes bya bas spros pa las byang sgor 'bar byed ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas gnas pa/ g.yos byed kyi rlung phroX zhes bya bas spros pa las nub sgor 'thib byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bkang nas gsol ba/ nor 'dzin gyi rlung phri zhes bya bas spros pa las lho sgor 'phrog byed ma'am g.yo ldan ma nag mo g.yas sdigs 'dzub dang /g.yon gtun shing bsnams pa/ de ltar sgo skyong bzhi ni zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ shin tu 'jig shing mche ba gtsigs ma/ /dbu skra dmar ser grol zhing 'phyang ba/ /sprul la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyi 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /rku snyag pa go cha byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas rnams su reg ste/ lce la suX/sogs bu ga brgyad gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya hūX/ oṃ badz+ra wā kya āX

glu( badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ zhes so/ /bstoganyis pa ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ oṃ badz+ra puspro mā le sogs mchod pa lngas gong bzhin mchod/ 'phrog byed cod paṇa sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra a du sha dzaX.oṃ gh+ri sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha huX/ oṃ badz+ra spro ṭa paṃ/ oṃ yu badz+ra lha rje hoX pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ sta a san hūṃ phaṭa kyis gdan phul bcu gsum pa phyag rgyas btab pa ni/ oṃ hūṃ haXs ma ya yu snga da ju dzaXhū ཾ ༷ baX hoXsam ya staX sa ma yo3snya/ zhes pa'i sngags dang / g.yas dang g.yon du pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa bcing pa ni/ phyag rgya thams cad kyi sngon 'gro ba yin la/ de 'dra re re'i mthar so'i phyag rgya 'ching ba las rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pa snying gar bzhag g.yas pa mchan khung g.yon du bcug pa dang / oṃ hūX swāhā/ lha spyi'i dam rgya'o/rdo rje khu tshur ram rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba dang / oṃ a hū ཾ ༷ swāhā/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i 'o/ /sor mo bsnol lag mthil lan gsum brdeb/ mthe bong thal mo'i dbus su bskyod pa dang / oṃ a swāhā/rdo rje mi'o/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ba dang / oṃ ā swāhā drag mo'i 'o/ /de nas mthe chung gnyisabasgreng ba dang / oṃ āXswāhā/ ro langs ma'i 'o/ /de nyid las gung mo bsgreng ba/ glu rna aX swāhā/gdol pa mo'i dang / rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad pa las 'dzub mo gnyis rtse sgur mor brkyang ba ni mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi ste/ oṃ ṛ swāhā/ seng ge mo'i 'o/ /oṃ grwa swāhā/ stag mo'i 'o/ /oṃ '-i swāhā/zhes ces spyang mo'i 'o/ /oṃ zhwa swāhā/ lug pa mo'i 'o/ /thal mo gnyis kha phye ste mthe bong khar bcug pa dang / oṃ klu swāhā/ rgyal dbang mo'i 'o/ /sor mo bsnol ba'i thal mo spyir bor bzhan pa dang /tsho( phre swāhā/ 'bar byed ma'i 'o/ /thal mo sbyar te kha phye ba kha'i thad dam gsang gnas su bzhag pa —278—

dang / oṃ phro swāhā/ 'thib byed ma'i 'o/ /pad skor gyi mthar sor mo skye gnas dbye ba'i tshul lam/yang na rdo rje bsdams pa las 'dzub mo gnyis brkyang ba gsang bar bzhag pa'am/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur rna ba'i rtsar bzhug pa dang / tso rtso phri swāhā/ 'phrog byed ma'i 'o/ /yang na de bzhi la/ oṃ i swāhā/ skye( 6snyi swāhā/ tsho( glu rna swāhā/ tso( ā swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyang bshad de/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i sngags de dag lan bdun bdun gyis brtan par byed pa'o/ /'di dag ni dam tshig gi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa yin te/ gdan bzhi'i bsdus rgyud gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa las 'di tsam kho na gsung drodi pas/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor la phyag rgya rgyas 'debs gzhan rnams mi dgos la/ dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags dang / rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs rnams las ni/ phyag rgya bzhi rgyas btab tu gsungs te/ rgyud rgyas pa'i dgongs par 'dod do/ /ya nga rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur / lha thams cad la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pas ma/tshan par gyur/ ༅ bzhi pa mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ nyer spyod lnga dang sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang gtor ma sogs byin gyis brlab par mos la/ oṃ ha ho khyi swāhā/ lan mang du brjod/ gong bzhin/ ngu khye mā me la sogasapa mchod pa lngas mchod/ spro na phyag rgya nyi shus kyang mchod cing sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod par mos la/ o hū swāhā/ sgeg mo dang / oṃ hu hos hā/ pi wa ma dang / kha'i rtsar mdzub mos g.yab pas/ tse( hū hu skyo swāhā glu ma dang / skyed su nir kyi swāhā/ gar ma dang / skye( hū swāhā dri chab ma dang / tse( shrī swāhā/ me tog ma dang / tse( ku swāhā/ bdug spos ma dang / skye( khri swāhā/ mar me ma rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu'i ma rdzo pa ni/ oṃ hu swāhā sa rdo rje blangs la/ mdzes pa'i rdo rje —279—

gsor byas la/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das par sgrol/ /chos kyi rnam par dag byed pa/ /rdo rje snying po blang bar gyis/ /lha nyi shu rtsa bdun du shes pas rdo rje gsor/ oṃ hi swāhā/ dril bu blangs/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta sa pra ra ṇi ta sarba shudha slo tra pra tsa li te pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da sam+bha we ta badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni sa rnyo ṣa ni hu hū hu ho ho ho ā kha swāhā/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ngo bor mos nas phyogs brgyad du dkrol lo/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ hu bde ba'i thugs gdan rdo rje can/ /bdag gi mig gis de mthong ngo / /yig ge dngos po'i rang bzhin ni/ /stong pa rgyas pa de yin no/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba'i/ /dbus ni rnam par shes byas te/ /yig ge thams cad 'joms byas nas/ /'di ni shi skye bsam pa yin/ /phan tshun 'phyud nas sbyor ba las/ /'gying bag tu ni 'da' bya'o/ /gnyis med chos ni rnyed gyur nas/ /myang ngan 'das pa 'di thob bo/ /'khor ba'i bya ba ma rmongs na/ /de ni mya ngan las 'das pa/ /rang bzhin kun gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /gar byed smyo ba bzhin du ni/ /rnal 'byor ma lnga sangs rgyas te/ /de ni de bzhin nyid du brtag /sna tshogs mang po gzugs sprul pa/ /sems can rnam par smin byed des/ /'khor ba yi ni don byed de/ /chos nyid 'di la ma rmongs na/ /rnal 'byor pa yi thar lam 'di/ /chos kyi snying po phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhi du/ /sems can sgrol byed rnal 'byor bdag la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu bdag nyid ngo bo gcig la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rmongs pa gcod la bstod phyag 'tshal/bdag gis rtag tu de bzhin nyid gcig bstod phyag 'tshal/ /ces pas bstod/ sprosapa la dga' na/ bstod pa rgyas pa byed par gzhus nas bshad cing man ngag las kyang mdzad do/ /de —280—

nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas bdud rtsi'i snod blangs la/ lag mthil g.yas par nyi ma'i steng du thod pa/ g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas kha bkab la/ lag mthil g.yon du a las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du su dkar po la ā li bcu drug gis bskor ba'o/de rnams dang sor mo rdo rjer gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas thod pa gang bar gyur/ lko ha ho hri zhes brjod cing / g.yon pa'i mthe bong hū las gser gyi sa gzhi srin lag su las ri rab tu mos/ bsrubs bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams te/ 'bru gsum gyis thigs gtor lan gsum/ mgrin par mchod rten dkar po gnas pa la phul/ de bzhin du snying gar ye shes sems dpa' dang / spyi bor bla ma rnams la thigs gtor gsum gsum 'bul/ de nas gong du bstan pa'i sngags rnams kyis nus na lha thams cad la lan gsum gsum 'bul la/ ma nus na gtso mo la lan gsum dang / 'khor rnams la re re'o/ /de rnams kyis yan lag bcu bzhi bstan zin to/ /de nas lha'i sku la sems 'dzin na/ lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags sam/ so so'i snying po brjod la/ lha rnams gsal btab ste/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i sku la sems bzung bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim gyi yan lag bzlas pa ni/thog mar bgrang 'phreng bsangs sbyangs/ ye shes kyi lhar gyur bzhu ba las bgrang 'phreng du ltas la/snyim pa sbyar ba nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du chud par bsam/ o pa de pa de ma hā dz+nya na sarba bzhi mahā ud bha we hū hu hu ho ho ho a swāhā/ ces bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ o hū swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci nus su bzla zhing / gtso bo la sum 'bum dang / 'khor rnams la khri khrag re re'o/ /o dzu hu swāhā/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi'i sngags so/ /'dir bla ma rngog pa rnams mtha' na bzhugs pa'i lha nas brtsams te rim gyis bzla ba nā ro pa'i man ngag tu 'dod mod nges par dgos pa ni min no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba'i gdan dang bla ma'i man ngag —281 —

las shes par bya'o/ /rjes thun gyi bya ba la/ gtor ma'i bya ba dang ma 'brel na/ skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu bya ste/ oṃ ut+pa tiṣ+ṭha hu swāhā/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang gi dbugs kyis drangs te lus la zhugs pa ni/ snying gar ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/lce la rdo rje ma spyi gtsug tu drag mo/ rna ba dang sna la ro langs ma/ mig gnyis la gdol ba mo/ mgrin par seng ge ma/ dpung pa gnyis su stag mo/ snying gar ce spyang ma/ lte bar 'ug pa ma/ brla g.yas la rgyal dbang ma/ g.yon la 'bar byed ma/ lag ngar g.yas la 'thib byed ma/ g.yon la g.yo ldan ma rnams thim ste/gnas de dang der yi ge'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang nyid la thim/ bdag nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ yang thun ma sgos kyi lha skur langs la dge ba bsngo'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i dbus su/khrag dang tsan dan gyi gru gsum du byugs pa'i nang zlum skor dang / le tshe dgu tshon dkar por 'bri/de dag las dbus su khrag gi thig le bcu gsum dang / re mig brgyad la lnga lnga bya/ gtor ma kha zas bzang dgu la sha dang nya dang byi kyu dang 'bru dang zas kyi bye brag 'byor tshad dbul/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dngos sam mtshon byed bsres la me tog dmar po'i la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga bshams/bdag bskyed kyi mtha' dkyil 'khor ma bsdus pa'i skabs yin na/ de'i dbus su dkyil 'khor dmigs/ dur khrod la phyogs skyong rnams spyan 'dren/ rang nyid las kyi lha mor zur du bye nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i las byed par bsam dgos shing / dus skabs g.yin dang bdag bskyed bsdus pa'i mtha' la yin na/ bdag nyid gtso mor skad cig gis bskyed la/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas lha bcu sa sum gyi dkyil 'khor sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa lha lnga'am/ gtso mo kho na spros kyang rung ste/maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du skad cig gis bzhugs par bsam/ de nas phyogs skyong rnams spyan drangs te 'god —282—

pa yin no/ /de'i phyir maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu yang lha grangs dang mthun par 'god dgos so/ /de la ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba bi ma la paṃ shodha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las yum las rlung / khriX las me/ oṃ āXhūṃ las skyed pu gsum/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang gi dbus dang shar nas g.yon skor gyi hūX suX hūṃ yuX huX rnams las gzhi mnyam dri chu rak+ta khu ba ngar snabs rnams re re yang 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzhin yi ge lnga po de rnams tshar re res mtshan pa/ rdzas lnga po so so'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi'i yig ge a dkar po'o//yang de'i steng du dbus dang shar nas g.yas skor gyi hūX spru gri dzi hūṃ las mi ba glang khyi rta glang po'i sha ste lcags kyu lnga po la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin slar yang yi ge de nyid kyis mtshan pa de dag kyang / lcags kyu chen po rnam snang mdzad/ rdo rje lcags kyu mi bskyod pa/ gnas kyi lcags kyu rin chen dbang / g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'od dpag med/ rgyal po'i lcags kyu don yod grub/ de ltar lcags kyu lnga so so'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la khriX dmar po/ ha hoXhiXha las 'od dpag med ser pos kha dog dang / hoXlas rnam snang dkar pos dri dang / khyiXlas mi bskyod pa sngon pos ro rnams phun sum tshogs par byas/ a khriX zhes brjod pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba 'char ka'i mdangs can dbu ba dang bcas par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa dang hūX yigalas rdo rje /ba cha gar gyur pa zhu nas lhung zhing 'dres pa shel gyi rnam pa ltar dngas par gyur/ de'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la ā li kā li rnams gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āXhuX brtsegs pa rnams su gyur/ de'i 'od 283—

——zer gyis 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyis bdud rtsi rnams bkug ste/de la zhugs yi ge gsum dang zla ba yang de nyid la thim/ oṃ ā hū/ lan gsum brjod de gtor ma byin gyis bas pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor spros dbus kyi re mig tu zhugs par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu kha sarba dharma r+ṇa a du nu pon twa ta/ oṃ gu swāhā/ ces pas maṇ+ḍal dkyil snyen ra gyi lha la phul/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hū dza grwa hā/oṃ brta li brta li ma hā brta li hu hū hū dza grwa hā/ lan gsum brjod/ zhing skyong rnams maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas so sor bzhugs pa ni/ shar du nag po la rgan byad ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang du drag po chen po la rgyal ba ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ nub tu lhas sbyin la nag mo bzang mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lhor nag po la dbang mo la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang shar du rtsigs byed la 'phrog byed ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ shar lhor 'jigs byed la drag mo'i gzugs la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ lho nub tu dga' ba las 'das pa la thod phreng ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ nub byang du bgegs kyi rgyal po la ral gri la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ gtso bo brgyad ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas na ral gri dang dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ 'khor rnams ni g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / g.yon mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ phyogs na gnas pa rnams shar dkar/ byang ser nub dmar lho nag zur thig gi sa la gnas pa gsum gsum ni phyed gzugs can thams cad kyang gcer bu spyan gsum ro'i —284—

gdan la gnas pa'o/ /de nas oṃ pra ru ar+ghaX nas oṃ guX snyu he'i bar tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ g.yon ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya gtor snod la reg par mos/ g.yas rdo rje sdig mdzub bsgrengs nas gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ 'di skad ces/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang gzhi'i/ khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang / khyad par gdol ba'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/lhas sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po rtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang /dga' ba la 'das bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u mas bstod/ / rgyal ma rnam par rgyal dbang mo/ /thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /nag mo sdang ba lam pa gī /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod can ma/ /thod 'phreng 'phreng can kha ṭāX ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu lag dang /lha yi dbang phyug ma rnams ni/ / mkha' 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid dang / /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal wo po/ /de bzhi rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /gos med sbyor ba skyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'dir sbyon cig /oṃ ka ska ta ra n+ta na/ nga da na sarba sdo yaX ha na ha na ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a mu ka sgyu i daXkwarla bā dha ya huX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaXswāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing rtse—285—

gol gtog lag gnyis khu tshur rgyab spras pa'i srin lag sbrel la/ glu( bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo ga yo gī shwa ri hūṃ hu hūṃ dza grwa hā/ ces lan mang du brjod la/ rang gi dam tshig la gnas par bsam/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang dbye dang dgug pa dang / /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba yi/ /las kyi dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi gtong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing cho se 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces 'phrin las gzhol/ hu hu hu/ zhes rdo rje dril bu snying gar bsnol/ phan tshun 'byud pa'i sbyor ldan pa/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni brgyan pa 'di/ /mgon po lus la mdzes pa'i sku/ /dngos las grol ba bdag phyag 'tshal/ ces glu blangs nas dril bu sil bzhin du/sems can sgrol mdzod sogs kyis bstod/ /de nas gtor chog tsam yin na/ sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/ gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gi sgrol/ /ma grol ba rnam bdag gis dgrol/ /de ltar rjes su brtse ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bdag bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i smon lam btab/ oṃ —286—

sarba ṭa yan pra dus na ha na ha na gro sna grot+na kha kha ji hi ji hi ru ca spyo bha wa pu nā rā ga ma nā ya hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod de se gol gtog /'jig rten pa'i lha rnams ga kho/gas swa/ gser la/ g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas sa la brkyang ste/ tsho( at+pa ti : swāhā/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu ba gong bzhin pas/ gzhal med khang bsdu ba mi dgos/mjug tu smon lam dang bkra shis la sogs pa bya'o/ /gal te tshogs mchod dang 'brel ba yin na/dang por gtor ma gnyis bshams/ tshogs rdzas dang lhan cig byin gyis brlab nas/ phud gcig 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma la sbran/ phud gnyis ba phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la sbran/ gong bzhin bsngos nas bstod pa yan chad song ba na/ bar 'dir tshigs bcad kyis 'dren cing tshigs bcad kyi blangs/ rang rang gi phud nas bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs la bsngos/ tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus/ lhag ma dang po dud sol ma la 'bul ba ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bkab la/myong gis kha khru btab/ skye( āXhūṃX ha ho / ༷༷hiX byin gyis brlabs/ mdzub mo mche ba'i phyag rgya kha 'gram du bzung la/ oX bhu brta li brta li/ zhes sbyan drangs/ oṃ ku ru ku ru brta li brta li/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gtsig byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig bsrung ma khrag dga' ma/ /ki li sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma/ / dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su/ /gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa sa /gsol cig ba'es shig dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /bdag gis las ni ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyis grogs mdzod cig oX grot+na gro sna sarba dusaX bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa phuX phre phroX phri phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod la se gol gsum gtog pas gshegs su gsol/ shin tu lhag ma chu dang sbyar te/ tsho( u tsi ṭa ha ri khyuXswāhā/—287—

zhes rol mo dang bcas te lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyal lo/ /de nas nang du 'ong nas bkra shis kyi glu blang ba ni/ te na huX te na huX/ te na te te hūX/ ston ka'i zla bzhin mdzes pa'i zhal/ /zla ba ltar dkar sku gtsang ma/ de na hūX sogs/ phun tshun 'byud pa'i sbyor 'chang ba/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya mchog /te na huX sogs/ /'gro ba la khyab rdzu 'phrul sku/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi gzugs can te/ /te na huX sogs/ rang dgar sems can grol mdzad pa/ /rkyen gzugs gang de la phyag 'tshal/ te na huX sogs/ /bkra shis dbyangs kyis bkang byas te/ /thams cad kun gyis glur blang ngo / /de nas yig ge brgya pa bzla bzhin du/ ma 'byoXr ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/sems can thams cad nad med sogs smon lam btab/ swa bhā wa dang / badz+ra shudha dang /yo ka shurnyo le sngags gsum brjod/ don yid la bzhag oX khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi mthar/ oX ga smo ga tsā snyu bhā wa naX huX phaṭa/ ces pas 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor mgron dang / oṃ sarba ྅rdziXrtu sogs sam/ oṃ ga smo ga smo swa bhā wa pu na rā ga ma nā ya dzaXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes se gol lan gsum gdab pas 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs/ tseX( ut+pa tiṣ+ṭha sogs gong nyer bsdus skabs su bstan pa bzhin byas nas/ mthar smon lam dang bkra shis kyang ci 'grub bya'o/ /'di ni rgyud rgyas pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ cho ga rgyas par sbyar ba ār+ya de ba'i gzhung la/ bla ma'i man ngag lag len sbyar ba ltar bshad pa yin la/ da lta'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa kho na'i lugs ni bha ba bha dra dang / a bha ya'i gzhung ltar yin no/ /lugs de yang nyams len la mkho bas logs su 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni nongs na mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ /dge ba gang de mkha' dang mnyam gyur nas/ /lhan skyes gdod ma'i shes rab mchog de dang / /yid gcugs rdo rje sems dpa' mngon gyur sho /ces dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye —288—

'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas gzhan la phan pa'i phyir nges par sbyar ba ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di'i rgyud gzhung 'grel pa man ngag gi nges gsang cha tsam rig nas/ snying po'i don shin tu 'aXbyer bde bar brjod pa ste/ sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po jo nang du nges par sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag /ma ṅga la/

dud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi thig le zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ //she shes dbang phyug snying rje'i bdud rtsi yis/ /bdag gi snying la dbugs dbyung nyer gnas mdzod/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' rig min yang / /dam pa'i gsung gi rjes 'brang 'dir rtsol te/ dad dang phan pa'i blo can gyis/ /bya ba 'ga' la 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de ni legs sam/ nyes kyang rung / /dam pa rnams kyis bkag pa med/ /rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen po rnams kyis nye bar sbyar ba de dag lag len tu 'debs dka' ba dang / 'di la rtsal 'don du byed pa yang nyung ba'i phyir dus mtha' 'dir gzhon la shin tu phan par ma mthong zhing / mkhas par mngon pa'i nga rgyal can phyis byung 'ga' zhig gis mdor bsdus su sbyar ba 'ga' zhig mthong yang lhag chad nor ba'i skyon mang pos snying po med par byas snang bas/ 'dir de dag las zlog ste nyung gsal 'khyer bde rang gzhung dang mthun cing lhag chad nor ba'i skyon dang bral bar bya'o/ /'di la bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ ye shes dbang phyug ma lha (〈dza〉 rtse bcu ) gsum ma'am/ bsdu na lugs 'di nyid kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyis kyang rung la/ de'i rjes su ye shes dbab pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ 8( badz+ra satwa ā be sha ya ā/zhes pa'am/ glu( yo ga ā be sha ya a/ ces pa 'bum phrag gsum mo/ /yang na tsho'o ma ṇi gu ru dra dha tsi li tsi li huX phaṭa/ sum 'bum bzlas na ltas pa tsam gyis 'bebs nus so/ /rmi rna ma ta li huX phaṭa/ sum 'bum bzlas na thos pa tsam gyis so/ /oṃ ma ta li tsit+ta tsa li ti hūṃX hūṃX —290—

phaṭa/ 'bum gyi thag ring du gnas pa la yang ngo / /tso te ba ta li ba ta li hūṃX phaṭa/ 'bum gyisaming tsam brjod pa'i yul 'a yang ngo / /oṃ ba ta li ba ta li hūṃX phaṭa/ sum 'bum bzlas pas/rdo shing sogs brtan pa'i dngos po la yang ngo / /de nas rdzas bsags te/ ra nag gi tshe bu bzhi dang /lce ste yan lag lnga/ gu gul dang / tshil chen te sman bdun bdud rtsi'i chu dang sbyar ba la/ rdo rje ma'i sa bon mang du bzlas pa'am/ yang 'ol ma si dang / dha tu ra dang / lcags kyu lnga dang gu gul dang /mar nag sogs sbyar ba lce la bzhag rgyu yin te/ de ltar ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas rnams kyang bsgrub par bya'o/ /'dir slob ma rjes bzung ye shes 'bebs pa lta bu cig bshad kyang / spyi dang 'dra bar byed pa legs shing / sa chog kyang dkyil chog mdor bsags las spyi dang mi 'dra ba 'ga' re bshad na'ang / gsang ba spyi'i cho ga ltar byas na legs so/ /sta gon la jon du 'gro ba ni/ sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar gyi yo byad rnams bshams/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang rang la thim gyi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde ba r+ṣa po'i char yang du spund pa ltar bya la/de nas lha sta gon ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir skya thig btab lha gnas su tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ oṃ huX swāhā/ lan bdun nas/ oṃ guX snya he'i bar du sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ tshom bu la dmigs nas/ oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni spyiX/ oṃ yo gāX pa ra huX/oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni suX/ oṃ lho ri ḍā ki ni khyuX/ oṃ be ta li ḍā ki ni yuX/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍali ḍā ki ni huX/ oṃ sing ha ḍā ki ni snro / oṃ bya gh+ra ḍā ki ni / oṃ dzhaiX dza sna ka ḍā ki ni snro / oṃ u lu ka ḍā ki ni dzhai / oṃ ḍā ki ni phuX/ oṃ dī pi ni pre/oṃ tsū ṣi ṇi phroX/ oṃ kaX po rdza phre/ zhes brjod/ mdun bskyed/ oṃ huX swā —291 —

hwas bsangs/ snya bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yaX las rlung zhes pa nas nyi ma'i gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ye shes mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa nas/ sems pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ khar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i mdog can/ byang du drag mo mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can/ nub tu ro langs mkha' 'gro ma byi dra'i mdog can/ ltor gdol pa mo mkha' 'gro ma bung bu'i mdog can zhes pa nas thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar du seng gdong ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ shar lhor stag gdong ma g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba/ lho nub tu ce spyang gdong ma g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du lug gdong ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba nas sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ shar sgor rgyal dbang ma nas/ drag tu rgod pa/ byang sgor nas gnas pa/ nub sgor nas gsol ba/ lho sgor 'phrog byed ma nas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /rang gi snying ka'i sa bon las/ 'od zer nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur gyi bar ye shes dgug gzhug dang / dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya'o/ /oX ha ho hru grwahwas mchod pa byin gyis brlab ba nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba rdzogs kyi bar/ sgrub thabs ltar byas nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ ye shes dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ces lan gsum mo/ /skye rna badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha snye dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs la/ ar+ghaX nas/—292—

shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ sems can sgrol byed sogs kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs la/bdag cag slob mar bcas la bsrung ba dang / nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis brlab pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod do/ /bum pa la sogs pa rdzas sta gon ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su bum pa/ shar du thig skud/ lhor rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ nub tu bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i dung chos/ mtshams bzhi dang bum pa'i mdun ngos de sngar/tshon rtsi lnga bzhag mtha' mchod pas bskor/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi gos zung dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ dag pa'i chu bo yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dkar mo mchog gi 'od zer 'phro ba/phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi yab la 'byud pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dza/ oX shri swāhā/ oX huX swāhā/ oṃ kuX swāhā/ oX khriX swāhā/oṃ i swāhā/ skye( gung swāhā/ ces pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya khu tshur gnyis las 'dzub mo gnyis sbyar ba'i phyag rgya snying gar bzhag la/ tseX( āXswāhā/ zhes dam la bzhag /bzung thag nas bzung ba'am/ lag pa g.yas pas bzung ba'i rdo rje'i bum pa'i khar reg la/ sngags de nyid brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /de nas oṃ huX suX khriX yuX huX swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa dung chos la bzla/ des rdor dril dang skud pa la bsangs gtor byas la/ oṃ huX swāhā/ brgya rtsas de rnams byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ snroX—293—

swāhā/ brgya rtsas tshon rtsi la sogs pa byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas gtor ma bshams te/ oṃ sarba bi ma la zhes pa nas dzaXhūṃ phaṭa grwahwa'i bar dang / bkra shis kyi bar du mngon rtogs bzhin gtor 'bul bya'o/ /de nas slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma khrus byas des maṇ+ḍal phul bsang chus bsangagator bya/ spro na mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang / slob dpon rdo rje semasadapa' yab yum gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas nang dbang bskur ba yang bya/ mdor bsdus su na de med kyang cho ga gang ltar yang / dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste sogs spyi dang mthun pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bu rbeng theg pa chen po yi/ /zhes sogs mngone byang las 'byung ba'i tshig gis spro ba bskyed/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /sogs kyis bshags pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sogs yi rang dang / sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas sogs skyabs 'gro dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar sogs sems bskyed dang / bdag gis dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ / sogs bsngo ba rnams byas la/ slob ma ye shes dbang phyug ma dkur mo/ kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ gnas gsum du bdud rtsi thig le byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi ta huX/ oṃ badz+ra wā kya āX oṃ badz+ra kā ya hoX zhes brjod/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga phul/ oṃ aXdzi ta saX rba rta ni hūX zhes lan bdun bsngags pa'i so shing sbyin la/ spyi dang mthun par dor/ oṃ sarba bi ma la saX sho dha ni huX phaṭa/ zhes ge rgyar chu sbyin/ srung skud dang ku sha spyi dang mthun/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /ces pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces pa'i bar/ rjes zlos lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzhin/ spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /theg —pa chen po 'bras 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog dpal dang ldan pa 'di/ khyed rnams rnam par grol ba yi/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /mtshams med lnga'i las 294—

can yang / /tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor zhugs dang dbang bskur ba/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /spyin bdag las can rnal 'byor pas/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /ji bzhin lam 'di rdo rje nyon/ /mnyam par ba the lta/ pas gtsug lag 'di'i/ /yi ge dang ni tshigs bcad tsam/ /gang dag nyan byed de dag ni/ /myo/tho ris longs spyo da thob 'gyur ba'am/yang na 'khor lo bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes pa'am/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dgaces so gas spyi dang mthun par brjod kyang rung / de nas rmi lam brtag cing ngan na srung ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de dag ni sta gon du gnas pa'i skor ro/ /de nas sngar gyi thig skud snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ suX khriX yuX hūX snro snruX snro ā+oṃ rnams yongs su gyur ba las/ thig skud re re yang lha mo dgu sto ༄ dgu'i bdag nyid du gyur/ huX huX huX zhes skud pa bsgril zhing brkyang la/ mthar thal mo kha sbyor du bzung ste/ tsho( 65 ā āX.aX/ hūX swāhā/ zhes lan ma/nga du bzlas shing byin gyis brlab la thig gdab par bya'o/ /thig gi bya ba rdzogs pa na rdul tshon lnga po/ huX sdoX/ khyiX yuX huX rnam/sa las byung ba'i tshon sna lnga po lha mo lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ sa bon lnga po de nyid lan mang du bzlas te/ slob dpon gyis dang por rdul tshon dgye zhing / phyi nas slob mgyu rnams kyis kyang ngo / /thig dang tshon gyi mtshan nyid ni g.yin du 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /thig mtshon gyi bya ba spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung mod kyi/ /gong du bshad pa nyid lugs 'di'i sgos chos su bshad pa'i phyir/ 'di kho na ltar bya'o/ / de nas rgyan dgod pa ni spyi dang 'dra ba las khyad par du shar du seng ge byang du rma bya/ nub tu ngang pa/ lhor chu srin gyis mtshan pa gnyis gnyis te rgyal mtshan brgyad dang / shar du rgyal dang bkra shis/ byang du dngos grub dang rdzu 'phrul/ nub tu rgyal ba dang rnam rgyal/ lhor grub pa dang 'jigs pa ste/ bum pa —295—

brgyad 'god par bshad cing / dngos su med na yid kyis bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor srung ba ni huX zhes sngon du 'gro bas po gad nas badz+ra ḍā ki ni āXhaX oṃ huX ha na ha na mā ra ya sdospyi na ghā ta ya ghā ta ya aX.aXhuX khyo phaṭa/ byang nas sgo ri ḍā ki ni āXhaX/ tseX( huX aXphaṭa/ nub nas be+e tā li ḍā ki ni ā haX/ oṃ huX āXphaṭa/ lco nas tsaṇ+ḍa li ḍā ki nī a ha/ oṃ hūX aX phaṭa/ slar yang dbus su bsam nas shar nas/ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni ā hi/ oṃ huX ha na sogs gong bzhin spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir stang stabs bcu bzhi bya'o/ /sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas bskor te/ oṃ hūX phu phaṭa/ rdo rje gur du gyur/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis bsgrig te brkyang ba bskor te/ oṃ rdza bha ni hūX phaṭa/ rdo rje rwa bar gyur lag pa gnyis gan rkyal du brkyang ba rtse sprad/ sa'i gnas lngar brdabs te/ tsho( dzu phaṭa/ sa 'og rim pa bdun du phug pas bgegs rnams kyis snying gar phur bus gdab cing / rdo rje'i sa gzhi bcings par 'gyur/ de nas dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga la gnyis las/ dang po bum pa sgrub pa ni/ bum pa bcu bzhi'am brgyad 'byor na rab ste/ lha mo bcu gsum dang las thams cad pa ste bcu bzhi dang / yang na bkra shis bum pa'i nub kyi rnam rgyal du gtso bum dang / ro langs ma'am seṅge ma la las bum 'tshol ba yin no/ /'on kyang deng sang lag len bum pa gnyis la byed pas/ spyi dang mthun par bkod la/bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa gong bzhin bskyed nas/ oṃ tā pa te tā pa te ma hā tā pa te hūX swāhā/lan bdun lha'i chu bo dal gyi 'bab par gyur/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang mthe'u chung rtse sbyar bum pa la reg tshul byed cing / oṃ hūX suX khriX yuX huX swāhā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas shing / bsdu na lha'i rnam pa bskyed pa med par sngags bzlas pa tsam kyis kyang chog mod kyi/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi lag len ltar na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ri zhes pa nas thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar dang las bum du seng gdong ma zhes pa rnes/rdo rje rtse lnga —296— (

pas mtshan par gyur: gyi bar lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin yin no/ /de nas gzungs thag nas bzung / skye( huX swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci 'grub dang / dam brgya'i skabs su bshad pa'i sngags sam/ lha rnams kyi 'byin sngags gang rung gi sgo nas/ 'khor gyi bzlas pa yang ci 'grub byas te/mthar mngon rtogs bzhin mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ shrī swāhā/ la sogs pas mchod/sems can sgrol byed: sogs kyis bstod nas/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang je sogs kyis/ bzod par gsol mchod yon phul/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zhu bar gyur/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gnyis las dang po la dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags las/rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' gtso rkyang gis chog pa'i lugs yod kyang / ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor la de mi 'grig cing / bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag ltar/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sgom pa nyid legs pas de'i dbang ltar byas nas bshad par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sgo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang gnas yo byin gyis nga rlob pa yang bya ste/ seṅge ma'i sngags kyis bsang ba las g.yin sdom pa'i cho ga sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar rdzogs par bsgom/ slar yang thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs par gyur/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃX las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yuX las rlud gi: nas nyi ma'i gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ phyogs bzhir suX khriX yuX huX rnams las byung ba'i kha ṭāX ga mtshams bzhir snro sde snroX : rnams las byung ba'i lcags kyu sgor bzhir phuX phre phroX phri rnams las ri rlu byung pa'i rang rang gi phyag rgya —297—

rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ ye shes mkha' 'i gro ma sngon mo: zhes pa nas/ yongs su bskor ba'o'i bar lha sta gon dang bum bskyed kyi skabasabazhi no/ /oṃ badz+ra kā ya hūX nas rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur: gyi bar yang sgrub thabs bzhi no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ ā+oṃ snyu hwas bsangs/ oṃ shri: sogs kyisamachod/ sems can sgrol byed sogs yu kyis bstod/ dzaXhuX baX hoXlan bcu drug sogs kyis gnyis su med par bsre'o/ /'dir mdor bsags kyi cho ga 'gyur snga phyi gnyis la 'gyur khyad tsam ma yin par rgya dpe rang las don gtan nas mi 'dra bar shin tu khyad che bar snang bas/ spyir yid brtan dka' ba tsam yin na'ang / 'dir sbyar ba ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag yin pa las/ mdor bsags/ 'gos 'gyur dang phal cher mthun la/ de nyid bla med kyi dkyil chog phal cher dang yang mthun pa'i legs par yang mngon no/ /'gyur rnying las nam mkha'i lha 'bebs pa kho na las gzhan ma bshad de/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i cho ga 'ga' zhig dang 'dra rung tsam mo/de'i rjes su mchod pa'i bya ba ni mchod pa bzang rgyas su bshams/ bsdu na sgrub thabs su byung ba'i mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba tsam gyis kyang chog la/ cung zad rgyas par byed na/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i: sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa: sogs/ oṃ pra ca su ga rnye huX swāhā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar:sogs/ oṃ purmye mā le hūX swāhā/ oṃ tsan+dan ga bur sogs/ oṃ dh+ra pe shwa ri huX swāhā/ oṃ mar me 'od zer: sogs/ oṃ tik+ṣa ṇa dī pe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ kha do go dri dang : sogs/ oṃ ku ru ku ru mahā ba li huX swāhā/ oṃ pa ṭa ha dang jo sogs/ oṃ badz+ra shabha āXhuX/ de nas gos zung spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ te na huX te na huX te na te te huXrdo zhes pa'i skabs/ lte —lha98—

snying dpral ba rnams su pad skor byas la/ slar snying gar phab/ hu hu: zhes rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten cing sgeg pa'i tshul du bya/ de nyid thams cad kyi sngon tu 'gro ba'i/ pi wa tshul gyi bsgreng bas dang / badz+ra bī ni/ pi wa gi tshul dang / gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / badz+ra wa se/ gling bu'i tshul lo/ /badz+ra shang kha rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe chung rtse sbyar ba dung gi tshul khar bldan go/sil khrol tshul gyis bsdeb pa dang / badz+ra dza la ha ri/ mkhar rnga brdung ba'i tshul lo/ /phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa dang / /badz+ra brnyi dpral bar thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /rnga yab tshubasdo gyis g.yob pa dang / /badz+ra tsa ma ra/ lag pa g.yas brkyang ste bskyod pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang / badz+ra dh+wa dza lag gnyis steng du bsgreng ba/ bla bre'i tshul gyis bri ba dang / badz+ra bi ta na rdo rje khu tshur gyi 'dzub mo brkyang bas ngos gnyis su bla re bri ba'i tshul lo/ /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang / /badz+ra pa tang gi g.yon pa'i mdzub mo sgreng ba la/ g.yas pa'i gong mdzub bsgreng bas bskor ba dang / gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang / badz+ra tsha trang ga g.yon de dang 'dra ba las g.yas kyi lag mthil bkab ba'o/ /rnga zlum tshul/ gyis brdeb pa dang / badz+ra mu ra dzo/ rnga steng nas brdung ba'i tshul lo/ /rdza rnga'i tshul gyis brdung ba dang / badz+ra pa ṭa ha/ blo gnyis nasabardung ba'i tshul lo/ /gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag bskyod/ /badz+ra ṇi ta/ gar gyi tshul bya'o/bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang / badz+ra ha phye/ rgod pa'i tshul lo/ /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / badz+ra ba li gya brla g.yon pa'i steng du lag mthil kha sbub du bzhug pa dang / lag gnyis rna ba'i thad dkar phyar ro/ khro bo'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa dang / badz+ra u gra rdo rje bsdams pa sar bzhag pa'o/ /mda' 'phen tshul gyis drang ba bya/ badz+ra shā ra g.yon gyi phyogs su mda' 'phang ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /badz+ra —299—

skro l+la g.yas kyi rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul lo/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis nu ma 'jib badz+ra o sna/ lag gnyis nu ma 'tshir ba'i tshul lo/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyor/ badz+ra bhak+ta/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul lo/ /de ltar na phyag rgya nyi shu'i mchod pa'o/ /phyag rgya spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ oṃ huX swāhā/ sgeg mo dang : zhes pa nas/ mar me ma'i bar sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ de bzhin du rgyal srid sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas ltag par dar sne 'phyang ba dang / oṃ hūX swāhā/ zhes dar dpyangs dang / sngags de nyid dang / lag pa g.yon pas mgo'i gnas lngar ga stugs pas cod pan dang / g.yas 'dzub mo brkyang ba'i rna ba mgrin pa dpung pa 'khrig ma nu ma rkang pa sogs la reg ste sngags de nyid de rgyan cha'o/ /na bza' skon pa'i tshul dang sngags de nyid de dgos so/ /thal mo khong stong du mnyam par sbyar/ oṃ rdza swāhā 'bras bu sna tshogs so/ /lag mthil g.yas pa'i steng du g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar ba dang / oX ha ho hri hūX swāhā/ bdud rtsi lnga dang /rdo rje bsdams pa kha phye la/ ma rna shrīXhuX sgying dzaXsaXswāhā/tsho kyu lnga sogs bza' ba sna tshogs so/ /de nas dril bu sil zhing / tso( hūX huX hūX ghuX phruX huX huX huX/ skye( ghi bhe ghi hūX/ tseX( te ghu te ghu huX/ mdzes pa'i rdo rje: lko pa nas/ho ho ho swāhā/ spro na huX bde ba'i thugs gdan:sogs kyang brjod/ sems can sgrol byed: sogs kyi mthar/ bcom ldan yan lag dang 'brel bde ba chen po'i byang chub brnyes/ /sgeg dang khro dang bzhed pa'i de kho na nyid sku/ /in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs 'bar ba mdzes pa'i lus/ /dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma khyed zhabs kyi pad+ma ra 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rigs kyi chu las byung ba dag pa'i sku/ /spyan dkyusang rab gsal zhing snying rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ kha smoX ga dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams/ /dpal ldan —300—
