rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod spyos kyi pad+ma na 'dud/ /'od kyi rang bzhin nor bu'i rigs las byung ba'i dri med lus/ /phyag gi khu tshur gyis ni kha ṭāX ga dang pad+ma'i snod/ /drag po'i char gyi rgyun deng 'dra bas sa steng tshim mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+ma ra 'dud/ /chu las skyes bzhin de nyid dbugs kyi thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /phyag mtshan kha ṭāX gas mtshan pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dzin mdzad cing / /skye bo rmongs pa'i the tshom nges par sel mdzad pa'i/ /ro langs mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+ma ra 'dud/ /las kyi rjes su byed pa'i me yi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i lus/ kha ṭaX gas mtshan pad snod kyis ni phyag gnyis mtshan/ kha za gtum po'i tshogs kun phye mar rab tu rlog /gtum mo mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+ma ra 'dud/ /dpal chen seṅge lug pa mo ni mang po hūX sgrogs nga ro can/ /dpal ldan stag mo rtse spyang mo yang skye ba'i rim ni gdug pa 'joms/ /zhags pa lcags kyu sdigs 'dzub dag gis bsnams pa'i phyag khyed kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma ra bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rab mchog 'bar byed 'jigs byed ma/ /'phrog byed ma ni rtag tu mnyam med dngos grub mang la ster/ /gdul dka' 'dul bar mdzad pa'i sems kyi bdag nyid rgyal/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma ra phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/zhes pas bstod/ skye( sko khri sdo dharma huX a ā āX.aX swāhā/ zhes lan mang du brjod do/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dang po slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ brgya byin gdugs ni thogs pa dang / /tshangs pa bsil g.yab g.yo ba par byed/ /seṅge mdun gnas gsol ka pa/ /'phrog byed yon tan sgrog —301—

byed cing / /'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod do/ /de nas shar du song nas hu zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang / rol pa'i stabs kyis 'dug nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol lo/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras dkar me tog dkar po sogs kyi gtor ma dang / dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa me tog dkar po bkram pa mdun du bkod/ mchod pa rnams kyang bsham mo/ /de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya g.yob cing / oṃ ba tā li mahā ba tā li hu hu hu dza swāhā/ zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ rgyu ba dang ni cher rgyu ba/ /yi dwags rgyu ba nyi ma zla/ /dngos grub gdong dang rgyal ba dang / /rta yi rgyal dang zla ba'i rgyal/ /lha mo u ma gaṅgā dang / /gzugs mdzes dga' ma 'dus pa dang / /gza' rnams kun dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /karti ka dang dpal ldan ma/ /lha mo ri bong 'dzin pa nyid/ /lhag pa dang ni lhag pa che/ /lha yi rgyal po lha min rgyal/ /pu'i si dang spos chen mo/ /hū ho ā kar+ṣa ya u r+ṣa ya/ sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hu phaṭa dza grwa hā/ zhes spyan drangs/ phyag rgya snga ma las 'dzub mo gnyis 'dud de/ tso( bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sa ma ya a dhi pa ti dzu hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan bdun la sogs pasaphul ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ sems can thams cad nad med cing / /zhes smon lam btab yig brgya bzod gsol sogs bya/ mchod yon 'gro phyogs su bsgreng bas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma shar phyogs su btang ngo / /de nas byang phyogs su song ste spyi'i bya ba sngar dang 'dra ba las/ /gtor ma spos dang me tog dri zhim dang / /'o ma'i kham phor sogs dang / /slob dpon mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang / /maṇ+ḍal me tog ser po bkram mo/ /oṃ rgyu ba: sogs kyi dod du/ oṃ mtha' yas dang ni nor —302—

rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma wo po dang / /dung skyongs dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dgrag 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang gu li ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang /gzugs chen 'od bzang lto 'phye che/ /smig sgyu dang ni smig sgyu che/ /oṃ ā ru a ga smo mahā nā ga a dhī pa ti sarba sgyi rtu wa phuX phaṭa swāhā/ g.yon gyi mthe bo'i steng du g.yas kyi lag mthil bzhag ste/ sor mo rnams gdengs ka ltar byas/ tseX( hi li hi li mahā hi li phruX phre phuXswāhā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaX sogs pas mchod pa man chad sngar dang 'dra ba las/gtor ma byang phyogs su gtang ngo / /de bzhin du nub phyogs su yang bya ba spyi rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang / /gtor ma zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / /ske tshe'i snum mkhur gyis brgyan pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal me tog dkar po bkram pa'o/ /oṃ nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / /rgyal bzang dga' byed phur bu dang / /phur bu che dang pad+ma'i gtsug /dung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni/ /gar chen 'bigs par byed pa dang / /gcod par byed dang bgang bar byed/ /nor bu nor min shin tu nor/ gzugs bzang rol pa rol chen po/ /rgod dang 'tshe dang rnam par bskyod/ /dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes rnams/ /bde ba chen po'i bka' 'di yis/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo 'dir sbyon/ /huX ā pa da ra ā pa da ra/ /oX pa ta li pa ta li bhak+ṣa pa ya yo gi ni ma ta huX huX hūX swāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcings shing sbyar nasasnying khar bzhag skye( dha na a dhi pa ta ye pa ta ye phuX swāhā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ rjes —303—

gong dang 'dra ba las gtor ma nub phyogs su bto ngo / /de nas lho phyogs su tsan dan dmar po dang / khrag gi maṇ+ḍal gru gsum la/ me tog dmar po dang sngon po sogs bkram/ gtor ma sha khrag sgog gtsong 'khur ba snum 'khur sogs kyis brgyan/ khrag gi mchod yon dang bcas pa bsham/slob dpon gyis rkang pa lan gsum du spos pas gru gsum gyi rnam par byas/ de'i dbus su rdo rje'i rkang stabs sngon du 'gro bas/ g.yas brkyang gi gnas la/ skye rna shing gcig zhes pa nasathams cad 'dir byon cig oṃ ka ka ta sogs/ 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo 'dud te/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha hū/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa dza phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis phul/ rjes sngags dang 'dra ba las/ gtor ma lho phyogs su gtang ngo / /'di dag la spro zhing nus na/ shar gyi gtor ma btang nas/ shar dang de'i phyogs bral gyi bgegs rnams bskrad cing tshams rngam rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du 'ongs nas/ nye reg byas/ phyag btsal/ rdo rje'i glu blang / yang gong bzhin/ shis pa brjod nas byang phyogs su song nas gtor ma sbyin pa sogs thams cad la des rigs 'dre bar bya/ de tsam mi lcogs na/ shar phyogs kyi gtor ma btang nas byang du 'gro ba sogs/g.yon skor gyis song nas/ lto phyogs kyi gtor ma btang grub mtshams/ phyogs bzhi'i bgegs bskrad cing tsham rngam byas nas nang du 'ong / nye reg la sogs pa ma byas kyang chog la/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i dbang du byas pa la/ shar byang nub gsum gyi gtor chog bor kyang rung / ma rgyud spyi'i cho ga phyogs bzhi gtor chog zhor la shes pa'i dgos pa yod pas des byed do/ /de nas skabs 'dir 'grub na sbyin sreg dang / chu'i mchod sbyin rgyas pas mnyes par bya la/ long med pa'am mi nus na/ lag mthil g.yas par nyi ma'i zhes pa nas/ bsrubs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhi/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /klu sgrub ār+ya de ba dang / /kun tu bzang po su ma ti/ /dge ba'i go cha rnam rgyal —304—

dbang / /mar pa chos kyi rdo rje dang / /mdo sde thogs med grags pa dang /rī /rgya tsha ra mo kun dga' dang / /gzi brjid dang ni seṅge sgra/ /sngo tsha kun mkhyen dzam gling pa/ /a mo gha pa grags rin pa/ /nam mkha' tshul khrims mkhyen rab rdze/ /cho khri sdo ldan blo gros ye rdor ba/ /mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams mchod do/ /oṃ ā skyo/ lha bcu gsum bskyed sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul mgron spyi la 'bul ba yang gzhan gyi rigs 'gre/ de rjes sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i gtor chog tshogs dang bcas pa de tsam zhig nges pa bya ba las/ o sarba bi ma la: zhes pa nas/ de nyid la thim/ oṃ ā hū/ o a kā jo ༷ nas yo ga shu lho'i sngags brjod pa'i bar du bya'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/kun kyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces bden stobs brjod/ dkyil 'bor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'du/na la/ /zhes pa nas/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /de ltar rjes su brtse ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi tshul khrims 'di bgyi'o/ /zhes sdom pa bzung / ā kha ldi ra hū bis me tog dang mig dar btang / /sangs rgyas kun kyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /sbyor ba'i gdan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seṅge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid —305—

pa'i nyis brgya bskyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum/ mnyam pa nyid gsum gyi don dran bzhin pas/oṃ su bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmaXswa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ /oṃ badz+ra shudhaXsarba dharmaXbadz+ra shurnyo3haX/ oṃ yo ga shudhaXsarba dharmaXyo ga shurnyo3snya/ lkog brjod/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi las ni rnam pa bzhi/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/lus sdams las ni dam tshig srung / /zhes dag pa'i chos sand/ nga rgyal dang ni khro ba dang / /brlang dang tshig rtsub spang bar bya/ /sdig pa'i grogs po spang bya zhing / /srog gcod rku ba de bzhin no/ /longs spyod kun la ma chags shing / /bdag nyid nges par chog shes bya/ /gar dang rol mo lta bu yi/ /phyi yi gtsug lag chags mi bya/ /lcags kyu lnga sogs dam tshig rnams/ /brnyas shing spang bar mi bya'o/ /zhesadam tshig la bkod/ /oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki ni pū dza u pa shrī nā ya/ ut+pa naX ni r+ya ta yā mi oṃ ā tsār+ya pū dza u pa sbru nā ya ad+ma nāX ni rgyu ta yā mi/ oṃ sa ka la sa twa pa ri tra ṇa ut+pa nāX nir+sā ta yā mi/ de ltar shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir phyag 'tshal ba gsum po de tshar re re bya'o/ /rang nyid shar sgo thag nas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs khar huX/ sa ma ya stuX/ sa ma ya hoX a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /gsung gi rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs/ /huX ni nyon mongs bsregs pa ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs/ /oṃ ni ye shes 'gugs pa ste/ /sku yi rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs/ /ces brjod/ yid 'ong khyod ni su zhig yin/ /zhes dris pa la/ sdug gu skal chen bdag lags so/ /oṃ gi li ki li ma li lhu ta/ badz+ra tsa li ta/ yuX yuX yuX swāhā/ zhes yol ba'i nang du gzhug go deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs —306—

kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /dung gi chu la/ha ho khyi/ lan gsum sngags pa khar 'thungs la/ de ring ye shes 'di shes pas/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar byos/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub pas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /oṃ du rga ti ā ha ra ya swāhā/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na yang ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ /dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pas dam la ba theg de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ bdag nyid ye shes dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog dkar mo phyag gnyis pa kha ṭa ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ snying chu shing gi me tog kha bye ba lta bu'i dbus su/ rlud gi sa bon yu yig phyogs bzhir yu yig bzhis bskor ba/ dbus kyi yu yig gi steng du hū sngon po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yang yu las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi rkang 'og gi slu pa drag —307—

tu g.yos pas bar snang la ye re re bteg de'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i rlud gi sa bon lnga las rlung g.yos/ hu yig bskul bas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer sna lnga mchog tu 'bar bas/ rang lus gang / gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes dbang phyug mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ skye( a kha la le hu a 'gyur rnying gi dpe 'ga' zhig las/ glu( le le le hu a/ zhes pa'ang yod ces pa dang / gong du bshad pa'i dbab pa'i sngags de dag las ci ltar rigs par brjod cing / slob ma dbang bskur gyi don du de tsam gyis ma phebs na/ slob ma seṅge mo'i gzugs su gsal pa'am/ snying gar rdo rje'i rtse mor hu/ mtha' rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba'i yu yig gis bskor ba/ gzhan sngar bzhin las/ hū zhes ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags bsnyen pa gang song des sngags pa'i me tog dang chus bsnun/ oṃ ra ma ra ma ho ho ho a a a phaṭa/ ces zlos shing rol mo dang 4sa pas/ gong du spund pa'i bdug spos kyis bdug dam rdzas lce la bzhag pa/ nga yo ga mahā kro dha hū hu hu swāhā/ zhes pa brtan byed kyi sngags su bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/ /slar yang / oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya/ pra ti ba ti ta hu hu hu ho ho ho swāhā/ zhes pa ni ye shes pa gshegs pa'i sngags so/ /nam mkha'i kha dog brtag na skabs 'dir yin yang / rang gzhung nas gsal bar ma bshad pas med kyang chog go /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hu hohoho grwa hā/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra gro sna ti twa i ma sa twa mahā ba la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang / /rdo rje'i mig ni sna—308—

bla na med/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūX a swāhā/ gdong g.yogs dkrol/ da ni dad pa'i shugasakyi su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes lta bar bskul/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal pra be sho3haX/ oṃ yo ga maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal da: to3haX/ oṃ gu phya maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣi ka to3haX/ sa ma ya ho sa ma ya ho/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar 'gyur/ cesabarjod/ slob ma dbang bskur la skabs 'dir lha ngo bstan no/ /ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas rnams su reg cing spyi bor khyuX nas/ dzhai gyi bar/ gnas brgyad du bzung bar bya/de rnams kyi 'jug pa'i cho ga yin cing / dkyil yu chog dngos bstan dang 'dra min cung zad yod pa ni/ dkyil chog rgyud rgyas pa la brten pa yin no zhes 'dod la dkyil 'khor 'di bsdus rgyud kyi yin cing / gsang gdan dang por 'jug pa'i cho ga gsal bar bstan pa nyid dbang btsan par byas te bshad pa yin la/ bla ma gong ma ches mkhas pa 'ga' zhig kyang 'di ltar ba ched do/ /de nas dngos bzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ring bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor mchog rab ste/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor rgyal po bskyed/ /bdag gis rnam shes 'pho ba shes/ /'di ni slob ma'i don de nyid/ /rgyal po nyid kyis dbang bskur stsol/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs bcas pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i go 'phangs las/ /phyir mi ldog par bdag 'gyur ba'i/ /rig pa gang yin deng bdag stsole// tsho( sgru sogs kyis bsang chus bsangs shing yungs dkar gtor/ /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub —309—

sems dpa' lha chen po rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang bcas pas shis pa brjod par bsam te/ skye( phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /sogs dang rol mo'i sgra bya/ chu dbang gi gong skabs 'dir/ /slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus/ /mar rngog sogs gong ma rnams ni gtor ma'i dbang bskur bar bzhed do/ /de yang rgyud las/ gnyis med gtor sbyin dbang bskur ba/de yi chos ni bshad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don du bzhed la/ 'grel pa nas gtor ma gtong ba sngon du 'gro bas/rdo rje'i dbang sogs bskur ba la 'chad do/ /des na gtor dbang ni/ rgyud tshig de'i don la zhugs pa dka' yang / byin brlab chen po dang ldan pa dang / man ngag yin pa'i phyir/byas na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur la/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i nyes pa med do/ /rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du mchod pa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/de'i steng du rang nyid mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul te/ chu dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ring 'khor ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /byang chub chen por dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ āXklu phe phaṭa huX swāhā/ ar+ghaX nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod chu'i dbang bskur bas/ kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur te/ me long ye shes mngon du byas so/ /bdag nyid rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po/ rin po che dang / dril bu nas brgyan par gyur/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ hūX traX hri a rnams las byung ba'i/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i dbu brgyan du gyur/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam pa can/ dkyil 'khor gyi thugs —310—

ka nas sprul te/ cod pan gyi dbang bskur thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen cod pan dam pa ni/ /dar dpyangs ldan pas dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ hu u grwa hā/ ar+gha sogs kyis mchod/cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur te/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du bya/ cod pan dngos su med na phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/rdo rje sems dpa' las gung mo rtse mo ltar brkyang / 'dzub mo rin po che'i dbyibs ltar byas pa/ rin po che'i phyag rgya mgo bor gtugs/ spros pa la dga' na gnyis kar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /de nas lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya ste hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'dra bas/ tsho( badz+ra kā ya hu a swāhā/ che kha/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad du reg pas/ yi ge brgyad po mthu dang ldan par byas par bsam mo/ /bdag nyid 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ /pad+ma dang : nas brgyan par gyur/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul/ dbang rdzas rdo rjes dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkha' yi/ /dbang ni khyod la ngas dbang bskur/ /oṃ shri yo gi ba ri sta a bhi khiñtsa ma tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya stu/rdo rje bzung de nyid gsor la snying gar gto de/thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /sems nyid rig stong gnyis su med pa ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/rdo rje rnal 'byor nam mkha'i ngo bor gnas pa'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis de nyid dran par bya ste/ lte ba na rdo rje sems dpa'/ steng gi 'dab ma brgyad ni byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ rwa lnga ni rgyal ba rigs lnga 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad ni —311—

lha mo brgyad/ rwa lnga ni mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur pas/ yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur nas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang nas rgyan par gyur/ bla ma don grub pa'i rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul te dril bu'i dbang bskur bar gyur/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /byang chub ma ce go tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /badz+ra / rga a/dril bu bzung ci rigs par dkrol la/ dku g.yon par bsten/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dgango bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yi/ /dngos po mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /ngag grag stong gnyis su med pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi ngo bor gnas pa'o/ /dril bu ye shes dbang phyug ma'i ngo bor gnas pa'i bum pa dang zhal gyi gnas su shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma/ steng gi 'dab ma zhes pa: nas/ lha mo brgyad kyi bdag nyid du gyur/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod rdo rje dril bu 'byud rgya dang / g.yon du 'gying ba'i tshul byas la/ bdag nyid ye shes dbang phyug ma la rnal 'byor nam mkha'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpas 'khyud par gyur/ 'dir 'byud tshul go bzlog pas bsgoms kyang wo ngo / /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rnal 'byor gyis/ /dpa' bo'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oX badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi khiñtsa maX/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ zhes brjod de phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ba yin la/dril bu dang de gnyis bsdoms pa ni bdag po'i dbang ste/ bdag po'i dbang thob pas sgo lnga'i rnam —312—

par shes pa gnas gyur te/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes mngon du byas/ me tog 'thor zhing / bco ( ma ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la mgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ rang gi mgrin par zla ba la a/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ā li kā li'i phreng ba byung ste/ mgrin pa'i a yig la thim/ o a ā i sī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i tse( 6( a a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa swāhā/ lan gsum me tog spyi bor bzhag te/bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dbang ngo / /bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang jonas brgyan par gyur/ bla ma rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas sprul/ ming gi dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdor dril spyi bor bzung nas/ he shrī yo gā ba ri stu/ a bhi 'a ṣañtsa ma nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ sngags kyi gsang mtshan rnying pa yid la dran par bya zhing / slob ma gsar pa la dbang bskur ba yin na/ skyes pa la rnal 'byor nam mkha' dang / bud med la ye shes dbang phyug mar gdags te/ /dpal rnal 'byo ra nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /dpal ye shes dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs ma'o/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ar+gha sogs kyis mchod/ ming gi dbang bskur bas gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag ste/ chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa mngon du gyur/ oṃ ha ho hri/ zhes pas mchod pa rnams byin gyis bas/ o shri swāhā: nas gung sruhwa'i bar lan bzhis/ phyogs bzhi'i sangs rgyas 'khore bcas la mchod par mos shing / bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes re re'i mthar yang gsol ba gdab bo/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i dus ni dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bzhir —313—

gom pa brgyad brgyad dor nas/ slob dpon gyi rjes su zlos pa'i tshul gyis/ mchod pa dang gsol gdab de rnams byed pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes su gnang ngo / /bar 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang logs su bskur ba'i lugs yod de/ de'i lugs ltar na spyi dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang gong du dam tshig gsum sbyin pa spangs pas so/ /de ltar mod kyi mdor bsags pa la sogs pa'i lugs 'di la ni/bum dbang spyi la rdo rje slob dpon du 'jog pa'i lugs yin pas/ 'di logs su mi dgos so/ /des na de'i rjes su mtha' brten dang po rdo rje brtul zhugs ni/rdo rje'i de kho na nyid yid la dran tsam byas te/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dugakhyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa mā ya/ la e ṣa twa dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hu hu hu ha ha ha ho/ /de nas gnyis pa rjes gnang ni/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs kun/ /ces pa la sogs pa sgeg sogs brgyad kyi tshigs cad brjod pa ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sogs dang 'dra'o/ /mdor bsags dang / nag po spyod pa'i gzhung gi dpe phal cher na/ lha mo drug las med pa la/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'phang / /zhes pas sgeg phreng me tog ma gsum gcig tu bsdoms so zhes 'ga' zhig 'chad kyang / rgya dpe ma dag pa'i skyon yin par mngon no/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /glu rna badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri/ ces mig thur dang / cho se rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni —314—

mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /ces me long dang / /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /go 'bor lo dang / khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ zhes dung gto par bya'o/ /de nasagasum pa lung bstan pa ni/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sirnyi sa ma ya bharnya wa snya zhes brjod/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba'i skur gyur/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/lag pa dag gis yang dag 'byud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rang gi thugs kar sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo/ oṃ hu a swāhā/zhes pa'i yi ge sdig pa'i gnyen po dpa' bo 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang rang gi sngags kyi phreng ba byung / snying ga'i yig 'bru lnga la thim pas/rgyud byin gyis brlab shing / ye shes brtan par gyur/ lha bcu gsum gyi sngags lan gsum gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor khri zhes sogs yi ge brgyad/ bkod de bsrung ba'o/ /de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du slob dpon gyi dbang bskur pa thob pas/ye shes bskyed pa'i rim par bsgom pa/ rnam shes las tshogs dang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub pa la dbang ba yin no/ /'dir bla ma gong ma rngog rnams ni/ lung ston 315—

yan chad la slob dpon gyi dbang zhes gsung la/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/slob ma me tog phog pa'i lhar bskyed/ chu dbang sngon du 'gro bas/ rig pa gtad pa la sngags kyi dbang bskur ba dang / gtso mo'am lha tshogs rnams kyi dam tshig phyag rgya/ slob dpon gyi rjes su zlos pa'i tshul gyi slob ma rnams phyag rgya 'char gzhug pa ni/ phyag rgya'i dbang ste/ 'di la slob ma'i dbang bskur zhes gsung ngo / /tshul 'di slob dpon gyi ni dbang bskur nas/ /rnam shes ye shes brtan par bya/ /zhesadakyil chog las gsungs pa'i rnam shes ye shes zhes pa'i don du dgongs par snang la/ de'i don gyi phyogs gcig la zhugs pa'ang yin mod kyi/ nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas 'dir ma bris so/ /yang gzhung las/ sbyor ba yi ni dbang bskur nas/ /gsang ba thams cad mngon par brjod/ /ces pa la thabs kyi dbang bskur gsang dbang dang / shes rab kyi dbang bskur gsum pa ste/ de gnyis bsdoms pa ni sbyor ba'i dbang ngo / /dbang gong ma 'di gnyis la bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'khor 'char ba dang / ye shes dbab pa dang me tog dor ba la sogs pa bzhed do/ /de dag 'grub na'ang byin rlabs che ba'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ lag len bsdu ba'i tshe ma 'grub kyang mi 'gal te/ de 'dra de 'di'i sgos kyi khyad chos kyang ma yin la/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung phal cher las kyang mi 'byung bas so/ /'dir ni nyung ngu la mos pa dag la cho ga zor yang bar brjod par bya ste/ /kun rtog thams cad rnams spangs pas/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod mthu yis/ /de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal/ /rdo rje dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyis/ /bka' drin de ring bdag la gsol/ /bcom ldan khyod zhabs pad+ma ni/ /spangs nas gzhan na skyabs ma —316—

mchis/ /de bas 'khor ba spang ba'i phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la bka' drin ma ljadi/ /ces lan gsum/ ā kha ldir hu gis mig dar bcings/ tso( u hā gis bdud rtsi gtor/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug dbyer ma mchis pa de nyid/rnal 'byor nam mkha'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ /yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyi/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā hu/ 'di ni de nyid bla na med/ /gnyis med ye shes brjod mi nus/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /dam pa'i bde ba yang dag myang / /a ho mahā su kha/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bsal/ de ltar na lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob pas/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i rnal 'byor rang lus thabs ldan gyi gsang ba rnams bsgom pa la dbang ngo / khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/dam tshig 'di ni bla na med/ /bzang po khyod kyis skyang bar bya/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrag go/de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ /sangs rgyas kun la gsang ba che/ /ji ltar dpal ldan thugs rdo rjes/ /rdo rje chos ni bstan pa ltar/ /—317—

mgon pos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ oṃ ā hu/ bdud rtsi gtor/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad/ gnyis med sbyor ba de nyid ni/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /so sor de nyid kyis bzung ba/ /rdo rje de nyid bdag nyid de/ /dril bu chos kyi gzungs ma'o/phyag rgya kha sbyor tshul gyis ni/ /de la thabs ni thim par 'gyur/ /thabs rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rig ma ye shes dbang phyug mar gyur/ yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis nas byang chub kyi sems 'ongs pa/ thabs shes kyi sna rtser byon pa dang rang gnas su gshegs pa'i rim pas/ lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi dga' ba'i rim pa rdzogs te lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas/ oṃ u ཿ gis gdong g.yogs bsal/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi gsang ba zab mo sgom pa la dbang ngo / /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag bu khyod ni ma yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrags/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ don dam smra ba'i seṅge: sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rtag par chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi/ /go 'phang mi g.yo rgyun du gnas/ /rtag tu phra phyir gos med pas/ /ye shes la ni rnam shes thim/ /rnam shes ye shes nyid gyur na/ /byang chub rim pa mthong bar gyur/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa —318—

rtog pa'i dri mas ma gos shing / rtag pa dang bral ba'i ye shes de nyid rang bzhin bde ba chen po ste/ bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ mchog gi go 'phang so sor rang gi rig pa mngon du byas/ de yang dkyil chog las gsang chen de dag thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur ba ni go 'phang mchog /ces pas dbang bzhi pa bstan no/ /de'i rjes su dam tshig gam spyod pa la gdams pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /de yi dngos po'i rang bzhin nyid/ /dngos po rang bzhin med pa sa /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim pa bstan/ /bzod pa'i chos ni sngon 'gro bas/ /sems can rnams kyi gzir mi bya/tshig rtsub kyal pa mi smra zhing / /sems can rnams ni sun mi dbyu/nga / /rbeb/ khrims sdom pa bsrung bya zhing / /skye bo rnams la brtse mi bya/ /bdag nyid shi bar gyur kyang bla/ /sems can srog gcod de lta min/ /rab 'bar me dang mtshungs pas na/ /gzhan gyi nor la reg mi bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus bsrung zhing / /phan tshun dbye ba'i las mi bya/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de la brdzun ni yod ma yin/ /spyod pa bag yod bcas pa dang / /bza' dang longs spyod bag yod bya/ /dga' bar rol pa bag yod cing / /gtor sogs cho ga'ang bag yod la/ /rnal 'byor ba ni 'grub 'dod pas/ /sems can bsten na 'gru/ba par 'gyur/ /gang zhig thams cad shes pa yi/ /slob ma sems dga'i las rnams bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed nas su/ /thams cad mnyam nyid lta bar bya/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i spyod pa bya/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor bsam gtan gus/bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /dkyil 'khor gtor ma la sogs pa/ /—319—

sems can don gyi tshul khrims rnams/ /bu yi srog bzhin bskyang bar bya/ /cesaso/ /de nas gtso bos ji ltar: sogs dang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te/ sogs dang / gzhan yang smon lam mang du gdab par bya'o/ /slar yang sbyin bsreg la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes par bya ste/ bdag nyid 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bya ba ni/ bdag 'jug nyid kyisarigs 'gre zhing / khyad par phra mo yod pa rnams kyang / zhor byung la bstan zin te/ lag len ni mthong brgyud pa las shes par bya'o/ /de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa kha gsos ba'am/ gsar —bar bshams te sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis brlab nas/ skye( pra titsā a jiX hūX swāhā/ skye( su ga rnye sogs sngags tsam maX/ gong du bstan pa ltar tshigs bcad dang bcas pas kyang mchod/ nang mchod phul/ bstod thung gis bstod/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor dbyer med par mos nas/ huX hūX huX mgon khyod yongs su thar pa'ang khyod/ /chos ston pa'ang khyod yin te/ /snying rje'i rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs bzang mthar phyin pa'ang khyod/ /kye khyod srid pa las sgrol khyod/ /rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thar pa rdo rje khyod nyid do/ /de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyis gsungs par mos la/ oṃ ra ma ra ma ho/ hi hi hi huX ho a/ oṃ ra ma ra ma ho huX huX huX ho he a/ oX ra ma ra ma phruX phruX hūX/ phruX phroX a oṃ ra ma ra ma ho/ ghu tsho tsho/ gh+ra sne/ ā swāhā/ ces glur blangs ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgralajosogs smon lam btab de nas slob ma'am yon bdag la dung chos kyi chu 'thor zhing / shis pa brjod pa ni/ de ring khyod ni 'khor byā yi/ /rgya mtsho las ni rab brgal zhing / /rdo rje las byung rdo rje sems/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang dbang bskur bas/ /myur du sems can thams cad kyi/ /don byed pa yi sems dang ldan/ /zhes brjod/ slob ma —320—

————rdedabang bskur dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs sgrub mchod tsam la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mos gsungs par bas ma sa shing / dung gi chu rang la gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs dang / /gtso bo: sogs kyis gzod par gsol/ oṃ na ma te hū/ na ma me hu na mo na ma hu snyu hwas phyag bya/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying ga dang g.yas pas khu tshur sa la bzhag ste/ tse( khyo rwad kyis sems can sogs/ tse( ga smo ga smo sogs sngags tshan gnyis kyis mgron rnar/sa gshegs su gsol ba yin/ sgrub mchod zhag sprel la/ nyi ma snga ma rnams su gtor mgron kho na gshegs su gsol nas/ de'i rjes su rten dang rdul tshon gyi lha la brtan bzhugs bya la/nyi ma rting ma la/ o khyod kyis sogs kyis gsol gdab mgron dang dkyil 'khor pa la lhan cig tu byas nas/ sngags gnyis kyis mgron rnams gshe/gas/ tse( 65sma tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis dkyil 'khor ba rang gi lus la bsdu'o/ /tse( gi li gi li di ni hu dza swāhā/ zhes rdul tshon phyags te/bum par blug nas spyan 'dren/ de'i cho ga ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /ltag gtor skyel ba'i sngar skabs 'dir zugad kyang / sngags sngon du grub na 'dir mi dgos la/ spyir dkyil snyen ra bris pa'i stsol du/slar yang spyin bsreg dang tshogs 'khor bya bar bshad cing / ras bris kyi phyogs la ni zhag sbrel gyi nyi ma snga ma rnams sngar bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ rten dang dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs lhan cig byas pas chog go /gang ltar yang mthar/ smon lam dang / bkra shis rgya cher bya/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer rnon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' mchog gi dbang phyug gar byed rol/ /hū hū hū zhes glu blang ngo / /de ltar na 'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snying po mdor bsags la gtso bor brten pa cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa la tshig zor yang bar sbyar ba yin pas/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la yang 321 spo

cho ga 'di nyid 'don pa spos pas phal cher 'grub la/ bstod pa dang / lha ngo bstan pa'i tshigasabacad rgyas pa kha 'gengs dgos pa yin no/ /yang snying po mdor bsags la ma brten par/ bsdusapa'i rgyud 'di las ji tsam gsungs pa rnams gzhir bzhag nas/ lhag ma rnams gsang ba spyi'i cho ga nas kha bkang na zor yang zhing legs pa zhig kyang 'byung mod kyi/ re zhig 'dir ma bris so/ /mar rngog gong ma'i lugs kyis kyang / dgyes rdor sogs dang mthun rung du sbyar ba'i yi ge du ma snang ba yang nges par gyis shig zab yangs rgyud ni nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /dregs ldan blo mig khab kyi bu gar lta/ /sngon dge gang yin blo gros mthur smin pas/ /de nyid gcig las chos kun 'jal 'di mtshar/ /rgya bod gzhung mang dag las legs bshad kyi/ /snying po bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di/ /yi ger bkod pa'i dge ba gang yin de/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun la rgyas par bsngo/ /zhes dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi thig le zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ shu bha ma stu/ gcig zhus dag/ //—322—

ces bya ba bzhugs/na mo bha ga ba ti dz+nyā ne shwa sdu/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i 'khrid yig ye shes sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang 'di bde chen 'dab brgya kha bye bas/ /rab tu 'od gsal ze'u 'bru mngon gyur ba/ /bla med bla ma ye shes dbang phyug mar/ /dngos kun lhan cig spyi bo'i gtsug gis mchod/ /dam pa snga mas mdzad mod kyang / /thor bur gnas shing gsal min pas/ lten tu zab cing gsang ba'i lam/ /'khrugs med 'dus shing gsal bar 'bri/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las 'byung ba rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rgyud kyi dngos bstan las kyang gsal mod/ grub thob lo paṇa brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba nyid gtso bor byas te bshad par bya'o/ /de la bdag gi gdan gsum pa'i zhabs kyi phyogs dang / bzhi pa'i stod kyi cha nas gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa gsungs/ gnas skabs gzhan mang po nas rlud gi rdzogs rim kyang ci rigs par bshad/ sbyor gdan bzhi pa nas g.yin lus phyag rgya'i skor rnams gsungs/sang gdan rab byed gnyis pa nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bstan cing bskyed rim phra thig kyang ste nor bu'i thig le dang / smin mtshams dang snying ga ste thig le'i man ngag dang / spyi 'gro sgo dgag pa dang / rdzogs rim ba nu —323—

dngos dang / ba lang rmig pa yi ge bcu gsum pa dang / yi ge gnyis pa dang / yi ge gcig pa dang gzhan sems shes par byed pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi sbyin sreg rnams gsungs so/ /rab byed gsum pa nas sgong skyes kyi man ngag dang / chu shing me tog yi ge bcu gsum pa dang / gong du 'pho ba dang / grong du 'jug pa dang de'i yan lag rnams so/ /rab byed bzhi pa las chu shing snye ma yi ge dgu pa dang / mchod rten bum pa'i yan lag rlung bcing ba dang / mchod rten gyi man ngag dang / mchod rten bum pa dngos yi ge dgu pa dang / snyu ma gsum gyi rnal 'byor rnams su gsungs so/ /de dag ni rtsa rgyud la brten tshul yin la/ bshad rgyud sbyor ba'i rab byed nas/ gsang ba'i spyin sreg dang chu shing me tog sogs rtsa rgyud dang 'dra min tsam rnam grangs du ma gsungs shing / gzhan yang phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid sogs mang du gsungs so/ /bshad rgyud man+t+ra ang sha nas o yig gi man ngag dang / gtum mo mda' 'phen dang / chu shing me tog gi rnam grangs gzhan dang brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa sogs gsungs so/ /de dag ni 'brel ba dang bla ma'i man ngag gi bzhed pas gsal bar bkral pa dang / rgyud kyi tshig don sgra ji bzhin pa las 'byung tshul rnams yin la/ spyi rgyud kyi dgongs don rdzogs rim mtha' dag su zhig gis rtogs par nus/ de lta mod kyi chos skor 'di la phyogs 'dir 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas na/ shing gcig gi bka' 'grel zhes bya ba ār+ya de bas mdzad pa der/ gnas brgyad nang don la sbyar ba'i bshad pa tsam yod/ g.yin yang dze tā —324—

ri'i de nyid bzhi pa sogs nas/ rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag thor bu ci rigs pa yod kyang / rim pa lnga pa dang spyod bsdus dang / dpyid kyi thig le lta bu rgyud don gyi 'gangs 'chun thub pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rgya gzhung byings che ba med pas/rdzogs rim rgyas pa ni rgyud kho na'i steng nas rtogs dgos shing / dmigs pa rnams phal cher yang rgyud kyi tshig don nyid las gsal bar 'byung ba'i phyir/lhag par yid ches pa'i gnas kyang yin pas/ rgyud kyi gnas skabs gang dang gang nas rdzogs rim ji ltar 'byung ba de go sla ba'i phyir/ dang po nyid du khungs smos pa khrin no/ /da ni de dag lag tu blang ba'i rim pa la/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la yang spyi dang khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po spyi'i sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i bsags sbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsum yin te gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro ni/ khro bo dang phyag mtshan gyi srung 'khor rlung dang sbyar ba dang / tshogs bsag bla ma'i rnal 'byor rlung dang sbyar ba gnyis yin te/ de dag kyang dpal rim pa bzhi pa'i 'khrid yig dang / dgyes rdor gyi man ngag bsre 'pho las 'byung ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim gyi lha la bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa'i man ngag dang / rdzogs rim zab mo ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di las ba'i nu ma'i man ngag ces bya ba 'byung ste/ gsang gdan gyi rab byed gnyis pa las/ de'i dbus su shes bya ba/ rnam —325—

par shes pa mkha' bzhin brtag /ces pa'i dbus kyi don/ 'khor lo bzhi/smin mtshams/ ltag pa nor bu ste bdun las 'dir rdo rje nor bu'o/ /de la'ang dmigs pa'i sgo nas rnam pa 'dra ba cig kyang skabs thob kyi sgrub pa po'i so so'i dus skabs kyi khyad par las/ bskyed rdzogs so sor 'gyur ba'i skabs cig yod pas/ 'dir bskyed rim du 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas te/ thun gyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ srung 'khor mchod gtor bskyed rim rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig bsgoms pa'i mthar/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes dbang phyug ma thugs rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gsang rtsa phrad mtshams kyi pad+ma'i sna rtser hūṃX las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam gyi nye bar thig le dkar po shin tu phra ba yod pa la sems bstad de mnyam par 'jogayang na rang nyid rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'am rdo rje sems dpar gsal btab ste/yum ye shes dbang phyug ma'am/ rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gsang rtsa phrad mtshams kyi rdo rje nor bu'i nang du/ phyag mtshan dang bcas pa'i thig le snga ma bzhin du bsgom/ skabs 'dir ye shes dbang phyug ma zhal gsum phyag drug sgom par ma nus na/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dkar mo kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa 'dzin par sgoms kyang rung ngo / /dmigs pa de la sems bstad nas rlung sbyor 'di ltar bsgom ste/ lus gnad bcos/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal/steng rlung dal bas rngubs te gsang bar gnon pa ci nus su bzung / yang dal bus btang ba la bslab/ de lta bu zla ba gzhig la sogs pa dmigs pa gsal mi gsal dang brtson 'grus che chung gi bye brag gis ji ltar rigs par bslab/—326—

rlung cung zad zin pa'i rtags bde sdug gi nyams gang rung zhig 'byung / de'i tshe rkang pa dkrug pa dang / rgyu zhabs kyi rgyab mdun dal bus brdung zhing mnye ba sogs byas nas/ dmigs pa dang rlung sbyor snga ma ltar gyi ngang nas/ pho ba ldir/lto ba 'gyur bya zhing / thur sel dbus nas cung zad yar 'then pa re byed de/rtag tu mi dgos rlung thengs gnyis gsum re la de 'dra lan re tsam bya/ steng 'og gi rlung thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas gsang ba'i sna rtse'i rdo rje thig le dang bcas pa la thim par bsam/ yang na yum gyi bha ga'i nang gi rtsa sna g.yas pa la hu nag po/ g.yon pa la hū dmar po/ nag po las rlung g.yon dmar po las me sbar/ srubs pas me lce cha gnyis su gyur te/ yab yum gyi rtsa sna dbus ma gnyis so so nas song / yab kyi byang chub kyi sems dkar po zhu zhing rtsa sgor byon/ /yum gyi dmar po'ang zhu ste rtsa sgor byon/ thig le dkar dmar kha sbyor du 'dug pa la sems bstad do/ /'di la gong ma rnams gsang ba'i ba lang rmig pa zer te 'on kyang rgyas bsdus ma gtogs gong ma dang 'dra bas ba nur 'thad do/ /'di las bde stong gi nyams khyad par can skye zhing / des lha sku la bogs 'don pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de la goms nas thig le'i rnal 'byor/ steng gi sna rtse la bslab ste gnas bdun las smin mtshams su'o/ /'di la sgo dgu dgag par yang man ngag las bshad/ bskyed rim gyi skabs 'dir ma byas kyang chogasngon 'gro bskyed rim snga ma bzhin bsgoms la/ rang gi smin phrag gi thad dpral ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan/ gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa/ dung dam rus pa las grub pa 'dra ba cig sgom gsung /—327—

chos 'byung de che na sor bzhi tsam/ chung na mthe bong tsam bsgom/ de'i bar ji ltar bde ba yin/ chos 'byung gi kha mtshams kyi nang du g.yas g.yon la ma reg tsam du thig le dkar po'i steng du hu dkar po bsgom ste/ rlud phyir dal bus btang phyir cung zad bzung bas rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas yar song ba/chos 'byung nang gi thig le la phog pas thig le drag tu 'khor/ chos 'byung dang hu mi 'khor bar bsam/ yang rlung nang du dal bus rngubs shing cung zad bzung ba'i skabs kyang rlung rnams sna sgo nas yar song ste/ chos 'byung gi thig le la phog pa sogs gong bzhin sgom/ bde nyams yid la byed cing sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/thun gyi mjug tu hū yig thig le dang bcas pa bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam pas mer gyis zhu/ rlan dang drod kyi rang bzhin can des chos 'byung gang ba la sems bstad de/ rlung gi rtsol ba sogs mi bya bar/ shes pa khong lhod kyis klod nas bzhag go /sngar hū yig la rig pa bsgrims pas dub pa de 'dir ngal gso ba yin/ yang na thig le hu dang bcas pa'i don du thig le'i rang bzhin gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rkyang pa bsgoms kyang chog go /dmigs pa 'dis kyang lha sku la bde bas rgyas thebs shing / bde ba la stong pa'i rgyas 'debs/ des kyang lha sku la bogs thon pa sogs 'byung ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di bskyed rim gyi cha lag yin yang ba'i nu ma ces pa'i brdas/ gsang ba'i sna rtse dang / spyi bo'am smin mtshams kyi sna rtse rnams ston pa yin pas/ 'di gnyis kar ba nu'i man ngag tu bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim zab mo nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ rgyud 'dir —328—

rdzogs rim gang sgoms kyang sngon du gtong dgos pa'i chos gnyis yod pas de'i dbang du byas nas rdzogs rim kun gyi sngon 'gro dang rdzogs rim dngos so/ /dang po la sgo dgu dgag pa dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ gsang gdan gnyis pa nas/ kha dog ser bo 'od 'bar ba'i ces pa nas/ lus la thams cad 'bar ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ rang nyid ye shes dbang phyug ma'am rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu gar khri yig ser bo 'od zer 'phro ba/ mgo bo thur bstan/ 'od zer gyis spyi gtsug gi sgo bkag par bsams la/ bum can 'jam rlud sgom pa zhag bdun la sogs pa bya/ de bzhin du smin mtshams su hu nag po mgo nang bstan/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ste zhag bdun sogs bsgom/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ mig gnyis su yang hu nag po/ rna ba gnyis dang sna'i bu ga gnyis la yu dmar po/ lce chung du su dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ chu lam du su dkar po/ bshang lam du khri ser po/lce chung gi su yig ma gtogs de rnams mgo bo nang du bstan pa'o/ /mgrin par snro g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ phrag dpung gi mtshams su dzhai g.yas (dkar g.yon nag pa/ snying gar snro g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ lte mebar lju g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ yi ge brtsegs ma de rnams mgo bo gyen bstan du bya/ de dag re re bzhin 'jam rlung bcas pa zhag bdun bdun tsam re bsgoms pas/ zla ba phyed dang bzhi tsam du 'gyur zhing / de nas dmigs pa gsal rung / mi gsal rung spyi bo nas bshang lam gyi bar du yas rim dang /—329—

bshang lam nas spyi bo'i bar mas rim gyis yi ge rnams gsal btab nas/dmigs pa gsal na cig car snang ba la yun ring du bsgom/ mi gsal na bar der mos sgom yud tsam re bya zhing / yas mas kyi rim pas gsal 'debs pa nyid gtso bor bsgom/ rlung yang bum pa can sbyor ba bzhi ldan nyid la nan tan du bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje bzlas pa ni/ rab byed gnyis par/ sa bon 'di ni bzlas par bya/ /zhes dang / bzlas dang bsam gtan rnal 'byor las/ /ces dang / bzhi pa las/ gal te bzlas 'dod rnal 'byor pas/ snying gi sa bon spangs na'o/ /zhes dang / sgra med ngag ni spangs nas su/ /yid kyi bzlas dang ldan par bya/ /ces sogs gsungs te/ lus gnad legs par bcos/ sngar bskyed rim gyi bde ba'i rgyas 'debs gnyis sam/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa cung zad goms pa'i skabs yin na/ bde bas dngos su rgyas 'debs/ gzhan du na mos pa tsam bya/ de yang rlud nang du 'jug pa na hu zhes dran cing / rang nyid lha'i skur gsal ba de nyid bde bar mos/ gnas pa na u zhes dran cing / bdag gzhan gnyis ka bde bar mos/ phyir 'gro ba na oṃ zhes dran cing snang ba thams cad bde bar mos/ 'di 'og nas 'byung pa'i rdzogs rim kun kyi sngon 'gro'i tshul du yang sbyor zhing / rdzogs rim de dang de la bde nyam skyes pa'i bogs 'don du yang sbyor la/ bskyed rim gyi phra thig gnyis pa'i bogs 'don du yang byed mod kyi/ sgo dgu dgag pa'i sbyor ba cung zad goms pa'i rjes su/ 'di nyid ched btad du yun ring bsgoms na/ rtsa lam sbyong ba'i thabs khyad par can du 'gyur ro/ /—330—

gnyis pa rdzogs rim dngos la/ khyab byed rdzogs rim gyi gnad dang /khyab bya rdzogs rim gyi gnad gnyis so/ /dang po la dbye na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor dang / chags can las rgya'i lam gnyis so/ /de'i dang po ni/ gsang gdan gnyis pa las/ kha dog med cing tshon kun dngos/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstan te/ mtshon byed thig le mtshon bya spros bral lo/ /de yang rang lhar gsal ba'i snying gar/ pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba la/ thig le sngon po 'dab ma bzhi la shar dkar ba/ byang ser ba/ nub dmar ba/ lho nag pa ste thig le bzhi gsal btab bo/ /dus gcig la gsal thebs na lnga char la sems 'dzin/ mi thebs na re re nas 'dzin/ yang na rdo rje nor bu'i nang du rlung sems 'dres pa'i thig le dmar po reg bya tsha ba bde drod kyi rang bzhin can cig bsgoms te/ de la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag go /dmigs pa 'di rlung dbyung ba dang phyi 'dzin nang 'dzin spel ma byed cing sbyangs pas gsal ba'i nyams khyad par can skye'o/ /cung zad goms nas sngar bshad pa'i gsang ba'i phra thig gi rlung sbyor de bsgoms pas/ bde stong gi nyams mtha' dbus med pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe rang shugs kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i nyams myong blos byas las 'das pa zhig 'byung ste/ bu dang slob ma sbyong ba'i dpes rtog pa la brten nas mi rtog pa bskyed pa'o/ /nyams len bsgom par bya ba ni mi rtog pa de yin na/ de yang rgyud las/ ye shes kyis ni shes bya brtag khres byas 'gro ba brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa/ bde stong gi nyams kyis lha sku la rgyas 'debs/ lha sku gsal stong bde ba rang shar des snang ba thams cad la rgyas —331—

'debs pa'i don yin/ 'on kyang lag len 'di ltar bya ste/ bde ba'i stan la lus gnad bcas nas rlud rang babs su bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa thams cad spangs te/ ci yang yid la mi byed par bzhag go /'dir lta stangs kyang sna rtser lta bar bshad/ de ltar yang rtsa rgyud kyi gsang gdan gnyis pa las/ mnyam nyid sems kyi nan tan gyis/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho nas/ /yid kyis bris nas kun chub cing / /yid kyi me tog mchod par bya/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i bdug spos dang / zhas rab sgron ma snang bar bya/ /bdud rtsi gtor mas tshim pa'i lus/ /thams cad drangs nas bza' bar bya/ /ces gsungs te sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos pa la 'jog pa ni mnyam nyid de/ maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i nges don rtsa ba'i dmigs pa yin la/ bsam mi khyab kyi dmigs skor dang po'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa ni maṇ+ḍal gtsang ba'i nges don te/sems de'i ngo bo la cher gyis bltas shing / gnas tshul ji lta bu zhes btsal bas/ phyi nang gnyis sam/ gzung 'dzin gnyis sam/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gang yang ma grub par rtogs pa de la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ sems rang bzhin gyis dag pa de dag par rtogs pa'i phyir du sems 'tshol byed pa ste dmigs chen gnyis pa'o/ /yid ces pa ni gnyis te snang ba dang rnam rtog gnyis la go bar bya'o/ /des na dri bzang gis byugs pa'i nges don ni/gzugs sgra sogs snang ba ci shar ba de ka'i steng du kha nang log gi shes pas btsal zhing brtags pa'i tshe/ snang tsam ma 'gag kyang de'i rang bzhin cir yang —332—

brjod du med pa de la 'jog pa ni/ dmigs chen gsum pa'o/ /de bzhin du me tog gi nges don ni/ yid rnam par rtog pa g.yo ba'i 'char sgo chags sdang dga' sdug la sogs pa ci shar yang shar ba de'i rang bzhin la rang gis brtags pas/shar ba'i dus nyid na ngos bzung med la med pa de ka yang yang rig par byed pa ste/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /de gnyis la goms na/ /bdug spos kyi nges don/ /yul snang shar yang rung / rnam rtog skyes kyang rung na/ gang shar de la ma bcos par bzhag pas stong pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i rgyun skyong ba ste dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /mar me'i nges don ni/ de dag la cung zad myong ba thon nas rig pa dpangs bstod/ res bsgrim/ res klod/ stong nyid la nges shes bskyed/ khyad par nang du sems stong pa nyid/ phyir yul stong pa nyid/ phyi nang mnyam nyid ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang skyong ba ste dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /zhal zas kyi dpe don ni/ de rnams la myong ba thon nas/ gong du bshad pa'i bde ba dang gsal ba'i nyams bskyed byed rnams bsgoms nas/ spros bral bsam gyi mi khyab de dang yang yang bsres bzhin nyams su blangs bas/ phyis dmigs pa la ma bltos par rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad bde stong du 'char la/ 'ga' zhig la rims kyis 'char ba yang yod/ 'ga' zhig la cig char du 'char ba yang yod de de ni ma nges so/ /'di dmigs chen bdun pa'o/ /de ltar na de dag ni bsam mi khyab kyi man ngag gam/ de kho na nyid la lhag par mos pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya/gnyis pa chags can las rgya'i lam ni gsang ba'i spyin sreg gi don —333—

phyogs gcig la yang gnas pa yin la/ 'di'i man ngag ni 'khrid yig logs su bkod yod do/ /gnyis pa khyab bya rdzogs rim gyi gnad la/ lam gyi rtsa ba dang / yan lag gnyis so/ /dang po la/ ba lang rmig pa'i gdams ngag dang / ba nu lta bu gdams ngag dang / chu shing snye ma'i gdams ngag dang / mchod rten bum pa'i gdams ngag ste bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ snga phyir byung ba kha cig 'di skad ces rang lus kyi phyi rol mdun du ba lang rmig pa sgom pa phyi dang / thig le la brten pa dang / yi ge la brten pa nang dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa gsang ba dang / ba lang rmig pa dper byas nas zung 'jug ston pa de kho na nyid de/ ba lang rmig pa'i gdams ngag bzhir 'dod kyang mi 'thad de/ mdun na yod pa kho na la bsgoms pas ni/ las dang po pa'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs par 'gro ba dka' ba'i phyir dang / gsum pa yang khyab byed kyi man ngag tu 'dus pas logs su bgrang rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir dang / bzhi pa ni dag sbyor tsam yin gyi/ ngo bo ni bsam mi khyab las gzhan pa'i gdams ngag ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ba lang rmig pa yi ge bcu gsum pa dang / yig ge gnyis pa dang / yi ge gcig pa dang / thig le tsam la dmigs pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang gdan gnyis pa las/ snying ga'i dbus su zla ba bsam/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad gnas su bsgom par bya/ /ces pa'i bar du gsungs pa'i don no/ /de yang sngon 'gro snga ma ltar byas te/ yi ge brgyad po yang lus la bkod/ rkang pa'i mthil gnyis su yu yig sngon po re re rma gi rang bzhin/ de'i steng du spu yig dmar po re re me'i —334—

rang bzhin/ snying ga'i gnas su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i tshul can/ de'i nang pad+ma'i lte bar thig le'i rang bzhin/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ maX hūX ngaX a gang rung cig sgom pa ltar bshad kyang lag len oX yig dkar po sgom/ mtha' skor du ṛ '-i spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis la kha dog dkar po g.yon skor du bskor ba'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang lte ba'i mtshams su ba lang rmig pa sgom dgos te/ de yang dngos gnas la rtsa kha phrag yod pa cig ka yin yang / skabs 'dir dmigs pas sgom rgyu/ mdun rgyab gnyis nas ut+pal la'i 'dab ma 'dra ba'i rnam pa re dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis nas rlung gser re yod pa dang g.yas g.yon 'dab ma gnyis kyi rtse mo steng du 'phrad la khad pa tsam bsgom/ snying ga'i pad+ma de'i tso ba lte bar zug pa de rtsa dbu ma yin/ snying ga yan chad kyi dbu ma mi sgom/ rlung ro bsal/ 'og rlung phyed tsam 'then pas/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi yuX yig las rlud g.yos/ khyuX yig las me 'bar/ byin pa dang brla'i lam las rgyud de/ nye ba tsam du sleb pas lus thams cad shin tu dros par bsam/ rlung phyir cung zad bzung ngo / /sdoms pa ni/ chu so ma rman khung gnyis dang rtsibs log gnyis/ rkang mthil gnyis dang lte ba snying ga'o/ /zhes 'og phyogs kyi gnas dgu dang / mig rna sna gnyis spyi gtsug lce chung dang /dpral ba rgyab ste sna gnyis gcig tu bsdoms/ zhes steng gi gnas dgu/ de ltar gnas bco brgyad po rnams las bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems drangs te spyi bor sleb par bsam/ rlung nang du rngubs pa dang lhan cig spyi bo nas bdud rtsi babs/ lce chung gi lam brgyud/ snying ga'i pad+ma'i steng du babs pas/ pad+ma 'dab —335—

brgyad kha bye zhing / ba lang rmig pa'ang kha phye bas/ zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsal zhing 'od 'bar ba la bdud rtsi de rnams sib sib thim/ de nas 'jam rlung kha sbyor du 'dzin/ ba lang rmig pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa'i kha phrag mda'i stong gi kha phrag 'dra ba'i g.yas nas rlung kha dog dkar po dang / g.yon nas dmar po langs te/ yi ge rnams kyi gdan zla ba la reg pas/ zla ba de nyid dum tsam cig g.yas skor du drag tu snyen ra dum tsam cig g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor/ zla ba 'khor dus lus bde bas gang bar mos/ 'di la yi ge mi 'khor zhing / zla ba yang pad+ma'i lte ba la cung zad ma reg par bsgom/ de kha'i ngang la rlung thengs gnyis sam gsum song mtshams nas rlud gnyis zhi/ zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa mer gyis zhu/ ba lang rmig pa khengs/ shes pa khong klod nas cung zad bzhag de dmigs thun gcig yin/ de nyid thun grangs dang / thun tshad med par yang yang sgom pa'o/ /thun gyi gzhug tu/ gong du bshad pa ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsang gdan gnyis par/ ba lang rmig pa'i steng du ni rtag tu bdud rtsi bzhag byas nas/ zhes sogs te dmigs pa'i khyad par g.yin rnams thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i zla ba'i steng du yi ge oṃ gcig pu bsgom/ lce chung du hūX dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ bdud rtsi rnams kyang hūX la 'khyil zhing 'bab pa dang / huX rang nyid las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di ni rgyud las/ ba lang rmig pa'i steng du ni/ /rtag tu bdud rtsi bzhag byas nas/ /zhes sogs kyi don du mdzad nas bla ma gong —336—

brjod du med pa de la 'jog pa ni/ dmigs chen gsum pa'o/ /de bzhin du me tog gi nges don ni/ yid rnam par rtog pa g.yo ba'i 'char sgo chags sdang dga' sdug la sogs pa ci shar yang shar ba de'i rang bzhin la rang gis brtags pas/shar ba'i dus nyid na ngos bzung med la med pa de ka yang yang rig par byed pa ste/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /de gnyis la goms na/ /bdug spos kyi nges don/ /yul snang shar yang rung / rnam rtog skyes kyang rung na/ gang shar de la ma bcos par bzhag pas stong pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i rgyun skyong ba ste dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /mar me'i nges don ni/ de dag la cung zad myong ba thon nas rig pa dpangs bstod/ res bsgrim/ res klod/ stong nyid la nges shes bskyed/ khyad par nang du sems stong pa nyid/ phyir yul stong pa nyid/ phyi nang mnyam nyid ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang skyong ba ste dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /zhal zas kyi dpe don ni/ de rnams la myong ba thon nas/ gong du bshad pa'i bde ba dang gsal ba'i nyams bskyed byed rnams bsgoms nas/ spros bral bsam gyi mi khyab de dang yang yang bsres bzhin nyams su blangs bas/ phyis dmigs pa la ma bltos par rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad bde stong du 'char la/ 'ga' zhig la rims kyis 'char ba yang yod/ 'ga' zhig la cig char du 'char ba yang yod de de ni ma nges so/ /'di dmigs chen bdun pa'o/ /de ltar na de dag ni bsam mi khyab kyi man ngag gam/ de kho na nyid la lhag par mos pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya/gnyis pa chags can las rgya'i lam ni gsang ba'i spyin sreg gi don —333—

phyogs gcig la yang gnas pa yin la/ 'di'i man ngag ni 'khrid yig logs su bkod yod do/ /gnyis pa khyab bya rdzogs rim gyi gnad la/ lam gyi rtsa ba dang / yan lag gnyis so/ /dang po la/ ba lang rmig pa'i gdams ngag dang / ba nu lta bu gdams ngag dang / chu shing snye ma'i gdams ngag dang / mchod rten bum pa'i gdams ngag ste bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ snga phyir byung ba kha cig 'di skad ces rang lus kyi phyi rol mdun du ba lang rmig pa sgom pa phyi dang / thig le la brten pa dang / yi ge la brten pa nang dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa gsang ba dang / ba lang rmig pa dper byas nas zung 'jug ston pa de kho na nyid de/ ba lang rmig pa'i gdams ngag bzhir 'dod kyang mi 'thad de/ mdun na yod pa kho na la bsgoms pas ni/ las dang po pa'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs par 'gro ba dka' ba'i phyir dang / gsum pa yang khyab byed kyi man ngag tu 'dus pas logs su bgrang rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir dang / bzhi pa ni dag sbyor tsam yin gyi/ ngo bo ni bsam mi khyab las gzhan pa'i gdams ngag ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ba lang rmig pa yi ge bcu gsum pa dang / yig ge gnyis pa dang / yi ge gcig pa dang / thig le tsam la dmigs pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang gdan gnyis pa las/ snying ga'i dbus su zla ba bsam/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad gnas su bsgom par bya/ /ces pa'i bar du gsungs pa'i don no/ /de yang sngon 'gro snga ma ltar byas te/ yi ge brgyad po yang lus la bkod/ rkang pa'i mthil gnyis su yu yig sngon po re re rlung gi rang bzhin/ de'i steng du khri yig dmar po re re me'i —334—

rang bzhin/ snying ga'i gnas su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i tshul can/ de'i nang pad+ma'i lte bar thig le'i rang bzhin/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ maX hūX ngaX a gang rung cig sgom pa ltar bshad kyang lag len oṃ yig dkar po sgom/ mtha' skor du ṛ kla spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis la kha dog dkar po g.yon skor du bskor ba'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang lte ba'i mtshams su ba lang rmig pa sgom dgos te/ de yang dngos gnas la rtsa kha phrag yod pa cig ka yin yang / skabs 'dir dmigs pas sgom rgyu/ mdun rgyab gnyis nas ut+pal la'i 'dab ma 'dra ba'i rnam pa re dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis nas rlud gser re yod pa dang g.yas g.yon 'dab ma gnyis kyi rtse mo steng du 'phrad la khad pa tsam bsgom/ snying ga'i pad+ma de'i rtsa ba lte bar zug pa de rtsa dbu ma yin/ snying ga yan chad kyi dbu ma mi sgom/ rlung ro bsal/ 'og rlung phyed tsam 'then pas/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi yuX yig las rlud g.yos/ khriX yig las me 'bar/ byin pa dang brla'i lam las rgyud de/ lte ba tsam du sleb pas lus thams cad shin tu dros par bsam/ rlung phyir cung zad bzung ngo / /sdoms pa ni/ chu so ma rman khung gnyis dang rtsibs log gnyis/ rkang mthil gnyis dang nye ba snying ga'o/ /zhes 'og phyogs kyi gnas dgu dang / mig rna sna gnyis spyi gtsug lce chung dang /dpral ba rgyab ste sna gnyis gcig tu bsdoms/ zhes steng gi gnas dgu/ de ltar gnas bco brgyad po rnams las bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems drangs te spyi bor sleb par bsam/ rlung nang du rngubs pa dang lhan cig spyi bo nas bdud rtsi babs/ lce chung gi lam brgyud/ snying ga'i pad+ma'i steng du babs pas/ pad+ma 'dab —335—

brgyad kha bye zhing / ba lang rmig pa'ang kha phye bas/ zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsal zhing 'od 'bar ba la bdud rtsi de rnams sib sib thim/ de nas 'jam rlung kha sbyor du 'dzin/ ba lang rmig pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa'i kha phrag mda'i stong gi kha phrag 'dra ba'i g.yas nas rlung kha dog dkar po dang / g.yon nas dmar po langs te/ yi ge rnams kyi gdan zla ba la reg pas/ zla ba de nyid dum tsam cig g.yas skor du drag tu 'khor dum tsam cig g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor/ zla ba 'khor dus lus bde bas gang bar mos/ 'di la yi ge mi 'khor zhing / zla ba yang pad+ma'i lte ba la cung zad ma reg par bsgom/ de kha'i ngang la rlung thengs gnyis sam gsum song mtshams nas rlud gnyis zhi/ zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa mer gyis zhu/ ba lang rmig pa khengs/ shes pa khong klod nas cung zad bzhag de dmigs thun gcig yin/ de nyid thun grangs dang / thun tshad med par yang yang sgom pa'o/ /thun gyi gzhug tu/ gong du bshad pa ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsang gdan gnyis par/ ba lang rmig pa'i steng du ni rtag tu bdud rtsi bzhag byas nas/ zhes sogs te dmigs pa'i khyad par gzhan rnams thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i zla ba'i steng du yi ge oṃ gcig pu bsgom/ lce chung du huX dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ bdud rtsi rnams kyang huX la 'khyil zhing 'bab pa dang / huX rang nyid las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di ni rgyud las/ ba lang rmig pa'i steng du ni/ /rtag tu bdud rtsi bzhag byas nas/ /zhes sogs kyi don du mdzad nas bla ma gong —336—

rnams kyi man ngag tu dmigs pa logs pa gcig tu bkral ba yin/ 'on kyang rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar na yi ge bcu gsum pa nyid kyi 'phros don du gsal bas snga ma la 'dus par snang ngo / /gsum pa ni/ rab byed gnyis pa las/ ā li kā li rab sbyor ba'i zhes sogs kyi don te/ 'khor ba las brgal mtshan nyid ni/ /zhes pa nas/ dngos po dngos po bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis pa kho nar bsgom/ lha'i rnal 'byor gzhan dang mi sbyor gsung / de yang snod bcud stong par sbyang ba sngon du song nas/ sa bon phyag mtshan tsam las bskyed/ gzhan dmigs pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ snying gar yi ge o gcig pu sgom pa las/ lce chung gi hu yang mi bsgom/ rlung kha sbyor dgang ba'i skabs g.yas g.yon gyi rlung gnyis oṃ la phog pas/ oṃ yig mer gyi zhu nas ba lang rmig pa khengs par bsam/ 'di la zla ba'i 'khor ba mi dgos so/ /'di'i skabs kyi yi ge rnying pa na/ rgyud las/ ā li kā li rab sbyor zhes gsungs pa'i don la da log dang ra 'dus pa a yin pas/ lag len du oṃ yig bsgom zer ba ni cal col tsam yin te/ ḍa dang ra 'dus pa sgra dang gzugs brnyan gang gi sgo nas kyang ar 'gro ba med cing / ḍa ra 'dus pa la ā li ka li'i tha snyad kyang gtan nas mi thob pa dang / a yin na oṃ sgom pa yang mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na o yig dbyangs dang klad kor gsal byed yin pas/ ā li kā li dbyangs gsal 'dres pa'i don ni/ o yig gi don no/ /'di gsum gyi skabs su yi ge mang nyung gi grangs ni me rlung gi yi ge mi —337—

the ba'i gzhan rnams la rtsi ba yin par gsal lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ kha cig snying chu shing gi me tog kha 'thur bstan de gyen du kha bye ba'i dkyil du bsgom zer te/ de ltar na chu shing snye ma'i man ngag tu 'gyur gyi ba lang rmig par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas na dmigs pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ oṃ yig kyang spangs te/ thig le dkar po zla ba 'khyil ba 'dra ba zhig bsgom/ rmig pa'i phyi rol g.yas su huX nag po dang / g.yon du huX dmar po rlung dang me'i rang bzhin bsgom/ nag po las rlung g.yos dmar po las me 'bar/ spyi bo'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba sogs sngar dang 'dra/ mthar thig le de me rlung gnyis la thim/ me hūX dmar po de rlung huX nag po la thim/ de yang dbyings su yal bar mos par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ba nu lta bu'i man ngag ni/ gnyis pa las/ steng gi mche ba gnyis las chu 'byin ro 'dra'o ma chu zhes pas/ zhes sogs kyi don no/ /de yang sngon 'gro snga ma bzhin btang la/ rang gi lte 'og sor bzhin/ rtsa klu dbang 'khyil ba kha dog dmar po sprul 'khyil ba ltar skor ba bdun 'khor ba/ sne gcig dbus su sleb pa steng du kha bltas/ sne gcig mtha' nas dbus su 'khyog te dbus su sleb nas kha 'og tu bltas pa/ de'i 'og gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i steng thad du/ chos 'byung / gru gsum dmar po sor bzhi pa/ de'i nang du khriX yig ser po me rlung gi rang bzhin can/ spyi bor tshangs bug gi sgor yang haX dkar po/ snying ga'i thad kyi dbus su huX dkar po bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rang bzhin can/ rkang mthil gnyis su me rlud gi yi ge yang gong gi ba lang rmig pa'i skabs bzhin gsal btang/ rlung phyir bsal zhing 'og rlud phyed tsam 'then —338—

pas/ rkang mthil gyi me rlung shugs dang ldan pa yar 'bar te/ chos 'byung gi nang gi khri yig la reg pas/ de las me 'bar klu dbang 'khyil ba'i 'og gi sgo nas zhugs/ de mes khengs te steng gi sgo nas 'bar/ rlud phyir bzung ba na/me'i 'od kyis lus nang thams cad khengs/ rtsa sbugs thams cad khyab pas/gong du bshad pa ltar/ gnas bco brgyad la sogs pa lus nang gi byang chub kyi sems thams cad yar skya bun nu nu song ste spyi bo'i ha yig la thim/ ha yig bongs ke che ru ni ma song / mdangs bkrag chen po dang ldan par bsam/ rlung kha sbyor drag tu bzung ngo / /dmigs pa'i gtso bo spyi bo'i ha la sems gtod pa nyid yin/ yang rnam grangs gcig la/ dmigs pa'i gnad de nyid kho na dang 'dra ba las/ lce chung du su dkar po mgo bo thur bstan bsam/ 'di yi ge hū yig la mchod rten gyi ming btags te/ gsang ba'am/ mgrin pa'am/ snying ga gang yang wo bar mchod rten hū sngon po bsgom rlung nang du 'jug pa'i skabs ha las bdud rtsi rgyun babs/ yas dkan gyi phugs yan chad gang / mthar lce chung gi su la thim/ de las bdud rtsi babs pa mchod rten te hu la thim par bsam mo/ /'dir yang bla ma'i man ngag las/ snying gar ba lang gi rmig rjes lta bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su skyong mo dang / dbus su sgang khyur re ba'i rtsa dkar po cig bsgoms te/ de'i steng du hu sgom par yang bzhed do/ /de'i tshe na byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun gyis rmig rjes lta bu'i rtsa de khengs par bsam dgos/ gang ltar yang 'di la dang por hū yig la khrus gsol bas hu gi nag nog dang skyon thams cad dag de nas bdud rtsi hū la thim pas hu gang / hu las bdud rtsi 'phros pa rtsa —339—

sbugs gzhan thams cad nas song ste/ lus nang gang zhing ba sbu'i bu ga thams cad nas dkar nyug nyug 'dug pa la phyir mi 'gro ba bsgom/ 'jug tu oṃ hū swāhā/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa byed de/ rlung 'byung 'jug spangs pa'i 'gog bzlas sam/ nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa hū/ 'byung ba snya/ phyir gnas pa hā dang /sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas bya'o/ /gsum pa chu shing snye ma'i gdams ngag la/ yi ge bcu gsum pa dang /yi ge dgu pa dang / sgong skyes khyim gyi man ngag ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gsang gdan gsum pa las/ chu shing me tog lte ba nas/ /snying du 'greng bar gnas pa yin/ /zhes pa nas/ 'khor ba'i pha rol bsgral bar bya/ zhes pa'i bar te/ lte 'og sor bzhir khri yig gser mdog me'i 'od can zhig dang / lte ba nas snying ga'i bar du rtsa dbu ma/ snying ga nas g.yon gyi phyogs su gug pas rtsa chu shing gi me tog ring thung sor lnga/ rtsa ba mtheb sor brgyad kyi 'khor ba tsam rtse rno zul ba kha dog dmar po'o/ /de'i nang na yi ge bcu gsum yod par mos pa tsam bya/rlung bum can kha sbyor drag tu bzung / lte 'og gi khri las gtum mo ye shes kyi me dbu ma'i nang du cung zad 'bar/ me 'od kyis lus thams cad gang / byang chub kyi sems rnams spyi bor 'dus shing thig le la thim/ thig le las bdud rtsi 'dzags/ lce chung du babs shing de las bdud rtsi phra mo chu zil lta bu dkar sib sib babs/ khyu yig bar gyi dbu ma'i phyi nang thams cad dang / chu shing me tog nyid kyang rlan par byas/ de sngar nas kha thur du phyogs pa de rkyen des steng du 'grengs shing / de'i bu ga dang bar gseng phra mo nas thig le phra mo zhugs pa —340—

dbus kyi hūX la phog pas/ huX las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i thigs thor 'dra ba spros te chu shing me tog gi nang nas kyang rlan par byas pa dang / me tog de pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam par kha bye'o/ /dper na rlan dang drod dang rlung gsum gyi nus pa smin pas/ me tog kha phye ba ltar 'dir yang gtum mo'i me 'od dang / rlung bum can dang / bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gsum gyis de kha phye'o/ /de la dbus su 'od dkar po'i nang du hūX dkar po/ mu khyud de lte ba'i mtha'i skor la ṛ grwa '-i lī bzhi de phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la g.yon skor gyis/ suX spuX yuX hūX/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang shar nas g.yas skor gyis/ thams cad kyang kha dog dkar bo 'od 'bar ba/ yi ge de rnams la spyi bo snro t+yā ljo lja lce chung brgyud pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun rnams so sor babs shing yu thim pas thams cad bdud rtsis gang ba'i sgo nas lus sems bde bas khyab/ de rnams las rtsa sbugs so so brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsi thig les gang / bsna'i mtha' tshun chod khyab/ 'od zer dkar po ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ sna thabathams cad khra gsal gyis gsal bar bsam/ de ltar yang yang gsal btab kyin bsgom/ thun 'jog khar rdo rje'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/gnyis pa ni/ gsang gdan bzhi pa las/ yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /zhes sogs kyis sngon 'gro bstan nas/ chu shing me tog lte ba nas/ /snying khar 'greng bar gnas pa la/ /zhes sogs te bshad ma thag pa de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ lte ba'i mu 'khyud la yi ge med/ 'dab ma la phyogs bzhir/ a āX.aX aX mtshams bzhir ṛ grwa '-i lī rnams bkod pa ni khyad par ro/ /gsum pa —341—

ni/ gsang gdan gsum pa las/ dbang po yul gyi ye shes ni/ /gnod par byed pa bsdoms par bya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de la 'di ni sgong skyes khyim gyi man ngag ces bya ba/ chu shing snye ma'i phyogs su gtogs pa tsam yin gyi dngos rang min pas/ chu shing snye ma yi ge gcig pa'i tha snyad byed pa ni legs par ma mthong ngo / /de yang rang gi snying gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha bye ba'i dbus su/ thig le dkar po byi'u sgo nga tsam zhig gi dbus su/ hu dkar po bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa cig bsgom/ man ngag gi yig chung rnying pa na de tsam las med la/ rgyud bshad las/ rkang mthil du me rlung gi rang bzhin yu khyu/ rlung gis me sbar gnas thams cad nas bdud rtsi drangs pa snying ga'i hū yig thig le dang bcas pa la thim par bsgoms zhes zugad do/ /bzhi pa mchod rten bum pa'i man ngag la rlud bcing ba dang / rlud thim par byed pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rab byed bzhi par/ stong pa mtshan nyid med pa yi/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam shes ye shes thim par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi man ngag ste/ rang ye shes dbang phyug ma'i skur gsal ba'i snying ga'am lte ba'i 'khor lo pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad du gsal ba'i pad+ma'i lte ba la 'od dkar po'i gong bu sgo nga'i dbyibs can gyi nang du hu dkar po chen po 'od 'bar ba dang /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ a ā a u bzhi'am/ dbyug pa lta bu'i ri mo gcig pa dang / de 'dra gnyis gshibs dang / lug brgyud lta bu ste tsheg drag dang / thig le ste klad kor gyi rnam pa rnams sgoms kyang rung / a bzhi'am a shad klad kor can bzhi sgom kyang rung ste/ de rnams rgyal ba rig lnga'i ngo bor —342—

mos/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma la/ dbyangs ma ning bzhi/ sangs rgyas spyan ma sogs yum bzhi'i ngo bor sgom/ dpyi mtshams su hu mgo sprod dang / sogs phrag tu yang hu mgo sprod bsgom/ snying ga'am lte ba'i hu las me 'od 'bar/ gnas thams cad nas bdud rtsi phra mo bkug ste/ snying ga'i thig le zla ba hu dang bcas pa la thim bar mos/ rlung sbyor bum pa can nyid do/ /'dir gong ma rnams kyi yi ge las/ rkang mthil nas me rlung gi sbyor ba dang / spyi bo lce chung nas bdud rtsi 'bab pa sogs snga ma rnams dang mtshungs bar byed par bshad kyang / dmigs pa phan tshun cung zad 'dres par mngon pas/ mchod rten bum pa'i skabs 'dir de dag dgos pa ma yin la/ yang phyis byung kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyun la 'gro 'ong byed pa'i dmigs pa 'dir sbyor zhing / de nyid stos pa sogs kyi rlung sbyor dang yang sbyor ba ni/ thob thang yang med cing yig ge rnying pa nas kyang ma bshad pas/ rang bzo 'ba' zhig go /gong du bshad pa de ltar bsgoms pas rlung dbu mar 'jug pa dang / rlung dbu mar gnas pa la bsngags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang gdan bzhi pa las/ gsang ba sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /de nyid de nyid mchog de nyid/ /ces pa nas/ rdzogs byang chub rim 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i bar te/ skabs 'di ni su dang khri gis sgo dgag pa tsam gsungs pa mtsho ni byed do/ /sgo dgu dgag pa thams cad byas nas/ rtsa dbu ma spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar du yod pa cig bsgom/ tshang ra'i gnas su hu mgo sprod/ sog phrag tu hu mgo sprod kyang gsal btab/ pad+ma dkar po'i rnam pa can gyi snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte ba dbu ma'i nang 'od kyi thig le'i dbus su hū dkar —343—

bo dang / phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab la suX khriX yuX huX dkar ser dmar nag pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma la/ rnams kha dog phyed gzugs kyi rnam pa ste/ gong sgo dgag pa'i skabs su ljo sgruX smyiXljo bshad pa bzhin no/ /rlung bum pa can kha sbyor drag tu bsgom rlung thengs gnyis tsam yig 'bru rnams la sems drag tu bstad/ de rjes rlud thengs gcig tsam la yig ge rnams stong par bsdu ste/ bla ma gong ma rnams ni/ dang por suX yig hūX la thim/ de bzhin du rim pas khriX yuX huX rnams kyang thim par bzhed/ de bzhin du mtshams kyi yig ge rnams kyi phyed g.yas pa rnams g.yas skor dang / phyed g.yon pa rnams kyang g.yas skor gyi thim zhes bzhed la/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni/ phyogs bzhi po lho nas g.yon skor gyis bsdus na 'byung ba'i thim rim dang mthun par mngon zhing /mtshams bzhi'i yang g.yas kyi cha rnams/ lho nub nas 'go brtsams pa'i g.yon skor dang / g.yon gyi phyogs rnams shar lho nas 'go brtsams pa'i g.yon skor gyis bsdus na/ 'byung ba thim pa'i go rim dang mthun no snyam mo/ /de nas hūX yang rim gyis rje phra je phra la yal nas gang yang bsam du med pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de nyid yang nas yang du sgom pa yin/ 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams/ yi ge rjes gzhig gi tha snyad mdzad par gda'/ de tsam ni mi 'gal la/tshig de tsam la brten nas phyis kyi kha cig mchod rten bum pa snga ma la ril 'dzin dang 'di la rjes gzhig ces zer ba ni/ ril 'dzin rjes gzhig ces pa gang la zer yang ma shes pa'i blun rtags bstan pa yin yang gzhan la med pa'i mkhas khyad du rloms nas smras par snang ngo de bzhin du zhabs skyed bzhi ni/ pus —344—

mo bzhi zer ba yang yig ge rnying pa lhag chad can la bris bshus byas 'dug kyang / rkang gnyis pa la pus mo bzhi e yod ltos/ de 'dra sems rnal du mi gnas pa'i gtam mo/ /mchod rten bum pa dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa 'di gnyis snying ga'i 'khor lo dang lte ba'i 'khor lo gang la brten kyang chog go /man ngag gzhan las snying ga'i 'khor lo kha thur du lta ba dang / nye ba'i 'khor lo kha gyen du lta ba kha sbyor dril bu'am bum pa'i rnam pa can las/ snying ga'i rtsa 'khor rnams la yi ge mgo bo thur bstan du bkod cing / lte ba'i hu gi 'od kyis de rnams bsdu ba dang nye ba'i 'khor lo la yi ge mgo gyen bstan du bkod nas/snying ga'i hū gi 'od kyis de rnams bsdu bar yang bzhed de/ lte bar dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing/ snying ga'i 'khor lo rgya chung bas dril bu'i dbyibs can du 'byung zhing /rgya gar gyi mchod rten mang po la bum ldir dril bu'i dbyibs su 'byung bas/mchod rten bum pa'i ming don dang 'grig pa'i man ngag shin tu legs pa zhig yod kyang 'dir ma spros so/ khyab bya bzhi po 'di dag la phyis byung shes rlom 'ga' zhig mchod brten bum pa shes rab gzhan gyi gdan/ ba lang rmig pa thabs pa dag gis gdan/ ba'i nu ma zung 'jug sbyor ba'i gdan/ chu shing me tog de kho na nyid gsang ba'i gdan/ zhes sa bcad byed kyang 'chad pa ni/ de dag gdan bzhi so so'i don la sbyor ba'i dngos dang 'grel pa dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med pa dang / gdan bzhi po'i ngo bo gang la 'jog kyang ngos ma zin 'dug pa'i phyir dang / de dag thabs dang shes rab dang zung 'jug dang de kho na nyid du so sor 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir dang /—345—

thabs dang shes rab dang zung 'jug gsum dang de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i bzhi tshan bgreng tshul 'di 'dra gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir/ de skad ces smra ba de ni blun po ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i phyir du tshig rkyang gi bris kha tsam bstan par zad do/ /gnyis pa lam gyi yan lag la/ ba lang rmig pa'i man ngag gi yan lag thor bu ba 'ga' dang gcig /ba nu'i man ngag yan lag me'i las dang gnyis/chu shing snye ma'i yan lag gong du 'pho ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang gsum/mchod rten bum pa'i yan lag sgyu ma gsum brgyud dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ ba lang rmig pa lta bu'i shun pa yod pa cig bsgom/ de'i nang du chud tsam gyis g.yas su ya nag po dang /g.yon du hu dmar po/ ya las rlud g.yos/ hū las me 'bar/ me de'i rtsa ba rma dang 'dres pas sngon po/ sked pa dmar po/ rtse mo dkar po cig bsgom/ de ltar yang yang gsal btab cing zhag mang du bsgoms nas/ de nas de ka 'dra ba cig rang gi lte bar bsgom te rlung bum pa can la bslab bo/ /'di lus kyi phyi rol gcig pur bsgoms pas don shin tu chung la/ dang po dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched du phyi ru bsgoms nas/ gsal ba na lte bar bsgom/ thog ma phyi ru bsgoms pa'i dgos pa gegs mi sdang ba yin/ 'di don gyi 'khor lo cig pa'i gtum mo snang ngo / /yang lus kyi dbus su rtsa a ba dhu tī snying gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba/ dbu ma'i nang du rtsa mdud ba lang rmig pa lta bu bsgom/ de'i dbus su rlud sems 'dres pa'i thig le cig bsam/ g.yas su hū nag po dang /—346—

g.yo ni du hu dmar po/ /nag po las rlung g.yos/ dmar po las me 'bar/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi bor son/ spyi bo'i thig le byang chub kyi sems zhu ste/ snying ga'i rlung sems 'dres pa'i thig le la thim/ 'di 'khor lo gnyis pa'i gtum mo yin/ rngog pa'i man ngag gi yi ge che ba na/ nang chu shing snye ma'i gdams ngag yin gsung pa de yang 'di dang gnad gcig de chu shing me tog gi gdams ngag yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dbu ma'i g.yon phyogs su yal ga'i tshul du snying chu shing gi me tog kha thur bstan de gyen du bslang / kha phye ba'i ze 'bru la/ thig le dkar po me long 'dra ba'i dbus su/ hū gzugs brnyan 'dra ba bsgom/ de'i g.yas g.yon du hū dmar po gnyis/ de nas me spro ba sogs dang / bdud rtsi'i rgyun thig le la thim pas/ thig le dang hu gnyis kar bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsgom/ zhes pa 'byung ste 'di ltar sgom phyin snying logs skyes la/ dbu ma'i nang gi bdud rtsi steng nas 'bab stabs mi bde bas me tog gis chu grangs pa bzhin sgom dgos mod/ lar nas 'di ba lang rmig pa yin gyi chu shing snye ma min pas logs skyes de mi dgos so/ /yang dbu ma'i nang snying gar hu dmar po/ /mgrin par a dmar po/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar hū dkar po/ tshangs bug tu ha dkar po/ hu las me byung / a dang hu dkar po phug ste ha la reg pas thig le'i rgyun babs/ hu dkar po dang a khengs/ snying ga'i hu la thim par bsgom/ 'di snying mgrin dpral ba gtsug tor te nye bar mi the ba'i 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i gtum mo yin no/ /gzhan yang snying gi nang khong stong dang / klad pa dud khang gi nang stong ba dang thig pa'i lam zhes pa smin mtshams kyi nang stong par thig le —347—
